With useClass or useExisting in place of useFactory, the class implements MailOptionsFactory, whose createMailOptions() returns them. transport, templates, imports and isGlobal also sit next to useFactory, useClass or useExisting in forRootAsync(). The resolved options are provided under the MAIL_MODULE_OPTIONS token.
blocks.zh: `MailModule.forRoot()` 获取这些选项，`forRootAsync()` 工厂返回它们。用 `useClass` 或 `useExisting` 代替 `useFactory`，类实现了 `MailOptionsFactory`，其 `createMailOptions()` 返回它们。`transport`、`templates`、`imports` 和 `isGlobal` 也位于 `forRootAsync()` 中的 `useFactory`、`useClass` 或 `useExisting` 旁边。解析的选项在 `MAIL_MODULE_OPTIONS` 令牌下提供。

blocks.md:
| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `transport` | `MailTransport` instance or class | none (required) | How mail leaves the application. A class is instantiated by Nest, so it can inject configuration. See [Send in production](/application/mail#send-in-production). |
| `templates` | `MailTemplateEngine` instance or class | none | Renders mail that names a `template`: `FileTemplateEngine`, or [your own](/application/mail#use-another-template-engine). A class is instantiated by Nest. Without one, a mail with a template fails with `MailTemplateError`. |
| `from` | address | none | The default sender. A message without a sender fails with `MailMessageError`. |
| `replyTo` | address or array | none | The default Reply-To. |
| `headers` | `Record<string, string>` | none | Added to every message. A message's own headers win. |
| `retry` | number, `false` or retry options | 3 attempts | Attempts per send, with backoff from `1s` doubling to `30s`, full jitter. `false` makes one attempt. See [Send after the order commits](/application/mail#send-after-the-order-commits). |
| `imports` | modules | none | Modules whose exports a transport or template engine class injects. |
| `isGlobal` | `boolean` | `true` | Registers `Mailer`, `MailEvents`, `MailTransport` and `MailTemplateEngine` globally. |
blocks.zh:
| 选择 | 类型 | 默认的 | 描述 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `transport` | `MailTransport` 实例或类 | 无（必填） | 邮件如何离开应用程序。一个类由 Nest 实例化，因此它可以注入配置。参见 [Send in production](/application/mail#send-in-production)。 |
| `templates` | `MailTemplateEngine` 实例或类 | 没有一个 | 呈现命名为 `template`：`FileTemplateEngine` 或 [你自己的](/application/mail#use-another-template-engine) 的邮件。一个类由 Nest 实例化。如果没有模板，带有模板的邮件将失败 `MailTemplateError`。 |
| `from` | 地址 | 没有一个 | 默认发件人。没有发件人的消息使用 `MailMessageError` 失败。 |
| `replyTo` | 地址或数组 | 没有一个 | 默认的回复。 |
| `headers` | `Record<string, string>` | 没有一个 | 添加到每条消息中。消息自己的标题获胜。 |
| `retry` | 号码，`false` 或重试选项 | 3 次尝试 | 每次发送的尝试次数，后退来自 `1s` 加倍至 `30s`，全抖动。 `false` 进行一次尝试。看 [Send after the order commits](/application/mail#send-after-the-order-commits). |
| `imports` | 模块 | 没有一个 | 传输或模板引擎类注入其导出的模块。 |
| `isGlobal` | `boolean` | `true` | 寄存器 `Mailer`,`MailEvents`,`MailTransport` 和 `MailTemplateEngine` 全球范围内。 |

blocks.md: The retry options are `attempts` (total, including the first), `backoff` (an object with `delay`, `factor`, `maxDelay` and `jitter`, or a function of the attempt) and `retryIf` (can only narrow which transient errors are retried). When an HTTP provider answers with a `Retry-After` header, typically with a 429 or a 503, the error keeps it as `retryAfterMs`, and the mailer waits at least that long before the next attempt, up to `maxDelay` (`30s` with a backoff function). The `signal` still ends the wait. SMTP replies have no `Retry-After`, and an outbox handler with `retry: false` leaves the wait to the outbox's backoff.

When an HTTP provider answers with a Retry-After header, typically with a 429 or a 503, the error keeps it as retryAfterMs, and the mailer waits at least that long before the next attempt, up to maxDelay (30s with a backoff function). The signal still ends the wait. SMTP replies have no Retry-After, and an outbox handler with retry: false leaves the wait to the outbox's backoff.
blocks.zh: 重试选项是 `attempts`（总计，包括第一个），`backoff`（一个对象 `delay`,`factor`,`maxDelay` 和 `jitter`，或尝试的函数）和 `retryIf`（只能缩小重试哪些瞬态错误的范围）。当一个 HTTP 提供者回答 `Retry-After` 头，通常是 429 或 503，错误将其保持为 `retryAfterMs`，并且邮件程序在下一次尝试之前至少等待那么长时间，直到 `maxDelay`(`30s` 具有后退功能）。这个 `signal` 等待仍然结束。SMTP 回复没有 `Retry-After` 和一个发件箱处理程序 `retry: false` 等待发件箱的回退。

blocks.md:
| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dir` | `string` | none (required) | The directory of the templates, with partials in its `partials/` folder. A relative path is resolved against the working directory. |

| 选择 | 类型 | 默认的 | 描述 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dir` | `string` | 无（必填） | 模板目录，其中包含部分 `partials/` 文件夹。根据工作目录解析相对路径。 |
| `layout` | `string` | 没有一个 | 包装每封电子邮件的 HTML 的模板，在 `body` 周围用三个大括号放置。`.txt` 版本（如果有的话）会包装文本。 |

blocks.md: `template: 'order-confirmation'` with the locale `pt-BR` renders the first file that exists of `order-confirmation.pt-BR.html`, `order-confirmation.pt.html` and `order-confirmation.html`, and the first of the same names with `.txt` as the text part, if any. Template names are letters, digits, `-` and `_`, in folders separated by `/`. Other names, and locales that aren't language tags, fail with `MailTemplateError`, so neither can reach a file outside `dir`.
blocks.text: template: 'order-confirmation' with the locale pt-BR renders the first file that exists of order-confirmation.pt-BR.html, order-confirmation.pt.html and order-confirmation.html, and the first of the same names with .txt as the text part, if any. Template names are letters, digits, - and _, in folders separated by /. Other names, and locales that aren't language tags, fail with MailTemplateError, so neither can reach a file outside dir.
blocks.zh: `template: 'order-confirmation'` 使用区域设置 `pt-BR` 呈现存在的第一个文件 `order-confirmation.pt-BR.html`, `order-confirmation.pt.html` 和 `order-confirmation.html`，以及第一个同名的 `.txt` 作为文本部分（如果有）。模板名称是字母、数字， `-` 和 `_`，在分隔的文件夹 `/`.其他非语言标记的名称和区域设置将失败 `MailTemplateError`，因此都无法访问外部的文件 `dir`.

blocks.md: Template syntax
blocks.text: Template syntax
blocks.zh: 模板语法

blocks.md: The syntax is a subset of Handlebars:
blocks.text: The syntax is a subset of Handlebars:
blocks.zh: 语法是手柄的子集：

blocks.md:
Syntax Renders
{{ customer.name }} The value, HTML-escaped. Paths use dots, and items.0 is an array's first item. A missing value renders as nothing. In a .txt template, the value as it is.
{{{ body }}} The value as it is, for HTML you produced yourself. HTML built with the html tag is inserted as it is between double braces too.
{{#if paid}} … {{else}} … {{/if}} The first part when the value is truthy, else the else part, which is optional. false, 0, an empty string, an empty list and a missing value are falsy. {{else if pending}} chains another condition.
{{#unless paid}} … {{/unless}} The opposite of #if, with an optional else part.
{{#each items}} … {{else}} … {{/each}} The first part once for every item of a list, or every value of an object; the else part for an empty or missing list.
this, @index, @first, @last, @key Inside #each: the item, its position from 0, whether it's the first or the last, and an object's key. A name the item doesn't have is looked up in the outer contexts.
../number, @root.shop The context outside the current #each, and the template's context.
{{> signature}} The partial partials/signature.html (.txt in a text template), in the mail's locale, with the context where it's included.
{{! note }}, {{!-- note --}} Comments, left out of the output. The second form may contain double braces.
\{{ Literal double braces.

There are no helpers and no expressions. Values are read from the context's own properties, never from a prototype, and functions aren't called. Anything else between double braces, a block that is never closed, and a double-braced value inside a tag but outside a quoted attribute value fail with `MailTemplateError`, which has the `file`, the `line` and the `column`.
blocks.text: There are no helpers and no expressions. Values are read from the context's own properties, never from a prototype, and functions aren't called. Anything else between double braces, a block that is never closed, and a double-braced value inside a tag but outside a quoted attribute value fail with MailTemplateError, which has the file, the line and the column.
blocks.zh: 没有帮手，没有表情。值是从上下文本身的属性中读取的，而不是从原型中读取的，函数也不被调用。双括号、永不关闭的块和标记内部但引用属性值外部的双括号值之间的任何其他内容都会失败 `MailTemplateError`，它有 `file`，这个 `line` 和 `column`.

blocks.md: Send options
blocks.text: Send options
blocks.zh: 发送选项

blocks.md: `mailer.send(MailClass, options)` and `mailer.send(message)` take:
blocks.text: mailer.send(MailClass, options) and mailer.send(message) take:
blocks.zh: `mailer.send(MailClass, options)` 和 `mailer.send(message)` 取：

blocks.md:
| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `to`, `cc`, `bcc` | One address or an array. An address is a string holding exactly one address, or an object with `name` and `address`. `bcc` goes only into the SMTP envelope. |
| `data` | The mail class's data, typed from its `render()`. |
| `locale` | Passed to `render()` in the render context, and to the template engine, which picks the template for it. See [Send it in the customer's language](/application/mail#send-it-in-the-customers-language). |
| `from`, `replyTo` | Override the module's defaults. |
| `subject`, `html`, `text` | The content, for a message written inline. `text` is derived from `html` when omitted. |
| `template`, `context` | The template the body is rendered from, and the values it reads, in place of `html` and `text`. A mail class's `render()` returns them the same way. |
| `attachments` | Each has `filename`, `content` (a `Buffer`, string or stream) or a local `path`, and optionally `contentType` and `cid`. See [Attach the invoice and preview the mail](/application/mail#attach-the-invoice-and-preview-the-mail). |
| `headers` | Custom headers, such as `List-Unsubscribe`. |
| `retry` | Overrides the module's `retry` for this send. |
| `signal` | An `AbortSignal` that stops the send and any wait between attempts. |
| `idempotencyKey` | Identifies the mail across redeliveries. The `Message-ID` is derived from it. |
blocks.zh:
| 选择 | 描述 |
| --- | --- |
| `to`,`cc`,`bcc` | 一个地址或一个数组。地址是包含一个地址的字符串，或者包含 `name` 和 `address` 的对象。`bcc` 只进入 SMTP 信封。 |
| `data` | 邮件类的数据，从其 `render()` 键入。 |
| `locale` | 传给 `render()` 在呈现上下文中，并传递给模板引擎，模板引擎为其选择模板。看 [Send it in the customer's language](/application/mail#send-it-in-the-customers-language). |
| `from`,`replyTo` | 覆盖模块的默认值。 |
| `subject`,`html`,`text` | 内容，用于内联编写的消息。`text` 源自 `html` 省略时。 |
| `template`,`context` | 呈现主体的模板及其读取的值，而不是 `html` 和 `text`.邮件班的 `render()` 以同样的方式返回它们。 |
| `attachments` | 每个都有 `filename`, `content` (a `Buffer`、字符串或流）或本地 `path` 以及可选地 `contentType` 和 `cid`.见 [Attach the invoice and preview the mail](/application/mail#attach-the-invoice-and-preview-the-mail). |
| `headers` | 自定义标题，如 `List-Unsubscribe`。 |
| `retry` | 覆盖模块的 `retry` 为了这次发送。 |
| `signal` | 安 `AbortSignal` 这将停止发送和尝试之间的任何等待。 |
| `idempotencyKey` | 标识跨重新投递的邮件。这个 `Message-ID` 是从它派生出来的。 |

blocks.md: `mailer.render(MailClass, options)` and `mailer.render(message)` take the same without the delivery options, and resolve to the `MailMessage`, which records its `template` and `locale`. `send()` resolves to `messageId`, `providerMessageId` (when the provider has one), `accepted` (the accepted envelope recipients), `response` (the final SMTP reply) and `attempts`.
blocks.text: mailer.render(MailClass, options) and mailer.render(message) take the same without the delivery options, and resolve to the MailMessage, which records its template and locale. send() resolves to messageId, providerMessageId (when the provider has one), accepted (the accepted envelope recipients), response (the final SMTP reply) and attempts.
blocks.zh: `mailer.render(MailClass, options)` 和 `mailer.render(message)` 取没有交付选项的相同，并解析到 `MailMessage`，它记录了它的 `template` 和 `locale`。`send()` 解析为 `messageId`、`providerMessageId`（当提供者有一个时）、`accepted`（接受的信封收件人）、`response`（最终 SMTP 回复）和 `attempts`。

blocks.md: Transports
blocks.text: Transports
blocks.zh: 运输

blocks.md:
| Transport | Options | Idempotency key |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `SmtpTransport` | `url` or `host`, `port`, `secure`, `startTls` (`required`, `opportunistic` or `never`; `required` by default, `opportunistic` for localhost), `auth` (`user` with `pass` or `accessToken`), `authMethod` (`PLAIN`, `LOGIN` or `XOAUTH2`), `name`, `tls`, `pool`, `timeouts`, `dkim` (`domainName`, `keySelector`, `privateKey`, `headers`) | derived `Message-ID` only |
| `ResendTransport` | `apiKey`, `baseUrl`, `timeout`, `fetch` | `Idempotency-Key`, 24 hours |
| `PostmarkTransport` | `serverToken`, `messageStream` (default `outbound`), `baseUrl`, `timeout`, `fetch` | none |
| `SendGridTransport` | `apiKey`, `baseUrl`, `timeout`, `fetch` | none |
| `SesTransport` | `region`, `credentials`, `configurationSetName`, `endpoint`, `timeout`, `fetch` | none |
| `FileMailTransport` | `directory`, `log` | development only |
| `LogMailTransport` | `body`, `logger` | development only |
| `InMemoryMailTransport` | none | tests only, see [Testing](/application/mail#testing) |
blocks.zh:
| 运输 | 选项 | 幂等键 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `SmtpTransport` | `url` 或 `host`、`port`、`secure`、`startTls`（`required`、`opportunistic` 或 `never`；`required` 默认情况下，`opportunistic` 表示本地主机）、`auth`（`user` 表示 `pass` 或 `accessToken`）、`authMethod`（`PLAIN`、`LOGIN` 或 `XOAUTH2`）、`name`、`tls`、`pool`、`timeouts`、`dkim`]（`domainName`、`keySelector`、`privateKey`、`headers`） | 衍生的 `Message-ID` 只有 |
| `ResendTransport` | `apiKey`,`baseUrl`,`timeout`,`fetch` | `Idempotency-Key`, 24 小时 |
| `PostmarkTransport` | `serverToken`,`messageStream`（默认 `outbound`),`baseUrl`,`timeout`,`fetch` | 没有一个 |
| `SendGridTransport` | `apiKey`,`baseUrl`,`timeout`,`fetch` | 没有一个 |
| `SesTransport` | `region`,`credentials`,`configurationSetName`,`endpoint`,`timeout`,`fetch` | 没有一个 |
| `FileMailTransport` | `directory`,`log` | 仅开发 |
| `LogMailTransport` | `body`,`logger` | 仅开发 |
| `InMemoryMailTransport` | 没有一个 | 仅测试，请参阅 [Testing](/application/mail#testing) |

blocks.md: `InMemoryMailTransport.mails` lists every mail received, oldest first, as a `SentMail`, which `filter()`, `find()` and `assertSent()` return too. A `SentMail` has the message's `messageId`, `from`, `to`, `cc`, `bcc`, `subject`, `html`, `text`, `attachments`, `headers`, `mail` (the mail class), `template` and `locale`, plus `sentAt` (when the transport received it), `raw` (the MIME source), `links` (every link, from the HTML, then the ones only the text part has), `link()`, `attachment()` and `message`, the `MailMessage` itself. `clear()` forgets them all.
blocks.text: InMemoryMailTransport.mails lists every mail received, oldest first, as a SentMail, which filter(), find() and assertSent() return too. A SentMail has the message's messageId, from, to, cc, bcc, subject, html, text, attachments, headers, mail (the mail class), template and locale, plus sentAt (when the transport received it), raw (the MIME source), links (every link, from the HTML, then the ones only the text part has), link(), attachment() and message, the MailMessage itself. clear() forgets them all.
blocks.zh: `InMemoryMailTransport.mails` 将收到的每封邮件列为 `SentMail`，其中 `filter()`,`find()` 和 `assertSent()` 也回来。一个 `SentMail` 有消息的 `messageId`,`from`,`to`,`cc`,`bcc`,`subject`,`html`,`text`,`attachments`,`headers`,`mail`（邮件类），`template` 和 `locale`,加上 `sentAt`（当运输机收到它时），`raw`（MIME 来源），`links`（每个链接，从 HTML，然后只有文本部分有），`link()`,`attachment()` 和 `message`，这个 `MailMessage` 本身。`clear()` 都忘了。

blocks.md: With `pool: true`, `SmtpTransport` keeps up to 5 connections, sends up to 100 messages per connection, and closes a connection after 30 seconds idle; an object with `maxConnections`, `maxMessages` and `idleTimeout` as `pool` changes those limits. Its default timeouts are `30s` to connect, `30s` for the greeting, `1m` per command and `5m` for the data. HTTP providers time out after `30s` per request.
blocks.text: With pool: true, SmtpTransport keeps up to 5 connections, sends up to 100 messages per connection, and closes a connection after 30 seconds idle; an object with maxConnections, maxMessages and idleTimeout as pool changes those limits. Its default timeouts are 30s to connect, 30s for the greeting, 1m per command and 5m for the data. HTTP providers time out after 30s per request.
blocks.zh: 和 `pool: true`,`SmtpTransport` 保持多达 5 个连接，每个连接最多发送 100 条消息，并在 30 秒空闲后关闭连接；具有 `maxConnections`,`maxMessages` 和 `idleTimeout` 作为 `pool` 更改这些限制。它的默认超时是 `30s` 连接，`30s` 为了问候，`1m` 每个命令和 `5m` 为了数据。HTTP 提供者在之后超时 `30s` 应要求。

blocks.md: Events
blocks.text: Events
blocks.zh: 事件

blocks.md: `MailEvents.events$` emits one event per send, after its retries. Each event is also published on a `node:diagnostics_channel` channel.
blocks.text: MailEvents.events$ emits one event per send, after its retries. Each event is also published on a node:diagnostics_channel channel.
blocks.zh: `MailEvents.events$` 每次发送在重试后发出一个事件。每个事件也发布在 `node:diagnostics_channel` 渠道。

blocks.md:
| Event type | Channel | When | Payload |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sent` | `nestjs:mail:sent` | The transport accepted the message. | `messageId`, `mail`, `recipients`, `subject`, `transport`, `attempts`, `durationMs`, `providerMessageId` |
| `failed` | `nestjs:mail:failed` | The send failed after its retries, or its `signal` aborted before the first attempt (`attempts` is 0). | The same fields without `providerMessageId`, plus `error` and `permanent` |
blocks.zh:
| 事件类型 | 渠道 | 何时 | 有效载荷 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sent` | `nestjs:mail:sent` | 运输机接受了消息。 | `messageId`,`mail`,`recipients`,`subject`,`transport`,`attempts`,`durationMs`,`providerMessageId` |
| `failed` | `nestjs:mail:failed` | 发送在重试后失败，或其 `signal` 在第一次尝试之前中止（`attempts` 是 0）。 | 相同的字段没有 `providerMessageId`,加上 `error` 和 `permanent` |

blocks.md: A message that fails validation throws before any event.
blocks.text: A message that fails validation throws before any event.
blocks.zh: 验证失败的消息会在任何事件之前抛出。

blocks.md: Errors
blocks.text: Errors
blocks.zh: 错误

blocks.md: Every error extends `MailError`, which has `permanent` (whether sending the same message again can't succeed) and `code` (the SMTP reply code or the provider's HTTP status). The mailer retries only errors that aren't permanent. See [Send after the order commits](/application/mail#send-after-the-order-commits).
blocks.text: Every error extends MailError, which has permanent (whether sending the same message again can't succeed) and code (the SMTP reply code or the provider's HTTP status). The mailer retries only errors that aren't permanent. See Send after the order commits.
blocks.zh: 每个错误都扩展 `MailError`，其中有 `permanent`（是否再次发送相同的消息不能成功）和 `code`（SMTP 回复代码或提供者的 HTTP 状态）。邮件程序只重试非永久性错误。参见 [Send after the order commits](/application/mail#send-after-the-order-commits)。

blocks.md:
| Error | When | Permanent |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `MailMessageError` | The message is invalid, before anything is sent. `field` names the field, `status` is 400. | Yes |
| `MailConnectionError` | DNS, a refused or reset connection, TLS or a certificate. `cause` holds the socket error. | No, except configuration problems such as a server without STARTTLS when it's required |
| `MailTimeoutError` | A phase outlived its timeout. Has `phase` and `timeoutMs`. | No |
| `MailSmtpError` | An SMTP error reply. Has `code`, `enhancedCode`, `command` and `response`. | For 5xx replies |
| `MailRecipientsRejectedError` | The server refused one or more recipients, and nothing was sent. `rejected` lists them. Extends `MailSmtpError`. | When any refusal is 5xx |
| `MailTemplateError` | A template is missing or doesn't compile, or a mail names a template without a template engine. Has `template`, and `file`, `line` and `column` for a problem in a file. | Yes |
| `MailProviderError` | An HTTP provider refused the request. Has `code` (the HTTP status), `provider`, `providerCode`, and `retryAfterMs` when the response had a valid `Retry-After`. | For 4xx except 408, 409 and 429 |
blocks.zh:
| 错误 | 何时 | 永久的 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `MailMessageError` | 在发送任何内容之前，该消息无效。`field` 命名字段，`status` 是 400。 | 是的 |
| `MailConnectionError` | DNS，拒绝或重置连接，TLS 或者证书。`cause` 保留套接字错误。 | 不，除了配置问题，如服务器没有 STARTTLS 需要时 |
| `MailTimeoutError` | 一个阶段超过了超时。具有 `phase` 和 `timeoutMs`。 | 不是 |
| `MailSmtpError` | SMTP 错误回复。具有 `code`、`enhancedCode`、`command` 和 `response`。 | 5xx 个回复 |
| `MailRecipientsRejectedError` | 服务器拒绝了一个或多个收件人，没有发送任何内容。`rejected` 列出了它们。扩展 `MailSmtpError`。 | 当任何拒绝是 5xx 时 |
| `MailTemplateError` | 模板丢失或无法编译，或者邮件在没有模板引擎的情况下命名模板。有 `template`，和 `file`,`line` 和 `column` 文件中的问题。 | 是的 |
| `MailProviderError` | HTTP 提供者拒绝了该请求。当响应具有有效的 `Retry-After` 时，具有 `code`（HTTP 状态）、`provider`、`providerCode` 和 `retryAfterMs`。 | 对于 4xx，除了 408、409 和 429 |

chapters.title: File storage
chapters.summary: An online store for cat food and supplies keeps three kinds of files.

blocks.md: An online store for cat food and supplies keeps three kinds of files. Product photos are uploaded by staff and shown to everyone. Invoices are PDF files that only the customer who paid should be able to download. And the warehouse team photographs products with the store's mobile app, which uploads large photos that shouldn't have to pass through the order API.
blocks.text: An online store for cat food and supplies keeps three kinds of files. Product photos are uploaded by staff and shown to everyone. Invoices are PDF files that only the customer who paid should be able to download. And the warehouse team photographs products with the store's mobile app, which uploads large photos that shouldn't have to pass through the order API.
blocks.zh: 一家猫粮和用品的网上商店保存着三种文件。产品照片由工作人员上传并展示给大家。发票是 PDF 文件，只有付款的客户才能下载。仓库团队使用商店的移动应用程序拍摄产品，该应用程序上传了不需要通过订单的大照片 API。

blocks.md: In development, all of this should work from a folder on the laptop. In production, the files go to S3 or Cloudflare R2, because the API runs on several instances and none of them has a disk that lasts. The code that stores and serves files should be the same in both.
blocks.text: In development, all of this should work from a folder on the laptop. In production, the files go to S3 or Cloudflare R2, because the API runs on several instances and none of them has a disk that lasts. The code that stores and serves files should be the same in both.
blocks.zh: 在开发过程中，所有这些都应该从笔记本电脑上的文件夹中工作。在生产中，文件会转到 S3 或 Cloudflare R2，因为 API 在多个实例上运行，但没有一个实例具有持久的磁盘。存储和服务文件的代码应该是相同的。

blocks.md: `@nestjs/storage` gives each place files live a name, a **disk**, and one API for all of them: `put()`, `get()`, `list()`, `delete()`, public URLs and signed URLs. It ships a local disk, an S3 disk that works with AWS S3 and S3-compatible stores (Cloudflare R2, MinIO, Backblaze B2), and an in-memory disk for tests. It talks to S3 over `fetch`, with no AWS SDK, and depends only on `@nestjs/common` and `@nestjs/core`.
blocks.text: @nestjs/storage gives each place files live a name, a disk, and one API for all of them: put(), get(), list(), delete(), public URLs and signed URLs. It ships a local disk, an S3 disk that works with AWS S3 and S3-compatible stores (Cloudflare R2, MinIO, Backblaze B2), and an in-memory disk for tests. It talks to S3 over fetch, with no AWS SDK, and depends only on @nestjs/common and @nestjs/core.
blocks.zh: `@nestjs/storage` 为每个实时位置文件指定一个名称、一个**磁盘**和一个 API 对于他们所有人： `put()`, `get()`, `list()`, `delete()`、公共 URL 和签名 URL。它发送一个本地磁盘，一个与 AWS S3 和 S3 兼容存储（Cloudflare R2、MinIO、Backblaze B2），以及用于测试的内存磁盘。它与 S3 通话 `fetch`，没有 AWS SDK，并且只取决于 `@nestjs/common` 和 `@nestjs/core`.

blocks.md: It doesn't parse uploads. multer on Express and `@nestjs/platform-fastify/multipart` on Fastify keep doing that, with `FileInterceptor()` as usual. This package is where the files end up: it provides a storage engine that streams each upload straight onto a disk.
blocks.text: It doesn't parse uploads. multer on Express and @nestjs/platform-fastify/multipart on Fastify keep doing that, with FileInterceptor() as usual. This package is where the files end up: it provides a storage engine that streams each upload straight onto a disk.
blocks.zh: 它不解析上传。穆尔特 Express 和 `@nestjs/platform-fastify/multipart` 在 Fastify 继续这样做，用 `FileInterceptor()` 像往常一样。这个包是文件的最终位置：它提供了一个存储引擎，将每个上传的文件直接传输到磁盘上。

blocks.md: In this tutorial, you'll:
blocks.text: In this tutorial, you'll:
blocks.zh: 在本教程中，您将：

blocks.md:
- configure a public disk for photos and a private disk for everything else,
- stream photo uploads onto the photos disk, with the type and size checked before anything is written,
- store invoices privately and hand out download links that expire after five minutes,
- let the mobile app upload photos directly to storage, with a signed upload URL,
- switch from local disks to S3 or R2 with configuration alone,
- test all of it against in-memory disks.
blocks.text: configure a public disk for photos and a private disk for everything else, stream photo uploads onto the photos disk, with the type and size checked before anything is written, store invoices privately and hand out download links that expire after five minutes, let the mobile app upload photos directly to storage, with a signed upload URL, switch from local disks to S3 or R2 with configuration alone, test all of it against in-memory disks.
blocks.zh:
- 为照片配置一个公共磁盘，为其他所有内容配置一个私有磁盘，
- 将照片上传到照片磁盘，在写入任何内容之前检查类型和大小，
- 私自存储发票并分发五分钟后过期的下载链接，
- 让手机 app 直接上传照片到存储，签名上传 URL，
- 仅通过配置从本地磁盘切换到 S3 或 R2，
- 针对内存磁盘测试所有这些。

blocks.md: Installation

blocks.md: To get started, install the required dependencies:
blocks.text: To get started, install the required dependencies:
blocks.zh: 要开始，请安装所需的依赖项：

blocks.md: Configure the disks
blocks.text: Configure the disks
blocks.zh: 配置磁盘

blocks.md: The app needs two disks. `photos` holds product photos, which anyone may see, so it has a public URL. `private` holds invoices and uploads that haven't been checked yet, and is only reachable through signed URLs. Keeping public and private files on separate disks (separate buckets, in production) means a file never becomes public by accident.
blocks.text: The app needs two disks. photos holds product photos, which anyone may see, so it has a public URL. private holds invoices and uploads that haven't been checked yet, and is only reachable through signed URLs. Keeping public and private files on separate disks (separate buckets, in production) means a file never becomes public by accident.
blocks.zh: 该应用程序需要两个磁盘。`photos` 保存产品照片，任何人都可以看到，所以它有一个公开的 URL。`private` 保存尚未检查的发票和上传，并且只能通过签名的 URL 访问。将公共文件和私有文件保存在单独的磁盘上（在生产中是单独的存储桶）意味着文件永远不会意外公开。

blocks.md: The disks are built from that configuration by a factory function:
blocks.text: The disks are built from that configuration by a factory function:
blocks.zh: 磁盘是通过工厂函数从该配置构建的：

blocks.md: A `LocalDisk` keeps files in a directory, which it creates at startup. `publicUrl` is where the files can be fetched publicly: the photos disk's `url(key)` returns URLs under it. In development, the app itself will serve that path (see [Upload product photos](/application/file-storage#upload-product-photos)); in production, a CDN will.
blocks.text: A LocalDisk keeps files in a directory, which it creates at startup. publicUrl is where the files can be fetched publicly: the photos disk's url(key) returns URLs under it. In development, the app itself will serve that path (see Upload product photos); in production, a CDN will.
blocks.zh: `LocalDisk` 将文件保存在启动时创建的目录中。`publicUrl` 是可以公开获取文件的地方：照片磁盘的 `url(key)` 返回其下的 URL。在开发中，应用程序本身将服务于该路径（参见 [Upload product photos](/application/file-storage#upload-product-photos)）；在生产中，CDN 将。

blocks.md: A local directory can't produce signed URLs the way S3 does, so the private disk signs its own: with `signedUrls`, its `signedUrl()` returns URLs under `baseUrl`, signed with HMAC-SHA256, which the app verifies and serves (see [Serve signed URLs in development](/application/file-storage#serve-signed-urls-in-development)). `keys` takes one or more keys. The first signs, and all of them verify, so you can rotate a key by putting the new one first and removing the old one once the links it signed have expired. A key must have at least 32 characters.

The first signs, and all of them verify, so you can rotate a key by putting the new one first and removing the old one once the links it signed have expired. A key must have at least 32 characters.
blocks.zh: 本地目录不能像 S3 那样生成签名的 URL，所以私有磁盘自己签名：with `signedUrls`,它的 `signedUrl()` 返回 URL `baseUrl`，签名 HMAC-SHA256，应用程序验证并提供服务（参见 [Serve signed URLs in development](/application/file-storage#serve-signed-urls-in-development)). `keys` 获取一个或多个键。第一个符号，它们都是验证的，所以你可以旋转一个密钥，把新的放在第一位，一旦它签名的链接过期，就删除旧的。密钥必须至少有 32 个字符。

blocks.md: `StorageModule` is global. Services inject a disk in one of three ways:

blocks.zh: `StorageModule` 是全球性的。服务通过以下三种方式之一注入磁盘：

blocks.md:
| Injection | Gives you |
| --- | --- |
| `private readonly files: StorageDisk` | The default disk, here `private` |
| `@InjectDisk('photos') private readonly photos: StorageDisk` | The disk called `photos` |
| `private readonly storage: Storage` | Every disk: `storage.disk('photos')`, for code that picks a disk at runtime |
blocks.zh:
| 注射 | 给你 |
| --- | --- |
| `private readonly files: StorageDisk` | 默认磁盘，此处 `private` |
| `@InjectDisk('photos') private readonly photos: StorageDisk` | 磁盘名为 `photos` |
| `private readonly storage: Storage` | 每个磁盘：`storage.disk('photos')`，对于在运行时选择磁盘的代码 |

blocks.md: The upload endpoint uses `FileInterceptor()` from `@nestjs/platform-express`, as any upload does. The difference is the `storage` option: `uploadToDisk()` is a multer storage engine that streams the file onto a disk instead of into memory or a temp folder:
blocks.text: The upload endpoint uses FileInterceptor() from @nestjs/platform-express, as any upload does. The difference is the storage option: uploadToDisk() is a multer storage engine that streams the file onto a disk instead of into memory or a temp folder:
blocks.zh: 上传端点使用 `FileInterceptor()` 来自 `@nestjs/platform-express` 就像任何上传一样。区别在于 `storage` 选项：`uploadToDisk()` 是一个 multer 存储引擎，它将文件流式传输到磁盘，而不是内存或临时文件夹：

blocks.md: By the time the handler runs, the photo is stored. `uploadToDisk()` has done three things on the way:
blocks.text: By the time the handler runs, the photo is stored. uploadToDisk() has done three things on the way:
blocks.zh: 当处理程序运行时，照片被存储。`uploadToDisk()` 在路上做了三件事：

blocks.md:
- **It checked what the file is, not what the client says it is.** A browser sends the type it guesses from the file name, and a script can send anything, so a file declared `image/png` may well be an HTML page or an SVG with a script in it. The engine reads the first bytes of the stream, detects the type from their signature (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, AVIF, HEIC and PDF are built in; [other formats](/application/file-storage#accept-csv-and-other-text-formats) take a detector of your own), and refuses anything not in `contentTypes` with a `415` before a byte is written. The stored content type is the detected one, never the client's.
- **It enforced the size limit without leaving a partial file.** multer stops reading at `limits.fileSize`. The engine then refuses to commit what it received: the request fails with `413 File too large`, nothing is stored, and no file is replaced.
- **It picked the key.** By default, a random UUID and the extension of the detected type, such as `2f1c0d6e-….png`. Unique keys matter: an upload never overwrites another, and a cached photo never goes stale.

The engine reads the first bytes of the stream, detects the type from their signature (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, AVIF, HEIC and PDF are built in; other formats take a detector of your own), and refuses anything not in contentTypes with a 415 before a byte is written. By default, a random UUID and the extension of the detected type, such as 2f1c0d6e-….png. Unique keys matter: an upload never overwrites another, and a cached photo never goes stale.
blocks.zh:
- **它检查的是文件是什么，而不是客户端所说的是什么。**浏览器发送它根据文件名猜测的类型，而脚本可以发送任何内容，因此一个文件声明 `image/png` 很可能是一个 HTML 页面或 SVG 里面有剧本。引擎读取流的第一个字节，从它们的签名中检测类型（JPEG,PNG,GIF, 网络,AVIF,HEIC 和 PDF 是内置的；[其他格式](/application/file-storage#accept-csv-and-other-text-formats) 带一个你自己的检测器），并拒绝任何不在 `contentTypes` 用一个 `415` 在写入字节之前。存储的内容类型是检测到的，而不是客户端的。
- **它在不留下部分文件的情况下强制执行了大小限制。** multer 停止读取 `limits.fileSize`.然后，引擎拒绝提交它接收到的内容：请求失败 `413 File too large`，不存储任何内容，也不替换任何文件。
- **它选择了密钥。**默认情况下，随机的 UUID 和检测到的类型的扩展名，例如 `2f1c0d6e-….png`。唯一的密钥很重要：一个上传永远不会覆盖另一个，缓存的照片永远不会过时。

blocks.md: `@UploadedFile()` returns a `StoredUpload`: multer's usual fields (`fieldname`, `originalname`, `mimetype`, `size`) plus `key`, `disk`, `contentType` and `etag`. `mimetype` is still the client's claim; use `contentType`.
blocks.text: @UploadedFile() returns a StoredUpload: multer's usual fields (fieldname, originalname, mimetype, size) plus key, disk, contentType and etag. mimetype is still the client's claim; use contentType.
blocks.zh: `@UploadedFile()` 返回一个 `StoredUpload`：multer 的常用字段（`fieldname`, `originalname`, `mimetype`, `size`) 更多 `key`, `disk`, `contentType` 和 `etag`. `mimetype` 仍然是客户的索赔；使用 `contentType`.

blocks.md: `ParseFilePipe` and its validators run after the interceptor, when a streamed file is already stored, and `FileTypeValidator` needs the file in memory to check its bytes. With `uploadToDisk()`, check type and size in the engine, as above. On Fastify, import `FileInterceptor` from `@nestjs/platform-fastify/multipart` and register `@fastify/multipart`; `uploadToDisk()` works the same with both.

With uploadToDisk(), check type and size in the engine, as above. On Fastify, import FileInterceptor from @nestjs/platform-fastify/multipart and register @fastify/multipart; uploadToDisk() works the same with both.
blocks.zh: `ParseFilePipe` 当流文件已经存储时，其验证器在拦截器之后运行，并且 `FileTypeValidator` 需要内存中的文件来检查其字节。和 `uploadToDisk()`，检查发动机中的类型和尺寸，如上所述。在 Fastify, 进口 `FileInterceptor` 来自 `@nestjs/platform-fastify/multipart` 和登记 `@fastify/multipart`; `uploadToDisk()` 两者都一样。

blocks.md: The interceptor runs before the handler, so the file is stored even when the product turns out not to exist. The service deletes it in that case, which keeps a mistyped id from leaving orphans behind. `url(key)` builds the public URL from the disk's `publicUrl`.

blocks.md: The `GET photos/:file` route serves photos in development. `serveFile()` streams a file from a disk as the response, with `Content-Type`, `Content-Length`, `ETag`, `Last-Modified`, the `Cache-Control` stored with the file (`private` when none is, so a shared cache never keeps a file that may be one user's), and `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, so the browser never second-guesses the type. `disposition: 'inline'` lets the browser show the image; for types that could run script in your origin, such as HTML or SVG, `serveFile()` sends `Content-Disposition: attachment` regardless. It answers `Range` requests with `206`, `If-None-Match` with `304`, and a missing file with `404`.
blocks.text: The GET photos/:file route serves photos in development. serveFile() streams a file from a disk as the response, with Content-Type, Content-Length, ETag, Last-Modified, the Cache-Control stored with the file (private when none is, so a shared cache never keeps a file that may be one user's), and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, so the browser never second-guesses the type. disposition: 'inline' lets the browser show the image; for types that could run script in your origin, such as HTML or SVG, serveFile() sends Content-Disposition: attachment regardless. It answers Range requests with 206, If-None-Match with 304, and a missing file with 404.
blocks.zh: 这个 `GET photos/:file` 路线服务于正在开发的照片。 `serveFile()` 从磁盘流式传输文件作为响应，使用 `Content-Type`, `Content-Length`, `ETag`, `Last-Modified`，这个 `Cache-Control` 与文件一起存储（`private` 如果没有，则共享缓存永远不会保存可能属于一个用户的文件），并且 `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`，因此浏览器永远不会再次猜测类型。 `disposition: 'inline'` 让浏览器显示图像；对于可以在源中运行脚本的类型，例如 HTML 或者 SVG, `serveFile()` 发送 `Content-Disposition: attachment` 不论。它回答 `Range` 请求 `206`, `If-None-Match` 和 `304`，以及一个丢失的文件 `404`.

blocks.md: Accept CSV and other text formats
blocks.text: Accept CSV and other text formats
blocks.zh: 接受 CSV 和其他文本格式

blocks.md: Built-in detection recognizes formats by the fixed bytes they start with. A CSV file has no such signature, so `contentTypes: ['text/csv']` on its own refuses every CSV with a `415`. For a format like that, pass `detectContentType`: a function that receives the start of the file and returns its type, or `undefined` when it doesn't recognize it.
blocks.text: Built-in detection recognizes formats by the fixed bytes they start with. A CSV file has no such signature, so contentTypes: ['text/csv'] on its own refuses every CSV with a 415. For a format like that, pass detectContentType: a function that receives the start of the file and returns its type, or undefined when it doesn't recognize it.
blocks.zh: 内置检测通过格式开头的固定字节来识别格式。一个 CSV 文件没有这样的签名，所以 `contentTypes: ['text/csv']` 它自己拒绝一切 CSV 用一个 `415`.对于这样的格式，通过 `detectContentType`：接收文件开头并返回其类型的函数，或 `undefined` 当它不认识它的时候。

blocks.md: The upload endpoint allows `text/csv` and passes the function to `uploadToDisk()`. Price lists go to the private disk, because nobody has checked their rows yet:
blocks.text: The upload endpoint allows text/csv and passes the function to uploadToDisk(). Price lists go to the private disk, because nobody has checked their rows yet:
blocks.zh: 上传端点允许 `text/csv` 并将函数传递给 `uploadToDisk()`。价目表将进入私有磁盘，因为还没有人检查过它们的行：

blocks.md:
- **Built-in detection comes first.** The function only runs when the file isn't one of the built-in formats. A PNG renamed to `prices.csv` is still detected as a PNG, and refused. Passing the exported `detectContentType()` helper as the option does nothing, because that's the check that already ran.
- **It sees the start of the file.** `bytes` holds the first 4 KiB, or the whole file when it's smaller. To change that, set `contentTypeSampleBytes` to a whole number from 1 byte to 64 KiB (it requires `detectContentType`). The second argument has `originalname` and `mimetype`, but they're the client's claims, so decide from the bytes.
- **What it returns is checked against `contentTypes`.** Types are compared without their parameters: `text/csv` in the list allows `text/csv; charset=utf-8`. When the function returns `undefined`, or a type that isn't in the list, the upload is refused with a `415` before a byte is written. Without `contentTypes`, any returned type is accepted, and an unrecognized file is stored as `application/octet-stream`.
- **The returned type is the one the file is stored and served with.** Include the charset for text formats. It also sets the extension: `file.extension` is `.csv` in `key()` above, and the default key ends with it too.
- **It may be async.** The engine waits for the promise while it holds the request, so it must settle quickly. Return `undefined` for a file you don't recognize rather than throwing: an error fails the upload as it would anywhere else in the request, so anything but an `HttpException` becomes a `500` instead of a `415`. So does returning anything but a string or `undefined`.

blocks.zh:
- **内置检测是第一位的。**该功能仅在文件不是内置格式时运行。一个 PNG 重命名为 `prices.csv` 仍然被检测为 PNG，并拒绝了。传递导出 `detectContentType()`helper 作为选项什么也不做，因为那是已经运行的检查。
- **它会看到文件的开头。** `bytes` 保存前 4 KiB，或者当文件较小时保存整个文件。要更改此设置 `contentTypeSampleBytes` 到 1 字节到 64 KiB 的整数（它需要 `detectContentType`).第二个论点有 `originalname` 和 `mimetype`，但它们是客户的索赔，所以根据字节来决定。
- **它返回的内容与 `contentTypes`.** 在没有参数的情况下比较类型： `text/csv` 列表中允许 `text/csv; charset=utf-8`.当函数返回时 `undefined`，或不在列表中的类型，上传将被拒绝 `415` 在写入字节之前。没有 `contentTypes`，任何返回的类型都被接受，无法识别的文件存储为 `application/octet-stream`.
- **返回的类型是存储和提供文件的类型。**包括文本格式的字符集。它还设置扩展名：`file.extension` 是 `.csv` 在 `key()` 上面，默认键也以它结尾。
- **它可能是异步的。**引擎在持有请求的同时等待承诺，因此它必须快速结算。返回 `undefined` 对于您不认识的文件，而不是抛出：一个错误会使上传失败，就像在请求中的其他地方一样，所以除了一个 `HttpException` 变成 `500` 而不是一个 `415`.返回除字符串或 `undefined`.

blocks.title: Warning

blocks.md: `serveSignedUrl()` checks the signature, the expiry and the method, then answers like `serveFile()`, with the file name the link was signed with. Download managers can resume a large file with `Range` requests.

blocks.md: Uploads stream to S3 too. A file up to 8 MiB goes up in one request; a longer one, or a stream whose length isn't known, goes up as a multipart upload, four 8 MiB parts at a time, and is aborted if anything fails, so a failed upload never becomes a file. Requests that fail with a network error, a timeout, throttling (`429`, `SlowDown`) or a `5xx` are retried with backoff, up to 3 attempts in all. `multipart`, `retry` and `timeout` tune this per disk.
blocks.text: Uploads stream to S3 too. A file up to 8 MiB goes up in one request; a longer one, or a stream whose length isn't known, goes up as a multipart upload, four 8 MiB parts at a time, and is aborted if anything fails, so a failed upload never becomes a file. Requests that fail with a network error, a timeout, throttling (429, SlowDown) or a 5xx are retried with backoff, up to 3 attempts in all. multipart, retry and timeout tune this per disk.
blocks.zh: 也将流上传到 S3。一个请求中高达 8 MiB 的文件会增加；一个较长的，或者一个长度未知的流，作为多部分上传，一次四个 8 MiB 的部分，如果有任何失败，就会中止，所以失败的上传永远不会成为一个文件。因网络错误、超时、节流而失败的请求（`429`,`SlowDown`）或一个 `5xx` 在后退的情况下重试，总共最多 3 次。`multipart`,`retry` 和 `timeout` 每个磁盘调整这个。

blocks.md: Production checklist
blocks.text: Production checklist
blocks.zh: 生产检查表

blocks.md:
- **Keep public and private files in separate buckets.** Give the photos bucket public read access, or put a CDN in front of it and point `publicUrl` at the CDN. Keep the private bucket fully private: invoices and uploads are only reachable through signed URLs. There is no per-file public flag, because new S3 buckets have object ACLs disabled, and a flag on one file is easy to get wrong.
- **Expire abandoned uploads.** Add a lifecycle rule to the private bucket that deletes objects under `incoming/` after a day, and one that aborts incomplete multipart uploads after a day.
- **Allow direct uploads from browsers with CORS.** The mobile app doesn't need it, but a web page that sends a `PUT` to a presigned URL does: allow `PUT` from your site's origin, with the `Content-Type` header.
- **Grant the app only what it uses.** An IAM policy with `s3:GetObject`, `s3:PutObject`, `s3:DeleteObject` and `s3:ListBucket` on the two buckets is enough. Keep `s3:ListBucket`: without it, S3 answers a request for a missing file with `403` instead of `404`, and `exists()` fails instead of returning `false`. For short-lived credentials, pass a `credentials` function that returns them.
- **Encrypt at rest.** S3 encrypts new objects by default; for a KMS key of your own, set `serverSideEncryption: 'aws:kms'` and `kmsKeyId` on the disk. R2 always encrypts.
- **Keep links short-lived.** Five minutes is plenty for a link a user clicks right away. A signed URL can't be revoked: it stays valid until it expires (or, on S3, until the credentials that signed it expire or lose access), so whoever it leaks to can use it until then.
- **Set a signing key per environment** for local disks (development and CI), from a secret, with at least 32 characters, and rotate it by putting the new key first in `keys`.
- **Don't use a local disk in production.** Files written to a container's disk vanish when the task is replaced, and other instances can't read them. Use S3, R2 or another object store (see [Use S3 or R2 in production](/application/file-storage#use-s3-or-r2-in-production)); local disks are for development and tests, and the module logs a warning at startup when it finds one with `NODE_ENV=production`.
- **Treat every key built from user input with care.** Keys are validated on every disk (no `..`, no absolute paths, no control characters), so user input can't escape a disk, but it can still name any file on it. Build keys from ids you control, as the upload endpoints above do.

blocks.zh:
- **将公共文件和私有文件保存在单独的存储桶中。**将照片存储桶授予公共读取权限，或者在其前面放置一个 CDN，并将 `publicUrl` 指向 CDN。保持私有桶完全私有：发票和上传只能通过签名的 URL 访问。没有每个文件的公共标志，因为新的 S3 存储桶禁用了对象 ACL，一个文件上的标志很容易出错。
- **过期放弃的上传。**向私有存储桶添加生命周期规则，删除下面的对象 `incoming/` 一天后，以及一天后中止不完整的多部分上传的一个。
- **允许从浏览器直接上传 CORS.**移动应用程序不需要它，但一个网页会发送一个 `PUT` 到预先签名的 URL 是否：允许 `PUT` 从站点的起源开始，使用 `Content-Type` 头球。
- **只授予应用程序使用的内容。** IAM 政策 `s3:GetObject`, `s3:PutObject`, `s3:DeleteObject` 和 `s3:ListBucket` 两桶就够了。保持 `s3:ListBucket`：如果没有它，S3 将响应丢失文件的请求 `403` 而不是 `404`，和 `exists()` 失败而不是返回 `false`.对于短期凭证，通过 a `credentials` 返回它们的函数。
- **静止时加密。**默认情况下，S3 会加密新对象；对于一个 KMS 您自己的钥匙，设置 `serverSideEncryption: 'aws:kms'` 和 `kmsKeyId` 在磁盘上。R2 总是加密。
- **保持链接的短时间。**对于一个用户立即点击的链接来说，五分钟是足够的。签名 URL 不可撤销：它一直有效，直到过期（或者，在 S3 上，直到签署它的凭据过期或失去访问权限），所以它泄露给谁都可以使用它，直到那时。
- **为本地磁盘（开发和 CI）设置每个环境的签名密钥**，从一个秘密开始，至少有 32 个字符，并通过首先将新密钥放在 `keys` 中来旋转它。
- **不要在生产中使用本地磁盘。**写入容器磁盘的文件在任务被替换时消失，其他实例无法读取这些文件。使用 S3、R2 或另一个对象存储（参见 [Use S3 or R2 in production](/application/file-storage#use-s3-or-r2-in-production)）；本地磁盘用于开发和测试，当模块找到带有 `NODE_ENV=production` 的磁盘时，它会在启动时记录一个警告。
- **谨慎对待用户输入生成的每个密钥。**每个磁盘上的密钥都经过验证（否 `..`，没有绝对路径，没有控制字符），因此用户输入无法转义磁盘，但它仍然可以命名磁盘上的任何文件。从您控制的 id 构建密钥，就像上面的上传端点所做的那样。

blocks.md: `StorageModule.forRoot()` takes these options, and a `forRootAsync()` factory returns `default` and disk instances. Disk classes, `imports` and `isGlobal` sit next to `useFactory`, `useClass` or `useExisting`. The options are provided as `STORAGE_MODULE_OPTIONS`.
blocks.text: StorageModule.forRoot() takes these options, and a forRootAsync() factory returns default and disk instances. Disk classes, imports and isGlobal sit next to useFactory, useClass or useExisting. The options are provided as STORAGE_MODULE_OPTIONS.
blocks.zh: `StorageModule.forRoot()` 接受这些选项，`forRootAsync()` 工厂返回 `default` 和磁盘实例。磁盘类 `imports` 和 `isGlobal` 位于 `useFactory`、`useClass` 或 `useExisting` 旁边。选项以 `STORAGE_MODULE_OPTIONS` 的形式提供。

blocks.md:
| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `disks` | none (required) | Disks by name: instances, or `StorageDisk` classes that Nest instantiates, which can inject. See [Configure the disks](/application/file-storage#configure-the-disks). |
| `default` | the only disk | The disk that `StorageDisk` and `storage.disk()` resolve to. Required with more than one disk. |
| `imports` | none | Modules whose exports the disk classes inject. |
| `isGlobal` | `true` | Registers `Storage`, `StorageDisk` and the named disks globally. |
blocks.zh:
| 选择 | 默认的 | 描述 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `disks` | 无（必填） | 磁盘名称：实例，或 `StorageDisk` 类 Nest 实例化，可以注入。看 [Configure the disks](/application/file-storage#configure-the-disks). |
| `default` | 唯一的磁盘 | 磁盘 `StorageDisk` 和 `storage.disk()` 下定决心。需要多个磁盘。 |
| `imports` | 没有一个 | 导出磁盘类注入的模块。 |
| `isGlobal` | `true` | 寄存器 `Storage`,`StorageDisk` 以及全局命名的磁盘。 |

blocks.md: Disk methods
blocks.text: Disk methods
blocks.zh: 磁盘方法

blocks.md: Every disk has the same methods, key rules and errors. A key is a relative, `/`-separated path of at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes, without empty, `.` or `..` segments, backslashes or control characters.
blocks.text: Every disk has the same methods, key rules and errors. A key is a relative, /-separated path of at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes, without empty, . or .. segments, backslashes or control characters.
blocks.zh: 每个磁盘都有相同的方法、关键规则和错误。密钥是相对的，`/`-至多 1024 的分离路径 UTF-8 字节，不空，`.` 或者 `..` 段、反斜杠或控制字符。

blocks.md:
| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `put(key, body, options)` | Writes a file atomically. Options: `contentType` (inferred from the extension by default), `cacheControl`, `contentDisposition`, `metadata` (string values, 2 KB in total), `contentLength`, `signal`. Resolves to `key`, `size`, `contentType` and `etag`. |
| `get(key, options)` | The file's metadata and its `body` as a Node stream. `range` takes `start` and an inclusive `end`, or `suffix`. |
| `getBuffer(key)`, `getText(key)` | The whole file. |
| `stat(key)`, `exists(key)` | The metadata without the body, or whether the file exists. |
| `delete(keys)` | One key or an array. Missing keys are ignored. |
| `list(options)`, `listAll(options)` | A page of `key`, `size`, `lastModified` and `etag` in UTF-8 byte order, with a `cursor`. Options: `prefix`, `cursor`, `limit` (up to 1000, the default). `listAll()` iterates every page. |
| `copy(from, to)`, `move(from, to)` | Within the disk, metadata included. |
| `url(key)` | The public URL under `publicUrl`. Throws without one. |
| `signedUrl(key, options)` | A download link. Options: `expiresIn` (default 15 minutes, at most 7 days), `filename`, `disposition`. See [Keep invoices private](/application/file-storage#keep-invoices-private). |
| `signedUpload(key, options)` | `url`, `method` (`PUT`), `headers` and `expiresAt` for a direct upload. Options: `contentType` (required), `contentLength`, `expiresIn`. See [Upload straight to storage from the mobile app](/application/file-storage#upload-straight-to-storage-from-the-mobile-app). |
blocks.zh:
| 方法 | 描述 |
| --- | --- |
| `put(key, body, options)` | 原子地写入文件。选项：`contentType`（默认情况下从扩展名推断）、`cacheControl`、`contentDisposition`、`metadata`（字符串值，共 2 个 KB）、`contentLength`、`signal`。解析为 `key`、`size`、`contentType` 和 `etag`。 |
| `get(key, options)` | 文件的元数据及其作为 Node 流的 `body`。`range` 取 `start` 和一个包含的 `end`，或 `suffix`。 |
| `getBuffer(key)`,`getText(key)` | 整个文件。 |
| `stat(key)`,`exists(key)` | 没有主体的元数据，或者文件是否存在。 |
| `delete(keys)` | 一个键或一个数组。丢失的密钥将被忽略。 |
| `list(options)`,`listAll(options)` | `key`、`size`、`lastModified` 和 `etag` 按 UTF-8 字节顺序排列，带有 `cursor`。选项：`prefix`、`cursor`、`limit`（默认最多 1000）。`listAll()` 迭代每一页。 |
| `copy(from, to)`,`move(from, to)` | 在磁盘内，包括元数据。 |
| `url(key)` | `publicUrl` 下的公共 URL。没有一个投掷。 |
| `signedUrl(key, options)` | 下载链接。选项：`expiresIn`（默认 15 分钟，最多 7 天），`filename`，`disposition`。参见 [Keep invoices private](/application/file-storage#keep-invoices-private)。 |
| `signedUpload(key, options)` | `url`、`method`（`PUT`）、`headers` 和 `expiresAt` 用于直接上传。选项：`contentType`（必填）、`contentLength`、`expiresIn`。参见 [Upload straight to storage from the mobile app](/application/file-storage#upload-straight-to-storage-from-the-mobile-app)。 |

blocks.md: `signedUrls` takes `baseUrl`, the route that serves the URLs, and `keys`, signing keys of at least 32 characters. The first key signs, and all of them verify. `S3Disk` defaults: `region` from `AWS_REGION`, then `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION`, then `us-east-1`; credentials from `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` and `AWS_SESSION_TOKEN`; `multipart` with a `partSize` of 8 MiB and a `concurrency` of 4; `retry: 3`, with backoff from 100 ms doubling to 20 seconds; no `timeout`; `batchDelete: true`.
blocks.text: signedUrls takes baseUrl, the route that serves the URLs, and keys, signing keys of at least 32 characters. The first key signs, and all of them verify. S3Disk defaults: region from AWS_REGION, then AWS_DEFAULT_REGION, then us-east-1; credentials from AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY and AWS_SESSION_TOKEN; multipart with a partSize of 8 MiB and a concurrency of 4; retry: 3, with backoff from 100 ms doubling to 20 seconds; no timeout; batchDelete: true.
blocks.zh: `signedUrls` 获取 `baseUrl`（为 URL 提供服务的路由）和 `keys`（至少 32 个字符的签名密钥）。第一个钥匙标志，他们都验证了。`S3Disk` 默认值：`region` 从 `AWS_REGION` 开始，然后 `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION`，然后 `us-east-1`；`AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`、`AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` 和 `AWS_SESSION_TOKEN` 的凭证；`multipart` 具有 8 MiB 的 `partSize` 和 4 的 `concurrency`；`retry: 3`，回退从 100 毫秒加倍到 20 秒；没有 `timeout`；`batchDelete: true`.

blocks.md: HTTP helpers
blocks.text: HTTP helpers
blocks.zh: HTTP 助手

blocks.md:
| Helper | Options | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `uploadToDisk(options)` | `disk` (a name or an instance, default the default disk), `contentTypes`, `detectContentType`, `contentTypeSampleBytes` (default 4 KiB, from 1 byte to 64 KiB, requires `detectContentType`), `cacheControl`, `key`, `metadata` | A storage engine for `FileInterceptor()`. `key` and `metadata` are functions of the file and the request. `detectContentType(bytes, file)` returns the type of a file the built-in detection doesn't recognize, or `undefined`, and may return a promise. See [Upload product photos](/application/file-storage#upload-product-photos) and [Accept CSV and other text formats](/application/file-storage#accept-csv-and-other-text-formats). |
| `serveFile(disk, key, options)` | `res` (required), `req`, `disposition` (default `attachment`), `filename`, `cacheControl` | Streams a file as the response, with `Range` and `If-None-Match` support when given `req`. |
| `serveSignedUrl(disk, options)` | `req`, `res`, `cacheControl` | Verifies and serves an app-served signed download URL. See [Serve signed URLs in development](/application/file-storage#serve-signed-urls-in-development). |
| `receiveSignedUpload(disk, options)` | `req`, `res`, `maxSize` | Verifies an app-served signed upload URL and streams the `PUT` body onto the disk. `maxSize` limits uploads signed without a `contentLength`. |
| `detectContentType(bytes)` | none | The type of a file from its first 16 bytes: JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, AVIF, HEIC or PDF, else `undefined`. It's the built-in detection `uploadToDisk()` runs, and knows nothing of the `detectContentType` option. |
blocks.zh:
| 帮手 | 选项 | 描述 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `uploadToDisk(options)` | `disk`（名称或实例，默认为默认磁盘），`contentTypes`,`detectContentType`,`contentTypeSampleBytes`（默认为 4 KiB，从 1 字节到 64 KiB，需要 `detectContentType`),`cacheControl`,`key`,`metadata` | `FileInterceptor()` 的存储引擎。`key` 和 `metadata` 是文件和请求的函数。`detectContentType(bytes, file)` 返回内置检测无法识别的文件类型，或 `undefined`，并可能返回承诺。参见 [Upload product photos](/application/file-storage#upload-product-photos) 和 [Accept CSV and other text formats](/application/file-storage#accept-csv-and-other-text-formats)。 |
| `serveFile(disk, key, options)` | `res`（必填），`req`,`disposition`（默认 `attachment`),`filename`,`cacheControl` | 流式传输文件作为响应，当给定 `req` 时，支持 `Range` 和 `If-None-Match`。 |
| `serveSignedUrl(disk, options)` | `req`,`res`,`cacheControl` | 验证并提供应用程序服务的签名下载 URL。参见 [Serve signed URLs in development](/application/file-storage#serve-signed-urls-in-development)。 |
| `receiveSignedUpload(disk, options)` | `req`,`res`,`maxSize` | 验证应用程序提供的签名上传 URL，并将 `PUT` 正文流式传输到磁盘。`maxSize` 限制没有 `contentLength` 签名的上传。 |
| `detectContentType(bytes)` | 没有一个 | 文件的前 16 个字节的类型： JPEG, PNG, GIF, 网络, AVIF, HEIC 或者 PDF,否则 `undefined`.是内置的检测 `uploadToDisk()` 跑步，对 `detectContentType` 选择。 |

blocks.md: Errors
blocks.text: Errors
blocks.zh: 错误

blocks.md: Every error extends `StorageError`. Outside the HTTP helpers, they aren't `HttpException`s, so map them in your own code where they mean something to your API.
blocks.text: Every error extends StorageError. Outside the HTTP helpers, they aren't HttpExceptions, so map them in your own code where they mean something to your API.
blocks.zh: 每个错误都会扩展 `StorageError`.在外面 HTTP 帮手，他们不是 `HttpException`s，所以在你自己的代码中映射它们，它们对你有意义 API.

blocks.md:
| Error | `status` | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `StorageFileNotFoundError` | 404 | `get()`, `stat()`, `copy()` or `move()` of a missing key. Has `key`. |
| `StorageInvalidKeyError` | 400 | A key that breaks the key rules. Has `reason`. |
| `StorageBodyLengthError` | 400 | The body didn't match `contentLength`. Has `expected` and `received`. |
| `StorageRangeNotSatisfiableError` | 416 | A range that starts past the end of the file. Has `size`. |
| `StorageKeyConflictError` | 409 | A local disk can't hold both `a` and `a/b`. |
| `StorageSignedUrlError` | 403 | A signed URL failed verification. `reason` is `missing`, `invalid`, `expired` or `method`. |
| `StorageServiceError` | none | The object store refused or failed. Has `code` (such as `AccessDenied` or `SlowDown`), `upstreamStatus`, `requestId` and `operation`. |
blocks.zh:
| 错误 | `status` | 何时 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `StorageFileNotFoundError` | 404 | 缺失密钥的 `get()`、`stat()`、`copy()` 或 `move()`。有 `key`。 |
| `StorageInvalidKeyError` | 400 | 打破密钥规则的密钥。有 `reason`。 |
| `StorageBodyLengthError` | 400 | 主体不匹配 `contentLength`。有 `expected` 和 `received`。 |
| `StorageRangeNotSatisfiableError` | 416 | 从文件末尾开始的范围。有 `size`。 |
| `StorageKeyConflictError` | 409 | 本地磁盘不能同时保存 `a` 和 `a/b`。 |
| `StorageSignedUrlError` | 403 | 签名的 URL 验证失败。`reason` 是 `missing`、`invalid`、`expired` 或 `method`。 |
| `StorageServiceError` | 没有一个 | 对象存储被拒绝或失败。具有 `code`（如 `AccessDenied` 或 `SlowDown`）、`upstreamStatus`、`requestId` 和 `operation`。 |

chapters.title: Overview
chapters.summary: Nest is database-agnostic, so you can integrate it with any SQL or NoSQL database.

blocks.md: Nest is database-agnostic, so you can integrate it with any SQL or NoSQL database. At the most basic level, connecting Nest to a database means loading the appropriate Node.js driver for that database, just as you would with [Express](https://expressjs.com/en/guide/database-integration.html) or Fastify, and making the client available to the rest of the application through a [provider](/providers).
blocks.text: Nest is database-agnostic, so you can integrate it with any SQL or NoSQL database. At the most basic level, connecting Nest to a database means loading the appropriate Node.js driver for that database, just as you would with Express or Fastify, and making the client available to the rest of the application through a provider.
blocks.zh: Nest 与数据库无关，因此您可以将其与任何 SQL 或 NoSQL 数据库集成。在最基本的层次上，将 Nest 连接到数据库意味着为该数据库加载适当的 Node.js 驱动程序，就像使用 [Express](https://expressjs.com/en/guide/database-integration.html) 或 Fastify 一样，并通过 [供应商](/providers) 使客户端对应用程序的其余部分可用。

blocks.md: Most applications work at a higher level of abstraction, with an ORM or a query builder. The chapters in this category cover the following integrations:
blocks.text: Most applications work at a higher level of abstraction, with an ORM or a query builder. The chapters in this category cover the following integrations:
blocks.zh: 大多数应用程序在更高的抽象层次上工作，具有 ORM 或者查询生成器。此类别中的章节涵盖以下集成：

blocks.md:
- **[TypeORM](/data/typeorm)** (`@nestjs/typeorm`): an ORM with decorator-based entities and the repository pattern. It supports most SQL databases, as well as MongoDB.
- **[Drizzle](/data/drizzle)** (`@nestjs/drizzle`): a lightweight, TypeScript-first ORM. You declare tables with plain functions and write queries with a SQL-like query builder, and Drizzle infers every result type from the schema.
- **[MongoDB](/data/mongodb)** (`@nestjs/mongoose`): [Mongoose](https://mongoosejs.com/) schemas and models for MongoDB.
- **[Prisma](/data/prisma)**: an ORM that generates a type-safe client from a schema file. It has no Nest-specific package: you expose the generated client through a provider.
- **[MikroORM](/data/mikroorm)** (`@mikro-orm/nestjs`, maintained by the MikroORM team): an ORM based on the Data Mapper, Unit of Work, and Identity Map patterns.
- **[Sequelize](/data/sequelize)** (`@nestjs/sequelize`): a promise-based ORM for SQL databases. With the `sequelize-typescript` package, you declare models with decorators.

blocks.md: Relations
blocks.text: Relations
blocks.zh: 关系

blocks.md: Relations are associations between two or more tables, based on common fields from each table, often involving primary and foreign keys.
blocks.text: Relations are associations between two or more tables, based on common fields from each table, often involving primary and foreign keys.
blocks.zh: 关系是两个或多个表之间的关联，基于每个表的公共字段，通常涉及主键和外键。

blocks.md: There are three types of relations:
blocks.text: There are three types of relations:
blocks.zh: 有三种类型的关系：

blocks.md:
One-to-one Every row in the primary table has one and only one associated row in the foreign table. Use the @OneToOne() decorator to define this type of relation.
One-to-many / Many-to-one Every row in the primary table has one or more related rows in the foreign table. Use the @OneToMany() and @ManyToOne() decorators to define this type of relation.
Many-to-many Every row in the primary table has many related rows in the foreign table, and every row in the foreign table has many related rows in the primary table. Use the @ManyToMany() decorator to define this type of relation.
To define relations in entities, use the corresponding **decorators**. For example, to define that each `User` can have multiple photos, use the `@OneToMany()` decorator.
blocks.text: To define relations in entities, use the corresponding decorators. For example, to define that each User can have multiple photos, use the @OneToMany() decorator.
blocks.zh: 要定义实体中的关系，请使用相应的**decorators**。例如，要定义每个 `User` 可以有多张照片，使用 `@OneToMany()` 装修师。

blocks.md: TypeORM Transactions
blocks.text: TypeORM Transactions
blocks.zh: TypeORM 交易

blocks.md: A [database transaction](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Database_transaction) is a unit of work performed against a database and treated in a coherent and reliable way, independent of other transactions. A transaction generally represents any change in a database.

blocks.md: Migrations
blocks.text: Migrations

blocks.md: [Migrations](https://typeorm.io/docs/advanced-topics/migrations/) provide a way to incrementally update the database schema to keep it in sync with the application's data model while preserving existing data in the database. To generate, run, and revert migrations, TypeORM provides a dedicated [CLI](https://typeorm.io/docs/advanced-topics/migrations/#creating-a-new-migration).

blocks.zh: [Migrations](https://typeorm.io/docs/advanced-topics/migrations/) 提供一种增量更新数据库模式的方法，使其与应用程序的数据模型保持同步，同时保留数据库中的现有数据。要生成、运行和还原迁移，TypeORM 提供了一个专用的 [CLI](https://typeorm.io/docs/advanced-topics/migrations/#creating-a-new-migration)。

blocks.md: Migration classes are separate from the Nest application source code, and TypeORM manages their lifecycle. Therefore, you can't use dependency injection or other Nest-specific features in migrations. To learn more, see the [migrations guide](https://typeorm.io/docs/advanced-topics/migrations/) in the TypeORM documentation.

blocks.md: Testing
blocks.text: Testing
blocks.zh: 检测

blocks.md: When unit testing an application, you usually want to avoid connecting to a database, to keep test suites independent and as fast as possible. However, your classes might depend on repositories obtained from the data source instance. The solution is to create mock repositories using [custom providers](/fundamentals/custom-providers). Each registered repository is automatically represented by an `<EntityName>Repository` token, where `EntityName` is the name of your entity class.

chapters.title: Drizzle
chapters.summary: As an alternative to TypeORM, you can use Drizzle ORM with the @nestjs/drizzle package.

blocks.md: As an alternative to TypeORM, you can use [Drizzle ORM](https://orm.drizzle.team/) with the `@nestjs/drizzle` package. Drizzle is a lightweight, TypeScript-first ORM. You declare tables with plain functions and write queries with a SQL-like query builder (or the relational query API for nested reads), and Drizzle infers every result type from the schema. There are no entity classes, decorators, or code generation steps.
blocks.text: As an alternative to TypeORM, you can use Drizzle ORM with the @nestjs/drizzle package. Drizzle is a lightweight, TypeScript-first ORM. You declare tables with plain functions and write queries with a SQL-like query builder (or the relational query API for nested reads), and Drizzle infers every result type from the schema. There are no entity classes, decorators, or code generation steps.
blocks.zh: 作为 TypeORM 的替代方案，您可以将 [Drizzle ORM](https://orm.drizzle.team/) 与 `@nestjs/drizzle` 包一起使用。Drizzle 是一个轻量级的，TypeScript-优先的 ORM。您使用普通函数声明表，并使用类似 SQL 的查询生成器（或用于嵌套读取的关系查询 API）编写查询，Drizzle 从模式中推断每个结果类型。没有实体类、装饰器或代码生成步骤。

blocks.md: To get started, install the required dependencies. This chapter uses [PostgreSQL](https://www.postgresql.org/) with the `node-postgres` driver, but Drizzle supports many other databases, including MySQL, SQLite, and Microsoft SQL Server, as well as serverless databases such as Neon, Turso, and Cloudflare D1. The steps in this chapter are the same for every database Drizzle supports: install the driver for your database, and import `drizzle()` from the matching [entry point](https://orm.drizzle.team/docs/connect-overview) (e.g., `drizzle-orm/mysql2` or `drizzle-orm/libsql`) instead of `drizzle-orm/node-postgres`.
blocks.text: To get started, install the required dependencies. This chapter uses PostgreSQL with the node-postgres driver, but Drizzle supports many other databases, including MySQL, SQLite, and Microsoft SQL Server, as well as serverless databases such as Neon, Turso, and Cloudflare D1. The steps in this chapter are the same for every database Drizzle supports: install the driver for your database, and import drizzle() from the matching entry point (e.g., drizzle-orm/mysql2 or drizzle-orm/libsql) instead of drizzle-orm/node-postgres.
blocks.zh: 要开始，请安装所需的依赖项。本章将 [PostgreSQL](https://www.postgresql.org/) 与 `node-postgres` 驱动程序一起使用，但 Drizzle 支持许多其他数据库，包括 MySQL、SQLite 和 MicrosoftSQL 服务器，以及无服务器数据库，如 Neon、Turso 和 Cloudflare D1。本章中的步骤对于 Drizzle 支持的每个数据库都是相同的：为您的数据库安装驱动程序，并从匹配的 [入口点](https://orm.drizzle.team/docs/connect-overview)（例如，`drizzle-orm/mysql2` 或 `drizzle-orm/libsql`）导入 `drizzle()`，而不是 `drizzle-orm/node-postgres`。

blocks.code:
$ npm install --save @nestjs/drizzle drizzle-orm@rc pg
$ npm install --save-dev drizzle-kit@rc @types/pg

With v0.x, only relations and relational queries work differently from this chapter (see [Upgrading to v1](https://orm.drizzle.team/docs/upgrade-v1)).

blocks.md: Once the dependencies are installed and the schema is defined, import the `DrizzleModule` into the root `AppModule`:
blocks.text: Once the dependencies are installed and the schema is defined, import the DrizzleModule into the root AppModule:
blocks.zh: 安装依赖项并定义模式后，将 `DrizzleModule` 导入到根 `AppModule` 中：

blocks.md: The `drizzle` option takes the `drizzle()` function of your driver. `DrizzleModule` calls it with the `connection` and the other Drizzle options once for each application instance. Every application, including each one your e2e tests create, therefore gets its own connection pool, which is closed when that application shuts down. Because you pass the function, every driver Drizzle supports works the same way, and TypeScript checks `connection` and the other options against that driver's `drizzle()` signature.
blocks.text: The drizzle option takes the drizzle() function of your driver. DrizzleModule calls it with the connection and the other Drizzle options once for each application instance. Every application, including each one your e2e tests create, therefore gets its own connection pool, which is closed when that application shuts down. Because you pass the function, every driver Drizzle supports works the same way, and TypeScript checks connection and the other options against that driver's drizzle() signature.
blocks.zh: 这个 `drizzle` 选项采用 `drizzle()` 驱动程序的功能。`DrizzleModule` 用 `connection` 还有另一个 Drizzle 每个应用程序实例一次的选项。因此，每个应用程序，包括您的 e2e 测试创建的每个应用程序，都有自己的连接池，当该应用程序关闭时，连接池就会关闭。因为你传递了函数，每个司机 Drizzle 支持的工作方式相同，并且 TypeScript 支票 `connection` 和其他选项相对于驾驶员 `drizzle()` 签名。

blocks.md: The `forRoot()` method supports the following options:
blocks.text: The forRoot() method supports the following options:
blocks.zh: 这个 `forRoot()` 方法支持以下选项：

blocks.md:
drizzle The drizzle() function of your driver, e.g., the one exported by drizzle-orm/node-postgres
connection A connection string, or the driver's connection options (e.g., a pg pool configuration)
db A database instance that you created, used instead of drizzle and connection (see below)
autoCloseConnection If true, the database's client (db.$client) is closed when the application shuts down (default: true)
Other options, such as `relations`, `logger`, or `casing`, are passed to `drizzle()` as well.
blocks.text: Other options, such as relations, logger, or casing, are passed to drizzle() as well.
blocks.zh: 其他选项，例如 `relations`,`logger`, 或 `casing`，被传递给 `drizzle()` 也是。

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md: Like the options of any module, the `forRoot()` options are evaluated when the `AppModule` file is imported, so `process.env.DATABASE_URL` must already be set at that point (e.g., by starting Node.js with the `--env-file=.env` flag). To read the connection string through `ConfigService` instead, use `forRootAsync()`, described in the "Async configuration" section below.

To read the connection string through ConfigService instead, use forRootAsync(), described in the "Async configuration" section below.

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md: The client is closed when you call `app.close()`, or when the process receives a termination signal if [shutdown hooks](/fundamentals/lifecycle-events#application-shutdown) are enabled. Pool-based clients (e.g., `node-postgres`, `postgres.js`, `mysql2`) are closed with `end()`, and others (e.g., `better-sqlite3`, `libsql`, PGlite) with `close()`. For a database created with Drizzle's [`withReplicas()`](https://orm.drizzle.team/docs/read-replicas) function, the clients of the primary and all replica databases are closed (with Drizzle v0.44.6 and later; earlier versions don't expose the replicas, so only the primary's client is closed). A client registered under several names is closed only once.
blocks.text: The client is closed when you call app.close(), or when the process receives a termination signal if shutdown hooks are enabled. Pool-based clients (e.g., node-postgres, postgres.js, mysql2) are closed with end(), and others (e.g., better-sqlite3, libsql, PGlite) with close(). blocks.md: Drizzle Transactions
blocks.text: Drizzle Transactions
blocks.zh: Drizzle 交易

blocks.md: A database transaction is a unit of work that the database management system treats as a whole, independently of other transactions: either all of its changes are applied, or none of them are. To learn more, see [Database transaction](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Database_transaction) on Wikipedia.
blocks.text: A database transaction is a unit of work that the database management system treats as a whole, independently of other transactions: either all of its changes are applied, or none of them are. To learn more, see Database transaction on Wikipedia.
blocks.zh: 数据库事务是一个工作单元，数据库管理系统将其视为一个整体，独立于其他事务：要么应用其所有更改，要么不应用任何更改。要了解更多信息，请参阅 [Database transaction](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Database_transaction) 在维基百科上。

blocks.md: To start a [Drizzle transaction](https://orm.drizzle.team/docs/transactions), call the `transaction()` method of the injected database. The callback receives a transaction object (`tx`) that exposes the same query API as the database:
blocks.text: To start a Drizzle transaction, call the transaction() method of the injected database. The callback receives a transaction object (tx) that exposes the same query API as the database:
blocks.zh: 开始 [Drizzle transaction](https://orm.drizzle.team/docs/transactions)，打电话给 `transaction()` 注入数据库的方法。回调接收事务对象（`tx`) 公开相同的查询 API 作为数据库：

blocks.md: If the callback throws or calls `tx.rollback()`, the transaction is rolled back and `transaction()` rejects with the error. Otherwise, the transaction is committed, and `transaction()` resolves with the value the callback returned. Queries that belong to the transaction must run through `tx`, not through the injected database.

blocks.zh: 如果回调抛出或调用 `tx.rollback()`，事务回滚，并且 `transaction()` 拒绝并出错。否则，事务被提交，并且 `transaction()` 使用回调返回的值进行解析。属于事务的查询必须通过 `tx`，而不是通过注入的数据库。

chapters.title: MongoDB
chapters.summary: Nest supports two methods for integrating with the MongoDB database.

blocks.md: Nest supports two methods for integrating with the [MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/) database. You can either use the [TypeORM](https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm) module described in the [TypeORM chapter](/data/typeorm), which has a connector for MongoDB, or use [Mongoose](https://mongoosejs.com), the most popular MongoDB object modeling tool. This chapter describes the latter, using the dedicated `@nestjs/mongoose` package.

blocks.md: With Mongoose, everything is derived from a [Schema](https://mongoosejs.com/docs/guide.html). Each schema maps to a MongoDB collection and defines the shape of the documents within that collection. Schemas are used to define [Models](https://mongoosejs.com/docs/models.html). Models are responsible for creating and reading documents from the underlying MongoDB database.

You may also use the `discriminatorKey` option to define the path for discrimination.

blocks.md: Virtuals
blocks.text: Virtuals
blocks.zh: 虚拟

blocks.md: In Mongoose, a **virtual** is a property that exists on a document but is not persisted to MongoDB. Instead, it is computed dynamically whenever it's accessed. Virtuals are typically used for derived or computed values, like combining fields (e.g., creating a `fullName` property by concatenating `firstName` and `lastName`), or for creating properties that rely on existing data in the document.

Virtuals are typically used for derived or computed values, like combining fields (e.g., creating a fullName property by concatenating firstName and lastName), or for creating properties that rely on existing data in the document.
blocks.zh: 在 Mongoose 中，**虚拟**是存在于文档上但不会持久化的属性 MongoDB 相反，每当访问它时，它都是动态计算的。虚拟通常用于派生或计算值，如组合字段（例如，创建 `fullName` 连接属性 `firstName` 和 `lastName`)，或用于创建依赖于文档中现有数据的属性。

chapters.title: Prisma
chapters.summary: Prisma is an open-source ORM for Node.js and TypeScript.

blocks.md: [Prisma](https://www.prisma.io) is an [open-source](https://github.com/prisma/prisma) ORM for Node.js and TypeScript. You can use it as an **alternative** to writing plain SQL or to other database access tools, such as SQL query builders (like [knex.js](https://knexjs.org/)) or other ORMs (like [TypeORM](https://typeorm.io/) and [Sequelize](https://sequelize.org/)). Prisma supports PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, SQLite, CockroachDB, and MongoDB (see [supported databases](https://www.prisma.io/docs/orm/reference/supported-databases)). This chapter uses Prisma ORM 7, which works with the SQL databases; MongoDB projects stay on Prisma ORM 6 for now.
blocks.text: Prisma is an open-source ORM for Node.js and TypeScript. You can use it as an alternative to writing plain SQL or to other database access tools, such as SQL query builders (like knex.js) or other ORMs (like TypeORM and Sequelize). Prisma supports PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, SQLite, CockroachDB, and MongoDB (see supported databases). This chapter uses Prisma ORM 7, which works with the SQL databases; MongoDB projects stay on Prisma ORM 6 for now.

Prisma 支持 PostgreSQL、MySQL， SQL 服务器、SQLite、CockroachDB 和 MongoDB （见 [支持的数据库](https://www.prisma.io/docs/orm/reference/supported-databases)).本章使用 Prisma ORM 7，它与 SQL 数据库； MongoDB 项目继续进行 Prisma ORM 暂时 6 个。

blocks.md: While you can use Prisma with plain JavaScript, it embraces TypeScript and provides a level of type safety that goes beyond the guarantees of other ORMs in the TypeScript ecosystem. See the [comparison of the type safety guarantees of Prisma and TypeORM](https://www.prisma.io/docs/orm/more/comparisons/prisma-and-typeorm#type-safety) for details.
blocks.text: While you can use Prisma with plain JavaScript, it embraces TypeScript and provides a level of type safety that goes beyond the guarantees of other ORMs in the TypeScript ecosystem. See the comparison of the type safety guarantees of Prisma and TypeORM for details.
blocks.zh: 虽然您可以使用 Prisma 普通 JavaScript，它拥抱 TypeScript 并提供了超出其他 ORM 保证的类型安全级别 TypeScript 生态系统。参见 [comparison of the type safety guarantees of Prisma and TypeORM](https://www.prisma.io/docs/orm/more/comparisons/prisma-and-typeorm#type-safety) 详情。

blocks.md: Prisma has no Nest-specific package. Instead, you generate a type-safe client (Prisma Client) from your Prisma schema, wrap it in a provider, and inject that provider wherever you need database access. This chapter sets up that integration with a [SQLite](https://sqlite.org/) database, which needs no database server, and notes the differences for PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQL Server along the way.
blocks.text: Prisma has no Nest-specific package. Instead, you generate a type-safe client (Prisma Client) from your Prisma schema, wrap it in a provider, and inject that provider wherever you need database access. This chapter sets up that integration with a SQLite database, which needs no database server, and notes the differences for PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQL Server along the way.
blocks.zh: Prisma 没有 Nest-特定包装。相反，您将生成一个类型安全的客户端（Prisma 客户）来自您的 Prisma 模式，将其包装在提供程序中，并将该提供程序注入到需要数据库访问的任何位置。本章通过 [SQLite](https://sqlite.org/) 数据库，不需要数据库服务器，并注意 PostgreSQL、MySQL 和 SQL 一路上的服务器。

blocks.title: Expand if you're using PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, or Azure SQL
blocks.md:
Install the adapter for your database instead of `@prisma/adapter-better-sqlite3`. Each adapter package includes its database driver.

- For PostgreSQL:

```bash
$ npm install @prisma/adapter-pg
```

- For MySQL (and MariaDB):

```bash
$ npm install @prisma/adapter-mariadb
```

- For SQL Server and Azure SQL:

```bash
$ npm install @prisma/adapter-mssql
```

blocks.title: Expand if you're using PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, or Azure SQL
blocks.md:
With PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQL Server, the connection URL points to the _database server_. Pass the matching provider to `prisma init` (e.g., `--datasource-provider postgresql`), or change the `provider` field of the `datasource` block, and set `DATABASE_URL` in `.env`. See the [connection URL reference](https://www.prisma.io/docs/orm/reference/connection-urls) for the required format.

**PostgreSQL**

```groovy
datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
}
```

```bash
DATABASE_URL="postgresql://USER:PASSWORD@HOST:PORT/DATABASE?schema=SCHEMA"
```

Replace the uppercase placeholders with your database credentials. If you're unsure what to provide for the `SCHEMA` placeholder, it's most likely the default value `public`. If you don't have a PostgreSQL server yet, run `npx prisma dev` to start a local Prisma Postgres database in your terminal.

**MySQL**

```groovy
datasource db {
  provider = "mysql"
}
```

```bash
DATABASE_URL="mysql://USER:PASSWORD@HOST:PORT/DATABASE"
```

Replace the uppercase placeholders with your database credentials.

**Microsoft SQL Server / Azure SQL Server**

```groovy
datasource db {
  provider = "sqlserver"
}
```

```bash
DATABASE_URL="sqlserver://HOST:PORT;database=DATABASE;user=USER;password=PASSWORD;encrypt=true"
```

Replace the uppercase placeholders with your database credentials. If you're unsure what to provide for the `encrypt` option, it's most likely the default value `true`.
