blocks.md: To hash passwords, use `PasswordHasher` from [`@nestjs/authentication`](/security/authentication). It hashes with scrypt from `node:crypto`, at the parameters OWASP recommends (N=2^17, r=8, p=1: about 128 MiB of memory per hash), on the libuv thread pool, so it doesn't block the event loop and needs no native dependency. scrypt is memory-hard, which makes guessing passwords on GPUs far more expensive than with bcrypt.
blocks.text: To hash passwords, use PasswordHasher from @nestjs/authentication. It hashes with scrypt from node:crypto, at the parameters OWASP recommends (N=2^17, r=8, p=1: about 128 MiB of memory per hash), on the libuv thread pool, so it doesn't block the event loop and needs no native dependency. scrypt is memory-hard, which makes guessing passwords on GPUs far more expensive than with bcrypt.
blocks.zh: 若要散列密码，请使用 `PasswordHasher` 来自 [`@nestjs/authentication`](/security/authentication).它用脚本散列 `node:crypto` 在参数处 OWASP 在 libuv 线程池上推荐（N=2^17，r=8，p=1：每个散列大约 128 MiB 内存），所以它不会阻塞事件循环，也不需要本地依赖关系。scrypt 是硬内存的，这使得在 GPU 上猜测密码比使用 bcrypt 昂贵得多。

blocks.md: When your application imports `AuthenticationModule`, `PasswordHasher` is a provider, so inject it where you store and check passwords:
blocks.text: When your application imports AuthenticationModule, PasswordHasher is a provider, so inject it where you store and check passwords:
blocks.zh: 当您的应用程序导入 `AuthenticationModule`,`PasswordHasher` 是提供程序，因此请将其注入存储和检查密码的位置：

blocks.md:
- `hash()` returns a self-describing string, such as `$scrypt$ln=17,r=8,p=1$<salt>$<hash>`: the parameters and a random salt are stored with the hash, so there is nothing else to keep.
- `verify()` compares in constant time. Pass `undefined` for an unknown user: it checks a dummy hash instead, so the response time doesn't reveal which accounts exist.
- Passwords are Unicode-normalized (NFKC) before hashing, so the same password typed on different keyboards verifies.
- `hash()` refuses an empty password and one over 4 KiB with a `RangeError`, and `verify()` answers `false` for them without hashing. Any other rule, such as a minimum length, is yours to check first.
- `needsRehash()` tells you that a stored hash was made with weaker parameters than the current ones. Check it after a successful `verify()`, and store a new hash while you have the plaintext:

Any other rule, such as a minimum length, is yours to check first. needsRehash() tells you that a stored hash was made with weaker parameters than the current ones. Check it after a successful verify(), and store a new hash while you have the plaintext:
blocks.zh:
- `hash()` 返回一个自描述字符串，例如 `$scrypt$ln=17,r=8,p=1$<salt>$<hash>`：参数和随机盐与散列一起存储，因此没有其他东西要保留。
- `verify()` 在恒定时间内进行比较。通过 `undefined` 对于未知用户：它检查一个虚拟散列，因此响应时间不会显示哪些帐户存在。
- 密码是 Unicode 标准化的（NFKC) 在散列之前，因此在不同键盘上键入的相同密码会进行验证。
- `hash()` 拒绝一个空密码和一个超过 4 KiB 的密码 `RangeError`，和 `verify()` 答案 `false` 对他们来说没有散列。任何其他规则，如最小长度，都是你先检查的。
- `needsRehash()` 告诉您存储的哈希是使用比当前参数更弱的参数创建的。成功后检查 `verify()`，并在拥有明文时存储新的散列：

blocks.md: The cost comes from the module's `password` option: set its `logN` to 18 to double it. It has a ceiling of 1 GiB of memory and 16 times the default work per hash, so with the default `r` of 8, `logN` stops at 20; parameters beyond it throw when the hasher is created, and a stored hash made with them never verifies. Outside the module, create one yourself with `new PasswordHasher()`. In tests, a cheaper instance keeps suites fast, with `logN` set to 10.

Outside the module, create one yourself with new PasswordHasher(). In tests, a cheaper instance keeps suites fast, with logN set to 10.
blocks.zh: 成本来自模块的 `password` 选项：设置其 `logN` 增加到 18 倍。它的内存上限为 1 GiB，每个散列的工作量是默认工作量的 16 倍，因此默认 `r` 8 个， `logN` 20 点停止；创建散列时会抛出超出它的参数，用它们制作的存储散列永远不会验证。在模块外部，您可以使用 `new PasswordHasher()` 在测试中，一个更便宜的实例可以保持套件的速度， `logN` 设置为 10。

Both are native modules, and bcrypt reads only the first 72 bytes of a password.

chapters.title: Security headers
chapters.summary: Security headers, such as the ones Helmet sets, tell browsers to turn on protections against well-known web attacks like cross-site scripting and clickjacking.

blocks.md: Security headers, such as the ones [Helmet](https://github.com/helmetjs/helmet) sets, tell browsers to turn on protections against well-known web attacks like cross-site scripting and clickjacking. Examples are `Content-Security-Policy`, `Strict-Transport-Security` and `X-Frame-Options`.
blocks.text: Security headers, such as the ones Helmet sets, tell browsers to turn on protections against well-known web attacks like cross-site scripting and clickjacking. Examples are Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security and X-Frame-Options.
blocks.zh: 安全头，例如 [Helmet](https://github.com/helmetjs/helmet) 设置，告诉浏览器打开针对众所周知的 web 攻击的保护，如跨站点脚本和点击劫持。例子有 `Content-Security-Policy`, `Strict-Transport-Security` 和 `X-Frame-Options`.

blocks.md: Starting with NestJS v12.1, Nest can set these headers for you with `app.useSecurityHeaders()`. It uses the same defaults as Helmet 8, works the same way on Express and Fastify, and needs no extra package.

blocks.md: The headers are set on every response: route responses, `404` responses, error responses, responses rejected by the [CSRF protection](/security/csrf), and Server-Sent Events streams. The `X-Powered-By` header is removed. The following rules apply:

blocks.md:
- Call `useSecurityHeaders()` before `app.init()` or `app.listen()`. Calling it afterwards, or calling it twice, throws an error.
- Options are validated when you call the method, so a bad configuration fails at startup (see [Configuring headers](/security/helmet#configuring-headers)).
- The headers are written by a framework-level middleware (Express) or `onRequest` hook (Fastify), registered at the point where you call the method. Middleware registered with `app.use()` before that call runs first, and responses that such middleware sends itself don't carry the headers, so call `useSecurityHeaders()` right after `NestFactory.create()`.
- `app.enableCsrfProtection()` shares the same request hook. You can call the two methods in any order: the headers are always written before the CSRF check runs.

blocks.zh:
- 在 `app.init()` 或 `app.listen()` 之前调用 `useSecurityHeaders()`。之后调用它，或者调用两次，都会抛出错误。
- 当您调用该方法时，选项会被验证，因此错误的配置会在启动时失败（参见 [Configuring headers](/security/helmet#configuring-headers)）。

- `app.enableCsrfProtection()` 共享相同的请求挂钩。可以按任意顺序调用这两个方法：头总是写在 CSRF 检查运行。

blocks.md:

chapters.title: CSRF Protection
chapters.summary: Cross-site request forgery (CSRF or XSRF) is an attack in which a malicious site makes a user's browser send unwanted, state-changing requests to your application.

blocks.md: Cross-site request forgery (CSRF or XSRF) is an attack in which a malicious site makes a user's browser send unwanted, state-changing requests to your application. Because the browser attaches the user's cookies to those requests, the application treats them as if the user had sent them on purpose.
blocks.text: Cross-site request forgery (CSRF or XSRF) is an attack in which a malicious site makes a user's browser send unwanted, state-changing requests to your application. Because the browser attaches the user's cookies to those requests, the application treats them as if the user had sent them on purpose.
blocks.zh: 跨站点请求伪造（CSRF 或者 XSRF) 是一种攻击，其中恶意站点使用户的浏览器向您的应用程序发送不需要的、改变状态的请求。因为浏览器将用户的 cookies 附加到这些请求上，所以应用程序会将它们视为用户故意发送的。

blocks.md: Starting with NestJS v12.1, Nest has built-in CSRF protection. It works the same way on Express and Fastify, and needs no extra package, cookie, session, or change to your client code.
blocks.text: Starting with NestJS v12.1, Nest has built-in CSRF protection. It works the same way on Express and Fastify, and needs no extra package, cookie, session, or change to your client code.
blocks.zh: 从 NestJSv12.1，Nest 有内置的 CSRF 保护。它的工作原理是一样的 Express 和 Fastify，并且不需要额外的包、cookie、会话或更改客户端代码。

blocks.md: How it works
blocks.text: How it works
blocks.zh: 它是如何工作的

blocks.md: Modern browsers tell the server where each request comes from. They send a [`Sec-Fetch-Site`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Headers/Sec-Fetch-Site) header (part of Fetch Metadata), which is `same-origin` when one of your own pages made the request, and `same-site` or `cross-site` when another site did. They also send an `Origin` header with cross-origin requests. The built-in protection rejects state-changing requests that the browser reports as cross-origin, following the algorithm of Go 1.25's [`CrossOriginProtection`](https://pkg.go.dev/net/http#CrossOriginProtection).
blocks.text: Modern browsers tell the server where each request comes from. They send a Sec-Fetch-Site header (part of Fetch Metadata), which is same-origin when one of your own pages made the request, and same-site or cross-site when another site did. They also send an Origin header with cross-origin requests. The built-in protection rejects state-changing requests that the browser reports as cross-origin, following the algorithm of Go 1.25's CrossOriginProtection.
blocks.zh: 现代浏览器告诉服务器每个请求来自哪里。他们发送一个 [`Sec-Fetch-Site`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Headers/Sec-Fetch-Site) 头（获取元数据的一部分），它是 `same-origin` 当您自己的一个页面提出请求时，以及 `same-site` 或者 `cross-site` 当另一个网站做的时候。他们还发送了一个 `Origin` 具有交叉源请求的标头。内置保护拒绝浏览器报告为交叉源的状态更改请求，遵循 Go 1.25 的算法 [`CrossOriginProtection`](https://pkg.go.dev/net/http#CrossOriginProtection).

blocks.md: In detail, each request is checked as follows:
blocks.text: In detail, each request is checked as follows:
blocks.zh: 详细地，每个请求的检查如下：

blocks.md:
1. `GET`, `HEAD` and `OPTIONS` requests are always allowed.
2. If the request has a `Sec-Fetch-Site` header, the values `same-origin` and `none` (a navigation the user started, such as opening a bookmark) are allowed. Any other value, including `same-site`, is rejected.
3. If the request has neither a `Sec-Fetch-Site` nor an `Origin` header, it is allowed, because it does not come from a browser.
4. Otherwise, the host of the `Origin` header must match the request's `Host` header (`:authority` on HTTP/2). The comparison is case-insensitive and ignores the default port of the scheme, so `https://example.com` matches `example.com:443`. The `X-Forwarded-Host` header is ignored.
blocks.text: GET, HEAD and OPTIONS requests are always allowed. If the request has a Sec-Fetch-Site header, the values same-origin and none (a navigation the user started, such as opening a bookmark) are allowed. Any other value, including same-site, is rejected. If the request has neither a Sec-Fetch-Site nor an Origin header, it is allowed, because it does not come from a browser. Otherwise, the host of the Origin header must match the request's Host header (:authority on HTTP/2). The comparison is case-insensitive and ignores the default port of the scheme, so https://example.com matches example.com:443. The X-Forwarded-Host header is ignored.
blocks.zh:
1. `GET`,`HEAD` 和 `OPTIONS` 请求总是被允许的。
2. 如果请求有一个 `Sec-Fetch-Site` 标题，值 `same-origin` 和 `none`（用户开始的导航，如打开书签）是允许的。任何其他值，包括 `same-site`，被拒绝。
3. 如果请求既没有 `Sec-Fetch-Site` 诺尔安 `Origin` 头，这是允许的，因为它不是来自浏览器。
4. 否则，`Origin` 头的主机必须匹配请求的 `Host` 头（HTTP/2 上的 `:authority`）。该比较不区分大小写，并且忽略了方案的默认端口，因此 `https://example.com` 匹配 `example.com:443`。忽略 `X-Forwarded-Host` 标题。

blocks.md: A request that would be rejected is still allowed when it matches an [excluded route](/security/csrf#excluding-routes), or when its `Origin` is one of the [trusted origins](/security/csrf#trusted-origins).
blocks.text: A request that would be rejected is still allowed when it matches an excluded route, or when its Origin is one of the trusted origins.
blocks.zh: 当请求与 [排除路线](/security/csrf#excluding-routes) 匹配时，或者当它的 `Origin` 是 [可信来源](/security/csrf#trusted-origins) 之一时，仍然允许被拒绝的请求。

blocks.md: Getting started
blocks.text: Getting started

blocks.md: To enable the protection, call the `enableCsrfProtection()` method on the Nest application object:
blocks.text: To enable the protection, call the enableCsrfProtection() method on the Nest application object:
blocks.zh: 要启用保护，请调用 `enableCsrfProtection()` 方法 Nest 应用对象：

blocks.md: The check runs for every request, including requests to routes that do not exist, before Nest middleware, body parsing, guards, interceptors and route handlers. The following rules apply:
blocks.text: The check runs for every request, including requests to routes that do not exist, before Nest middleware, body parsing, guards, interceptors and route handlers. The following rules apply:
blocks.zh: 检查对每个请求运行，包括对不存在的路由的请求 Nest 中间件、主体解析、防护、拦截器和路由处理程序。适用以下规则：

blocks.md:
- Call `enableCsrfProtection()` before `app.init()` or `app.listen()`. Calling it afterwards, or calling it twice, throws an error.
- Options are validated when you call the method, so a bad configuration fails at startup. For example, a misspelled option throws `Invalid CSRF protection options: unknown option "trustedOrigin" (expected "trustedOrigins", "exclude").`
- The check is registered as a framework-level middleware (Express) or `onRequest` hook (Fastify) at the point where you call the method. Middleware registered with `app.use()` before that call runs first, so call `enableCsrfProtection()` right after `NestFactory.create()`.
- `app.useSecurityHeaders()` (see [Security headers](/security/helmet)) shares the same request hook. You can call the two methods in any order: the headers are always written before the CSRF check runs, so rejected requests carry them too.
- `setGlobalPrefix()` and `enableVersioning()` can be called before or after `enableCsrfProtection()`, because exclusions are resolved when the application initializes.

- 在 `app.init()` 或 `app.listen()` 之前调用 `enableCsrfProtection()`。之后调用它，或者调用两次，都会抛出错误。
- 当您调用该方法时，选项会被验证，因此错误的配置会在启动时失败。例如，拼写错误的选项会抛出 `Invalid CSRF protection options: unknown option "trustedOrigin" (expected "trustedOrigins", "exclude").`
- 检查被注册为框架级中间件（Express）或 `onRequest` 钩子（Fastify) 在调用方法的点上。注册的中间件 `app.use()` 在调用首先运行之前，请调用 `enableCsrfProtection()` 就在之后 `NestFactory.create()`.

blocks.md: A rejected request becomes a `ForbiddenException`, which goes through your global [exception filters](/exception-filters) like any other exception. Without a custom filter, the client receives a `403` response like this:

blocks.md: Since the check runs before routing, controller-scoped filters, guards and interceptors don't run for rejected requests.
blocks.text: Since the check runs before routing, controller-scoped filters, guards and interceptors don't run for rejected requests.
blocks.zh: 由于检查在路由之前运行，因此控制器范围内的过滤器、保护和拦截器不会针对被拒绝的请求运行。

blocks.md: Options
blocks.text: Options

blocks.md: The `enableCsrfProtection()` method takes an optional options object:
blocks.text: The enableCsrfProtection() method takes an optional options object:

| Option           | Type                                                      | Description                                                                                  |
| ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

Any other option is rejected when the method is called.

blocks.md: Trusted origins
blocks.text: Trusted origins

blocks.md: A frontend served from another origin, such as an admin panel on a sibling subdomain, sends cross-origin requests. The browser reports them as `same-site` or `cross-site`, so they are rejected unless you list the frontend's origin in `trustedOrigins`:
blocks.text: A frontend served from another origin, such as an admin panel on a sibling subdomain, sends cross-origin requests. The browser reports them as same-site or cross-site, so they are rejected unless you list the frontend's origin in trustedOrigins:

blocks.md: Each entry must be a serialized origin in the form `scheme://host[:port]`:
blocks.text: Each entry must be a serialized origin in the form scheme://host[:port]:
blocks.zh: 每个条目必须是 `scheme://host[:port]` 形式的序列化源：

blocks.md:
- A path (even a trailing `/`), query string, fragment, credentials and wildcards are not allowed. List every origin separately.
- Entries are normalized the way browsers serialize the `Origin` header: lower-case, without the default port. `https://Example.com:443` becomes `https://example.com`.
- A request is exempt when its `Origin` header equals one of the entries exactly.

blocks.md: Server-to-server requests usually carry neither `Sec-Fetch-Site` nor `Origin`, so they pass the check without any configuration. Exclude a route when it must accept requests with a foreign origin, for example from a webhook sender that sets an `Origin` header, or from an identity provider that sends the user back to your application with a cross-site form `POST` (SAML, or OAuth's `form_post` response mode).

Exclude a route when it must accept requests with a foreign origin, for example from a webhook sender that sets an Origin header, or from an identity provider that sends the user back to your application with a cross-site form POST (SAML, or OAuth's form_post response mode).
blocks.zh: 服务器到服务器请求通常既不携带 `Sec-Fetch-Site` 也不 `Origin`，因此它们无需任何配置即可通过检查。当路由必须接受来自外部来源的请求时，排除该路由，例如来自设置 `Origin` 头，或来自身份提供者，该提供者使用跨站点表单将用户发送回您的应用程序 `POST`(SAML，或 OAuth 的 `form_post` 响应模式）。

- Matching is case-sensitive, and a trailing slash does not match. The query string is ignored.
- Non-canonical request paths never match: paths that contain `//`, `.` or `..` segments, `;`, `#`, `\`, or a percent-encoded `.`, `/` or `\`. Such requests go through the check like any other, so the protection fails closed.
- On Fastify, exclusions are matched against the URL before `rewriteUrl` runs, as with `MiddlewareConsumer.exclude()`.

blocks.md: Instead of a list, `exclude` also accepts a predicate that receives the platform request object (an Express `Request` or a `FastifyRequest`) and returns `true` to skip the check. It is called only for requests that would otherwise be rejected.

blocks.md: A predicate receives the raw request, so none of the matching rules above apply to it. For example, a predicate that tests whether `request.url` starts with `/public/` also skips the check for `/public/../account`, which a router or proxy may resolve to `/account`. Prefer a list of routes where you can.

blocks.md: Limitations
blocks.text: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.md:
- The protection is not a token scheme. It relies on the browser's `Sec-Fetch-Site` header, which browsers only send to secure origins (HTTPS or `localhost`), or on the `Origin` header.
- `GET`, `HEAD` and `OPTIONS` requests are never checked, so handlers for these methods must not change state.
- The `Origin`/`Host` fallback does not know the scheme. For browsers that don't send `Sec-Fetch-Site`, a request from `http://example.com` to `https://example.com` is allowed (fails open), as in Go. [HSTS](/security/helmet#default-headers), which `app.useSecurityHeaders()` sends by default, mitigates this.
- `X-Forwarded-Host` is ignored. Behind a proxy that rewrites the `Host` header, browsers that don't send `Sec-Fetch-Site` hit the fallback and receive a `403`. Configure the proxy to preserve `Host`, or add your public origin to `trustedOrigins`.
- A `403` response does not carry CORS headers when CORS is registered after the protection, which is the case with the `cors` option of `NestFactory.create()`.
- Middleware registered with `app.use()` before `enableCsrfProtection()` runs before the check, and requests that such middleware answers are not checked.
- WebSocket upgrade requests are not checked. If your [gateways](/websockets/gateways) authenticate connections with cookies, validate the handshake's `Origin` header yourself.

If your gateways authenticate connections with cookies, validate the handshake's Origin header yourself.

- 这种保护不是一种象征性的方案。它依赖于浏览器的 `Sec-Fetch-Site` 头，浏览器仅将其发送到安全源（HTTPS 或者 `localhost`），或在 `Origin` 头球。
- `GET`,`HEAD` 和 `OPTIONS` 请求从不被检查，因此这些方法的处理程序不能更改状态。
- 这个 `Origin`/`Host` 回退不知道这个计划。对于不发送的浏览器 `Sec-Fetch-Site`，来自 `http://example.com` 二 `https://example.com` 是允许的（无法打开），就像在 Go 中一样。[HSTS](/security/helmet#default-headers)，其中 `app.useSecurityHeaders()` 默认发送，缓解了这种情况。
- `X-Forwarded-Host` 被忽略。在一个代理后面重写 `Host` 标题，不发送的浏览器 `Sec-Fetch-Site` 点击回退并收到一个 `403`.配置代理以保留 `Host`，或将您的公共来源添加到 `trustedOrigins`.

blocks.md: When you need a token-based approach
blocks.text: When you need a token-based approach
blocks.zh: 当您需要基于令牌的方法时

blocks.md: CSRF abuses the credentials that a browser attaches to requests automatically, so non-browser clients, such as mobile apps, CLI tools and other servers, don't need CSRF protection. Their requests carry neither `Sec-Fetch-Site` nor `Origin`, and are allowed.
blocks.text: CSRF abuses the credentials that a browser attaches to requests automatically, so non-browser clients, such as mobile apps, CLI tools and other servers, don't need CSRF protection. Their requests carry neither Sec-Fetch-Site nor Origin, and are allowed.
blocks.zh: CSRF 滥用浏览器自动附加到请求的凭据，因此非浏览器客户端（如移动应用程序），CLI 工具和其他服务器，不需要 CSRF 保护。他们的请求既不包含 `Sec-Fetch-Site` 也不 `Origin`，并且是允许的。

blocks.md: Every evergreen browser has sent `Sec-Fetch-Site` since 2023. Very old browsers that send neither header look like non-browser clients, so their requests are allowed too. If you must protect users of such browsers, add a token-based scheme, as described below.
blocks.text: Every evergreen browser has sent Sec-Fetch-Site since 2023. Very old browsers that send neither header look like non-browser clients, so their requests are allowed too. If you must protect users of such browsers, add a token-based scheme, as described below.
blocks.zh: 每个常青浏览器都发送了 `Sec-Fetch-Site` 自 2023 年起。非常旧的浏览器既不发送标头，看起来就像非浏览器客户端，所以它们的请求也是允许的。如果您必须保护此类浏览器的用户，请添加一个基于令牌的方案，如下所述。

blocks.md: Token-based protection
blocks.text: Token-based protection
blocks.zh: 基于令牌的保护

blocks.md: Token-based schemes store a secret in a cookie or session, and require the client to send a matching token with each state-changing request. They need changes to your client code and a package that depends on the underlying platform.
blocks.text: Token-based schemes store a secret in a cookie or session, and require the client to send a matching token with each state-changing request. They need changes to your client code and a package that depends on the underlying platform.
blocks.zh: 基于令牌的方案将秘密存储在 cookie 或会话中，并要求客户端在每个状态更改请求中发送匹配的令牌。他们需要对您的客户端代码和依赖于底层平台的包进行更改。

blocks.md: Multiple Throttler Definitions
blocks.text: Multiple Throttler Definitions
blocks.zh: 多个节气门定义

blocks.md: Sometimes you want multiple throttling definitions, such as no more than 3 calls per second, 20 calls per 10 seconds, and 100 calls per minute. To do so, define them in the array with named options. You can reference these names later in the `@SkipThrottle()` and `@Throttle()` decorators to change the options per route or controller.

blocks.zh: 有时您需要多个节流定义，例如每秒不超过 3 个呼叫、每 10 秒 20 个呼叫和每分钟 100 个呼叫。为此，请在带有命名选项的数组中定义它们。您可以稍后在 `@SkipThrottle()` 和 `@Throttle()` 装饰器更改每个路由或控制器的选项。

blocks.md: Customization
blocks.text: Customization
blocks.zh: 定制

blocks.md: You may want to bind the guard to a controller or globally, but disable rate limiting for one or more endpoints. For that, use the `@SkipThrottle()` decorator to disable the throttler for an entire class or a single route. The `@SkipThrottle()` decorator also accepts an object with string keys (throttler names) and boolean values. This is useful when you want to exclude _most_ of a controller, but not every route, and to configure skipping per throttler set if you have more than one. If you don't pass an object, the default is `{ default: true }`.

The @SkipThrottle() decorator also accepts an object with string keys (throttler names) and boolean values. This is useful when you want to exclude _most_ of a controller, but not every route, and to configure skipping per throttler set if you have more than one. If you don't pass an object, the default is { default: true }.
blocks.zh: 您可能希望将防护绑定到控制器或全局绑定，但禁用一个或多个端点的速率限制。为此，请使用 `@SkipThrottle()` 装饰器禁用整个类或单个路由的节流阀。`@SkipThrottle()` 装饰器还接受带有字符串键（节流阀名称）和布尔值的对象。当您想要排除控制器的 _most_（但不是每条路线）时，这非常有用，如果您有多个节流阀集，则可以配置每个节流阀集的跳过。如果不传递对象，默认值为 `{ default: true }`。

blocks.md: The `@SkipThrottle()` decorator can skip a route or a class, or negate the skipping of a route within a skipped class.
blocks.text: The @SkipThrottle() decorator can skip a route or a class, or negate the skipping of a route within a skipped class.
blocks.zh: 这个 `@SkipThrottle()` 装饰器可以跳过路由或类，或者在跳过的类中否定路由的跳过。

blocks.md: The `@Throttle()` decorator overrides the `limit` and `ttl` set in the root module, to give tighter or looser security options. You can apply it to a class or a method. Since version 5, the decorator takes an object whose keys are throttler set names and whose values are objects with `limit` and `ttl` keys (and, optionally, `blockDuration`), similar to the options passed to the root module. If you didn't set a name in the root options, use the key `default`:

blocks.md: Configuration

blocks.md: The following options are valid for each object in the array passed to the `ThrottlerModule`:
blocks.text: The following options are valid for each object in the array passed to the ThrottlerModule:
blocks.zh: 以下选项对传递到 `ThrottlerModule` 的数组中的每个对象有效：

blocks.md:
name the name used internally to track which throttler set is in use. Defaults to default if not passed. For named throttlers, the name is also appended to the rate limit response headers (e.g., X-RateLimit-Remaining-long)
ttl the number of milliseconds that each request is kept in storage
limit the maximum number of requests within the TTL
blockDuration the number of milliseconds for which requests are blocked once the limit is reached. Defaults to the ttl value
ignoreUserAgents an array of regular expressions matching user agents to ignore when throttling requests
skipIf a function that takes the ExecutionContext and returns a boolean to short-circuit the throttler logic. Like @SkipThrottle(), but based on the request
getTracker a function that overrides the default tracker logic for this throttler set (see the table below)
generateKey a function that overrides the default key generation logic for this throttler set (see the table below)
setHeaders whether to add the rate limit headers to the response. Defaults to true

To set up a custom storage, or to apply some of the above options globally to every throttler set, pass an options object instead of an array. Define the throttler sets in its `throttlers` property, and use the options in the following table:
blocks.text: To set up a custom storage, or to apply some of the above options globally to every throttler set, pass an options object instead of an array. Define the throttler sets in its throttlers property, and use the options in the following table:
blocks.zh: 若要设置自定义存储，或将上述某些选项全局应用于每个节气门集，请传递选项对象而不是数组。在其中定义节气门组 `throttlers` 属性，并使用下表中的选项：

blocks.md:
storage a custom storage service that keeps track of the throttling. See Storages
ignoreUserAgents an array of regular expressions matching user agents to ignore when throttling requests
skipIf a function that takes the ExecutionContext and returns a boolean to short-circuit the throttler logic. Like @SkipThrottle(), but based on the request
throttlers an array of throttler sets, defined using the table above
errorMessage a string, or a function that takes the ExecutionContext and the ThrottlerLimitDetail and returns a string, which overrides the default throttler error message
getTracker a function that takes the request and the ExecutionContext and returns a string (or a Promise of one), overriding the default logic of the getTracker() method
generateKey a function that takes the ExecutionContext, the tracker string, and the throttler name as a string, and returns the string used as the storage key for the rate limit value. This overrides the default logic of the generateKey() method
setHeaders whether to add the rate limit headers to the response. Defaults to true
ipv6SubnetPrefix the prefix length used to group IPv6 addresses into a single tracker, so that a client cannot evade the limit by rotating through the addresses of its subnet. Applies only to the built-in tracker (not to a custom getTracker). Defaults to 64

chapters.title: Versioning
chapters.summary: Versioning lets you run different versions of your controllers or individual routes within the same application.

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md: This chapter applies only to HTTP-based applications.
blocks.text: This chapter applies only to HTTP-based applications.
blocks.zh: 本章仅适用于 HTTP-基于的应用程序。

blocks.md: Versioning lets you run **different versions** of your controllers or individual routes within the same application. Applications change frequently, and you often need to introduce breaking changes while still supporting the previous version of the application.
blocks.text: Versioning lets you run different versions of your controllers or individual routes within the same application. Applications change frequently, and you often need to introduce breaking changes while still supporting the previous version of the application.
blocks.zh: 版本控制允许您在同一应用程序中运行**不同版本**的控制器或单个路由。应用程序经常更改，您经常需要引入突破性的更改，同时仍然支持应用程序的先前版本。

blocks.md: Nest supports four types of versioning:
blocks.text: Nest supports four types of versioning:
blocks.zh: Nest 支持四种版本控制类型：

blocks.md:
URI Versioning The version is passed within the URI of the request (default)
Header Versioning A custom request header specifies the version
Media Type Versioning The Accept header of the request specifies the version
Custom Versioning Any aspect of the request may specify the version(s). You provide a custom function that extracts the version(s).
URI Versioning Type
blocks.text: URI Versioning Type
blocks.zh: URI 版本类型

blocks.md: URI Versioning uses the version passed within the URI of the request, such as `https://example.com/v1/route` and `https://example.com/v2/route`.
blocks.text: URI Versioning uses the version passed within the URI of the request, such as https://example.com/v1/route and https://example.com/v2/route.
blocks.zh: URI 版本控制使用在请求的 URI 中传递的版本，例如 `https://example.com/v1/route` 和 `https://example.com/v2/route`。

blocks.title: Notice
blocks.md: With URI Versioning, the version is automatically added to the URI after the global path prefix (if one exists) and before any controller or route paths.
blocks.text: With URI Versioning, the version is automatically added to the URI after the global path prefix (if one exists) and before any controller or route paths.
blocks.zh: 和 URI 版本控制，版本会自动添加到 URI 在全局路径前缀（如果存在）之后，在任何控制器或路由路径之前。

blocks.md: By default, the version in the URI is automatically prefixed with `v`. To change the prefix, set the `prefix` key to your desired value, or set it to `false` to disable it.
blocks.text: By default, the version in the URI is automatically prefixed with v. To change the prefix, set the prefix key to your desired value, or set it to false to disable it.

blocks.md: Media Type Versioning uses the `Accept` header of the request to specify the version.
blocks.text: Media Type Versioning uses the Accept header of the request to specify the version.
blocks.zh: 媒体类型版本控制使用 `Accept` 指定版本的请求头。

blocks.md: Within the `Accept` header, the version is separated from the media type with a semicolon (`;`), followed by a key-value pair that represents the version to use for the request, such as `Accept: application/json;v=2`. The key is treated as a prefix for the version, so the `key` property must include both the key and the separator.
blocks.text: Within the Accept header, the version is separated from the media type with a semicolon (;), followed by a key-value pair that represents the version to use for the request, such as Accept: application/json;v=2. The key is treated as a prefix for the version, so the key property must include both the key and the separator.
blocks.zh: 在 `Accept` 标头中，版本与媒体类型用分号(`;`) 分隔，后面跟着表示用于请求的版本的键值对，例如 `Accept: application/json;v=2`。键被视为版本的前缀，因此 `key` 属性必须同时包含键和分隔符。

blocks.md: The `key` property is the key and separator of the key-value pair that contains the version. For `Accept: application/json;v=2`, set the `key` property to `v=`.

blocks.md: Custom Versioning Type
blocks.text: Custom Versioning Type
blocks.zh: 自定义版本控制类型

blocks.md: Custom Versioning uses any aspect of the request to specify the version (or versions). Nest analyzes the incoming request with an `extractor` function that returns a string or an array of strings.
blocks.text: Custom Versioning uses any aspect of the request to specify the version (or versions). Nest analyzes the incoming request with an extractor function that returns a string or an array of strings.
blocks.zh: 自定义版本控制使用请求的任何方面来指定版本。Nest 使用 `extractor` 返回字符串或字符串数组的函数。

blocks.md: If the requester provides multiple versions, the extractor function can return an array of strings sorted from the highest version to the lowest. Versions are matched to routes in order from highest to lowest.
blocks.text: If the requester provides multiple versions, the extractor function can return an array of strings sorted from the highest version to the lowest. Versions are matched to routes in order from highest to lowest.
blocks.zh: 如果请求者提供多个版本，提取器函数可以返回一个字符串数组，从最高版本到最低版本排序。版本按照从高到低的顺序与路线匹配。

blocks.md: If the `extractor` returns an empty string or array, no versioned route is matched, so a request to one receives a `404` response status. [`VERSION_NEUTRAL`](/http/versioning#version-neutral) routes still match, as do routes that do not specify a version when no [global default version](/http/versioning#global-default-version) is set.
blocks.text: If the extractor returns an empty string or array, no versioned route is matched, so a request to one receives a 404 response status. VERSION_NEUTRAL routes still match, as do routes that do not specify a version when no global default version is set.
blocks.zh: 如果 `extractor` 返回一个空字符串或数组，没有匹配版本化的路由，因此对一个的请求会收到一个 `404` 响应状态。[`VERSION_NEUTRAL`](/http/versioning#version-neutral) 路由仍然匹配，不指定版本的路由也是如此 [全局默认版本](/http/versioning#global-default-version) 已经设置好了。

blocks.md: For example, if an incoming request specifies that it supports versions `1`, `2`, and `3`, the `extractor` **must** return `['3', '2', '1']`. This ensures that the highest possible route version is selected first.
blocks.text: For example, if an incoming request specifies that it supports versions 1, 2, and 3, the extractor must return ['3', '2', '1']. This ensures that the highest possible route version is selected first.
blocks.zh: 例如，如果传入请求指定它支持版本 `1`、`2` 和 `3`，则 `extractor` **必须** 返回 `['3', '2', '1']`。这确保首先选择最高可能的路由版本。

blocks.md: If versions `['3', '2', '1']` are extracted, but routes exist only for versions `2` and `1`, the route that matches version `2` is selected (version `3` is ignored).
blocks.text: If versions ['3', '2', '1'] are extracted, but routes exist only for versions 2 and 1, the route that matches version 2 is selected (version 3 is ignored).
blocks.zh: 如果版本 `['3', '2', '1']` 提取，但路由仅存在于版本中 `2` 和 `1`，匹配版本的路由 `2` 已选中（版本 `3` 被忽略）。

blocks.md: With the Express adapter, make your `extractor` return a single version (a string, or an array with one element). Selecting the highest matching version from a multi-element array **does not reliably work** in Express due to design limitations of the adapter. If you need that behavior, use the Fastify adapter, which supports both single-version and highest-matching-version selection.

blocks.md: Usage
blocks.text: Usage
blocks.zh: 使用

blocks.md: Versioning lets you version controllers and individual routes, and also lets certain resources opt out of versioning. Usage is the same regardless of the versioning type your application uses.
blocks.text: Versioning lets you version controllers and individual routes, and also lets certain resources opt out of versioning. Usage is the same regardless of the versioning type your application uses.
blocks.zh: 版本控制允许您对版本控制器和单个路由进行版本控制，也允许某些资源选择退出版本控制。无论应用程序使用何种版本类型，用法都是相同的。

blocks.title: Notice
blocks.md: If versioning is enabled for the application but a controller or route does not specify a version (and no [global default version](/http/versioning#global-default-version) is set), that controller or route behaves like a [`VERSION_NEUTRAL`](/http/versioning#version-neutral) one. With URI Versioning, it is served only at its path without a version (`/cats`, while `/v1/cats` receives a `404` response status). With the other versioning types, it is served whatever version the request contains, or none. A request containing a version that has no corresponding controller or route receives a `404` response status, as does a request without a version when only versioned controllers or routes match its path.
blocks.text: If versioning is enabled for the application but a controller or route does not specify a version (and no global default version is set), that controller or route behaves like a VERSION_NEUTRAL one. With URI Versioning, it is served only at its path without a version (/cats, while /v1/cats receives a 404 response status). chapters.title: Cookies
chapters.summary: An HTTP cookie is a small piece of data that the user's browser stores.

blocks.md: An **HTTP cookie** is a small piece of data that the user's browser stores. Cookies were designed as a reliable mechanism for websites to remember stateful information. When the user visits the website again, the browser automatically sends the cookie with the request.
blocks.text: An HTTP cookie is a small piece of data that the user's browser stores. Cookies were designed as a reliable mechanism for websites to remember stateful information. When the user visits the website again, the browser automatically sends the cookie with the request.
blocks.zh: 到**HTTPcookie**是用户浏览器存储的一小块数据。Cookies 被设计为网站记住状态信息的可靠机制。当用户再次访问网站时，浏览器会自动发送包含请求的 cookie。

blocks.md: Starting with NestJS v12.1, Nest supports cookies out of the box. The same API works on every HTTP adapter (Express, Fastify, or your own adapter extending `AbstractHttpAdapter`), and no extra package is needed:
blocks.text: Starting with NestJS v12.1, Nest supports cookies out of the box. The same API works on every HTTP adapter (Express, Fastify, or your own adapter extending AbstractHttpAdapter), and no extra package is needed:

blocks.md:
- the `@Cookies()` and `@SignedCookies()` parameter decorators read the cookies sent with the request
- the HTTP adapter's `setCookie()` and `clearCookie()` methods write `Set-Cookie` response headers
- the `cookies` application option enables signed cookies, with support for rotating secrets
blocks.text: the @Cookies() and @SignedCookies() parameter decorators read the cookies sent with the request the HTTP adapter's setCookie() and clearCookie() methods write Set-Cookie response headers the cookies application option enables signed cookies, with support for rotating secrets

- 这个 HTTP 适配器的 `setCookie()` 和 `clearCookie()` 方法写入 `Set-Cookie` 响应头
- 这个 `cookies` 应用程序选项启用签名 Cookie，支持旋转秘密

blocks.md: The controller never needs to know the type of the response object: `setCookie()` accepts whatever the underlying platform provides (an Express `Response`, a `FastifyReply`, and so on), which keeps the code platform-agnostic. Each call appends its own `Set-Cookie` header, so all the cookies set while handling a request are sent, on every platform. Because these methods only need the response object, you can also call them from a guard or an interceptor, using `context.switchToHttp().getResponse()`.
blocks.text: The controller never needs to know the type of the response object: setCookie() accepts whatever the underlying platform provides (an Express Response, a FastifyReply, and so on), which keeps the code platform-agnostic. Each call appends its own Set-Cookie header, so all the cookies set while handling a request are sent, on every platform. Because these methods only need the response object, you can also call them from a guard or an interceptor, using context.switchToHttp().getResponse().
blocks.zh: 控制器从来不需要知道响应对象的类型： `setCookie()` 接受底层平台提供的任何内容（ Express `Response`, a `FastifyReply`，等等），这使得代码与平台无关。每个调用都附加自己的 `Set-Cookie` 头，因此在处理请求时设置的所有 cookies 都会在每个平台上发送。因为这些方法只需要响应对象，所以也可以从防护或拦截器调用它们，使用 `context.switchToHttp().getResponse()`.

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md: `setCookie()` and `clearCookie()` are optional members of the `HttpServer` interface. `AbstractHttpAdapter` implements them once, on top of its `appendHeader()` method, so every adapter that extends it (including `ExpressAdapter` and `FastifyAdapter`) supports them.
blocks.text: setCookie() and clearCookie() are optional members of the HttpServer interface. AbstractHttpAdapter implements them once, on top of its appendHeader() method, so every adapter that extends it (including ExpressAdapter and FastifyAdapter) supports them.
blocks.zh: `setCookie()` 和 `clearCookie()` 是可选成员 `HttpServer` 接口。`AbstractHttpAdapter` 实现一次，在其顶部 `appendHeader()` 方法，因此每个扩展它的适配器（包括 `ExpressAdapter` 和 `FastifyAdapter`）支持他们。

blocks.md: The cookie value must be a string. It is always percent-encoded with `encodeURIComponent()` (and decoded again by `@Cookies()`), so any string is safe to store. Convert other types yourself, for example with `JSON.stringify()`.
blocks.text: The cookie value must be a string. It is always percent-encoded with encodeURIComponent() (and decoded again by @Cookies()), so any string is safe to store. Convert other types yourself, for example with JSON.stringify().
blocks.zh: cookie 值必须是字符串。它总是用百分比编码 `encodeURIComponent()` （并再次由 `@Cookies()`），因此任何字符串都可以安全存储。自己转换其他类型，例如使用 `JSON.stringify()`.

blocks.md: The `options` argument (the `CookieSerializeOptions` interface, exported from `@nestjs/common`) accepts the following attributes:
blocks.text: The options argument (the CookieSerializeOptions interface, exported from @nestjs/common) accepts the following attributes:
blocks.zh: 这个 `options` 论点（`CookieSerializeOptions` 接口，从 `@nestjs/common`) 接受以下属性：

blocks.md:
| Option        | Description                                                                                                                             | Default   |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------- |
| `path`        | `Path` attribute.                                                                                                                       | `'/'`     |
| `domain`      | `Domain` attribute. Must be a valid host name, optionally with a leading dot. When omitted, the cookie is host-only.                   | not set   |
| `maxAge`      | `Max-Age` attribute, in **seconds**. Must be an integer.                                                                                | not set   |
| `expires`     | `Expires` attribute, as a `Date`. Browsers give precedence to `maxAge` when both are set.                                              | not set   |
| `httpOnly`    | `HttpOnly` attribute. Hides the cookie from client-side JavaScript.                                                                     | `false`   |
| `secure`      | `Secure` attribute. The browser only sends the cookie over HTTPS.                                                                       | `false`   |
| `sameSite`    | `SameSite` attribute: `'strict'`, `'lax'` or `'none'`. `'none'` requires `secure: true`.                                                | not set   |
| `partitioned` | `Partitioned` attribute (CHIPS). Requires `secure: true`.                                                                               | `false`   |
| `priority`    | `Priority` attribute (non-standard, honored by Chromium): `'low'`, `'medium'` or `'high'`.                                              | not set   |
| `signed`      | Signs the value with the first configured secret. See [Signing cookies](#signing-cookies).                                             | `false`   |
blocks.zh:
| 选择 | 描述 | 默认的 |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------- |
| `path` | `Path` 特征。 | `'/'` |
| `domain` | `Domain` 特征。必须是有效的主机名，可选地带有前导点。省略时，cookie 仅适用于主机。 | 未设置 |
| `maxAge` | `Max-Age` 属性，以**秒**为单位。必须是整数。 | 未设置 |
| `expires` | `Expires` 属性，作为 `Date`。当两者都设置时，浏览器优先考虑 `maxAge`。 | 未设置 |
| `httpOnly` | `HttpOnly` 属性。从客户端隐藏 cookieJavaScript。 | `false` |
| `secure` | `Secure` 属性。浏览器仅通过 HTTPS 发送 cookie。 | `false` |
| `sameSite` | `SameSite` 属性：`'strict'`、`'lax'` 或 `'none'`。`'none'` 需要 `secure: true`。 | 未设置 |
| `partitioned` | `Partitioned` 属性 (CHIPS)。需要 `secure: true`。 | `false` |
| `priority` | `Priority` 属性（非标准，由 Chromium 授予）：`'low'`、`'medium'` 或 `'high'`。 | 未设置 |
| `signed` | 使用第一个配置的秘密对值进行签名。参见 [Signing cookies](#signing-cookies)。 | `false` |

blocks.md: Apart from `path`, no attribute has a default value, `httpOnly` included, which matches the behavior of Express and `@fastify/cookie`. For cookies that carry credentials or session identifiers, set `httpOnly`, `secure` and `sameSite` explicitly.
blocks.text: Apart from path, no attribute has a default value, httpOnly included, which matches the behavior of Express and @fastify/cookie. For cookies that carry credentials or session identifiers, set httpOnly, secure and sameSite explicitly.
blocks.zh: 除了 `path` 之外，没有任何属性具有默认值，包括 `httpOnly`，它与 Express 和 `@fastify/cookie` 的行为相匹配。对于携带凭据或会话标识符的 Cookie，请显式设置 `httpOnly`、`secure` 和 `sameSite`。

blocks.title: Warning
blocks.md: `maxAge` is expressed in **seconds**, as in RFC 6265 and `@fastify/cookie`. Express' `res.cookie()` method takes `maxAge` in **milliseconds**, so a value carried over from it unchanged makes the cookie live 1000 times longer. For one day, pass `60 * 60 * 24`.
blocks.text: maxAge is expressed in seconds, as in RFC 6265 and @fastify/cookie. Express' res.cookie() method takes maxAge in milliseconds, so a value carried over from it unchanged makes the cookie live 1000 times longer. For one day, pass 60 * 60 * 24.
blocks.zh: `maxAge` 以**秒**表示，如 RFC 6265 和 `@fastify/cookie`. Express' `res.cookie()` 方法需要 `maxAge` 以**毫秒**为单位，因此一个不变的值可以使 cookie 的寿命延长 1000 倍。一天，通过 `60 * 60 * 24`.

blocks.md: `clearCookie()` writes an empty cookie with `Max-Age=0` and an `Expires` date in the past. Browsers only remove a cookie when the `path` and `domain` match the ones it was set with, so pass the same values to both methods. Since `path` defaults to `/` in both of them, `clearCookie(res, 'theme')` clears a cookie set with `setCookie(res, 'theme', value)`. The `maxAge`, `expires` and `signed` options are ignored by `clearCookie()`.
blocks.text: clearCookie() writes an empty cookie with Max-Age=0 and an Expires date in the past. Browsers only remove a cookie when the path and domain match the ones it was set with, so pass the same values to both methods. Since path defaults to / in both of them, clearCookie(res, 'theme') clears a cookie set with setCookie(res, 'theme', value). The maxAge, expires and signed options are ignored by clearCookie().
blocks.zh: `clearCookie()` 用过去的 `Max-Age=0` 和 `Expires` 日期写入一个空 cookie。浏览器仅在 `path` 和 `domain` 与设置的 cookie 匹配时删除 cookie，因此将相同的值传递给两种方法。由于 `path` 在两者中都默认为 `/`，因此 `clearCookie(res, 'theme')` 清除了带有 `setCookie(res, 'theme', value)` 的 cookie 集。`clearCookie()` 忽略了 `maxAge`、`expires` 和 `signed` 选项。

blocks.md: Signing cookies
blocks.text: Signing cookies
blocks.zh: 签名 cookies

blocks.md: A signed cookie carries an HMAC signature next to its value, which lets the server detect whether the client tampered with it. To enable signing, pass a secret through the `cookies` option of the `NestFactory.create()` method:
blocks.text: A signed cookie carries an HMAC signature next to its value, which lets the server detect whether the client tampered with it. To enable signing, pass a secret through the cookies option of the NestFactory.create() method:
blocks.zh: 签名 cookie 携带 HMAC 其值旁边的签名，这可以让服务器检测客户端是否篡改了它。若要启用签名，请通过 `cookies` 选择权 `NestFactory.create()` 方法：

blocks.md: Then, set cookies with the `signed` option and read them back with the `@SignedCookies()` decorator:
blocks.text: Then, set cookies with the signed option and read them back with the @SignedCookies() decorator:
blocks.zh: 然后，使用 `signed` 选项并用 `@SignedCookies()` 装饰师：

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md: Import the `@SignedCookies()` decorator from the `@nestjs/common` package.
blocks.text: Import the @SignedCookies() decorator from the @nestjs/common package.
blocks.zh: 导入 `@SignedCookies()` 装饰师 `@nestjs/common` 包装。

blocks.md: `@SignedCookies('uid')` resolves to the original, unsigned value when the signature verifies. When the cookie is missing, is not signed, was tampered with, or was signed with a secret that is not configured, it resolves to `undefined`. Called without a name, `@SignedCookies()` returns an object that contains only the cookies whose signature verifies. Like `@Cookies()`, it accepts pipes after the cookie name.
blocks.text: @SignedCookies('uid') resolves to the original, unsigned value when the signature verifies. When the cookie is missing, is not signed, was tampered with, or was signed with a secret that is not configured, it resolves to undefined. Called without a name, @SignedCookies() returns an object that contains only the cookies whose signature verifies. Like @Cookies(), it accepts pipes after the cookie name.
blocks.zh: `@SignedCookies('uid')` 当签名验证时，解析为原始的未签名值。当 cookie 丢失、未签名、被篡改或使用未配置的秘密签名时，它会解析为 `undefined`.无名打电话， `@SignedCookies()` 返回一个对象，该对象仅包含其签名验证的 cookies。喜欢 `@Cookies()`，它接受 cookie 名称后的管道。

blocks.md: Signing fails loudly when no secret is configured: `setCookie()` with the `signed` option throws an error, and so does resolving a `@SignedCookies()` parameter (unless `cookie-parser` provides signed cookies, see [below](#using-cookie-parser-or-fastifycookie)), which results in a `500 Internal Server Error` response instead of every signed cookie silently reading as `undefined`. An empty secret (an empty string, an empty array, or an array with an empty entry) throws when the application is created.
blocks.text: Signing fails loudly when no secret is configured: setCookie() with the signed option throws an error, and so does resolving a @SignedCookies() parameter (unless cookie-parser provides signed cookies, see below), which results in a 500 Internal Server Error response instead of every signed cookie silently reading as undefined. An empty secret (an empty string, an empty array, or an array with an empty entry) throws when the application is created.
blocks.zh: 当没有配置秘密时，签名会大声失败：`setCookie()` 带有 `signed` 选项会抛出错误，解析 `@SignedCookies()` 参数也会抛出错误（除非 `cookie-parser` 提供签名 cookie，请参见 [以下](#using-cookie-parser-or-fastifycookie)），这会导致 `500 Internal Server Error` 响应，而不是每个签名 cookie 默认读取为 `undefined`。创建应用程序时抛出一个空秘密（空字符串、空数组或具有空条目的数组）。

blocks.title: Warning
blocks.md: A `secret` that is `undefined`, for example because an environment variable is not set, counts as no secret at all. The application starts, and the error only surfaces when a request sets or reads a signed cookie. Validate your configuration at startup, for example as described in the [Configuration](/application/configuration#schema-validation) chapter.
blocks.text: A secret that is undefined, for example because an environment variable is not set, counts as no secret at all. The application starts, and the error only surfaces when a request sets or reads a signed cookie. Validate your configuration at startup, for example as described in the Configuration chapter.
blocks.zh: 一个 `secret` 那就是 `undefined` 例如，因为没有设置环境变量，所以根本算不上秘密。应用程序启动，只有当请求设置或读取签名的 cookie 时，错误才会出现。在启动时验证您的配置，例如 [Configuration](/application/configuration#schema-validation) 篇章。

blocks.title: Warning
blocks.md: Signing protects the integrity of a cookie, not its confidentiality: the value is stored in plain text, and the client can read it. Do not store sensitive data in a signed cookie. Also note that, as with the `cookie-signature` package, the cookie name is not part of the signed data, so a value signed for one cookie also verifies when the client sends it under another name.
blocks.text: Signing protects the integrity of a cookie, not its confidentiality: the value is stored in plain text, and the client can read it. Do not store sensitive data in a signed cookie. Also note that, as with the cookie-signature package, the cookie name is not part of the signed data, so a value signed for one cookie also verifies when the client sends it under another name.
blocks.zh: 签名保护的是 cookie 的完整性，而不是它的机密性：值以纯文本存储，客户端可以读取它。不要将敏感数据存储在签名的 cookie 中。还要注意，与 `cookie-signature` 包，cookie 名称不是签名数据的一部分，因此为一个 cookie 签名的值也会验证客户端何时以另一个名称发送它。

blocks.md: Rotating secrets
blocks.text: Rotating secrets
blocks.zh: 旋转秘密

blocks.md: To replace a secret without invalidating the cookies signed with it, pass an array of secrets. Nest signs new cookies with the first secret and verifies incoming cookies against all of them:
blocks.text: To replace a secret without invalidating the cookies signed with it, pass an array of secrets. Nest signs new cookies with the first secret and verifies incoming cookies against all of them:
blocks.zh: 若要替换一个秘密而不使与其签名的 cookie 失效，请传递一个秘密数组。Nest 使用第一个秘密标记新的 cookie，并根据所有传入的 cookie 进行验证：

blocks.md: To rotate, add the new secret at the beginning of the array, and remove the previous one once every cookie signed with it has expired. Signatures are compared in constant time, and against every secret, so the response time does not reveal which secret matched.
blocks.text: To rotate, add the new secret at the beginning of the array, and remove the previous one once every cookie signed with it has expired. Signatures are compared in constant time, and against every secret, so the response time does not reveal which secret matched.
blocks.zh: 若要旋转，请在数组的开头添加新的秘密，并在每个与其签名的 cookie 过期后删除前一个秘密。签名在恒定的时间内进行比较，并针对每个秘密进行比较，因此响应时间不会揭示哪个秘密匹配。

blocks.md: Signature format
blocks.text: Signature format
blocks.zh: 签名格式

blocks.md: Nest signs cookies in the format of the `cookie-signature` package, which `cookie-parser` and `express-session` use as well: the `s:` prefix, followed by the value, a dot, and the HMAC-SHA256 digest of the value in base64, without padding. As a result:
blocks.text: Nest signs cookies in the format of the cookie-signature package, which cookie-parser and express-session use as well: the s: prefix, followed by the value, a dot, and the HMAC-SHA256 digest of the value in base64, without padding. As a result:
blocks.zh: Nest 格式为 cookies 签名 `cookie-signature` 包，其中 `cookie-parser` 和 `express-session` 也可以使用：`s:` 前缀，后跟值、点和 HMAC-SHA256base64 中值的摘要，没有填充。结果：

blocks.md:
- cookies signed with the same secret by Express (the `signed` option of `res.cookie()`), `cookie-parser` or `express-session` keep verifying after you move to the built-in API, and `cookie-parser` can verify cookies signed by Nest
- values signed by `@fastify/cookie`, which omits the `s:` prefix, verify as well. The opposite direction does not work: the `unsignCookie()` method of `@fastify/cookie` cannot verify cookies signed by Nest, because of the `s:` prefix

blocks.md: `setCookie()` and `clearCookie()` reject invalid input instead of escaping it, so neither a cookie name nor an attribute can inject additional attributes or headers through `;`, CR or LF characters. They throw a `TypeError` when:

blocks.md: Before the built-in support was available, reading cookies required the `cookie-parser` middleware (Express) or the `@fastify/cookie` plugin (Fastify). Applications that use them keep working, and the built-in decorators cooperate with them:
blocks.text: Before the built-in support was available, reading cookies required the cookie-parser middleware (Express) or the @fastify/cookie plugin (Fastify). Applications that use them keep working, and the built-in decorators cooperate with them:
blocks.zh: 在内置支持可用之前，读取 cookies 需要 `cookie-parser` 中间件（Express）或 `@fastify/cookie` 插件（Fastify）。使用它们的应用程序继续工作，内置装饰器与它们协作：

blocks.md:
- `@Cookies()` returns `req.cookies` as is whenever a middleware or plugin has populated it, and only parses the `Cookie` header itself otherwise. The behavior of that package therefore carries over. For example, `cookie-parser` moves signed cookies from `req.cookies` to `req.signedCookies` when it is given a secret, and turns `j:`-prefixed JSON cookies into objects.
- When the `cookies.secret` application option is set, `@SignedCookies()` always verifies the raw `Cookie` header against the Nest secrets, and ignores `req.signedCookies`. Configure the same secret (or secrets) as your middleware, so that the cookies it signed keep verifying.
- Without the `cookies.secret` option, `@SignedCookies()` falls back to the `req.signedCookies` object populated by `cookie-parser` (when it is given a secret), and treats the cookies it marked as invalid as missing. `@fastify/cookie` does not populate `req.signedCookies`, so on Fastify, `@SignedCookies()` requires the `cookies.secret` option.

- `@Cookies()` 回报 `req.cookies` 中间件或插件填充了它，并且只解析 `Cookie` 否则标题本身。因此，该包的行为会继续下去。例如，`cookie-parser` 将签名的 cookie 从 `req.cookies` 二 `req.signedCookies` 当它被赋予一个秘密，并转向 `j:`-前缀 JSON 将 cookies 变成对象。
- 当设置了 `cookies.secret` 应用程序选项时，`@SignedCookies()` 总是根据 Nest 秘密验证原始 `Cookie` 标头，并忽略 `req.signedCookies`。配置与您的中间件相同的秘密，以便它签名的 cookies 保持验证。
- 没有 `cookies.secret` 选项，`@SignedCookies()` 回到 `req.signedCookies` 对象由 `cookie-parser`（当它被赋予秘密时），并将其标记为无效的 cookies 视为丢失。`@fastify/cookie` 不填充 `req.signedCookies`,等等 Fastify,`@SignedCookies()` 需要 `cookies.secret` 选择。

blocks.md: Nest never assigns `req.cookies` itself. If you remove `cookie-parser` or `@fastify/cookie`, replace any code that reads `request.cookies` (or calls `reply.setCookie()`) with the built-in decorators and adapter methods. Likewise, if your application defines its own `@Cookies()` decorator with `createParamDecorator()`, you can replace it with the built-in one. When you replace `res.cookie()` calls with `setCookie()`, remember to convert `maxAge` from milliseconds to seconds.

blocks.title: Notice
blocks.md: The default server-side session storage is purposely not designed for a production environment. It leaks memory under most conditions, does not scale past a single process, and is meant for debugging and development. Read more in the [express-session repository](https://github.com/expressjs/session).

blocks.md: The `secret` is used to sign the session ID cookie. It can be either a string (a single secret) or an array of secrets. If you provide an array, only the first element is used to sign the session ID cookie, while all elements are considered when verifying the signature in requests. The secret should not be easily guessed; a random set of characters works best.

If you provide an array, only the first element is used to sign the session ID cookie, while all elements are considered when verifying the signature in requests. The secret should not be easily guessed; a random set of characters works best.
blocks.zh: 这个 `secret` 用于签名会话 ID 曲奇。它可以是一个字符串（单个秘密），也可以是一个秘密数组。如果提供数组，则只有第一个元素用于签名会话 IDcookie，而在验证请求中的签名时会考虑所有元素。秘密不应该轻易猜到；一组随机的字符效果最好。

blocks.md: Enabling the `resave` option forces the session to be saved back to the session store, even if the session was never modified during the request. The default value is `true`, but relying on the default is deprecated because the default will change in the future.
blocks.text: Enabling the resave option forces the session to be saved back to the session store, even if the session was never modified during the request. The default value is true, but relying on the default is deprecated because the default will change in the future.
blocks.zh: 启用 `resave` 选项强制将会话保存回会话存储区，即使在请求期间从未修改过会话。默认值为 `true`，但不推荐依赖默认值，因为默认值将来会更改。

blocks.md: Likewise, enabling the `saveUninitialized` option forces a session that is "uninitialized" to be saved to the store. A session is uninitialized when it is new but not modified. Choosing `false` is useful for implementing login sessions, reducing server storage usage, or complying with laws that require permission before setting a cookie. Choosing `false` also helps with race conditions where a client makes multiple parallel requests without a session (see the [`saveUninitialized` documentation](https://github.com/expressjs/session#saveuninitialized)).

Choosing false also helps with race conditions where a client makes multiple parallel requests without a session (see the saveUninitialized documentation).
blocks.zh: 同样，启用 `saveUninitialized` 选项强制将“未初始化”的会话保存到存储。当会话是新的但未修改时，会话未初始化。选择 `false` 对于实现登录会话、减少服务器存储使用或遵守在设置 cookie 之前需要许可的法律非常有用。选择 `false` 对于客户端在没有会话的情况下发出多个并行请求的竞争情况也有帮助（请参见 [`saveUninitialized` documentation](https://github.com/expressjs/session#saveuninitialized)).

chapters.summary: This chapter covers files in both directions: receiving files that clients upload, and streaming files back to clients.

blocks.md: To handle file uploads, Nest provides a built-in module based on the [multer](https://github.com/expressjs/multer) middleware package for Express. Multer handles data posted in the `multipart/form-data` format, which is primarily used to upload files with an HTTP `POST` request. The module is fully configurable, so you can adjust its behavior to your application's requirements.

The module is fully configurable, so you can adjust its behavior to your application's requirements.
blocks.zh: 要处理文件上传， Nest 提供基于 [穆尔特](https://github.com/expressjs/multer) 中间件包 Express.Multer 处理发布在 `multipart/form-data` 格式，主要用于上传文件 HTTP `POST` 请求。该模块是完全可配置的，因此您可以根据应用程序的需求调整其行为。

blocks.md: Memory usage and storage
blocks.text: Memory usage and storage
blocks.zh: 内存使用和存储

blocks.md: By default, Multer uses its in-memory storage engine (`memoryStorage()`): every uploaded file is read completely into memory and exposed as a `Buffer` on `file.buffer` before your route handler runs. This is convenient for small files (avatars or CSV imports), but each in-flight upload occupies as much memory as its size, so large files or many concurrent uploads can quickly exhaust the memory of your process.
blocks.text: By default, Multer uses its in-memory storage engine (memoryStorage()): every uploaded file is read completely into memory and exposed as a Buffer on file.buffer before your route handler runs. This is convenient for small files (avatars or CSV imports), but each in-flight upload occupies as much memory as its size, so large files or many concurrent uploads can quickly exhaust the memory of your process.
blocks.zh: 默认情况下，Multer 使用其内存存储引擎（`memoryStorage()`）：每个上传的文件都被完全读入内存，并作为 `Buffer` 在 `file.buffer` 在路由处理程序运行之前。这对于小文件（头像或 CSV 导入），但每次飞行中上传占用的内存与其大小一样多，因此大文件或许多并发上传会很快耗尽进程的内存。

blocks.title: Warning
blocks.md: Multer does not limit the size of uploaded files by default. When you keep files in memory, always set `limits.fileSize`.
blocks.text: Multer does not limit the size of uploaded files by default. When you keep files in memory, always set limits.fileSize.
blocks.zh: 默认情况下，Multer 不限制上传文件的大小。将文件保存在内存中时，始终设置 `limits.fileSize`。

blocks.md: File size limit
blocks.text: File size limit
blocks.zh: 文件大小限制

blocks.md: Use the `limits` option to reject files that are too large. When a limit is exceeded, Nest responds with a `413 File too large` error (for `fileSize`) or `400 Bad Request` (for other limits, such as `files`) and the route handler is not called.
blocks.text: Use the limits option to reject files that are too large. When a limit is exceeded, Nest responds with a 413 File too large error (for fileSize) or 400 Bad Request (for other limits, such as files) and the route handler is not called.
blocks.zh: 使用 `limits` 拒绝太大文件的选项。当超过限制时，Nest 回应一个 `413 File too large` 错误（对于 `fileSize`）或 `400 Bad Request`（对于其他限制，例如 `files`) 并且不调用路由处理程序。

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md: Unlike `MaxFileSizeValidator`, which runs after the whole file has been received, `limits.fileSize` makes Multer stop storing the file and reject the request as soon as the limit is reached, so oversized files never fully reach memory or disk. See the [Multer limits](https://github.com/expressjs/multer#limits) for the full list of options.
blocks.text: Unlike MaxFileSizeValidator, which runs after the whole file has been received, limits.fileSize makes Multer stop storing the file and reject the request as soon as the limit is reached, so oversized files never fully reach memory or disk. See the Multer limits for the full list of options.
blocks.zh: 不像 `MaxFileSizeValidator`，在接收到整个文件后运行，`limits.fileSize` 使 Multer 停止存储文件，并在达到限制后立即拒绝请求，因此过大的文件永远不会完全到达内存或磁盘。参见 [Multer limits](https://github.com/expressjs/multer#limits) 查看完整的选项列表。

blocks.md: Field name limits
blocks.text: Field name limits
blocks.zh: 字段名限制

blocks.md: Field names such as `user[address][city]` or `tags[2]` build nested objects and arrays in the request body. Two limits bound them: `fieldNestingDepth`, the number of nesting levels (`a[b][c]` has 2), and `fieldArrayIndexLimit`, the highest array index (`tags[2]` uses index 2). A request that exceeds either one is rejected with a `400 Bad Request` response. Starting with NestJS v12.1.4, they default to 32 and 1000 respectively (Multer leaves them unlimited), so that a single request cannot build an arbitrarily deep body or a huge array. Set a limit to `Infinity` to lift it.
blocks.text: Field names such as user[address][city] or tags[2] build nested objects and arrays in the request body. Two limits bound them: fieldNestingDepth, the number of nesting levels (a[b][c] has 2), and fieldArrayIndexLimit, the highest array index (tags[2] uses index 2). A request that exceeds either one is rejected with a 400 Bad Request response. Starting with NestJS v12.1.4, they default to 32 and 1000 respectively (Multer leaves them unlimited), so that a single request cannot build an arbitrarily deep body or a huge array. Set a limit to Infinity to lift it.
blocks.zh: 字段名，例如 `user[address][city]` 或者 `tags[2]` 在请求主体中构建嵌套对象和数组。有两个限制：`fieldNestingDepth`，嵌套级数（`a[b][c]` 有 2），并且 `fieldArrayIndexLimit`，最高数组索引（`tags[2]` 使用索引 2）。超过其中任何一个的请求将被拒绝 `400 Bad Request` 回应。从 NestJSv12.1.4，它们分别默认为 32 和 1000（Multer 让它们不受限制），这样单个请求就无法构建任意深的主体或巨大的数组。将限制设置为 `Infinity` 把它抬起来。

blocks.md: Disk storage
blocks.text: Disk storage
blocks.zh: 磁盘存储

blocks.md: To keep memory usage constant regardless of file size, write uploads to disk with the `diskStorage()` engine. Multer then streams each file to disk as it arrives, and the file object exposes `destination`, `filename` and `path` instead of `buffer`.
blocks.text: To keep memory usage constant regardless of file size, write uploads to disk with the diskStorage() engine. Multer then streams each file to disk as it arrives, and the file object exposes destination, filename and path instead of buffer.
blocks.zh: 无论文件大小如何，要保持内存使用恒定，请使用 `diskStorage()` 引擎将上传内容写入磁盘。然后，Multer 在每个文件到达时将其流式传输到磁盘，文件对象公开 `destination`、`filename` 和 `path`，而不是 `buffer`。

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md: The `diskStorage()` and `memoryStorage()` functions are exported from the `multer` package. As a shorthand, pass `dest: './uploads'` to store files on disk under random names. If you pass a `destination` function instead of a string, you are responsible for creating the directory.
blocks.text: The diskStorage() and memoryStorage() functions are exported from the multer package. As a shorthand, pass dest: './uploads' to store files on disk under random names. If you pass a destination function instead of a string, you are responsible for creating the directory.
blocks.zh: 这个 `diskStorage()` 和 `memoryStorage()` 函数从 `multer` 包装。作为速记，pass`dest: './uploads'` 将文件以随机名称存储在磁盘上。如果你通过了 `destination` 函数而不是字符串，您负责创建目录。

blocks.md: To apply the same storage and limits to every file interceptor in a module, set them as [default options](/http/file-upload#default-options) or with [async configuration](/http/file-upload#async-configuration).
blocks.text: To apply the same storage and limits to every file interceptor in a module, set them as default options or with async configuration.
blocks.zh: 要对模块中的每个文件拦截器应用相同的存储和限制，请将它们设置为 [默认选项](/http/file-upload#default-options) 或带有 [异步配置](/http/file-upload#async-configuration)。

blocks.md: Files stored on disk are not removed automatically once your route handler has run. Delete them (for example with `unlink()` from `fs/promises`) once you have processed them, including when processing fails. Starting with NestJS v12.1.4, if a pipe rejects the request (for example, because `ParseFilePipe` validation fails), the route handler does not run, and the stored files are removed once the error response has been sent.
blocks.text: Files stored on disk are not removed automatically once your route handler has run. Delete them (for example with unlink() from fs/promises) once you have processed them, including when processing fails. Starting with NestJS v12.1.4, if a pipe rejects the request (for example, because ParseFilePipe validation fails), the route handler does not run, and the stored files are removed once the error response has been sent.
blocks.zh: 一旦路由处理程序运行，存储在磁盘上的文件不会自动删除。删除它们（例如使用 `unlink()` 来自 `fs/promises`) 一旦您处理了它们，包括处理失败时。从 NestJSv12.1.4，如果管道拒绝请求（例如，因为 `ParseFilePipe` 验证失败），路由处理程序不运行，并且在发送错误响应后删除存储的文件。

blocks.md: Sending files to external storage
blocks.text: Sending files to external storage
blocks.zh: 将文件发送到外部存储

blocks.md: To store uploads in S3, Cloudflare R2 or another external store without buffering them in memory or writing a temporary file, use a storage engine that streams each file to its destination as it arrives. The [`@nestjs/storage`](/application/file-storage) package provides one, `uploadToDisk()`, which you pass as the `storage` option of `FileInterceptor()`. See [Upload product photos](/application/file-storage#upload-product-photos). Any other Multer [storage engine](https://github.com/expressjs/multer/blob/main/StorageEngine.md) works the same way.
blocks.text: To store uploads in S3, Cloudflare R2 or another external store without buffering them in memory or writing a temporary file, use a storage engine that streams each file to its destination as it arrives. The @nestjs/storage package provides one, uploadToDisk(), which you pass as the storage option of FileInterceptor(). See Upload product photos. Any other Multer storage engine works the same way.
blocks.zh: 若要将上传内容存储在 S3、Cloudflare R2 或其他外部存储中，而不将其缓冲在内存中或写入临时文件，请使用存储引擎，在每个文件到达时将其流式传输到目的地。[`@nestjs/storage`](/application/file-storage) 包提供了一个 `uploadToDisk()`，您可以将其作为 `FileInterceptor()` 的 `storage` 选项传递。见 [Upload product photos](/application/file-storage#upload-product-photos)。任何其他 Multer[存储引擎](https://github.com/expressjs/multer/blob/main/StorageEngine.md) 都以同样的方式工作。

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md: On the `FastifyAdapter`, you can also receive the file as a stream inside the route handler with `FileStreamInterceptor()`. See [Streaming uploads](/http/file-upload#streaming-uploads).
blocks.text: On the FastifyAdapter, you can also receive the file as a stream inside the route handler with FileStreamInterceptor(). See Streaming uploads.
blocks.zh: 在 `FastifyAdapter` 上，您也可以使用 `FileStreamInterceptor()` 在路由处理程序中以流的形式接收文件。参见 [Streaming uploads](/http/file-upload#streaming-uploads)。

blocks.md: Fastify
blocks.text: Fastify
blocks.zh: Fastify

blocks.md: Starting with NestJS v12.1, applications running on the `FastifyAdapter` (see [Performance (Fastify)](/http/performance)) can handle file uploads with the same API, backed by the [@fastify/multipart](https://github.com/fastify/fastify-multipart) plugin instead of Multer. The interceptors described in this chapter take the same arguments and options, populate the request in the same way, and fail with the same error responses, while `@UploadedFile()`, `@UploadedFiles()`, `ParseFilePipe`, `ParseFilePipeBuilder` and the built-in file validators work unchanged.
blocks.text: Starting with NestJS v12.1, applications running on the FastifyAdapter (see Performance (Fastify)) can handle file uploads with the same API, backed by the @fastify/multipart plugin instead of Multer. The interceptors described in this chapter take the same arguments and options, populate the request in the same way, and fail with the same error responses, while @UploadedFile(), @UploadedFiles(), ParseFilePipe, ParseFilePipeBuilder and the built-in file validators work unchanged.
blocks.zh: 从 NestJSv12.1，运行在 `FastifyAdapter`（见 [Performance (Fastify)](/http/performance)）可以处理文件上传 API，由 [@fastify/multipart](https://github.com/fastify/fastify-multipart) 插件而不是 Multer。本章中描述的拦截器采用相同的参数和选项，以相同的方式填充请求，并以相同的错误响应失败，而 `@UploadedFile()`,`@UploadedFiles()`,`ParseFilePipe`,`ParseFilePipeBuilder` 内置的文件验证器工作不变。

blocks.text: First, install the plugin:

blocks.md: The interceptor options are the ones Multer accepts: `dest`, `storage`, `limits` (an object, or a function that receives the request and returns one), `fileFilter`, `preservePath` and `defParamCharset`. Uploaded files are exposed as `req.file` or `req.files` and text fields as `req.body`, exactly as with Multer. `UploadedMultipartFile` has the same shape as `Express.Multer.File`, so you don't need the `@types/multer` package.

blocks.md: `MultipartModule` sets default options for the upload interceptors of the module that imports it, just like `MulterModule`. Its `registerAsync()` method accepts `useFactory` (with `imports` and `inject`), `useClass` and `useExisting`.

blocks.md: Storage
blocks.text: Storage
blocks.zh: 存储

blocks.md: As with Multer, files are kept in memory (in `file.buffer`) unless you set the `dest` or `storage` option. `dest` writes each file to the given folder under a random name, and the `diskStorage()` function lets you choose the folder and the file name. Disk storage sets `destination`, `filename` and `path` on the file instead of `buffer`.
blocks.text: As with Multer, files are kept in memory (in file.buffer) unless you set the dest or storage option. dest writes each file to the given folder under a random name, and the diskStorage() function lets you choose the folder and the file name. Disk storage sets destination, filename and path on the file instead of buffer.
blocks.zh: 与 Multer 一样，文件保存在内存中（在 `file.buffer` 中），除非您设置了 `dest` 或 `storage` 选项。`dest` 将每个文件以随机名称写入给定的文件夹，`diskStorage()` 函数允许您选择文件夹和文件名。在文件上设置磁盘存储集 `destination`、`filename` 和 `path`，而不是 `buffer`。

blocks.md: Storage engines follow Multer's storage engine contract (`_handleFile()` and `_removeFile()`), so Multer's own `multer.diskStorage()` and third-party Multer storage engines can be passed as `storage` unchanged.
blocks.text: Storage engines follow Multer's storage engine contract (_handleFile() and _removeFile()), so Multer's own multer.diskStorage() and third-party Multer storage engines can be passed as storage unchanged.

blocks.text: Limits
blocks.zh: 限制

Unless configured otherwise, the maximum file size (`fileSize`) is the Fastify `bodyLimit` (1 MiB by default) and the maximum number of parts (`parts`) is 1000, whereas Multer limits neither. Larger files are rejected with a `413 File too large` response. You can raise these limits:

blocks.md: Plugin registration
blocks.text: Plugin registration
blocks.zh: 插件注册

blocks.md: The `multipart` option of the `FastifyAdapter` controls how the `@fastify/multipart` plugin is registered:
blocks.text: The multipart option of the FastifyAdapter controls how the @fastify/multipart plugin is registered:
blocks.zh: 这个 `multipart` 选择权 `FastifyAdapter` 控制如何 `@fastify/multipart` 插件已注册：

blocks.md:
- not set (default): the adapter registers the plugin when an upload interceptor is used, unless it has been registered already
- an options object (`FastifyMultipartOptions`, e.g., `limits`): the adapter registers the plugin with these options when the application initializes
- `true`: same as above, with the plugin's default options
- `false`: the adapter never registers the plugin, for applications that register it themselves or parse multipart requests with another library (the upload interceptors still require `@fastify/multipart`, and the application fails to start if it is not registered)
blocks.text: not set (default): the adapter registers the plugin when an upload interceptor is used, unless it has been registered already an options object (FastifyMultipartOptions, e.g., limits): the adapter registers the plugin with these options when the application initializes true: same as above, with the plugin's default options false: the adapter never registers the plugin, for applications that register it themselves or parse multipart requests with another library (the upload interceptors still require @fastify/multipart, and the application fails to start if it is not registered)
blocks.zh:
- 未设置（默认值）：当使用上传拦截器时，适配器会注册插件，除非它已经注册
- 选项对象（`FastifyMultipartOptions`，例如，`limits`)：当应用程序初始化时，适配器用这些选项注册插件
- `true`：与上面相同，使用插件的默认选项
- `false`：适配器从不注册插件，对于自己注册插件或使用另一个库解析多部分请求的应用程序（上传拦截器仍然需要 `@fastify/multipart`，如果未注册，应用程序将无法启动）

blocks.md: Set the option to `true` (or pass an options object) when an upload interceptor is instantiated outside the dependency injection system, for example `new (FileInterceptor('file'))()` passed to `app.useGlobalInterceptors()`, as it doesn't trigger the automatic registration. The same applies when upload interceptors are only used in [lazy-loaded modules](/fundamentals/lazy-loading-modules) that are loaded after the application has started, since plugins can no longer be registered at that point.

blocks.md: If you prefer to register the plugin yourself, pass it to `app.register()`, either before or after `app.init()`. The adapter takes this registration over, so the plugin is registered only once, and your options take precedence over the ones passed through the `multipart` option:
