blocks.title: Warning
blocks.md: Registering `@fastify/multipart` directly on the Fastify instance (`app.getHttpAdapter().getInstance().register(multipart)`), or passing a dynamic `import()` of it to `app.register()`, only works before `app.init()` (which `app.listen()` calls for you). After that, the adapter has already registered the plugin for your upload interceptors, and Fastify fails with an `FST_ERR_DEC_ALREADY_PRESENT` error. Use `app.register(multipart)` or the `multipart` option instead, or set the option to `false` to manage the plugin yourself.
blocks.text: Registering @fastify/multipart directly on the Fastify instance (app.getHttpAdapter().getInstance().register(multipart)), or passing a dynamic import() of it to app.register(), only works before app.init() (which app.listen() calls for you). After that, the adapter has already registered the plugin for your upload interceptors, and Fastify fails with an FST_ERR_DEC_ALREADY_PRESENT error. Use app.register(multipart) or the multipart option instead, or set the option to false to manage the plugin yourself.
blocks.zh: 注册 `@fastify/multipart` 直接在 Fastify 实例（`app.getHttpAdapter().getInstance().register(multipart)`），或传递动态 `import()` 它到 `app.register()`，只在之前有效 `app.init()`（哪个 `app.listen()` 呼唤你）。之后，适配器已经为您的上传拦截器注册了插件，并且 Fastify 失败 `FST_ERR_DEC_ALREADY_PRESENT` 错误。使用 `app.register(multipart)` 或者 `multipart` 选项，或将选项设置为 `false` 自己管理插件。

blocks.md: Streaming uploads
blocks.text: Streaming uploads
blocks.zh: 流式上传

blocks.md: The interceptors described so far store every file (in memory or on disk) before the route handler runs. To process a file as it arrives instead, for example to pipe a large upload to its final destination, use `FileStreamInterceptor()`, which is available on Fastify only. It takes the name of the field that holds the file and an optional options object (the same as for the other interceptors, except `dest` and `storage`), and hands the route handler a file with a `stream` property in place of `buffer`:
blocks.text: The interceptors described so far store every file (in memory or on disk) before the route handler runs. To process a file as it arrives instead, for example to pipe a large upload to its final destination, use FileStreamInterceptor(), which is available on Fastify only. It takes the name of the field that holds the file and an optional options object (the same as for the other interceptors, except dest and storage), and hands the route handler a file with a stream property in place of buffer:
blocks.zh: 到目前为止描述的拦截器在路由处理程序运行之前存储每个文件（在内存中或磁盘上）。要在文件到达时对其进行处理，例如将大型上传文件通过管道传输到其最终目的地，请使用仅在 Fastify 上可用的 `FileStreamInterceptor()`。它获取保存文件的字段名称和可选的选项对象（与其他拦截器相同，除了 `dest` 和 `storage`），并将具有 `stream` 属性的文件交给路由处理程序，而不是 `buffer`：

blocks.md: Since the file is never buffered, a few rules apply:
blocks.text: Since the file is never buffered, a few rules apply:
blocks.zh: 由于文件从不缓冲，因此适用以下几条规则：

blocks.md:
- Text fields must precede the file in the form. The ones sent before it are available in `req.body` (`@Body()`), while the parts that follow the file are not parsed.
- Only one file is accepted, in the given field. A file in any other field fails the request with a `400 Unexpected file field` response.
- The file size is not known up front, so `MaxFileSizeValidator` doesn't apply, and neither does the magic number check of `FileTypeValidator` (set its `skipMagicNumbersValidation` option to `true` to compare the client-provided mime type only). The `fileSize` limit is still enforced: once it is exceeded, the stream errors with a `PayloadTooLargeException`.
- Whatever the route handler leaves unread is discarded before the response is sent, so that the client can finish uploading. When the handler returns a `StreamableFile` (which may be the upload itself), the rest of the upload is discarded once the response has been sent instead. For this reason, a handler that responds with a `StreamableFile` of something other than the upload should read the upload first - otherwise, a client that is still uploading over a connection that is not kept alive may fail with an `EPIPE` or `ECONNRESET` error.
blocks.text: Text fields must precede the file in the form. The ones sent before it are available in req.body (@Body()), while the parts that follow the file are not parsed. Only one file is accepted, in the given field. A file in any other field fails the request with a 400 Unexpected file field response. The file size is not known up front, so MaxFileSizeValidator doesn't apply, and neither does the magic number check of FileTypeValidator (set its skipMagicNumbersValidation option to true to compare the client-provided mime type only). The fileSize limit is still enforced: once it is exceeded, the stream errors with a PayloadTooLargeException. Whatever the route handler leaves unread is discarded before the response is sent, so that the client can finish uploading. When the handler returns a StreamableFile (which may be the upload itself), the rest of the upload is discarded once the response has been sent instead. For this reason, a handler that responds with a StreamableFile of something other than the upload should read the upload first - otherwise, a client that is still uploading over a connection that is not kept alive may fail with an EPIPE or ECONNRESET error.
blocks.zh:
- 表单中的文件前面必须有文本字段。在它之前发送的那些在 `req.body`(`@Body()`)，而文件后面的部分没有被解析。
- 在给定的字段中，只接受一个文件。任何其他字段中的文件都会使请求失败 `400 Unexpected file field` 回应。
- 事先不知道文件大小，所以 `MaxFileSizeValidator` 不适用，幻数检查也不适用 `FileTypeValidator` （设置其 `skipMagicNumbersValidation` 选项 `true` 仅比较客户端提供的 mime 类型）。这个 `fileSize` 限制仍然被强制执行：一旦超过，流就会出错 `PayloadTooLargeException`.
- 在发送响应之前，路由处理程序留下的任何未读内容都会被丢弃，以便客户端可以完成上传。当处理程序返回一个 `StreamableFile`（这可能是上传本身），一旦响应被发送，上传的其余部分就会被丢弃。因此，一个处理程序使用 `StreamableFile` 除了上传之外的其他内容应该首先读取上传——否则，仍在通过未保持活动状态的连接上传的客户端可能会失败 `EPIPE` 或者 `ECONNRESET` 错误。

blocks.md: Differences from Multer
blocks.text: Differences from Multer
blocks.zh: 与 Multer 的区别

blocks.md: Besides the [default limits](/http/file-upload#limits), the Fastify interceptors differ from Multer in the following ways:
blocks.text: Besides the default limits, the Fastify interceptors differ from Multer in the following ways:
blocks.zh: 除了 [默认限值](/http/file-upload#limits)，这个 Fastify 拦截器与 Multer 的区别如下：

blocks.md:
- A text field of exactly `fieldSize` bytes is accepted, while Multer rejects it.
- Field names that could pollute a prototype (`constructor`, or names with a `__proto__`, `constructor` or `prototype` segment, such as `user[constructor]`) fail the request with a `400 Invalid field name` response. Multer accepts them.
- Text fields sent with a `Content-Type: application/json` header arrive parsed, and invalid JSON fails the request with a `400` response (a `@fastify/multipart` feature). Malformed part header lines are ignored, whereas Multer fails the request with a `400` response.
- `fileFilter` functions and storage engines receive the Fastify request instead of the Express one.
- The `attachFieldsToBody` plugin option is not supported, as it consumes the request body before the interceptors run.
- Multer's `highWaterMark`, `fileHwm`, `defCharset` and `streamHandler` options are not supported by the interceptors.
blocks.text: A text field of exactly fieldSize bytes is accepted, while Multer rejects it. Field names that could pollute a prototype (constructor, or names with a proto, constructor or prototype segment, such as user[constructor]) fail the request with a 400 Invalid field name response. Multer accepts them. Text fields sent with a Content-Type: application/json header arrive parsed, and invalid JSON fails the request with a 400 response (a @fastify/multipart feature). Malformed part header lines are ignored, whereas Multer fails the request with a 400 response. fileFilter functions and storage engines receive the Fastify request instead of the Express one. The attachFieldsToBody plugin option is not supported, as it consumes the request body before the interceptors run. Multer's highWaterMark, fileHwm, defCharset and streamHandler options are not supported by the interceptors.
blocks.zh:
- 的文本字段 `fieldSize` 字节被接受，而 Multer 拒绝它。
- 可能污染原型的字段名（`constructor`，或带有 `__proto__`,`constructor` 或者 `prototype` 段，例如 `user[constructor]`) 用 a 失败请求 `400 Invalid field name` 回应。莫特接受他们。
- 文本字段与 `Content-Type: application/json` 标头到达解析，且无效 JSON 请求失败 `400` 响应（a`@fastify/multipart` 特征）。格式错误的零件标题行将被忽略，而 Multer 使用 `400` 回应。
- `fileFilter` 函数和存储引擎接收 Fastify 请求而不是 Express 一。
- 这个 `attachFieldsToBody` 不支持插件选项，因为它会在拦截器运行之前消耗请求主体。
- 穆尔特的 `highWaterMark`,`fileHwm`,`defCharset` 和 `streamHandler` 拦截器不支持选项。

blocks.md: With the Express adapter, if the stream emits an error before any data has been sent, the client receives a `400 Bad Request` response, and the error is logged. Starting with NestJS v12.1.4, the response body no longer contains the error message, which may include the path of the file. If data has already been sent, the response is ended. To customize this behavior, pass a handler to the `setErrorHandler()` method:
blocks.text: With the Express adapter, if the stream emits an error before any data has been sent, the client receives a 400 Bad Request response, and the error is logged. Starting with NestJS v12.1.4, the response body no longer contains the error message, which may include the path of the file. If data has already been sent, the response is ended. To customize this behavior, pass a handler to the setErrorHandler() method:
blocks.zh: 与 Express 适配器，如果流在发送任何数据之前发出错误，则客户端接收 `400 Bad Request` 响应，并记录错误。从 NestJSv12.1.4，响应正文不再包含错误消息，其中可能包括文件的路径。如果数据已经发送，则响应结束。要自定义此行为，请将处理程序传递给 `setErrorHandler()` 方法：

chapters.title: Compression
chapters.summary: Compression can significantly reduce the size of the response body, which makes a web app faster to load.

blocks.md: Compression can significantly reduce the size of the response body, which makes a web app faster to load.
blocks.text: Compression can significantly reduce the size of the response body, which makes a web app faster to load.
blocks.zh: 压缩可以显著减小响应体的大小，这使得 web 应用程序加载速度更快。

blocks.md: For **high-traffic** websites in production, we strongly recommend offloading compression from the application server, typically to a reverse proxy (e.g., Nginx). In that case, don't use compression middleware.
blocks.text: For high-traffic websites in production, we strongly recommend offloading compression from the application server, typically to a reverse proxy (e.g., Nginx). In that case, don't use compression middleware.
blocks.zh: 对于生产中的**高流量**网站，我们强烈建议从应用服务器卸载压缩，通常卸载到反向代理（例如 Nginx）。在这种情况下，不要使用压缩中间件。

blocks.md: Use with Express (default)
blocks.text: Use with Express (default)
blocks.zh: 与 Express（默认）

blocks.md: Use the [compression](https://github.com/expressjs/compression) middleware package to enable response compression. It supports the gzip, deflate, and Brotli encodings, and picks one based on the request's `Accept-Encoding` header.
blocks.text: Use the compression middleware package to enable response compression. It supports the gzip, deflate, and Brotli encodings, and picks one based on the request's Accept-Encoding header.
blocks.zh: 使用 [压缩](https://github.com/expressjs/compression) 启用响应压缩的中间件包。它支持 gzip、deflate 和 Brotli 编码，并根据请求选择一种 `Accept-Encoding` 头球。

blocks.md: First, install the required packages:
blocks.text: First, install the required packages:
blocks.zh: 首先，安装所需的软件包：

blocks.code:
$ npm i --save compression
$ npm i --save-dev @types/compression

blocks.md: Once the installation is complete, apply the compression middleware globally:
blocks.text: Once the installation is complete, apply the compression middleware globally:
blocks.zh: 安装完成后，全局应用压缩中间件：

blocks.md: Use with Fastify
blocks.text: Use with Fastify
blocks.zh: 与 Fastify

blocks.md: If you use the `FastifyAdapter`, use the [@fastify/compress](https://github.com/fastify/fastify-compress) plugin instead:
blocks.text: If you use the FastifyAdapter, use the @fastify/compress plugin instead:
blocks.zh: 如果您使用 `FastifyAdapter`，使用 [@fastify/compress](https://github.com/fastify/fastify-compress) 插件代替：

blocks.code: $ npm i --save @fastify/compress

blocks.md: Once the installation is complete, register the `@fastify/compress` plugin. It compresses all eligible responses by default.
blocks.text: Once the installation is complete, register the @fastify/compress plugin. It compresses all eligible responses by default.
blocks.zh: 安装完成后，注册 `@fastify/compress` 插件。默认情况下，它会压缩所有符合条件的响应。

blocks.title: Warning
blocks.md: Make sure you pass the `NestFastifyApplication` type when creating the application. Otherwise, the `register()` method isn't available to apply the plugin.
blocks.text: Make sure you pass the NestFastifyApplication type when creating the application. Otherwise, the register() method isn't available to apply the plugin.
blocks.zh: 确保你通过了 `NestFastifyApplication` 创建应用程序时键入。否则，`register()` 方法不可用于应用插件。

blocks.md: By default, `@fastify/compress` uses the first encoding the client accepts, in this order of preference: `zstd` (on Node.js versions that support it), `br` (Brotli), `gzip`, and `deflate`. Brotli achieves a high compression ratio, but higher quality levels are slow. The plugin sets the Brotli quality (`BROTLI_PARAM_QUALITY`) to 4 by default instead of zlib's default of 11. You can set it anywhere from 0 (fastest) to 11 (smallest output), trading compression time against response size. Tune this value for your workload. The following example sets the quality explicitly:
blocks.text: By default, @fastify/compress uses the first encoding the client accepts, in this order of preference: zstd (on Node.js versions that support it), br (Brotli), gzip, and deflate. Brotli achieves a high compression ratio, but higher quality levels are slow. The plugin sets the Brotli quality (BROTLI_PARAM_QUALITY) to 4 by default instead of zlib's default of 11. You can set it anywhere from 0 (fastest) to 11 (smallest output), trading compression time against response size. Tune this value for your workload. The following example sets the quality explicitly:
blocks.zh: 默认情况下， `@fastify/compress` 使用客户端接受的第一个编码，按以下优先级顺序： `zstd` （上 Node.js 支持它的版本）， `br` （布罗特利）， `gzip`，和 `deflate`.Brotli 实现了高压缩比，但更高的质量水平是缓慢的。插件设置 Brotli 质量（`BROTLI_PARAM_QUALITY`) 默认为 4，而不是 zlib 默认的 11。您可以将其设置为从 0（最快）到 11（最小输出）的任何位置，根据响应大小权衡压缩时间。为您的工作负载调整此值。以下示例显式设置质量：

blocks.md: Alternatively, you can restrict `@fastify/compress` to gzip and deflate. Responses may be larger, but they are compressed faster.
blocks.text: Alternatively, you can restrict @fastify/compress to gzip and deflate. Responses may be larger, but they are compressed faster.
blocks.zh: 或者，您可以限制 `@fastify/compress` 压缩和放气。响应可能更大，但它们被压缩得更快。

blocks.md: To specify the encodings, pass the `encodings` option in the second argument to `app.register()`:
blocks.text: To specify the encodings, pass the encodings option in the second argument to app.register():
blocks.zh: 要指定编码，请将第二个参数中的 `encodings` 选项传递给 `app.register()`：

blocks.code: await app.register(compression, { encodings: ['gzip', 'deflate'] });

blocks.md: This configuration tells `@fastify/compress` to use only the gzip and deflate encodings, preferring gzip when the client supports both.
blocks.text: This configuration tells @fastify/compress to use only the gzip and deflate encodings, preferring gzip when the client supports both.
blocks.zh: 此配置告诉 `@fastify/compress` 要只使用 gzip 和 deflate 编码，当客户端支持两者时，首选 gzip。

chapters.title: Server-Sent Events
chapters.summary: Server-Sent Events (SSE) is a server push technology that enables a client to receive automatic updates from a server over an HTTP connection.

blocks.md: Server-Sent Events (SSE) is a server push technology that enables a client to receive automatic updates from a server over an HTTP connection. Each notification is sent as a block of text terminated by a pair of newlines (see [Server-sent events on MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Server-sent_events) to learn more).
blocks.text: Server-Sent Events (SSE) is a server push technology that enables a client to receive automatic updates from a server over an HTTP connection. Each notification is sent as a block of text terminated by a pair of newlines (see Server-sent events on MDN to learn more).
blocks.zh: 服务器发送的事件（SSE) 是一种服务器推送技术，它使客户端能够通过 HTTP 联系。每个通知都是以一对换行符结尾的文本块发送的（请参见 [Server-sent events on MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Server-sent_events) 了解更多）。

blocks.md: Usage
blocks.text: Usage
blocks.zh: 使用

blocks.md: To enable Server-Sent Events on a route (a route registered within a **controller class**), annotate the route handler with the `@Sse()` decorator.
blocks.text: To enable Server-Sent Events on a route (a route registered within a controller class), annotate the route handler with the @Sse() decorator.
blocks.zh: 若要在路由（在**控制器类**中注册的路由）上启用服务器发送的事件，请使用 `@Sse()` 装修师。

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md: The `@Sse()` decorator and the `MessageEvent` interface are imported from the `@nestjs/common` package, while `Observable`, `interval`, and `map` are imported from the `rxjs` package.
blocks.text: The @Sse() decorator and the MessageEvent interface are imported from the @nestjs/common package, while Observable, interval, and map are imported from the rxjs package.
blocks.zh: 这个 `@Sse()` 装饰和 `MessageEvent` 接口是从 `@nestjs/common` 包，而 `Observable`,`interval`，和 `map` 是从 `rxjs` 包装。

blocks.title: Warning
blocks.md: Server-Sent Events routes must return an `Observable` stream (or a `Promise` that resolves to one, as shown [below](/http/server-sent-events#client-disconnection)).
blocks.text: Server-Sent Events routes must return an Observable stream (or a Promise that resolves to one, as shown below).

blocks.md: In the example above, we defined a route named `sse` that propagates real-time updates. Clients can listen to these events using the [EventSource API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/EventSource).
blocks.text: In the example above, we defined a route named sse that propagates real-time updates. Clients can listen to these events using the EventSource API.
blocks.zh: 在上面的示例中，我们定义了一个名为 `sse` 传播实时更新。客户端可以使用 [EventSource API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/EventSource).

blocks.md: The `sse()` method returns an `Observable` that emits multiple `MessageEvent` objects (in this example, a new `MessageEvent` every second). Each `MessageEvent` object should respect the following interface to match the specification:

blocks.md: When a client closes the SSE connection (e.g., with `eventSource.close()`), Nest automatically unsubscribes from the returned `Observable`. This stops the event stream and cleans up any associated resources, including the interval timer in the example above.

This makes it the right place to release external resources, such as database cursors or file handles, tied to the stream.

This makes it the right place to release external resources, such as database cursors or file handles, tied to the stream.
blocks.zh: 这个 `finalize` 运算符（从 `rxjs`) 每当 `Observable` 终止：通过完成、错误或取消订阅（包括客户端断开连接）。这使得它成为释放绑定到流的外部资源（如数据库游标或文件句柄）的正确位置。

blocks.md: An `@Sse()` handler can be asynchronous, returning a `Promise<Observable>` rather than an `Observable` directly. This is common when the stream needs expensive setup before the first event can be produced, such as opening a database cursor, acquiring a model session, or authorizing against a downstream service.

blocks.md: This leaves a gap. That's the right behavior for the stream, but it means the `Observable`'s teardown logic never runs, and anything allocated during setup (the `session` above) leaks.

chapters.title: Performance (Fastify)
chapters.summary: By default, Nest uses the Express framework.

blocks.md: By default, Nest uses the [Express](https://expressjs.com/) framework. Nest is also compatible with other libraries, such as [Fastify](https://github.com/fastify/fastify). It achieves this framework independence through a framework adapter, whose primary job is to proxy middleware and handlers to the appropriate library-specific implementations.
blocks.text: By default, Nest uses the Express framework. Nest is also compatible with other libraries, such as Fastify. It achieves this framework independence through a framework adapter, whose primary job is to proxy middleware and handlers to the appropriate library-specific implementations.
blocks.zh: 默认情况下，Nest 使用 [Express](https://expressjs.com/) 框架。Nest 也与其他库兼容，如 [Fastify](https://github.com/fastify/fastify)。它通过框架适配器实现这种框架独立性，框架适配器的主要工作是将中间件和处理程序代理到适当的特定于库的实现。

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md: A framework adapter can only be implemented for a library that provides request/response pipeline processing similar to Express.
blocks.text: A framework adapter can only be implemented for a library that provides request/response pipeline processing similar to Express.
blocks.zh: 框架适配器只能用于提供类似于 Express 的请求/响应管道处理的库。

blocks.md: [Fastify](https://github.com/fastify/fastify) is a good alternative framework for Nest because it solves design issues in a similar way to Express. However, Fastify is significantly **faster** than Express, achieving nearly twice the benchmark results. Nest still uses Express as the default HTTP provider because Express is widely used, well known, and has an enormous set of compatible middleware, which is available to Nest users out of the box.

blocks.zh: [Fastify](https://github.com/fastify/fastify) 是 Nest 的一个很好的替代框架，因为它以类似于 Express 的方式解决设计问题。然而，Fastify 明显**快**于 Express，达到了基准结果的近两倍。Nest 仍然使用 Express 作为默认的 HTTP 提供程序，因为 Express 被广泛使用，众所周知，并且有一组巨大的兼容中间件，Nest 用户开箱即用。

blocks.md: Because Nest is framework independent, you can migrate between the two. Fastify can be a better choice when raw speed is a priority. To use Fastify, choose the built-in `FastifyAdapter`, as shown in this chapter.

chapters.title: Webhooks
chapters.summary: An online store for cat food and supplies sells to cat shelters and resellers that buy in bulk, through its API.

blocks.md: An online store for cat food and supplies sells to cat shelters and resellers that buy in bulk, through its API. Northside Pet Supplies, a reseller, places an order and wants to know when it ships and when it's cancelled, without polling: a webhook to its warehouse system. The store receives webhooks too: the payment provider reports payments, and the carrier reports shipments. Both directions look simple, and both go wrong in the same ways:
blocks.text: An online store for cat food and supplies sells to cat shelters and resellers that buy in bulk, through its API. Northside Pet Supplies, a reseller, places an order and wants to know when it ships and when it's cancelled, without polling: a webhook to its warehouse system. The store receives webhooks too: the payment provider reports payments, and the carrier reports shipments. Both directions look simple, and both go wrong in the same ways:
blocks.zh: 一家销售猫粮和用品的在线商店通过其销售给猫收容所和批量购买的经销商 API. Northside Pet Supplies 是一家经销商，下了订单，想知道订单何时发货，何时取消，而无需投票：一个连接到其仓库系统的网络钩子。商店也接收 webhooks：支付提供者报告付款，运营商报告发货。两个方向看起来都很简单，但都以相同的方式出错：

blocks.md:
- **Sending.** A `fetch()` after the order commits is lost when the process dies in between, and sent for a transaction that then rolls back. A retry sends the same event twice without telling the partner so. Every partner writes its own verifier for a homemade signature. A partner that is down for an hour is hammered, a dead endpoint is never turned off, and nobody can answer "did you send it?". And the URL the partner typed is a server-side request forgery waiting to happen: `https://169.254.169.254/` answers with the cloud credentials.
- **Receiving.** The signature is checked on a body the framework parsed and serialized again (a stray space breaks it, and a tampered body can pass), compared with `===` instead of in constant time, with no timestamp window, and a redelivered event runs the handler twice: an order marked paid twice, or shipped twice.
blocks.text: Sending. A fetch() after the order commits is lost when the process dies in between, and sent for a transaction that then rolls back. A retry sends the same event twice without telling the partner so. Every partner writes its own verifier for a homemade signature. A partner that is down for an hour is hammered, a dead endpoint is never turned off, and nobody can answer "did you send it?". And the URL the partner typed is a server-side request forgery waiting to happen: https://169.254.169.254/ answers with the cloud credentials. Receiving. The signature is checked on a body the framework parsed and serialized again (a stray space breaks it, and a tampered body can pass), compared with === instead of in constant time, with no timestamp window, and a redelivered event runs the handler twice: an order marked paid twice, or shipped twice.
blocks.zh:
- **发送。**一个 `fetch()` 当进程在中间死亡时，订单提交丢失，并被发送给事务，然后回滚。重试会在不告诉合作伙伴的情况下两次发送相同的事件。每个合作伙伴为自制签名编写自己的验证器。一个倒下一个小时的合作伙伴被锤打，一个死端点永远不会关闭，没有人能回答“是你发的吗？”.和 URL 类型的合作伙伴是等待发生的服务器端请求伪造：`https://169.254.169.254/` 使用云凭据回答。
- **正在接收。**签名在框架解析并再次序列化的主体上进行检查（散乱的空格会破坏它，篡改的主体可以通过），与 `===` 而不是在恒定时间，没有时间戳窗口，重新交付事件运行处理程序两次：标记为两次支付的订单或两次发货的订单。

blocks.md: `@nestjs/webhooks` makes both directions one thing to configure. Outgoing webhooks travel through the [outbox](/reliability/outbox): `webhooks.dispatch()` adds the message in the same transaction as the order, and after the commit a worker fans it out to the partner's endpoints, signs each request the way [Standard Webhooks](https://www.standardwebhooks.com) specifies, retries with backoff for about two days, keeps a log of every attempt, and replays on request. Incoming webhooks are one decorator, `@VerifyWebhook()`, which checks the signature on the raw body and skips redeliveries.
blocks.text: @nestjs/webhooks makes both directions one thing to configure. Outgoing webhooks travel through the outbox: webhooks.dispatch() adds the message in the same transaction as the order, and after the commit a worker fans it out to the partner's endpoints, signs each request the way Standard Webhooks specifies, retries with backoff for about two days, keeps a log of every attempt, and replays on request. Incoming webhooks are one decorator, @VerifyWebhook(), which checks the signature on the raw body and skips redeliveries.
blocks.zh: `@nestjs/webhooks` 使两个方向都是一个配置。传出的 webhooks 通过 [发件箱](/reliability/outbox):`webhooks.dispatch()` 将消息添加到与订单相同的事务中，并在提交后由工作人员将其发送到合作伙伴的端点，并在每个请求上签名 [Standard Webhooks](https://www.standardwebhooks.com) 指定，回退大约两天的重试，记录每次尝试，并根据要求重播。传入的 webhooks 是一个装饰器，`@VerifyWebhook()`，它检查原始主体上的签名并跳过重新传递。

blocks.md: In this tutorial, you'll add webhooks to the store's order API, on PostgreSQL with Drizzle:
blocks.text: In this tutorial, you'll add webhooks to the store's order API, on PostgreSQL with Drizzle:
blocks.zh: 在本教程中，您将在 PostgreSQL 上使用 Drizzle 将 webhooks 添加到商店订单 API 中：

blocks.md:
- Partners subscribe to `order.shipped` and `order.cancelled` through the API, and see their secret once.
- The API sends the webhooks after the commit, signed, and retries them while a partner is down.
- Partners read their delivery log, and ask for a replay.
- The API receives the payment provider's payment webhooks (Standard Webhooks) and the carrier's shipment webhooks (Stripe's scheme), verified on the raw body and processed exactly once.
- Secrets rotate without a gap, and a URL that points inside the store's network is refused.
blocks.text: Partners subscribe to order.shipped and order.cancelled through the API, and see their secret once. The API sends the webhooks after the commit, signed, and retries them while a partner is down. Partners read their delivery log, and ask for a replay. The API receives the payment provider's payment webhooks (Standard Webhooks) and the carrier's shipment webhooks (Stripe's scheme), verified on the raw body and processed exactly once. Secrets rotate without a gap, and a URL that points inside the store's network is refused.
blocks.zh:
- 合作伙伴订阅 `order.shipped` 和 `order.cancelled` 通过 API 看看他们的秘密。
- 这个 API 提交后发送 webhooks，签名，并在合作伙伴关闭时重试。
- 合作伙伴阅读他们的交付日志，并要求重播。
- 这个 API 接收支付提供者的支付 webhooks（标准 webhooks）和承运人的装运 webhooks（Stripe 的方案），在原始主体上验证并精确处理一次。
- 秘密没有间隙地旋转，URL 商店网络内的积分被拒绝。

blocks.md: There's nothing to create for webhooks, or for the outbox they travel through: no tables, entities or Prisma models. Register their two stores, and each creates its own schema, `nest_webhooks` and `nest_outbox`, and migrates it: at startup in development and in tests, and in production with `npx @nestjs/webhooks migrate` and `npx @nestjs/outbox migrate`, or with their `migrationSql()` in your own migrations.

Register their two stores, and each creates its own schema, nest_webhooks and nest_outbox, and migrates it: at startup in development and in tests, and in production with npx @nestjs/webhooks migrate and npx @nestjs/outbox migrate, or with their migrationSql() in your own migrations.
blocks.zh: 无需为 webhooks 或它们所经过的发件箱创建任何内容：没有表、实体或 Prisma 模型。注册他们的两个存储，每个存储创建自己的模式，`nest_webhooks` 和 `nest_outbox`，并迁移它：在开发和测试启动时，以及在生产中 `npx @nestjs/webhooks migrate` 和 `npx @nestjs/outbox migrate`，或与他们的 `migrationSql()` 在你自己的迁移中。

blocks.md: The package keeps the endpoints, with their secrets, the messages it dispatched, their deliveries and the log of every attempt in a **store**, which it reads through two contracts, `WebhookEndpointStore` and `WebhookDeliveryStore`. Until you register one, the module keeps them in memory: fine for a first run, but a restart loses every pending delivery, and two instances don't share them.
blocks.text: The package keeps the endpoints, with their secrets, the messages it dispatched, their deliveries and the log of every attempt in a store, which it reads through two contracts, WebhookEndpointStore and WebhookDeliveryStore. Until you register one, the module keeps them in memory: fine for a first run, but a restart loses every pending delivery, and two instances don't share them.
blocks.zh: 包将端点及其机密、它发送的消息、它们的交付和每次尝试的日志保存在**存储**中，包通过两个合同读取这些日志， `WebhookEndpointStore` 和 `WebhookDeliveryStore`.在您注册一个之前，模块会将它们保留在内存中：第一次运行没问题，但重新启动会丢失每个待处理的传递，并且两个实例不会共享它们。

blocks.md: On PostgreSQL, register the package's store, `PostgresWebhookStore` from `@nestjs/webhooks/postgres`. The outbox needs one too, for the messages that carry dispatched webhooks out of your transaction and for the inbox that deduplicates incoming ones: `PostgresOutboxStore` from `@nestjs/outbox/postgres`, as in [the outbox tutorial](/reliability/outbox#keep-messages-in-your-database). Both run their SQL through the database client your application already has, and keep their tables in schemas of their own. They're ordinary providers, registered once, in the root module, next to `WebhooksModule` and `OutboxModule`: all four are application-wide. `AppModule` creates each with a factory that injects the Drizzle database and its package's storage registry, which the store registers itself with:

blocks.md: `fromDrizzle(db)` is the stores' **executor**: it runs their statements through your Drizzle database, whichever driver it uses, such as `pg` or PGlite. `fromPg(pool)`, `fromTypeOrm(dataSource)`, `fromPrisma(prisma)` and `fromKysely(db)` do the same for a node-postgres pool, TypeORM, Prisma and Kysely. `@nestjs/webhooks/postgres` and `@nestjs/outbox/postgres` both export them, so `AppModule` imports `fromDrizzle` once, for both stores. At startup, each module logs the store it uses.

blocks.md: **The schema.** The webhook store keeps its tables in a schema of its own, `nest_webhooks` (the `schema` option names another). On MySQL, which has no schemas, they're tables of the connection's database, with the schema's name as their prefix: `nest_webhooks_endpoints` and so on.

blocks.zh: **模式。**webhook 存储将其表保存在自己的模式中，`nest_webhooks`（`schema` 选项命名另一个）。在没有模式的 MySQL 上，它们是连接数据库的表，模式的名称作为前缀：`nest_webhooks_endpoints` 等等。

blocks.md:
| Table | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `nest_webhooks.endpoints` | The partners' endpoints: URL, event types, tenant, and secrets |
| `nest_webhooks.messages` | What was dispatched, byte for byte |
| `nest_webhooks.deliveries` | One per message and endpoint, with its status, attempts and lease |
| `nest_webhooks.delivery_attempts` | The log: every attempt, with the status code, the response and how long it took |
| `nest_webhooks.migrations` | The versions of the store's schema applied |
blocks.zh:
| 桌子 | 它持有什么 |
| --- | --- |
| `nest_webhooks.endpoints` | 合作伙伴的终点：URL、事件类型、租户和秘密 |
| `nest_webhooks.messages` | 逐字节分派了什么 |
| `nest_webhooks.deliveries` | 每个消息和端点一个，包含其状态、尝试和租赁 |

blocks.md: The outbox's store keeps its messages, dead letters and inbox in `nest_outbox` (`nest_outbox_messages` and so on, on MySQL), as in [the outbox tutorial](/reliability/outbox#keep-messages-in-your-database). They belong to the stores: your migrations don't create them, and your own tables can't collide with them. A few choices in there matter to the package:
blocks.text: The outbox's store keeps its messages, dead letters and inbox in nest_outbox (nest_outbox_messages and so on, on MySQL), as in the outbox tutorial. They belong to the stores: your migrations don't create them, and your own tables can't collide with them. A few choices in there matter to the package:
blocks.zh: 发件箱的存储将其邮件、死信和收件箱保存在 `nest_outbox` (`nest_outbox_messages` 等等，在 MySQL 上），如在 [发件箱教程](/reliability/outbox#keep-messages-in-your-database).它们属于存储：您的迁移不会创建它们，您自己的表也不能与它们冲突。其中的几个选择对软件包很重要：

blocks.md:
- An endpoint's secrets are a JSON array, newest first: during a rotation, the old secret stays for the overlap, with an expiry. With `encryption` configured (see [Register the modules](/http/webhooks#register-the-modules)), what is stored is sealed.
- A message's `body` is `text`, not `jsonb`. It is the exact JSON that was signed and sent, and `jsonb` would reformat it: a partner storing the request and its signature could no longer verify a replay.
- A delivery is unique per message and endpoint. The fan-out that creates deliveries runs after the commit, inside the outbox, so it can run twice; the unique key makes the second run insert nothing.
- No foreign key from a delivery to its endpoint: a deleted endpoint's log stays. Attempts go with their delivery.
- Times are epoch milliseconds (`bigint`), from the package's clock, never the database's.

No foreign key from a delivery to its endpoint: a deleted endpoint's log stays. Attempts go with their delivery. Times are epoch milliseconds (bigint), from the package's clock, never the database's.
blocks.zh:
- 端点的秘密是 JSON 数组，最新的优先：在旋转期间，旧的秘密会保留重叠，并有一个过期日期。和 `encryption` 已配置（参见 [Register the modules](/http/webhooks#register-the-modules))，存储的是密封的。
- 一条消息的 `body` 是 `text`,不 `jsonb`.这是准确的 JSON 签字发送了， `jsonb` 将重新格式化它：存储请求及其签名的合作伙伴不能再验证重播。
- 每个消息和端点的传递都是唯一的。创建投递的扇出在提交后在发件箱内运行，因此它可以运行两次；唯一键使第二次运行不插入任何内容。
- 没有从交付到其端点的外键：已删除端点的日志保留。尝试伴随着他们的交付。
- 时间是历元毫秒（`bigint`），来自包的时钟，而不是数据库的时钟。

blocks.md: **Migrations.** The packages ship their schemas as versioned migrations, and the stores apply them themselves. With the `migrate` option, each applies the ones its schema hasn't had yet at startup, before the relay and the worker run, in one transaction that holds an advisory lock: of several instances that start together, one migrates, and the others find nothing left to do. `migrate` defaults to `true`, except with `NODE_ENV=production`. So in development and in tests, the stores create their schemas on the first start, and your migrations only create your own tables.

So in development and in tests, the stores create their schemas on the first start, and your migrations only create your own tables.
blocks.zh: **迁移。**软件包将其模式作为版本迁移发送，存储本身应用它们。使用 `migrate` 选项，在中继和工作程序运行之前，每个实例都会在一个持有咨询锁的事务中应用其模式在启动时尚未拥有的内容：在一起启动的几个实例中，一个实例迁移，而其他实例则无事可做。`migrate` 默认为 `true`，但 `NODE_ENV=production` 除外。因此，在开发和测试中，存储在一开始就创建它们的模式，而您的迁移只创建您自己的表。

The packages' command lines do it from your deploy step, next to `npx drizzle-kit migrate`. They read the database from `DATABASE_URL`, or from `--url`, and need `pg` installed:

blocks.md: With `migrate` off, a store whose schema is behind fails the startup with a `WebhookSchemaError` (the outbox's store, with an `OutboxSchemaError`) that names these three ways, and fails every call the same way until the schema catches up, which it notices without a restart. During a rolling deploy, the previous version of your application keeps running on a schema that the new one migrated. There are no down migrations.

During a rolling deploy, the previous version of your application keeps running on a schema that the new one migrated. There are no down migrations.
blocks.zh: 和 `migrate` 关闭，模式背后的存储会使启动失败 `WebhookSchemaError`（发件箱的商店，有一个 `OutboxSchemaError`）命名这三种方式，并以相同的方式失败每个调用，直到模式赶上，它注意到这一点而无需重新启动。在滚动部署期间，应用程序的先前版本将继续在新版本迁移的模式上运行。没有向下迁移。

blocks.md: **Transactions.** No method of the webhook store takes your transaction. `webhooks.dispatch(tx, ...)` adds the message to the outbox in your transaction, through the outbox's store, and `webhook.processInTransaction(tx, ...)` records an incoming webhook in the outbox's inbox the same way; the fan-out after the commit, the worker and everything else run on the stores' own connections. With Drizzle, `tx` is what `db.transaction()` hands its callback, as the next sections show. The outbox's store refuses the database itself, whose statements would commit on their own, with an `OutboxTransactionRequiredError` that says what to pass. With the other executors, pass a node-postgres client after `BEGIN` (not the pool), TypeORM's `EntityManager` from `dataSource.transaction()`, Prisma's interactive transaction client, or a Kysely transaction.
blocks.text: Transactions. No method of the webhook store takes your transaction. webhooks.dispatch(tx, ...) adds the message to the outbox in your transaction, through the outbox's store, and webhook.processInTransaction(tx, ...) records an incoming webhook in the outbox's inbox the same way; the fan-out after the commit, the worker and everything else run on the stores' own connections. With Drizzle, tx is what db.transaction() hands its callback, as the next sections show. The outbox's store refuses the database itself, whose statements would commit on their own, with an OutboxTransactionRequiredError that says what to pass. With the other executors, pass a node-postgres client after BEGIN (not the pool), TypeORM's EntityManager from dataSource.transaction(), Prisma's interactive transaction client, or a Kysely transaction.
blocks.zh: **交易。** webhook store 的任何方法都不会处理您的交易。`webhooks.dispatch(tx, ...)` 通过 outbox 的存储将邮件添加到事务处理中的 outbox，以及 `webhook.processInTransaction(tx, ...)` 以同样的方式在发件箱的收件箱中记录一个传入的 webhook；提交后的扇出、worker 和其他一切都在商店自己的连接上运行。和 Drizzle,`tx` 是什么 `db.transaction()` 如下一节所示，发出回调。outbox 的存储拒绝数据库本身，数据库的语句将自行提交 `OutboxTransactionRequiredError` 上面写着要传递什么。与其他执行器一起，在之后传递 node-postgres 客户端 `BEGIN`（不是泳池），TypeORM 的 `EntityManager` 来自 `dataSource.transaction()`,Prisma 的交互式事务客户端，或 Kysely 事务。

blocks.md: **Isolation.** The stores rely on READ COMMITTED, PostgreSQL's default isolation level: their statements race each other, and under a stricter level they would fail with serialization errors. At startup, each checks the database's `default_transaction_isolation`, and fails if it's stricter. Your own transactions may run at any level. Under REPEATABLE READ or SERIALIZABLE, though, a copy of an incoming webhook that `processInTransaction()` handles in your transaction, racing the first one's commit, fails with PostgreSQL's serialization error instead of being skipped as a duplicate: the sender gets an error, and its retry finds the webhook recorded.
blocks.text: Isolation. The stores rely on READ COMMITTED, PostgreSQL's default isolation level: their statements race each other, and under a stricter level they would fail with serialization errors. At startup, each checks the database's default_transaction_isolation, and fails if it's stricter. Your own transactions may run at any level. Under REPEATABLE READ or SERIALIZABLE, though, a copy of an incoming webhook that processInTransaction() handles in your transaction, racing the first one's commit, fails with PostgreSQL's serialization error instead of being skipped as a duplicate: the sender gets an error, and its retry finds the webhook recorded.
blocks.zh: **隔离。**商店依赖 READCOMMITTEDPostgreSQL 的默认隔离级别：它们的语句相互竞争，在更严格的级别下，它们会出现序列化错误。在启动时，每个检查数据库的 `default_transaction_isolation`，如果更严格，就会失败。您自己的事务可以在任何级别运行。在下面 REPEATABLEREAD 或者 SERIALIZABLE 但是，一个传入的 webhook 的副本 `processInTransaction()` 事务中的句柄，与第一个提交竞争，由于 PostgreSQL 的序列化错误而失败，而不是作为重复项被跳过：发送者得到一个错误，它的重试发现 webhook 被记录了。

blocks.md:
- **Tables, not a schema.** MySQL has no schemas inside a database, so the stores keep their tables in the connection's database, the one in the URL's path, next to yours, and `schema` becomes their prefix: `nest_webhooks_endpoints`, `nest_webhooks_deliveries` and so on, and `nest_outbox_messages` for the outbox. It takes lowercase letters, digits and underscores, at most 40 characters.
- **Your transactions.** `dispatch()` and `processInTransaction()` work at REPEATABLE READ, MySQL's default, as at READ COMMITTED: there's nothing to configure, and the stores don't check the database's default. When MySQL breaks a deadlock in your transaction (error 1213), it rolls the whole transaction back, and the client's error reaches your code: run the transaction again. The stores run their own transactions again themselves. With `processInTransaction()`, that can happen when copies of one webhook arrive at once and the first one's transaction rolls back: the sender gets an error, and its retry goes through.
- **Keys are bounded.** Ids and tenants are indexed columns: at most 255 characters, 256 for a tenant, which the package's own ids and its limit on `tenant` stay within. An incoming webhook's id goes into the inbox's key, of at most 255 characters too, and the verifier refuses a longer id on every database, with a 401, before the handler runs.
- **Migrations aren't one transaction.** MySQL commits each DDL statement on its own, so `migrate` applies the statements one at a time, under a lock (`GET_LOCK()`), and a run that failed resumes at the statement it stopped at. Your own tool must send one statement per call too, as the TypeORM migration in **Migrations** above does. The command lines take a `mysql://` URL, and `sql --dialect mysql` prints MySQL's SQL: add `--statement-breakpoints` for a drizzle-kit custom migration, since its MySQL migrator sends one statement per breakpoint.
- **The server.** The stores check it at startup, and refuse MariaDB, a connection without a database, and a `sql_mode` that isn't strict (MySQL's default is). Keep `NO_BACKSLASH_ESCAPES` out of it too.

blocks.zh:
- **表，而不是模式。** MySQL 数据库中没有模式，因此存储库将表保存在连接的数据库中，而连接的数据库中的表 URL 你的路旁边，`schema` 成为他们的前缀：`nest_webhooks_endpoints`,`nest_webhooks_deliveries` 等等，等等 `nest_outbox_messages` 发件箱。它使用小写字母、数字和下划线，最多 40 个字符。
- **您的交易。**`dispatch()` 和 `processInTransaction()` 工作于 REPEATABLEREADMySQL 的默认值，如 READCOMMITTED：没有什么需要配置的，存储不会检查数据库的默认值。当 MySQL 打破事务中的死锁（错误 1213）时，它会回滚整个事务，客户端的错误到达您的代码：再次运行事务。商店再次自己进行交易。和 `processInTransaction()` 当一个 webhook 的副本同时到达，而第一个 webhook 的事务回滚时，就会发生这种情况：发送者得到一个错误，它的重试通过。
- **键是有界的。** ID 和租户是索引列：最多 255 个字符，租户为 256 个字符，其中包本身的 ID 及其限制 `tenant` 待在里面。传入的 webhook 的 id 会进入收件箱的密钥，最多也有 255 个字符，在处理程序运行之前，验证器会拒绝每个数据库上更长的 id，使用 401。
- **迁移不是一个事务。**MySQL 提交每个事务 DDL 声明本身，所以 `migrate` 在锁下一次应用一个语句（`GET_LOCK()`），失败的运行在它停止的语句处继续。您自己的工具也必须每次调用发送一条语句，因为 TypeORM 上面**迁移**中的迁移确实如此。命令行采用 `mysql://`URL，和 `sql --dialect mysql` 打印 MySQLSQL：添加 `--statement-breakpoints` 对于 drizzle-kit 自定义迁移，因为它的 MySQL 迁移器每个断点发送一条语句。
- **服务器。**存储在启动时检查它，并拒绝 MariaDB（一个没有数据库的连接）和 `sql_mode` 这并不严格（MySQL 的默认值是）。保持 `NO_BACKSLASH_ESCAPES` 也出去了。

blocks.md:
- `eventTypes`: the message types this application sends. `dispatch()` refuses any other, and so does an endpoint that tries to subscribe to one, with the known types in the message.
- `retry`: the vocabulary shared with the outbox, the HTTP client and resilience. Ten attempts, and a backoff that starts at 5 seconds, grows fourfold and is capped at a day, with jitter: what the Standard Webhooks spec recommends, "a retry schedule spanning multiple days".
- `disableEndpointAfter`: an endpoint that has failed every attempt for five days without a single success is switched off, and its owner is told (see [Retries, the delivery log and replay](/http/webhooks#retries-the-delivery-log-and-replay)).
- `delivery`: one attempt has 15 seconds for DNS, the connection, TLS, the request and the response. `allowHttp` and `allowPrivateNetworks` are off by default: only public `https://` endpoints are accepted. `WEBHOOKS_ALLOW_LOCAL=1` turns them on in development, where the partner's receiver runs on this machine. Cloud metadata addresses stay blocked even then.
- `worker`: the background deliverer, one per process. `WEBHOOKS_WORKER=off` turns it off in instances that only serve the API.
- `encryption`: endpoint secrets sealed at rest, with the family's shape: the first key encrypts, every key decrypts. Optional, from `WEBHOOKS_ENCRYPTION_KEYS`.

blocks.zh:
- `eventTypes`：此应用程序发送的消息类型。`dispatch()` 拒绝任何其他端点，以及尝试订阅消息中已知类型的端点。
- `retry`：与发件箱共享的词汇，HTTP 客户和弹性。十次尝试，以及从 5 秒开始的回退，增长四倍，并以一天为上限，并伴有抖动：标准 Webhooks 规范推荐的，“跨越多天的重试时间表”。
- `disableEndpointAfter`：连续五天每次尝试都失败且没有一次成功的端点将被关闭，并通知其所有者（参见 [Retries, the delivery log and replay](/http/webhooks#retries-the-delivery-log-and-replay)）。
- `delivery`：一次尝试有 15 秒 DNS，连接，TLS、请求和响应。`allowHttp` 和 `allowPrivateNetworks` 默认情况下关闭：仅限公共 `https://` 接受端点。`WEBHOOKS_ALLOW_LOCAL=1` 在开发中打开它们，其中合作伙伴的接收器在这台机器上运行。即便如此，云元数据地址仍会被阻止。
- `worker`：后台传递器，每个进程一个。`WEBHOOKS_WORKER=off` 在仅服务于 API 的实例中关闭它。
- `encryption`：静止时密封的端点秘密，具有家族形状：第一个密钥加密，每个密钥解密。可选，来自 `WEBHOOKS_ENCRYPTION_KEYS`。

blocks.md: Retries, the delivery log and replay
blocks.text: Retries, the delivery log and replay
blocks.zh: 重试、交付日志和重播

blocks.md: A 2xx from the partner is a success. Anything else is a failed attempt: a 5xx, a 4xx, a 3xx (redirects are never followed), a timeout, a refused connection. The worker retries after the backoff, honors a `Retry-After` header in seconds or as an HTTP date (up to the backoff's cap, a day; any other value is ignored), and on a 429, 502, 503 or 504 pauses that endpoint until then, five seconds without a header: its other deliveries wait without an attempt, so a partner asking for a breather gets one probe, not one per batch, while the other partners' deliveries go on. Three answers end a delivery early: a 410 Gone, which also disables the endpoint (`gone`); a destination the transport refuses (the subscription checks, run again at every send, because DNS changes); and `retry.retryIf` saying no. After the last attempt, the delivery is `failed` with the reason `exhausted`.
blocks.text: A 2xx from the partner is a success. Anything else is a failed attempt: a 5xx, a 4xx, a 3xx (redirects are never followed), a timeout, a refused connection. The worker retries after the backoff, honors a Retry-After header in seconds or as an HTTP date (up to the backoff's cap, a day; any other value is ignored), and on a 429, 502, 503 or 504 pauses that endpoint until then, five seconds without a header: its other deliveries wait without an attempt, so a partner asking for a breather gets one probe, not one per batch, while the other partners' deliveries go on. Three answers end a delivery early: a 410 Gone, which also disables the endpoint (gone); a destination the transport refuses (the subscription checks, run again at every send, because DNS changes); and retry.retryIf saying no. After the last attempt, the delivery is failed with the reason exhausted.
blocks.zh: 合作伙伴的 2xx 是成功的。其他任何事情都是失败的尝试：5xx、4xx、3xx（从不跟踪重定向）、超时、连接被拒绝。工人在回退后重试，兑现 `Retry-After` 标题（秒）或作为 HTTP 日期（直到回退的上限，一天；任何其他值都被忽略），并且在 429、502、503 或 504 上暂停该端点，直到那时，5 秒钟没有标头：它的其他传递等待而没有尝试，因此请求呼吸器的合作伙伴得到一个探针，而不是每个批次一个，而其他合作伙伴的传递继续进行。三个答案会提前结束传递：一个 410 消失，这也会禁用端点（`gone`);传输拒绝的目的地（订阅检查，在每次发送时再次运行，因为 DNS 变化）；和 `retry.retryIf` 说不。在最后一次尝试之后，交付是 `failed` 有理由 `exhausted`.

blocks.md: An endpoint that fails every attempt for `disableEndpointAfter` is disabled with the reason `failing`, and `WebhooksEvents` emits `endpoint-disabled`: tell the partner. A success at any point resets the clock. A disabled endpoint, whether by the worker or by the partner (`enabled: false` in the subscription `update()`), gets no delivery for anything dispatched while it stays disabled: the fan-out skips it, and nothing creates those deliveries later. A replay doesn't either, because it re-sends deliveries that exist. What does exist are the deliveries that were pending when the endpoint was disabled: they fail with the reason `endpoint-disabled` when their turn comes, and after re-enabling, the partner can ask for those again, as the failed deliveries they are. Re-enabling forgets the failures, and the endpoint receives what is dispatched from then on.

What does exist are the deliveries that were pending when the endpoint was disabled: they fail with the reason endpoint-disabled when their turn comes, and after re-enabling, the partner can ask for those again, as the failed deliveries they are. Re-enabling forgets the failures, and the endpoint receives what is dispatched from then on.
blocks.zh: 每次尝试都失败的端点 `disableEndpointAfter` 被禁用的原因是 `failing`，和 `WebhooksEvents` 排放 `endpoint-disabled`：告诉搭档。任何时候的成功都会重置时钟。由工人或合作伙伴禁用的端点（`enabled: false` 在订阅中 `update()`)，当它保持禁用时，不会收到任何分派的传递：扇出会跳过它，并且以后不会创建这些传递。重播也不会，因为它重新发送现有的交付。当端点被禁用时，确实存在待处理的交付：它们失败的原因是 `endpoint-disabled` 当轮到他们时，在重新启用后，合作伙伴可以再次要求这些，因为它们是失败的交付。重新启用会忘记失败，端点接收从那时起调度的内容。

The partner reads its own log, and asks for a delivery to be sent again, one or every failed one since an outage began. The bulk retry takes an endpoint and the start of the outage, both optional:

blocks.md: A retry starts a new round: `attempts` back to 0, sent now, with the same `webhook-id` and the same body. The log of the earlier rounds stays. Because the id is the same, a partner whose inbox kept it answers 2xx without running its handler, so a replay is safe for a delivered webhook too: Northside can ask for the last hour again after losing its own database, and get only what it hasn't processed.

Because the id is the same, a partner whose inbox kept it answers 2xx without running its handler, so a replay is safe for a delivered webhook too: Northside can ask for the last hour again after losing its own database, and get only what it hasn't processed.
blocks.zh: 重试开始新一轮：`attempts` 回到 0，现在发送，相同 `webhook-id` 和同一具尸体。前几轮的日志仍然存在。因为 id 是相同的，一个合作伙伴的收件箱保留了它回答 2xx 而不运行它的处理程序，所以对于交付的 webhook 来说，重播也是安全的：Northside 可以在丢失自己的数据库后再次请求最后一个小时，并且只得到它没有处理的内容。

blocks.md: Operators get the same through `WebhookDeliveries` without a tenant: `stats()` (pending, due, leased and failed counts, and `lagMs`, how long the most overdue delivery has waited, the number to alert on), `retry()` across tenants, and `prune('30d')`, which nothing calls for you. `WebhooksEvents.events$` emits `delivered`, `retry-scheduled`, `delivery-failed`, `endpoint-disabled` and `destination-blocked`, each also on a `node:diagnostics_channel` channel named `nestjs:webhooks:<event>`.

blocks.zh: 运营商在没有租户的情况下通过 `WebhookDeliveries` 获得相同的结果：`stats()`（待处理、到期、租赁和失败计数，以及 `lagMs`，最逾期的交付已经等待了多长时间，要警报的号码），`retry()` 跨租户，以及 `prune('30d')`，没有什么需要你。`WebhooksEvents.events$` 发射 `delivered`、`retry-scheduled`、`delivery-failed`、`endpoint-disabled` 和 `destination-blocked`，每个也在名为 `nestjs:webhooks:<event>` 的 `node:diagnostics_channel` 信道上。

blocks.md: `@VerifyWebhook('payments')` on the route verifies the request before the handler runs, and `@IncomingWebhook()` gives what was verified: the sender's `id` for the webhook, the signed `timestamp`, the `payload` parsed from the signed bytes, and `processInTransaction()`:

blocks.zh: 路由上的 `@VerifyWebhook('payments')` 在处理程序运行之前验证请求，`@IncomingWebhook()` 给出已验证的内容：webhook 的发件人的 `id`、签名的 `timestamp`、从签名字节解析的 `payload` 和 `processInTransaction()`：

blocks.md: What the decorator checks, in order: the three `webhook-` headers are present and well formed, with a `webhook-id` of at most 255 characters, counted in code points; one `v1,` signature in `webhook-signature` matches the HMAC of `id.timestamp.body` with one of the configured secrets (compared in constant time; several secrets can be listed while the payment provider rotates); the signed timestamp is within 5 minutes of now, in either direction; the body is JSON. A request that fails gets a 401 with a generic message. The reason never goes to the sender; it goes to the `verification-failed` event, with the receiver's name. A signed body that isn't JSON gets a 400 from the framework's body parser before the decorator sees it, so no event is emitted for it. The same holds for a body over the body parser's size limit (100 kB on Express and 1 MiB on Fastify by default): it gets a 413 before the decorator runs, and no event is emitted. If the payment provider sends larger bodies, raise the limit with `useBodyParser()`, as described in [Raw body](/faq/raw-body#body-parser-size-limit).

A request that fails gets a 401 with a generic message. The reason never goes to the sender; it goes to the verification-failed event, with the receiver's name. A signed body that isn't JSON gets a 400 from the framework's body parser before the decorator sees it, so no event is emitted for it. The same holds for a body over the body parser's size limit (100 kB on Express and 1 MiB on Fastify by default): it gets a 413 before the decorator runs, and no event is emitted. If the payment provider sends larger bodies, raise the limit with useBodyParser(), as described in Raw body.
blocks.zh: 装饰师检查的顺序是：三个 `webhook-` 头部存在并且形成良好，具有 `webhook-id` 最多 255 个字符，以代码点计算；一 `v1,` 签名 `webhook-signature` 匹配 HMAC 的 `id.timestamp.body` 具有配置的秘密之一（在恒定时间内比较；当支付提供者轮换时，可以列出几个秘密）；签名的时间戳在现在 5 分钟内，任意一个方向；尸体是 JSON.失败的请求会得到一个带有通用消息的 401。原因永远不会归咎于发件人；它去了 `verification-failed` 事件，带有接收者的姓名。一个签名的机构 JSON 在装饰器看到它之前，从框架的主体解析器中获取 400，因此不会为它发出任何事件。对于超过正文解析器大小限制（100 kB 在 Express 和 1 MiB 开启 Fastify 默认情况下）：在装饰器运行之前，它会得到一个 413，并且不会发出任何事件。如果支付提供者发送较大的实体，请将限额提高至 `useBodyParser()` 如中所述 [Raw body](/faq/raw-body#body-parser-size-limit).

blocks.md: Then comes deduplication. The payment provider retries until it gets a 2xx, so a timeout after the handler succeeded makes it send the same `webhook-id` again. The receiver keeps an inbox of the ids it processed (the outbox's inbox, consumer `webhooks:payments`): a known id is answered with an empty 200 without running the handler, and an id is recorded only after the handler succeeded, so a handler that threw is run again on the payment provider's retry. Two copies arriving together at one instance run the handler once; two instances receiving them at the same moment could both run it, which is what the next paragraph is for.

The receiver keeps an inbox of the ids it processed (the outbox's inbox, consumer webhooks:payments): a known id is answered with an empty 200 without running the handler, and an id is recorded only after the handler succeeded, so a handler that threw is run again on the payment provider's retry. Two copies arriving together at one instance run the handler once; two instances receiving them at the same moment could both run it, which is what the next paragraph is for.
blocks.zh: 然后是重复数据删除。支付提供者会重试，直到它得到 2xx，因此在处理程序成功后超时会使它发送相同的 `webhook-id` 再一次。接收器保留一个收件箱，其中包含它所处理的 ID（发件箱的收件箱、消费者 `webhooks:payments`)：在不运行处理程序的情况下用空 200 回答已知 id，并且只有在处理程序成功后才记录 id，因此在支付提供者的重试中再次运行抛出的处理程序。两个副本一起到达一个实例运行一次处理程序；同时接收到它们的两个实例都可以运行它，这就是下一段的目的。

blocks.md: `markPaid()` moves money-related state, so the controller goes one step further with `processInTransaction()`: the webhook's id is recorded *through the order's transaction*, and `markPaid()` runs only if it is new. The record and the new status commit together. A redelivery after a crash between the handler and the inbox write, or one racing this request on another instance, finds the id and changes nothing; it resolves with `duplicate` set, which the controller uses to log only once. And when `markPaid()` throws, a payment for the wrong amount, say, the transaction rolls back, the record with it, the sender gets the 409, and its retry gets another chance once the order is fixed.

And when markPaid() throws, a payment for the wrong amount, say, the transaction rolls back, the record with it, the sender gets the 409, and its retry gets another chance once the order is fixed.

blocks.zh: 具有自己方案的发送者是扩展 `WebhookSignatureScheme` 的类。假设商店还通过市场进行销售，该市场在其发布的 URL 后面跟着正文，并将事件的 id 放在正文中：

blocks.md:
- `verify(request, keys)` gets the request's `headers` (lower-case names) and its `rawBody`, as received, and one key per configured secret. It returns `valid: true`, with the sender's `id` when a header carries one and the signed `timestamp` in epoch seconds when the scheme signs one (the receiver's `tolerance` then applies), or `valid: false` with a `reason` for the `verification-failed` event and a `detail`. It runs synchronously, before the body is parsed as JSON.
- `WebhookSignatureScheme.matches(expected, candidates)` compares in constant time. Never compare signatures with `===`.
- `idFromPayload(payload, headers)` gives the deduplication id when no header carries one, from the parsed body, as the built-in Stripe scheme does with the event's `id`. An id longer than 255 characters, from either, is refused with `malformed-header`.
- `key(secret)` turns each configured secret into the key `verify()` receives, once, at startup, where a malformed secret stops the application. The default takes the secret's text and refuses an empty one or one with surrounding whitespace. Override it for an encoded secret, as the `standard` scheme does for `whsec_…`.

blocks.zh:
- `verify(request, keys)` 获取请求的 `headers` （小写名称）及其 `rawBody`，以及每个配置的秘密一个密钥。它返回 `valid: true`，与发件人的 `id` 当标头携带一个和签名 `timestamp` 当方案签署一个（接收者的 `tolerance` 则适用），或 `valid: false` 用一个 `reason` 为了 `verification-failed` 事件和 a `detail`.在主体被解析为之前，它会同步运行 JSON.
- `WebhookSignatureScheme.matches(expected, candidates)` 在恒定时间内进行比较。切勿将签名与 `===` 进行比较。
- `idFromPayload(payload, headers)` 当没有头携带来自解析正文的重复数据删除 id 时，会给出重复数据删除 id，就像内置条带方案对事件的 `id` 所做的那样。使用 `malformed-header` 拒绝长于 255 个字符的 id。
- `key(secret)` 将每个配置的密钥转换为 `verify()` 在启动时接收的密钥，其中格式错误的密钥会停止应用程序。默认值接受秘密的文本，并拒绝一个空的文本或一个周围有空白的文本。对于编码的秘密覆盖它，就像 `standard` 方案对 `whsec_…` 所做的那样。

blocks.md: A secret leaks, or a partner's policy says a year is enough. `POST /partner/webhook-endpoints/:id/rotate-secret` (see [Let partners subscribe](/http/webhooks#let-partners-subscribe)) returns a new secret, and the old one keeps signing next to it for `secretRotationOverlap`, 24 hours: every delivery carries two `v1,` signatures, and a Standard Webhooks verifier accepts any one that matches. The partner adds the new secret to its list, deploys, removes the old one, on its own schedule. After the overlap, only the new secret signs. `rotateSecret()` with `overlap: 0` retires the old one at once, for a leaked secret.
blocks.text: A secret leaks, or a partner's policy says a year is enough. POST /partner/webhook-endpoints/:id/rotate-secret (see Let partners subscribe) returns a new secret, and the old one keeps signing next to it for secretRotationOverlap, 24 hours: every delivery carries two v1, signatures, and a Standard Webhooks verifier accepts any one that matches. The partner adds the new secret to its list, deploys, removes the old one, on its own schedule. After the overlap, only the new secret signs. rotateSecret() with overlap: 0 retires the old one at once, for a leaked secret.
blocks.zh: 机密泄露，或者合作伙伴的政策说一年就够了。`POST /partner/webhook-endpoints/:id/rotate-secret`（见 [Let partners subscribe](/http/webhooks#let-partners-subscribe)）返回一个新的秘密，旧的秘密继续在它旁边签名 `secretRotationOverlap`, 24 小时：每次送货携带两个 `v1,` 签名，标准的 Webhooks 验证器接受任何匹配的签名。合作伙伴按照自己的时间表将新秘密添加到其列表中，部署，删除旧秘密。重叠后，只有新的秘密标志。`rotateSecret()` 和 `overlap: 0` 因为一个泄露的秘密，立刻让旧的退休。

blocks.md:
- The outbox, both stores, the migrations, the fan-out, the signing and the verification are real. Only the network is replaced: `InMemoryWebhookTransport` answers 200 and keeps every request, and `respondWith(503)` or a function simulates a partner that is down, slow or picky.
- `deliver()` is the whole pipeline after the commit: `relay.runOnce()` publishes the committed messages (the fan-out creates the deliveries), `worker.runOnce()` claims one batch and sends it.
- `SentWebhook.isSignedWith(secret)` verifies the `v1` signature with an endpoint's secret, and `data` is the body's `data`, so a test asserts on what the partner would have verified and read.
- `signWebhook()` produces the body and headers the payment provider, Stripe or GitHub would send. Reuse its `id` for a redelivery, move `timestamp` to test the tolerance, change a byte of the body for a tampered request.
- For behavior that depends on time, such as backoff, leases and the rotation overlap, move `Date.now()` forward with `vi.spyOn(Date, 'now')`. The worker and the stores take the time from it, and real timers keep running for sockets.
- The example's `tutorial.e2e-spec.ts` runs every section of this page over real HTTP, on PGlite and on a PostgreSQL server: the API delivers to the partner's receiver through the default transport, with the outage, the replay, the redeliveries and the rotation. Its `zod.e2e-spec.ts` boots the same app with the Zod variants of the DTOs and `StandardSchemaValidationPipe`. Its store tests run the stores through Drizzle on PGlite, PostgreSQL and MySQL, and through TypeORM on PostgreSQL: the contract suites, a dispatch that commits and rolls back with the order, and the schemas in production.

- 发件箱、两个存储、迁移、扇出、签名和验证都是真实的。仅更换网络：`InMemoryWebhookTransport` 回答 200 个并保留每个请求，以及 `respondWith(503)` 或者一个函数模拟一个情绪低落、缓慢或挑剔的伙伴。
- `deliver()` 是提交后的整个管道：`relay.runOnce()` 发布提交的消息（扇出创建传递），`worker.runOnce()` 认领一批并发送。
- `SentWebhook.isSignedWith(secret)` 验证 `v1` 使用端点的机密签名，以及 `data` 是身体的 `data` 因此，测试断言合作伙伴会验证和读取什么。
- `signWebhook()` 生成支付提供者、Stripe 或 GitHub 将发送的正文和标题。重复使用它 `id` 若要重新交付，请移动 `timestamp` 若要测试公差，请更改正文中的一个字节以表示篡改的请求。
- 对于依赖于时间的行为，如后退、租赁和旋转重叠，将 `Date.now()` 与 `vi.spyOn(Date, 'now')` 一起向前移动。工人和商店从中抽出时间，实时计时器继续为插座运行。

blocks.md: Delivery guarantees
blocks.text: Delivery guarantees
blocks.zh: 交货保证

blocks.md: Outgoing webhooks are delivered **at least once**; the receiver deduplicates by `webhook-id`.
blocks.text: Outgoing webhooks are delivered at least once; the receiver deduplicates by webhook-id.
blocks.zh: 传出的 webhooks 被传送**至少一次**；接收器通过 `webhook-id` 进行重复数据删除。

blocks.md:
| Situation | Outcome |
| --- | --- |
| The order's transaction rolls back | The message never existed and nothing is sent |
| The order's transaction commits | One delivery per subscribed endpoint of the tenant, eventually delivered or failed with its attempt log |
| The outbox redelivers the message (a relay crashed after the fan-out) | The fan-out is idempotent: one delivery per message and endpoint |
| The endpoint was created after the message, or is disabled | It doesn't receive it, and a replay doesn't bring it back |
| A worker dies after claiming | Sent by another worker once the lease expires (`worker.lease`, 1 minute) |
| A worker dies after sending, before recording | **Sent twice**, with the same `webhook-id`, once the lease expires |
| Two workers, same delivery | A claim is exclusive for the lease, and every later write is fenced by it |
| The partner answers 2xx | Delivered |
| It answers anything else, or nothing | Retried with backoff, `Retry-After` honored; 429, 502, 503 and 504 pace the endpoint |
| It answers 410 Gone | Failed (`rejected`), and the endpoint is disabled (`gone`) |
| Every attempt fails for `disableEndpointAfter` | The endpoint is disabled (`failing`), once |
| A partner asks for a replay | A new round with the same `webhook-id`, so its inbox skips it |
blocks.zh:
| 情况 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 订单的事务回滚 | 消息从未存在过，也没有发送任何内容 |
| 订单的事务提交 | 租户的每个订阅端点一次交付，最终交付或失败，并附有其尝试日志 |
| 发件箱重新传递消息（扇出后中继崩溃） | 扇出是幂等的：每个消息和端点一个传递 |
| 端点是在消息之后创建的，或者已被禁用 | 它不会收到它，重播也不会把它带回来 |
| 一名工人在索赔后死亡 | 租约到期后由另一名工人寄出（`worker.lease`，1 分钟） |
| 工人在发送后、录制前死亡 | **发送两次**，相同 `webhook-id`，一旦租约到期 |
| 两个工人，同样的交付 | 索赔仅限于租赁，以后的每一次写入都受到索赔的限制 |
| 合作伙伴回答 2xx | 交付 |
| 它回答任何其他问题，或者什么都不回答 | 后退重试，`Retry-After` 荣誉；429、502、503 和 504 对端点进行起搏 |
| 它回答 410 消失 | 失败 (`rejected`)，且端点已禁用 (`gone`) |
| 每次尝试都失败了 `disableEndpointAfter` | 端点被禁用（`failing`)，一 |
| 合作伙伴要求重播 | 新一轮相同 `webhook-id` 所以它的收件箱会跳过它 |

blocks.md: Deliveries have **no order**. A worker sends one endpoint's deliveries one at a time, most overdue first, but a failed attempt waits out its backoff while later messages go out, several workers send to the same endpoint at once, and a replay sends an old message now. Two updates of one order can reach the partner in either order. Receivers cope as they do with duplicates: the body's `timestamp` is when the message was dispatched (`webhook-timestamp` is when this attempt was signed), so a handler can ignore an event older than the state it already holds, or treat the webhook as a signal and read the current state from the API.

A worker sends one endpoint's deliveries one at a time, most overdue first, but a failed attempt waits out its backoff while later messages go out, several workers send to the same endpoint at once, and a replay sends an old message now. Two updates of one order can reach the partner in either order. Receivers cope as they do with duplicates: the body's timestamp is when the message was dispatched (webhook-timestamp is when this attempt was signed), so a handler can ignore an event older than the state it already holds, or treat the webhook as a signal and read the current state from the API.
blocks.zh: 送货没有订单**。一个工人一次发送一个端点的传递，大多数是先过期的，但失败的尝试等待其回退，而稍后的消息发出，几个工人同时发送到同一端点，重播现在发送旧消息。一个订单的两次更新可以以任一顺序到达合作伙伴。接收者处理重复的方式与处理重复的方式相同：身体的 `timestamp` 是发送消息的时间（`webhook-timestamp` 是此尝试被签名的时候），因此处理程序可以忽略比它已经持有的状态更老的事件，或者将 webhook 视为信号并从 API.

blocks.md: Incoming webhooks run their handler **once per webhook id and receiver in the common case** with the default inbox (again after a crash between the handler and the inbox write, or when two copies race on two instances), and their `processInTransaction()` work **exactly once**.

blocks.zh: 传入的 webhooks 使用默认收件箱运行它们的处理程序**在常见情况下每个 webhook id 和接收器一次**（在处理程序和收件箱写入之间崩溃之后，或者当两个副本在两个实例上竞争时），以及它们的 `processInTransaction()` 工作**正好一次**。

blocks.md: Production checklist
blocks.text: Production checklist
blocks.zh: 生产检查表

blocks.md:
- Keep the endpoints and the deliveries in your application's database, on a database server: register `PostgresWebhookStore`, or `MySqlWebhookStore`, and the outbox's store next to it ([Keep webhooks in your database](/http/webhooks#keep-webhooks-in-your-database)). The production guard refuses to start in memory; `allowInMemoryStorage` is for a process whose pending deliveries you can afford to lose.
- Apply both stores' migrations before a new version starts, with `npx @nestjs/webhooks migrate` and `npx @nestjs/outbox migrate` or your migration tool, and check them in CI with `status`. With `NODE_ENV=production`, the stores don't migrate at startup: a schema that's behind fails it instead.
- On PostgreSQL, keep the database's default isolation at READ COMMITTED: the stores refuse a stricter one. On MySQL, run a transaction again when MySQL breaks a deadlock in it (error 1213): it rolled back, with the messages it dispatched and the webhooks it recorded.
- Leave `delivery.allowHttp` and `delivery.allowPrivateNetworks` off. A partner's URL is untrusted input, and the transport resolves it itself and pins the address it checked. Use `allowedAddresses` for the one private range you really deliver to, and alert on `destination-blocked` events: a customer pointing a webhook at your metadata service is worth a look.
- Run the worker in a few instances (`WEBHOOKS_WORKER`), not in every API pod: each claim is a short transaction, and the leases keep them from sending the same delivery twice.
- Alert on `lagMs` and `failed` from `deliveries.stats()`, and on `endpoint-disabled`: tell the partner, by email, that their endpoint was switched off and why.
- Version the payloads. A partner keeps its handler for years, and `retry()` re-sends the body as it was dispatched. Add fields to a type's `data`, never rename or remove one. For a breaking change, add a new type, `order.shipped.v2` in `eventTypes`, and dispatch both in the same transaction (`dispatch()` takes an array) while partners move their subscriptions over; an endpoint subscribed to `*` gets both. Then stop dispatching the old type. Replays of older messages still carry the old shape until the log is pruned.
- Give partners the delivery log and the replay. It answers "did you send it?" before they open a ticket.
- Rotate secrets with the overlap, never with `overlap: 0` unless a secret leaked, and seal them at rest with `WEBHOOKS_ENCRYPTION_KEYS`. Keep the keys in a secret manager.
- Prune the log. `deliveries.prune('30d')` from a [cron job](/application/task-scheduling#declarative-cron-jobs); nothing schedules it for you.
- For incoming webhooks, keep `rawBody: true`, and keep the receivers' secrets in the environment. List the old and the new secret while a provider rotates.
- Keep provider handlers short and idempotent in their own right (a status check inside the transaction), even with `processInTransaction()`: the inbox protects against a redelivery, the check against a provider that sends two different events for one fact.
- Prune the inbox with `OutboxInbox.prune()` on a window longer than any provider's retry schedule (Stripe retries for three days, GitHub doesn't retry at all). For GitHub, that window is also how long a replayed request is caught, with the deduplication keyed on the body ([Other senders](/http/webhooks#other-senders)).
- Call `app.enableShutdownHooks()`, so a deploy lets attempts in flight finish and releases the rest.
- For a store of your own, run the contract suites with `concurrent: true` in CI, against the database version you run in production.
blocks.text: Keep the endpoints and the deliveries in your application's database, on a database server: register PostgresWebhookStore, or MySqlWebhookStore, and the outbox's store next to it (Keep webhooks in your database). The production guard refuses to start in memory; allowInMemoryStorage is for a process whose pending deliveries you can afford to lose. Apply both stores' migrations before a new version starts, with npx @nestjs/webhooks migrate and npx @nestjs/outbox migrate or your migration tool, and check them in CI with status. With NODE_ENV=production, the stores don't migrate at startup: a schema that's behind fails it instead. On PostgreSQL, keep the database's default isolation at READ COMMITTED: the stores refuse a stricter one. On MySQL, run a transaction again when MySQL breaks a deadlock in it (error 1213): it rolled back, with the messages it dispatched and the webhooks it recorded. Leave delivery.allowHttp and delivery.allowPrivateNetworks off. A partner's URL is untrusted input, and the transport resolves it itself and pins the address it checked. Use allowedAddresses for the one private range you really deliver to, and alert on destination-blocked events: a customer pointing a webhook at your metadata service is worth a look. Run the worker in a few instances (WEBHOOKS_WORKER), not in every API pod: each claim is a short transaction, and the leases keep them from sending the same delivery twice. Alert on lagMs and failed from deliveries.stats(), and on endpoint-disabled: tell the partner, by email, that their endpoint was switched off and why. Version the payloads. A partner keeps its handler for years, and retry() re-sends the body as it was dispatched. Add fields to a type's data, never rename or remove one. For a breaking change, add a new type, order.shipped.v2 in eventTypes, and dispatch both in the same transaction (dispatch() takes an array) while partners move their subscriptions over; an endpoint subscribed to * gets both. Then stop dispatching the old type. Replays of older messages still carry the old shape until the log is pruned. Give partners the delivery log and the replay. It answers "did you send it?" before they open a ticket. Rotate secrets with the overlap, never with overlap: 0 unless a secret leaked, and seal them at rest with WEBHOOKS_ENCRYPTION_KEYS. Keep the keys in a secret manager. Prune the log. deliveries.prune('30d') from a cron job; nothing schedules it for you. For incoming webhooks, keep rawBody: true, and keep the receivers' secrets in the environment. List the old and the new secret while a provider rotates. Keep provider handlers short and idempotent in their own right (a status check inside the transaction), even with processInTransaction(): the inbox protects against a redelivery, the check against a provider that sends two different events for one fact. Prune the inbox with OutboxInbox.prune() on a window longer than any provider's retry schedule (Stripe retries for three days, GitHub doesn't retry at all). For GitHub, that window is also how long a replayed request is caught, with the deduplication keyed on the body (Other senders). Call app.enableShutdownHooks(), so a deploy lets attempts in flight finish and releases the rest. For a store of your own, run the contract suites with concurrent: true in CI, against the database version you run in production.
blocks.zh:
- 将端点和交付保存在应用程序的数据库中，在数据库服务器上：注册 `PostgresWebhookStore` 或 `MySqlWebhookStore`，并将发件箱存储在它旁边（[Keep webhooks in your database](/http/webhooks#keep-webhooks-in-your-database)）。生产警卫拒绝在内存中启动；`allowInMemoryStorage` 适用于您可以承受丢失待处理交付的过程。
- 在新版本开始之前，使用 `npx @nestjs/webhooks migrate` 和 `npx @nestjs/outbox migrate` 或您的迁移工具应用两个存储库的迁移，并使用 `status` 在 CI 中签入它们。使用 `NODE_ENV=production`，存储不会在启动时迁移：背后的模式会使其失败。
- 在 PostgreSQL 上，将数据库的默认隔离设置为 READCOMMITTED：商店拒绝更严格的。在 MySQL 上，当 MySQL 打破事务中的死锁（错误 1213）时，再次运行事务：它回滚，发送的消息和记录的 webhooks。
- 离开 `delivery.allowHttp` 和 `delivery.allowPrivateNetworks` 离开。合伙人的 URL 是不受信任的输入，传输会自动解析它并固定它检查的地址。使用 `allowedAddresses` 对于您真正交付的一个私人范围，并保持警惕 `destination-blocked` 事件：客户将 webhook 指向您的元数据服务值得一看。
- 在几个实例中运行 worker（`WEBHOOKS_WORKER`），不是每一个 APIpod：每次索赔都是一笔短期交易，租赁可以防止他们两次发送相同的货物。
- 警戒 `lagMs` 和 `failed` 来自 `deliveries.stats()`，等等 `endpoint-disabled`：通过电子邮件告知合作伙伴他们的端点已关闭以及原因。
- 版本有效载荷。合伙人保留其处理程序多年，并且 `retry()` 重新发送发送的正文。将字段添加到类型 `data`，切勿重命名或删除。要进行突破性更改，请添加一个新类型，`order.shipped.v2` 在 `eventTypes`，并在同一事务中调度两者（`dispatch()` 获取一个数组），而合作伙伴将他们的订阅移至；订阅的端点 `*` 两者兼得。那就停止派遣旧式。旧消息的重播仍然保留旧形状，直到日志被修剪。
- 向合作伙伴提供交付日志和回放。它回答“你发送了吗？”在他们开票之前。
- 用重叠旋转秘密，除非有秘密泄露，否则永远不要用 `overlap: 0` 旋转，并用 `WEBHOOKS_ENCRYPTION_KEYS` 密封它们。把钥匙放在一个秘密管理器里。
- 修剪原木。`deliveries.prune('30d')` 来自 [cron 作业](/application/task-scheduling#declarative-cron-jobs)；没有什么能为你安排的。
- 对于传入的 webhooks，保持 `rawBody: true`，并将接收者的秘密保存在环境中。在提供者轮换时列出新旧秘密。
- 使提供程序处理程序在其自身的权限（事务内部的状态检查）中保持简短和幂等，即使 `processInTransaction()`：收件箱防止重新传递，检查针对为一个事实发送两个不同事件的提供者。
- 修剪收件箱 `OutboxInbox.prune()` 在比任何提供者的重试时间表都长的窗口上（条纹重试三天，GitHub 根本不重试）。对于 GitHub，该窗口也是捕获重放请求的时长，重复数据删除键在主体上（[Other senders](/http/webhooks#other-senders)).
- 呼吁 `app.enableShutdownHooks()`，因此部署让飞行中的尝试完成并释放其余的。
- 对于您自己的商店，请使用 `concurrent: true` 在 CI，与生产中运行的数据库版本相比。
