blocks.md: Database queries and outbound HTTP
blocks.text: Database queries and outbound HTTP
blocks.zh: 数据库查询和出站 HTTP

blocks.md: Since `@nestjs/observe` 0.3.0, database queries and outbound requests appear as spans with no configuration, nested under the method that made them. A slow repository call shows _which_ statement it was waiting on.
blocks.text: Since @nestjs/observe 0.3.0, database queries and outbound requests appear as spans with no configuration, nested under the method that made them. A slow repository call shows _which_ statement it was waiting on.
blocks.zh: 自从 `@nestjs/observe`0.3.0，数据库查询和出站请求显示为没有配置的跨度，嵌套在创建它们的方法下。缓慢的存储库调用显示它正在等待的_which_语句。

blocks.alt: A query opened in the waterfall

blocks.md: Databases are instrumented at the driver rather than the ORM: `pg`, `mysql2` and `mongodb` are detected if your application already depends on them, which covers TypeORM, MikroORM, Drizzle, Mongoose, Knex, Sequelize, and Prisma's driver adapters without naming any of them. ORMs that ship their own nested copy of a driver (MikroORM and Mongoose do, whenever versions disagree) are handled too. The driver's own housekeeping (connection handshakes, authentication, pings) is not recorded. A query span is labeled with its verb and table (`SELECT users`) and carries the statement with **every literal removed** - strings, numbers, `IN (...)` lists, and comments are replaced before the span leaves the process, and bound parameters are never read at all. Repeated queries under one parent fold into a single node with a count, so an N+1 reads as `SELECT order_items ×47` rather than 47 rows.
blocks.text: Databases are instrumented at the driver rather than the ORM: pg, mysql2 and mongodb are detected if your application already depends on them, which covers TypeORM, MikroORM, Drizzle, Mongoose, Knex, Sequelize, and Prisma's driver adapters without naming any of them. ORMs that ship their own nested copy of a driver (MikroORM and Mongoose do, whenever versions disagree) are handled too. The driver's own housekeeping (connection handshakes, authentication, pings) is not recorded. A query span is labeled with its verb and table (SELECT users) and carries the statement with every literal removed - strings, numbers, IN (...) lists, and comments are replaced before the span leaves the process, and bound parameters are never read at all. Repeated queries under one parent fold into a single node with a count, so an N+1 reads as SELECT order_items ×47 rather than 47 rows.
blocks.zh: 数据库是在驱动程序处而不是 ORM:`pg`,`mysql2` 和 `mongodb` 如果您的应用程序已经依赖于它们，则会检测到它们，这包括 TypeORM,微型蠕虫,Drizzle、猫鼬、Knex、Sequelize 和 Prisma 的驱动程序适配器，但没有命名其中任何一个。也可以处理发送自己的驱动程序嵌套副本的 ORM（MikroORM 和 Mongoose，每当版本不一致时）。驱动程序自己的内务（连接握手、身份验证、ping）不会被记录。查询跨度用其动词和表（`SELECT users`) 并携带**删除每个文字**的语句——字符串、数字，`IN (...)` 在跨度离开进程之前，列表和注释会被替换，并且绑定的参数根本不会被读取。一个父节点下的重复查询折叠到一个计数节点中，因此 N+1 读取为 `SELECT order_items ×47` 而不是 47 排。

blocks.md: Outbound HTTP is read from Node's own diagnostics channels, so `fetch`, `undici`, and everything built on `node:http` (axios, got, most SDKs) are covered with nothing patched. The span is labeled `GET api.example.com` and carries the URL with sensitive query parameters masked. The SDK also sends the current trace id as `x-request-id`, which makes [HTTP-to-HTTP tracing](/observability/distributed-tracing#http-to-http) automatic.
blocks.text: Outbound HTTP is read from Node's own diagnostics channels, so fetch, undici, and everything built on node:http (axios, got, most SDKs) are covered with nothing patched. The span is labeled GET api.example.com and carries the URL with sensitive query parameters masked. The SDK also sends the current trace id as x-request-id, which makes HTTP-to-HTTP tracing automatic.
blocks.zh: 出境 HTTP 是从 Node 自己的诊断渠道，所以 `fetch`,`undici` 以及建立在 `node:http`（axios，got，大多数 SDK）没有任何修补。跨度已标记 `GET api.example.com` 并携带 URL 隐藏了敏感的查询参数。这个 SDK 还将当前跟踪 id 发送为 `x-request-id`，这使得 [HTTP-to-HTTP tracing](/observability/distributed-tracing#http-to-http) 自动的。

blocks.md: Set `outgoing: false` to switch all of it off, or `database: false` / `http: false` individually.
blocks.text: Set outgoing: false to switch all of it off, or database: false / http: false individually.
blocks.zh: 设置 `outgoing: false` 把它全部关掉，或者 `database: false`/`http: false` 个别地。

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md: These spans are **not billed**. They are detail about a method span you already sent, so they don't count toward your Observability Events or your rate cap. A request that runs ten queries costs the same as before.
blocks.text: These spans are not billed. They are detail about a method span you already sent, so they don't count toward your Observability Events or your rate cap. A request that runs ten queries costs the same as before.
blocks.zh: 这些跨度是**未计费**。它们是您已经发送的方法跨度的详细信息，因此它们不计入您的可观察性事件或您的速率上限。运行十个查询的请求的成本与以前相同。

blocks.md: WebSocket gateways
blocks.text: WebSocket gateways
blocks.zh: WebSocket 网关

blocks.md: Messages handled by `@SubscribeMessage()` are reported as requests with the `ws` protocol and an operation id of `GatewayClass:pattern`, on any platform adapter. The `ws` option block takes the same `ignore`, `tags`, `setAttributes`, and `getUserId` hooks as the other transports; each receives `{ gateway, pattern, client, data }`. Connections and disconnections are not operations and are not reported.
blocks.text: Messages handled by @SubscribeMessage() are reported as requests with the ws protocol and an operation id of GatewayClass:pattern, on any platform adapter. The ws option block takes the same ignore, tags, setAttributes, and getUserId hooks as the other transports; each receives { gateway, pattern, client, data }. Connections and disconnections are not operations and are not reported.
blocks.zh: 在任何平台适配器上，由 `@SubscribeMessage()` 处理的消息都会报告为具有 `ws` 协议和操作 id 为 `GatewayClass:pattern` 的请求。`ws` 选项块采用与其他传输相同的 `ignore`、`tags`、`setAttributes` 和 `getUserId` 挂钩；每个人都收到 `{ gateway, pattern, client, data }`。连接和断开不是操作，不会报告。

blocks.md: Queues
blocks.text: Queues
blocks.zh: 尾巴

blocks.md: `@nestjs/bullmq` and the original `@nestjs/bull` are both instrumented: every processor run is reported as a job, with its queue wait, attempt number, and outcome. A job added from inside a traced operation inherits that operation's trace id - see [Distributed tracing](/observability/distributed-tracing#queue-jobs-bullmq-and-bull).
blocks.text: @nestjs/bullmq and the original @nestjs/bull are both instrumented: every processor run is reported as a job, with its queue wait, attempt number, and outcome. A job added from inside a traced operation inherits that operation's trace id - see Distributed tracing.
blocks.zh: `@nestjs/bullmq` 和原始的 `@nestjs/bull` 都是工具化的：每个处理器运行都被报告为一个作业，包括它的队列等待、尝试次数和结果。从跟踪操作内部添加的作业继承该操作的跟踪 id-参见 [Distributed tracing](/observability/distributed-tracing#queue-jobs-bullmq-and-bull)。

blocks.md: Runtime metrics and profiling
blocks.text: Runtime metrics and profiling
blocks.zh: 运行时度量和分析

blocks.md: `runtimeMetrics` (default `true`) samples memory, CPU, garbage collection, and event loop latency on an interval (`runtimeMetricsInterval`, default `60000` ms) and feeds the **Profiler**. The same samples double as the application's heartbeat: a **Telemetry silence** alert fires when they stop arriving, which gives you lightweight uptime monitoring without an external probe.
blocks.text: runtimeMetrics (default true) samples memory, CPU, garbage collection, and event loop latency on an interval (runtimeMetricsInterval, default 60000 ms) and feeds the Profiler. The same samples double as the application's heartbeat: a Telemetry silence alert fires when they stop arriving, which gives you lightweight uptime monitoring without an external probe.
blocks.zh: `runtimeMetrics`（默认 `true`) 存储器样本，CPU、垃圾收集和间隔内的事件循环延迟（`runtimeMetricsInterval`, 默认 `60000`ms) 并馈送**Profiler**。相同的样本是应用程序的心跳：当它们停止到达时，**遥测静音**警报会触发，这使您无需外部探头即可轻量级正常运行时间监控。

blocks.md: Errors and failed requests
blocks.text: Errors and failed requests
blocks.zh: 错误和失败的请求

blocks.md: An error that escapes a controller, resolver, or job is captured automatically. These options decide what comes with it: the source code around the failing frame, and the headers and body of the request that failed.
blocks.text: An error that escapes a controller, resolver, or job is captured automatically. These options decide what comes with it: the source code around the failing frame, and the headers and body of the request that failed.
blocks.zh: 会自动捕获逃逸控制器、解析器或作业的错误。这些选项决定了随之而来的内容：失败帧周围的源代码，以及失败请求的头和正文。

blocks.md: Error source context
blocks.text: Error source context
blocks.zh: 错误源上下文

blocks.md: Errors that propagate out of a controller, resolver, job, or span are captured automatically. When `sourceContext` is enabled (the default), the SDK also reads the source lines around each in-app stack frame of a captured error and attaches them. This lets the dashboard show the failing code alongside the stack trace, even for a production failure on a build you don't have checked out.
blocks.text: Errors that propagate out of a controller, resolver, job, or span are captured automatically. When sourceContext is enabled (the default), the SDK also reads the source lines around each in-app stack frame of a captured error and attaches them. This lets the dashboard show the failing code alongside the stack trace, even for a production failure on a build you don't have checked out.
blocks.zh: 会自动捕获从控制器、解析器、作业或跨度传播的错误。何时 `sourceContext` 启用（默认值），SDK 还会读取捕获错误的每个应用内堆栈帧周围的源代码行，并附加它们。这使得仪表板可以在堆栈跟踪旁边显示失败代码，即使是您尚未签出的版本上的生产失败。

blocks.md: This is an option of `createObserveModule()`, not `forRoot()`. Set `sourceContext: false` to disable it, or pass an object to tune the defaults:
blocks.text: This is an option of createObserveModule(), not forRoot(). Set sourceContext: false to disable it, or pass an object to tune the defaults:
blocks.zh: 这是 `createObserveModule()` 的选项，而不是 `forRoot()`。设置 `sourceContext: false` 以禁用它，或者传递一个对象来调整默认值：

blocks.md:
| Option           | Type      | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ---------------- | --------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `linesOfContext` | `number`  | `5`     | Lines read on either side of the frame's line.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `maxFrames`      | `number`  | `5`     | How many in-app frames, counted from the top of the stack, get source attached. Bounds the payload on deep stacks.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `sourceMaps`     | `boolean` | `false` | Resolves compiled frames back through source maps before reading source. Only needed if the process runs compiled output _without_ Node's own source map support (`--enable-source-maps` or `process.setSourceMapsEnabled(true)`); with that on, frames already carry original positions and this is redundant. Costs a map parse per compiled file on first touch, cached after. |

blocks.title: Warning
blocks.md: Enabling this ships fragments of your application's source code (usually a few lines around the error) to your dashboard, where they are stored alongside the error. Frames inside `node_modules` and Node internals are never read, only application source. Turn it off if shipping any source is not acceptable for your codebase.
blocks.text: Enabling this ships fragments of your application's source code (usually a few lines around the error) to your dashboard, where they are stored alongside the error. Frames inside node_modules and Node internals are never read, only application source. Turn it off if shipping any source is not acceptable for your codebase.
blocks.zh: 启用此功能会将应用程序源代码的片段（通常是错误周围的几行）发送到您的仪表板，并将它们存储在错误旁边。内部框架 `node_modules` 和 Node 从不读取内部文件，只读应用程序源。如果您的代码库不接受发送任何源代码，请将其关闭。

blocks.md: Capturing failed and slow requests
blocks.text: Capturing failed and slow requests
blocks.zh: 捕获失败和缓慢的请求

blocks.md: When an HTTP request **fails**, the SDK records a small, fixed allow-list of its headers alongside it - `user-agent`, `content-type`, `content-length`, `accept`, `host`, `origin` and `referer`. None of these authenticate or identify the caller. If you set `slowerThanMs`, requests that ran at least that long are captured the same way, failed or not. An ordinary request records nothing. Request bodies are **off** by default; turn them on explicitly if you want them:
blocks.text: When an HTTP request fails, the SDK records a small, fixed allow-list of its headers alongside it - user-agent, content-type, content-length, accept, host, origin and referer. None of these authenticate or identify the caller. If you set slowerThanMs, requests that ran at least that long are captured the same way, failed or not. An ordinary request records nothing. Request bodies are off by default; turn them on explicitly if you want them:
blocks.zh: 当 HTTP 请求**失败**时，SDK 会在其旁边记录一个小的、固定的允许列表——`user-agent`、`content-type`、`content-length`、`accept`、`host`、`origin` 和 `referer`。这些都不能认证或识别呼叫者。如果设置 `slowerThanMs`，运行至少那么长时间的请求都会以相同的方式捕获，无论是否失败。一个普通的请求什么都不记录。默认情况下，请求主体为**关闭**；如果需要，请显式打开它们：

blocks.md: Everything captured passes through [`redaction`](/observability/sdk#logs) before it leaves the process: sensitive keys (`password`, `token`, `authorization`, ...) are masked by name inside the body, and naming a sensitive header records `[REDACTED]` instead of its value. `capture: false` records nothing. The capture is shown on the request's detail page as a **Request** card.
blocks.text: Everything captured passes through redaction before it leaves the process: sensitive keys (password, token, authorization, ...) are masked by name inside the body, and naming a sensitive header records [REDACTED] instead of its value. capture: false records nothing. The capture is shown on the request's detail page as a Request card.
blocks.zh: 捕获的一切都会通过 [`redaction`](/observability/sdk#logs) 在它离开进程之前：敏感键（`password`,`token`,`authorization`, ...) 被主体内部的名称掩盖，并命名敏感的头记录 `[REDACTED]` 而不是它的价值。`capture: false` 什么都没记录。捕获在请求的详细信息页面上显示为**请求**卡片。

blocks.md: Logs and trace correlation
blocks.text: Logs and trace correlation
blocks.zh: 日志和轨迹相关性

blocks.md: Every execution gets a trace id. These options decide how your log lines relate to it: forwarded to the dashboard, or only stamped with the id so your own log stack can link to the trace.
blocks.text: Every execution gets a trace id. These options decide how your log lines relate to it: forwarded to the dashboard, or only stamped with the id so your own log stack can link to the trace.
blocks.zh: 每次执行都会得到一个跟踪 id。这些选项决定了您的日志行与它的关系：转发到仪表板，或者只标记 id，以便您自己的日志堆栈可以链接到跟踪。

blocks.md: Logs
blocks.text: Logs
blocks.zh: 日志

blocks.md: `forwardLogs` (default `false`) sends your application's log lines (anything written through Nest's `Logger`) to the dashboard, correlated to the trace that was active when each line was written. On an execution page, every line is placed on the trace's clock next to the span that was in flight when it was written. Log forwarding is available on Pro and above.
blocks.text: forwardLogs (default false) sends your application's log lines (anything written through Nest's Logger) to the dashboard, correlated to the trace that was active when each line was written. On an execution page, every line is placed on the trace's clock next to the span that was in flight when it was written. Log forwarding is available on Pro and above.
blocks.zh: `forwardLogs`（默认 `false`）发送应用程序的日志行（任何写入的内容 Nest 的 `Logger`) 到仪表板，与每行写入时活动的跟踪相关联。在执行页面上，每一行都放在跟踪的时钟上，紧挨着编写时正在飞行的跨度。日志转发在 Pro 及以上版本上可用。

blocks.md: Forwarding logs moves them onto infrastructure you don't control, so redaction is on by default. The same redaction also scrubs the message and stack of every captured error and any captured request data, whether or not `forwardLogs` is on:
blocks.text: Forwarding logs moves them onto infrastructure you don't control, so redaction is on by default. The same redaction also scrubs the message and stack of every captured error and any captured request data, whether or not forwardLogs is on:
blocks.zh: 转发日志会将它们移动到您无法控制的基础架构上，因此默认情况下会启用编辑功能。同样的编辑还会擦除每个捕获的错误和任何捕获的请求数据的消息和堆栈，无论是否 `forwardLogs` 正在开启：

blocks.md:
| `redaction` field    | Type       | Default        | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| -------------------- | ---------- | -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `enabled`            | `boolean`  | `true`         | Whether anything is scrubbed at all.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `useDefaultPatterns` | `boolean`  | `true`         | Applies the built-in patterns: bearer tokens, JWTs, AWS key ids, PEM private keys, `key=value` secrets, and Luhn-valid card numbers. Disable only if you're replacing them wholesale with your own `patterns`; there's no supported case for forwarding logs unredacted.  |
| `patterns`           | `RegExp[]` | -              | Extra patterns to mask, for secrets shaped in a way only your codebase knows (internal token prefixes, customer identifiers). Always applied as if global, so a match is never limited to the first occurrence in a line.                                                |
| `keys`               | `string[]` | -              | Extra keys whose values are masked outright (in log attributes, captured headers and bodies, and URL query strings), on top of the built-in list. Compared case-insensitively and ignoring `-`/`_`, so `apiKey`, `api_key`, and `API-KEY` are one entry.                                                                               |
| `replacement`        | `string`   | `'[REDACTED]'` | Text substituted for anything matched.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
blocks.zh:
| `redaction` 领域 | 类型 | 默认的 | 描述 |
| -------------------- | ---------- | -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | 是否有任何东西被擦洗过。 |
| `useDefaultPatterns` | `boolean` | `true` | 应用内置模式：承载令牌、JWT， AWS 密钥 ID， PEM 私钥， `key=value` 秘密和卢恩有效的卡号。仅当您用自己的批发替换它们时禁用 `patterns`;不支持未经编辑的转发日志。 |
| `patterns` | `RegExp[]` | - | 要屏蔽的额外模式，用于以只有您的代码库知道的方式形成的秘密（内部令牌前缀、客户标识符）。总是像全局一样应用，因此匹配永远不会局限于一行中的第一次出现。 |
| `keys` | `string[]` | - | 其值被完全屏蔽的额外键（在日志属性、捕获的标头和正文中，以及 URL 查询字符串），位于内置列表的顶部。比较不区分大小写和忽略 `-`/`_`,所以 `apiKey`,`api_key`，和 `API-KEY` 是一个条目。 |
| `replacement` | `string` | `'[REDACTED]'` | 替换任何匹配内容的文本。 |

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md: Even with `forwardLogs` off, the SDK augments `ConsoleLogger` so every line written inside a traced execution carries its trace id (`attachTraceIdToLogs`, see [Trace correlation](#trace-correlation)). That lets you correlate your own log aggregator with traces in the dashboard without shipping the log content anywhere.
blocks.text: Even with forwardLogs off, the SDK augments ConsoleLogger so every line written inside a traced execution carries its trace id (attachTraceIdToLogs, see Trace correlation). That lets you correlate your own log aggregator with traces in the dashboard without shipping the log content anywhere.
blocks.zh: 即使有 `forwardLogs` 关闭， SDK 增加 `ConsoleLogger` 因此，在跟踪执行中写入的每一行都携带其跟踪 id（`attachTraceIdToLogs`,见 [Trace correlation](#trace-correlation)).这允许您将自己的日志聚合器与仪表板中的跟踪相关联，而无需将日志内容传输到任何地方。

blocks.md: Trace correlation
blocks.text: Trace correlation
blocks.zh: 迹线相关性

blocks.md: These are also options of `createObserveModule()`. They shape how requests get a trace id and how that id shows up in your own logs:
blocks.text: These are also options of createObserveModule(). They shape how requests get a trace id and how that id shows up in your own logs:
blocks.zh: 这些也是 `createObserveModule()` 的选项。它们决定了请求获取跟踪 id 的方式以及该 id 在您自己的日志中的显示方式：

blocks.md:
| Option                | Type                       | Default                                                       | Description                                                                                                                         |
| --------------------- | -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `traceIdKey`          | `string`                   | `'traceId'`                                                   | The key used to store the trace id in the request context, for later retrieval through `TracerService`.                            |
| `traceIdGenerator`    | `(req: unknown) => string` | Adopts a well-formed `x-request-id` (HTTP header, or TCP/Redis packet metadata) if present, else a UUID v7 | Generates the trace id per request. Called with the request object for HTTP; for other protocols it receives the transport context. |
| `attachTraceIdToLogs` | `boolean`                  | `true`                                                        | Augments `ConsoleLogger` to include the trace id in log messages, so logs can be correlated with traces even without `forwardLogs`. In the default text format the id ends the line, after the message (`   Trace ID: <id>`); with [JSON logging](/application/logger#json-logging) it is a `traceId` field. Lines written outside a traced execution are unchanged. |
blocks.zh:
| 选择 | 类型 | 默认的 | 描述 |
| --------------------- | -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `traceIdKey` | `string` | `'traceId'` | 用于在请求上下文中存储跟踪 id 的键，以便稍后通过 `TracerService` 检索。 |
| `traceIdGenerator` | `(req: unknown) => string` | 采用一种成型良好的 `x-request-id`(HTTP 标题，或 TCP/Redis 数据包元数据）如果存在，否则 aUUIDv7 | 生成每个请求的跟踪 id。用 HTTP 的请求对象调用；对于其他协议，它接收传输上下文。 |
| `attachTraceIdToLogs` | `boolean` | `true` | 增加 `ConsoleLogger` 以在日志消息中包含跟踪 id，因此即使没有 `forwardLogs`，日志也可以与跟踪相关联。在默认的文本格式中，id 在消息（` Trace ID: <id>`）之后结束行；对于 [JSON 伐木作业](/application/logger#json-logging)，它是一个 `traceId` 字段。在跟踪执行之外写入的行保持不变。 |

blocks.md: Because the default generator adopts an incoming `x-request-id`, a chain of HTTP services already shares one trace with no extra configuration. The same applies to the TCP and Redis microservice transports on `@nestjs/microservices` 12.0.4 or later. Propagating across gRPC, the other microservice transports, and GraphQL takes a few lines - see [Distributed tracing](/observability/distributed-tracing).
blocks.text: Because the default generator adopts an incoming x-request-id, a chain of HTTP services already shares one trace with no extra configuration. The same applies to the TCP and Redis microservice transports on @nestjs/microservices 12.0.4 or later. Propagating across gRPC, the other microservice transports, and GraphQL takes a few lines - see Distributed tracing.
blocks.zh: 因为默认生成器采用传入 `x-request-id` 一连串的 HTTP 服务已经共享一个跟踪，无需额外配置。这同样适用于 TCP 和 Redis 微服务传输 `@nestjs/microservices` 12.0.4 或更高版本。传播 gRPC、其他微服务传输，以及 GraphQL 需要几行 - 参见 [Distributed tracing](/observability/distributed-tracing).

blocks.md: Shaping what is recorded
blocks.text: Shaping what is recorded
blocks.zh: 塑造记录的内容

blocks.md: These options enrich what the SDK records (who a request was for, what it concerned) and keep out what you don't need.
blocks.text: These options enrich what the SDK records (who a request was for, what it concerned) and keep out what you don't need.
blocks.zh: 这些选项丰富了 SDK 记录（请求是给谁的，它涉及什么），并保留你不需要的。

blocks.md: Associating users with telemetry
blocks.text: Associating users with telemetry
blocks.zh: 将用户与遥测相关联

blocks.md: `getUserId` reads the incoming request and returns whatever identifier your system uses for a person: a user id, an account id, or a tenant-scoped id. Set it once and the **Users** view populates automatically:
blocks.text: getUserId reads the incoming request and returns whatever identifier your system uses for a person: a user id, an account id, or a tenant-scoped id. Set it once and the Users view populates automatically:
blocks.zh: `getUserId` 读取传入的请求，并返回系统用于人员的任何标识符：用户 id、帐户 id 或租户范围 id。设置一次，**用户**视图将自动填充：

blocks.md: The same option exists on `rpc` (receiving the transport id and the `BaseRpcContext`), `grpc` (receiving the call object), `graphql` (receiving the GraphQL context, for operations with no enclosing HTTP request), and `ws` (receiving the gateway message), each reading the transport's own context instead of an HTTP request. Reporting a user identifier is optional: traffic without one still shows up everywhere except the per-user views. The dashboard treats the identifier as an opaque string and never tries to resolve it into a name or an email, so prefer an opaque internal id over anything personally identifying.
blocks.text: The same option exists on rpc (receiving the transport id and the BaseRpcContext), grpc (receiving the call object), graphql (receiving the GraphQL context, for operations with no enclosing HTTP request), and ws (receiving the gateway message), each reading the transport's own context instead of an HTTP request. Reporting a user identifier is optional: traffic without one still shows up everywhere except the per-user views. The dashboard treats the identifier as an opaque string and never tries to resolve it into a name or an email, so prefer an opaque internal id over anything personally identifying.
blocks.zh: 相同的选项存在于 `rpc`（接收传输 id 和 `BaseRpcContext`),`grpc`（接收呼叫对象），`graphql`（接收 GraphQL 上下文，对于没有封装的操作 HTTP 请求），以及 `ws`（接收网关消息），每个都读取传输自己的上下文，而不是 HTTP 请求。报告用户标识符是可选的：除了每个用户的视图之外，没有用户标识符的流量仍然会显示在任何地方。仪表板将标识符视为不透明的字符串，从不试图将其解析为姓名或电子邮件，因此更喜欢不透明的内部 id，而不是任何个人身份识别。

blocks.md: Tags and custom attributes
blocks.text: Tags and custom attributes
blocks.zh: 标记和自定义属性

blocks.md: `http`, `rpc`, `grpc`, `graphql`, and `jobs` each accept the same two options for attaching your own data to every request they cover:
blocks.text: http, rpc, grpc, graphql, and jobs each accept the same two options for attaching your own data to every request they cover:
blocks.zh: `http`,`rpc`,`grpc`,`graphql`，和 `jobs` 每个都接受相同的两个选项，将您自己的数据附加到它们涵盖的每个请求：

blocks.md:
| Option          | Applies                                                       | Description                                                                         |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `tags`          | The same static `Record<string, string>` to every request     | For constants that don't vary per call, e.g., `project`, `env`, `region`.           |
| `setAttributes` | A function of the request/call/job, returning key-value pairs | For anything that varies per call, e.g., a feature flag, a tenant id, a queue name. |

Both appear as tags on the resulting request, job, or span, and are searchable and visible on its detail page. The function receives whatever the transport has: the request for `http`, the transport id and `BaseRpcContext` for `rpc`, the call object for `grpc`, the resolve info and GraphQL context for `graphql`, and `{ queueName, name, id }` for `jobs`. To tag a single span from inside your code rather than every request, use `TracerService` (see [Manual instrumentation](/observability/manual-instrumentation)).
blocks.text: Both appear as tags on the resulting request, job, or span, and are searchable and visible on its detail page. The function receives whatever the transport has: the request for http, the transport id and BaseRpcContext for rpc, the call object for grpc, the resolve info and GraphQL context for graphql, and { queueName, name, id } for jobs. To tag a single span from inside your code rather than every request, use TracerService (see Manual instrumentation).
blocks.zh: 两者都以标记的形式出现在生成的请求、作业或跨度上，并且可以在其详细信息页面上搜索和可见。该函数接收传输的任何内容：`http` 的请求、`rpc` 的传输 id 和 `BaseRpcContext`、`grpc` 的调用对象、`graphql` 的解析信息和 GraphQL 上下文，以及 `jobs` 的 `{ queueName, name, id }`。要从代码中标记单个跨度，而不是每个请求，请使用 `TracerService`（参见 [Manual instrumentation](/observability/manual-instrumentation)）。

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md: A GraphQL server is usually an HTTP endpoint, so its requests are already subject to the `http` options: `http.ignore` drops a request before the GraphQL layer sees it, and `http.getUserId` supplies the user for queries over HTTP. The `graphql` block tunes what happens _inside_ a request that was let through, per operation rather than per resolver, and `graphql.getUserId` is only consulted for operations that aren't already inside an HTTP trace, such as subscriptions over a WebSocket.
blocks.text: A GraphQL server is usually an HTTP endpoint, so its requests are already subject to the http options: http.ignore drops a request before the GraphQL layer sees it, and http.getUserId supplies the user for queries over HTTP. The graphql block tunes what happens _inside_ a request that was let through, per operation rather than per resolver, and graphql.getUserId is only consulted for operations that aren't already inside an HTTP trace, such as subscriptions over a WebSocket.
blocks.zh: GraphQL 服务器通常是 HTTP 端点，因此它的请求已经受到 `http` 选项的约束：`http.ignore` 在 GraphQL 层看到请求之前放弃请求，`http.getUserId` 向用户提供通过 HTTP 进行查询。`graphql` 块调谐每个操作而不是每个解析器允许通过的请求中发生的事情，并且 `graphql.getUserId` 仅对尚未在 HTTP 跟踪中的操作进行咨询，例如通过 WebSocket 进行订阅。

blocks.md: Ignoring noisy operations
blocks.text: Ignoring noisy operations
blocks.zh: 忽略噪声操作

blocks.md: Every inbound transport block (`http`, `rpc`, `grpc`, `graphql`, and `ws`) has an `ignore` option that skips instrumentation entirely for matching calls, such as a health check endpoint, an internal probe, or anything else not worth a trace:
blocks.text: Every inbound transport block (http, rpc, grpc, graphql, and ws) has an ignore option that skips instrumentation entirely for matching calls, such as a health check endpoint, an internal probe, or anything else not worth a trace:
blocks.zh: 每个入站传输块（`http`,`rpc`,`grpc`,`graphql`，和 `ws`) 有 `ignore` 完全跳过用于匹配调用的仪器的选项，例如运行状况检查端点、内部探头或任何其他不值得跟踪的内容：

blocks.md: `http.ignore` accepts an array of paths, `{ method, path }` pairs (`path` can be a string or a `RegExp`), and plain `RegExp`s or a single predicate function over the request. `rpc.ignore`, `grpc.ignore`, and `graphql.ignore` are predicates over the transport's own context (the `@nestjs/microservices` transport id and `BaseRpcContext`, the gRPC call object, and the GraphQL resolve info respectively). Matching a GraphQL field name skips the whole operation that field leads, not only that field: an operation is measured end to end, so it is either traced or not.
blocks.text: http.ignore accepts an array of paths, { method, path } pairs (path can be a string or a RegExp), and plain RegExps or a single predicate function over the request. rpc.ignore, grpc.ignore, and graphql.ignore are predicates over the transport's own context (the @nestjs/microservices transport id and BaseRpcContext, the gRPC call object, and the GraphQL resolve info respectively). Matching a GraphQL field name skips the whole operation that field leads, not only that field: an operation is measured end to end, so it is either traced or not.
blocks.zh: `http.ignore` 接受路径数组，`{ method, path }` 对（`path` 可以是字符串或 `RegExp`），和普通 `RegExp`s 或请求上的单个谓词函数。`rpc.ignore`,`grpc.ignore`，和 `graphql.ignore` 是传输自身上下文的谓词（`@nestjs/microservices` 运输 id 和 `BaseRpcContext`，这个 gRPC 调用对象，以及 GraphQL 分别解析信息）。匹配一个 GraphQL 字段名跳过字段引导的整个操作，而不仅仅是该字段：操作是端到端测量的，因此它要么被跟踪，要么不被跟踪。

blocks.md: `ignore` stops telemetry from being generated at all. The dashboard's spend-control drop filters are a different tool: they discard already-generated events at ingestion to reduce billed volume. Use `ignore` when you don't want a trace to exist, and drop filters when you want to tune cost on data the SDK is already producing.
blocks.text: ignore stops telemetry from being generated at all. The dashboard's spend-control drop filters are a different tool: they discard already-generated events at ingestion to reduce billed volume. Use ignore when you don't want a trace to exist, and drop filters when you want to tune cost on data the SDK is already producing.
blocks.zh: `ignore` 完全阻止遥测生成。仪表板的支出控制下降过滤器是一个不同的工具：它们在摄入时丢弃已经生成的事件，以减少计费量。使用 `ignore` 当您不希望跟踪存在时，当您想要调整数据成本时，请删除过滤器 SDK 已经在生产了。

blocks.md: `http` additionally takes `queryParamsObfuscateRegex`, a `RegExp` that masks sensitive query string values before they're sent. It is applied on top of the built-in redaction, which always masks well-known sensitive parameters (`token`, `password`, `code`, `signature`, and so on).
blocks.text: http additionally takes queryParamsObfuscateRegex, a RegExp that masks sensitive query string values before they're sent. It is applied on top of the built-in redaction, which always masks well-known sensitive parameters (token, password, code, signature, and so on).
blocks.zh: `http` 另外需要 `queryParamsObfuscateRegex`, 一个 `RegExp` 这将在发送敏感的查询字符串值之前屏蔽它们。它应用在内置编辑的顶部，内置编辑总是屏蔽众所周知的敏感参数（`token`,`password`,`code`,`signature`，等等）。

blocks.md: Trace sampling and batching
blocks.text: Trace sampling and batching
blocks.zh: 痕量取样和配料

blocks.md:
| Option              | Type                                                                       | Default | Description                                                                                               |
| ------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `tracesSampleRate`  | `number \| ((protocol: 'http' \| 'rpc' \| 'grpc' \| 'graphql' \| 'ws', attributes) => boolean)` | `1.0`   | Fraction of traces sent, or a predicate for per-trace decisions. `1.0` sends everything; `0.1` sends 10%. |
| `maxTracesPerBatch` | `number`                                                                   | `1000`  | Caps how many traces go out per batch, to bound volume on high-traffic applications.                      |
| `flushInterval`     | `number` (ms)                                                              | `5000`  | How often the SDK batches and sends collected traces.                                                     |

Telemetry is buffered in the process and shipped on the flush interval rather than inline with each request. Sampling here decides what the SDK _produces_. The dashboard's per-project spend controls (span sampling, rate caps, drop filters) act on what it has already sent, and you can change them without a redeploy.
blocks.text: Telemetry is buffered in the process and shipped on the flush interval rather than inline with each request. Sampling here decides what the SDK _produces_. The dashboard's per-project spend controls (span sampling, rate caps, drop filters) act on what it has already sent, and you can change them without a redeploy.
blocks.zh: 遥测在进程中被缓冲，并在刷新间隔发送，而不是与每个请求内联。这里的采样决定了 SDK_生产_。仪表板的每个项目支出控制（跨度采样、速率上限、下降过滤器）作用于它已经发送的内容，您可以在不重新部署的情况下更改它们。

blocks.zh: 完整配置参考

blocks.text: All options at a glance. Options listed under createObserveModule() must be set there; everything else goes to forRoot()/forRootAsync().
blocks.zh: 所有选项一目了然。`createObserveModule()` 下列出的选项必须设置在那里；其他的都去 `forRoot()`/`forRootAsync()`。

| Where                   | Option                                | Purpose                                                                   |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

chapters.title: Manual instrumentation
chapters.summary: Most of the SDK is automatic instrumentation: you configure it once and it decides what to record.

blocks.md: Most of the SDK is automatic instrumentation: you configure it once and it decides what to record. `TracerService` is the manual half. Inject it anywhere in your application to add spans inside an already-traced request, attach context to that request, capture errors you handled yourself, and report your own metrics.
blocks.text: Most of the SDK is automatic instrumentation: you configure it once and it decides what to record. TracerService is the manual half. Inject it anywhere in your application to add spans inside an already-traced request, attach context to that request, capture errors you handled yourself, and report your own metrics.
blocks.zh: 大部分 SDK 是自动仪器：您配置一次，它就会决定记录什么。`TracerService` 是手动的一半。将其注入应用程序中的任何位置，以在已跟踪的请求中添加跨度，将上下文附加到该请求，捕获您自己处理的错误，并报告您自己的指标。

blocks.md: `ObserveModule.forRoot()` registers a global module that exports `TracerService`, so you can inject it in any module without importing `ObserveModule` again. (`forRootAsync()` is global too, unless you pass `global: false`.) Every method reads the trace from the ambient async context, so calling one outside of a request, job, or other instrumented operation throws: there is no trace to attach to. This is deliberate, because a silently dropped span is harder to notice than an error. The exceptions are `currentTraceId()`, which returns `null` instead, and [custom metrics](#custom-metrics), which aren't tied to a trace.

(forRootAsync() is global too, unless you pass global: false.) The exceptions are currentTraceId(), which returns null instead, and custom metrics, which aren't tied to a trace.
blocks.zh: `ObserveModule.forRoot()` 注册导出的全局模块 `TracerService`，因此您可以将其注入到任何模块中，而无需导入 `ObserveModule` 再来一次。（`forRootAsync()` 也是全球性的，除非你通过 `global: false`.) 每个方法都从环境异步上下文中读取跟踪，因此在请求、作业或其他插入操作之外调用一个方法会抛出：没有要附加的跟踪。这是故意的，因为静默下降的跨度比错误更难被注意到。例外情况是 `currentTraceId()`，它返回 `null` 相反，并且 [自定义指标](#custom-metrics)，与痕迹无关。

blocks.md: Creating spans
blocks.text: Creating spans
blocks.zh: 创建跨度

blocks.md: `createSpan(name, callback)` runs the callback inside a new span nested under the currently active one, and returns a promise of the callback's return value. The span's duration is the callback's duration, so `await` anything you want measured:
blocks.text: createSpan(name, callback) runs the callback inside a new span nested under the currently active one, and returns a promise of the callback's return value. The span's duration is the callback's duration, so await anything you want measured:
blocks.zh: `createSpan(name, callback)` 在嵌套在当前活动跨度下的新跨度内运行回调，并返回回调返回值的承诺。跨度的持续时间就是回调的持续时间，所以 `await` 您想要测量的任何东西：

blocks.md: Spans nest by call stack: a `createSpan()` inside another `createSpan()` callback becomes its child, which produces the waterfall on the trace detail page. The callback may be synchronous or asynchronous. Auto-instrumented spans (controller methods, providers, database calls) and your custom spans share the same tree, so a hand-named span appears exactly where it ran relative to everything else.

The callback may be synchronous or asynchronous. Auto-instrumented spans (controller methods, providers, database calls) and your custom spans share the same tree, so a hand-named span appears exactly where it ran relative to everything else.
blocks.zh: 通过调用堆栈跨越嵌套：a`createSpan()` 在另一个里面 `createSpan()` 回调成为它的子级，它会在跟踪详细信息页面上生成瀑布。回调可以是同步的或异步的。自动插入的跨度（控制器方法、提供程序、数据库调用）和您的自定义跨度共享同一棵树，因此手动命名的跨度会准确地出现在它相对于其他所有内容运行的位置。

blocks.md: The `span` argument is a `TraceSpanDelegate`. Its `addTags(tags)` method (or `setTag(key, value)` for a single entry) attaches key-value pairs to that span alone. Like the `tags`/`setAttributes` options described in [SDK → Tags and custom attributes](/observability/sdk#tags-and-custom-attributes), they're searchable and shown on the span in the trace view. The difference is scope: those options cover every request, while these tags cover one span.

The difference is scope: those options cover every request, while these tags cover one span.
blocks.zh: 这个 `span` 论点是 `TraceSpanDelegate`.其 `addTags(tags)` 方法（或 `setTag(key, value)` 对于单个条目）将键值对单独附加到该跨度。喜欢 `tags`/`setAttributes` 中描述的选项 [SDK → Tags and custom attributes](/observability/sdk#tags-and-custom-attributes)，它们是可搜索的，并显示在跟踪视图的跨度上。区别在于范围：这些选项涵盖每个请求，而这些标签涵盖一个跨度。

blocks.md: `activeSpan()` resolves to the `TraceSpanDelegate` of the currently active span without creating a new one. Use it to tag the enclosing span from code that didn't create it:
blocks.text: activeSpan() resolves to the TraceSpanDelegate of the currently active span without creating a new one. Use it to tag the enclosing span from code that didn't create it:
blocks.zh: `activeSpan()` 决心 `TraceSpanDelegate` 的当前活动跨度，而不创建新跨度。使用它来标记未创建封闭跨度的代码：

blocks.code:
const span = await this.tracerService.activeSpan();
span.addTags({ cacheHit: 'false' });

blocks.md: It rejects if no span is active for the current trace.
blocks.text: It rejects if no span is active for the current trace.
blocks.zh: 如果当前跟踪没有活动的跨度，它将拒绝。

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md: The **Spans** analytics view aggregates by span name, across every route that calls them. Pick names that describe the work (`orders.recalculate`, `cache.lookup`) rather than the caller, so the dashboard can tell you whether something is slow everywhere or only from one endpoint.
blocks.text: The Spans analytics view aggregates by span name, across every route that calls them. Pick names that describe the work (orders.recalculate, cache.lookup) rather than the caller, so the dashboard can tell you whether something is slow everywhere or only from one endpoint.
blocks.zh: **Spans**分析视图按跨度名称聚合，跨越调用它们的每条路由。选择描述作品的名称（`orders.recalculate`,`cache.lookup`）而不是呼叫者，因此仪表板可以告诉您某个东西是在任何地方都很慢，还是只从一个端点开始。

blocks.md: Errors that propagate out of a controller, job, or span are recorded automatically. `captureError()` is for the ones that don't: anything you caught and handled but still want visible in the dashboard:
blocks.text: Errors that propagate out of a controller, job, or span are recorded automatically. captureError() is for the ones that don't: anything you caught and handled but still want visible in the dashboard:

blocks.md: The error is attached to the current trace, with the optional tags recorded alongside it, and gets the same source-context treatment as any other captured error if [`sourceContext`](/observability/sdk#error-source-context) is enabled.

blocks.md: Request-scoped attributes
blocks.text: Request-scoped attributes
blocks.zh: 请求范围属性

blocks.md: `setAttribute(key, value)` and `getAttribute(key)` write and read the trace's own context store. Its values live for the duration of the request and are readable from anywhere downstream, without threading them through every function signature:
blocks.text: setAttribute(key, value) and getAttribute(key) write and read the trace's own context store. Its values live for the duration of the request and are readable from anywhere downstream, without threading them through every function signature:
blocks.zh: `setAttribute(key, value)` 和 `getAttribute(key)` 写入和读取跟踪自己的上下文存储。它的值在请求期间有效，并且可以从下游的任何地方读取，而无需通过每个函数签名：

blocks.md: `getAttribute()` returns `undefined` for a key that was never set. Both throw when called outside a traced context.
blocks.text: getAttribute() returns undefined for a key that was never set. Both throw when called outside a traced context.
blocks.zh: `getAttribute()` 回报 `undefined` 对于一把从未设置过的钥匙。当在跟踪上下文之外调用时，两者都会抛出。

blocks.md: The trace id lives in the same store, so `getAttribute(traceIdKey)` retrieves the current trace id, e.g., to correlate with an external system or to [propagate it to another service](/observability/distributed-tracing). `currentTraceId()` is a shorthand for that lookup with one deliberate difference: it returns `null` outside a traced context instead of throwing, because forwarding a trace id downstream can legitimately happen when there is no trace yet.
blocks.text: The trace id lives in the same store, so getAttribute(traceIdKey) retrieves the current trace id, e.g., to correlate with an external system or to propagate it to another service. currentTraceId() is a shorthand for that lookup with one deliberate difference: it returns null outside a traced context instead of throwing, because forwarding a trace id downstream can legitimately happen when there is no trace yet.
blocks.zh: 跟踪 id 存在于同一存储中，因此 `getAttribute(traceIdKey)` 检索当前跟踪 id，例如，以与外部系统或 [将其传播到其他服务](/observability/distributed-tracing) 相关联。`currentTraceId()` 是查找简写，有一个刻意的区别：它在跟踪上下文之外返回 `null`，而不是抛出，因为当还没有跟踪时，可以合法地将跟踪 id 转发到下游。

If you already use the pattern described in the [Async local storage](/recipes/async-local-storage) recipe, this store can replace your hand-rolled one.

blocks.md: Custom metrics
blocks.text: Custom metrics
blocks.zh: 自定义指标

blocks.md: Three metric types are available, each created by name (or retrieved, if the name already exists). They report into the **Custom** section of the dashboard, and you can alert on them like any built-in metric.
blocks.text: Three metric types are available, each created by name (or retrieved, if the name already exists). They report into the Custom section of the dashboard, and you can alert on them like any built-in metric.
blocks.zh: 有三种度量类型可用，每种类型都是按名称创建的（如果名称已经存在，则可以检索）。它们报告到仪表板的**自定义**部分，您可以像任何内置指标一样提醒它们。

blocks.md: Unlike the methods above, metrics aren't tied to a trace, so you can report them from anywhere, including startup and shutdown code, `onModuleInit()` hooks, and cron jobs.
blocks.text: Unlike the methods above, metrics aren't tied to a trace, so you can report them from anywhere, including startup and shutdown code, onModuleInit() hooks, and cron jobs.
blocks.zh: 与上面的方法不同，度量不绑定到跟踪，因此您可以从任何地方报告它们，包括启动和关闭代码，`onModuleInit()` 钩子和 cron 作业。

blocks.md:
| Method    | For                                                                        | Reporting method |
| --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------- |
| `counter` | Values that only go up - requests served, orders placed, retries attempted | `increment()`    |
| `gauge`   | Values that go up and down - queue depth, active connections, cache ratio  | `increment()`, `decrement()`, `setValue(value)` |
| `summary` | Distributions you want quantiles over - latency, payload size              | `observe(value)` |
blocks.zh:
| 方法 | 为了 | 报告方法 |
| --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------- |
| `counter` | 只会增加的值 - 已发送的请求、下的订单、尝试的重试次数 | `increment()` |
| `gauge` | 上下移动的值 - 队列深度、活动连接、缓存比率 | `increment()`,`decrement()`,`setValue(value)` |
| `summary` | 您想要超过分位数的分布 - 延迟、有效载荷大小 | `observe(value)` |

blocks.md: Calling `counter('orders.placed')` twice returns the same instance, so you don't need to hold a reference in a field, though doing so is cheaper on a hot path. Passing attributes on a later call updates the existing metric's description and labels in place.
blocks.text: Calling counter('orders.placed') twice returns the same instance, so you don't need to hold a reference in a field, though doing so is cheaper on a hot path. Passing attributes on a later call updates the existing metric's description and labels in place.
blocks.zh: 呼叫 `counter('orders.placed')` 两次返回相同的实例，因此您不需要在字段中保存引用，尽管在热路径中这样做更便宜。在以后的调用中传递属性会更新现有指标的描述和标签。

blocks.md:
| Attribute      | Applies to              | Description                                                                                                                           |
| -------------- | ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `description`  | counter, gauge, summary | Shown alongside the metric in the dashboard. Worth setting: a bare metric name rarely explains itself to a future reader.             |
| `labels`       | counter, gauge, summary | Dimensions the metric is broken down by, so the chart can be split rather than showing one aggregate line.                            |
| `initialValue` | counter, gauge          | Starting value. Only applied while the metric is still at `0`, so a restart-time declaration doesn't clobber a value already counted. |
| `kind`         | gauge                   | `'ratio'` (default) for values that stand alone per report, or `'additive'` for values that sum across reporting instances.           |
| `sampleSize`   | summary                 | How many observations per label are retained to compute quantiles from, which bounds the summary's memory under load.                 |
blocks.zh:
| 特征 | 适用于 | 描述 |
| -------------- | ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `description` | 计数器、仪表、汇总 | 显示在仪表板中的指标旁边。价值设置：一个裸露的度量名称很少能向未来的读者解释自己。 |
| `labels` | 计数器、仪表、汇总 | 指标按维度进行细分，因此图表可以拆分，而不是显示一条汇总线。 |
| `initialValue` | 计数器，仪表 | 起始值。仅在度量仍处于 `0`，因此重新启动时间声明不会覆盖已计数的值。 |
| `kind` | 测量 | `'ratio'`（默认值）对于每个报表独立的值，或 `'additive'` 对于跨报告实例求和的值。 |
| `sampleSize` | 总结 | 每个标签保留多少个观测值来计算分位数，这限制了负载下摘要的内存。 |

blocks.md: A metric that has been declared but never reported reads as "unknown" rather than `0` in the dashboard. This is a real state, not missing data: "we have never heard from this metric" and "this metric is currently zero" are different facts, and showing the second in place of the first would hide a broken deploy.

blocks.zh: 已声明但从未报告的度量读取为“未知”，而不是 `0` 在仪表板里。这是一个真实的状态，而不是缺失的数据：“我们从未听说过这个指标”和“这个指标目前为零”是不同的事实，显示第二个而不是第一个会隐藏一个失败的部署。

chapters.title: Distributed tracing
chapters.summary: A trace is everything your applications recorded under a single trace id: the request or job that started it, and every span underneath.

blocks.md: A **trace** is everything your applications recorded under a single trace id: the request or job that started it, and every span underneath. Within a single service this is automatic. The SDK generates a trace id when work starts, and every span underneath, including ones you add manually with [`TracerService`](/observability/manual-instrumentation), inherits it.
blocks.text: A trace is everything your applications recorded under a single trace id: the request or job that started it, and every span underneath. Within a single service this is automatic. The SDK generates a trace id when work starts, and every span underneath, including ones you add manually with TracerService, inherits it.
blocks.zh: **跟踪**是您的应用程序在单个跟踪 id 下记录的所有内容：启动它的请求或作业，以及下面的每个跨度。在单个服务中，这是自动的。这个 SDK 工作开始时生成跟踪 id，以及下面的每个跨度（包括手动添加的跨度）[`TracerService`](/observability/manual-instrumentation)，继承它。

blocks.md: Across services, it depends on the channel. HTTP calls, queue jobs, and (on `@nestjs/microservices` 12.0.4 or later) the TCP and Redis transports carry the trace id on their own; gRPC and the other microservice transports need it forwarded. A single user action that touches more than one service (an API call that fans out to a gRPC service, or a message sent to another application over a microservice transport) shows up as **one trace** in your dashboard only if every service involved uses the same trace id. Otherwise, each service mints its own via `traceIdGenerator`, and the action shows up as several disconnected traces, one per service.
blocks.text: Across services, it depends on the channel. HTTP calls, queue jobs, and (on @nestjs/microservices 12.0.4 or later) the TCP and Redis transports carry the trace id on their own; gRPC and the other microservice transports need it forwarded. A single user action that touches more than one service (an API call that fans out to a gRPC service, or a message sent to another application over a microservice transport) shows up as one trace in your dashboard only if every service involved uses the same trace id. Otherwise, each service mints its own via traceIdGenerator, and the action shows up as several disconnected traces, one per service.
blocks.zh: 跨服务，这取决于渠道。HTTP 调用、队列作业和（打开 `@nestjs/microservices`12.0.4 或更高版本）TCP 和 Redis 运输工具本身携带跟踪 id；gRPC 其他微服务传输需要转发它。涉及多个服务的单个用户操作（一个 API 把粉丝叫来 gRPC 服务，或通过微服务传输发送到另一个应用程序的消息）仅当涉及的每个服务使用相同的跟踪 id 时，才会在仪表板中显示为**一个跟踪**。否则，每个服务都会创建自己的 via`traceIdGenerator`，并且该操作显示为多个断开的跟踪，每个服务一个。

blocks.md: Where forwarding is needed, it is application code, not a dashboard setting, and the pattern is always the same: the caller puts its current trace id on whatever channel the protocol has, and the callee's `traceIdGenerator` reads it back out. This page shows how for each transport.
blocks.text: Where forwarding is needed, it is application code, not a dashboard setting, and the pattern is always the same: the caller puts its current trace id on whatever channel the protocol has, and the callee's traceIdGenerator reads it back out. This page shows how for each transport.
blocks.zh: 在需要转发的地方，它是应用程序代码，而不是仪表板设置，模式总是相同的：呼叫者将其当前跟踪 id 放在协议具有的任何信道上，而被叫方的 `traceIdGenerator` 读回去。此页面显示了每次传输的方法。

blocks.md: To forward a trace id downstream, a service first reads the one it's currently running under. `TracerService.currentTraceId()` returns it:

It returns `null` instead, so code that forwards a trace id from startup hooks or other untraced paths doesn't need a `try`/`catch`. If your code can run outside a trace, check for `null` before setting a header.

It returns null instead, so code that forwards a trace id from startup hooks or other untraced paths doesn't need a try/catch. If your code can run outside a trace, check for null before setting a header.
blocks.zh: 它从相同的上下文存储中读取 `getAttribute()`/`setAttribute()`，但与那些不同的是，它不会抛出跟踪上下文。它返回 `null` 相反，从启动挂钩或其他未跟踪路径转发跟踪 id 的代码不需要 `try`/`catch`.如果代码可以在跟踪之外运行，请检查 `null` 在设置标题之前。

blocks.md: HTTP to HTTP
blocks.text: HTTP to HTTP
blocks.zh: HTTP 二 HTTP

blocks.md: HTTP propagation is automatic in both directions. On the way in, the default `traceIdGenerator` adopts a well-formed `x-request-id` header and otherwise mints a time-ordered UUID (v7). On the way out, the SDK adds the current trace id as `x-request-id` to outbound requests that don't already carry one, so a call from one instrumented service to another lands in the same trace with no application code.
blocks.text: HTTP propagation is automatic in both directions. On the way in, the default traceIdGenerator adopts a well-formed x-request-id header and otherwise mints a time-ordered UUID (v7). On the way out, the SDK adds the current trace id as x-request-id to outbound requests that don't already carry one, so a call from one instrumented service to another lands in the same trace with no application code.
blocks.zh: HTTP 两个方向的传播都是自动的。在进来的路上，默认 `traceIdGenerator` 采用一种成型良好的 `x-request-id` 头，否则铸造一个时间顺序 UUID(v7)。在离开的路上，SDK 将当前跟踪 id 添加为 `x-request-id` 对于尚未携带应用程序代码的出站请求，因此从一个检测服务到另一个检测服务的调用会落在同一个跟踪中，而没有应用程序代码。

blocks.md: Outbound propagation covers `fetch` and `undici`, including the [HTTP client](/application/http-client), on every supported Node version, and clients built on `node:http` (axios, got, `@nestjs/axios`) on Node 22.12 and later, the first release that lets a header be added after the request object is created. To limit which hosts receive the header, or switch it off, see [`outgoing.http.propagateTraceId`](/observability/sdk#database-queries-and-outbound-http).

To limit which hosts receive the header, or switch it off, see outgoing.http.propagateTraceId.
blocks.zh: 出站传播涵盖每个受支持的 Node 版本上的 `fetch` 和 `undici`，包括 [HTTP 客户](/application/http-client)，以及 Node22.12 及更高版本上基于 `node:http`（axios、got、`@nestjs/axios`）构建的客户端，这是第一个允许在创建请求对象后添加标头的版本。若要限制哪些主机接收报头，或将其关闭，请参见 [`outgoing.http.propagateTraceId`](/observability/sdk#database-queries-and-outbound-http)。

blocks.zh: gRPC

The SDK attaches the current trace id to every packet sent through a `ClientProxy` registered as a provider (e.g., with `ClientsModule`), and the default `traceIdGenerator` on the receiving side adopts it, so no application code is needed.

blocks.title: Warning
blocks.md: The same `traceIdGenerator` is called with HTTP requests and RPC contexts alike. In a [hybrid application](/faq/hybrid-application) that serves both HTTP and a microservice transport, write the generator defensively: check for `headers` first, then fall back to the payload.
blocks.text: The same traceIdGenerator is called with HTTP requests and RPC contexts alike. In a hybrid application that serves both HTTP and a microservice transport, write the generator defensively: check for headers first, then fall back to the payload.

blocks.md: GraphQL
blocks.text: GraphQL
blocks.zh: GraphQL

blocks.md: No extra configuration is needed when the GraphQL server sits behind the same service's HTTP layer. It joins whatever trace the HTTP agent already opened for that request, which may itself have been propagated via `x-request-id` as described above. Only operations with no enclosing HTTP trace, such as a subscription over a raw WebSocket, need separate handling, and there's currently no built-in propagation hook for that case.
blocks.text: No extra configuration is needed when the GraphQL server sits behind the same service's HTTP layer. It joins whatever trace the HTTP agent already opened for that request, which may itself have been propagated via x-request-id as described above. Only operations with no enclosing HTTP trace, such as a subscription over a raw WebSocket, need separate handling, and there's currently no built-in propagation hook for that case.
blocks.zh: 无需额外配置 GraphQL 服务器位于同一服务的后面 HTTP 层。它加入任何跟踪 HTTP 代理已经为请求打开，该请求本身可能已经通过 `x-request-id` 如上所述。仅操作不封闭 HTTP 跟踪，如原始 WebSocket 上的订阅，需要单独处理，目前没有针对这种情况的内置传播挂钩。

blocks.md: Queue jobs (BullMQ and Bull)
blocks.text: Queue jobs (BullMQ and Bull)
blocks.zh: 队列作业（BullMQ 和 Bull）

blocks.md: Queue propagation is automatic. When a job is added from inside a traced operation (a request handler, an RPC handler, another job), the SDK stamps the current trace id onto the job's options, and the processor that picks the job up runs under that id instead of minting its own. The request and every job it enqueued render as one trace, with no application code involved:
blocks.text: Queue propagation is automatic. When a job is added from inside a traced operation (a request handler, an RPC handler, another job), the SDK stamps the current trace id onto the job's options, and the processor that picks the job up runs under that id instead of minting its own. The request and every job it enqueued render as one trace, with no application code involved:
blocks.zh: 队列传播是自动的。当从跟踪操作（请求处理程序、RPC 处理程序，另一项工作），SDK 将当前跟踪 id 标记到作业的选项上，拾取作业的处理器在该 id 下运行，而不是创建自己的 id。请求及其排队的每个作业呈现为一个跟踪，不涉及应用程序代码：

blocks.md: This works the same way for `@nestjs/bullmq` and `@nestjs/bull`, for `add()` and `addBulk()`, and whether the worker runs in the same process as the producer or in a separate service: the id travels through Redis with the job. A retried job keeps the id it was enqueued with, so every attempt lands in the same trace.
blocks.text: This works the same way for @nestjs/bullmq and @nestjs/bull, for add() and addBulk(), and whether the worker runs in the same process as the producer or in a separate service: the id travels through Redis with the job. A retried job keeps the id it was enqueued with, so every attempt lands in the same trace.
blocks.zh: 这同样适用于 `@nestjs/bullmq` 和 `@nestjs/bull`, 为了 `add()` 和 `addBulk()`，以及 worker 是在与 producer 相同的进程中运行还是在单独的服务中运行：id 遍历 Redis 有了工作。重试作业保留它排队时使用的 id，因此每次尝试都落在同一个跟踪中。

blocks.md: Two cases deliberately start a trace of their own:
blocks.text: Two cases deliberately start a trace of their own:
blocks.zh: 有两个案例故意开始自己的痕迹：

blocks.md:
- **Repeatable jobs and `@nestjs/schedule` handlers.** A schedule outlives the operation that registered it, so each firing is its own trace rather than part of an ever-growing trace attached to whichever request set the schedule up.
- **Jobs added outside any traced operation**, e.g., from a bootstrap hook or a plain script. There is no trace to inherit.
blocks.text: Repeatable jobs and @nestjs/schedule handlers. A schedule outlives the operation that registered it, so each firing is its own trace rather than part of an ever-growing trace attached to whichever request set the schedule up. Jobs added outside any traced operation, e.g., from a bootstrap hook or a plain script. There is no trace to inherit.
blocks.zh:
- **可重复作业及 `@nestjs/schedule` 处理程序。**计划的寿命比注册它的操作长，因此每次触发都是它自己的跟踪，而不是附加到设置计划的任何请求的不断增长的跟踪的一部分。
- **在任何跟踪操作之外添加的作业**，例如从引导钩子或纯脚本。没有遗传的痕迹。

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md: The trace id is stored under the `observeTraceId` job option. To attach a job to a trace the SDK did not see (e.g., one enqueued by a non-Nest producer), set that option yourself when adding the job.
blocks.text: The trace id is stored under the observeTraceId job option. To attach a job to a trace the SDK did not see (e.g., one enqueued by a non-Nest producer), set that option yourself when adding the job.
blocks.zh: 跟踪 id 存储在 `observeTraceId` 工作选择。将作业附加到跟踪 SDK 没有看到（例如，一个由非 Nestproducer），在添加作业时自行设置该选项。

blocks.title: Warning
blocks.md: Trace inheritance for jobs requires `@nestjs/observe` 0.3.0 or later on **both** the service that adds the job and the service that processes it. With an older producer, jobs carry no id and each run opens its own trace, as before.
blocks.text: Trace inheritance for jobs requires @nestjs/observe 0.3.0 or later on both the service that adds the job and the service that processes it. With an older producer, jobs carry no id and each run opens its own trace, as before.
blocks.zh: 跟踪作业的继承要求 `@nestjs/observe`0.3.0 或更高版本，包括添加作业的服务和处理作业的服务。对于旧的生产者，作业没有 id，每次运行都会打开自己的跟踪，就像以前一样。

blocks.md: What a trace looks like in the dashboard
blocks.text: What a trace looks like in the dashboard
blocks.zh: 仪表板中的跟踪是什么样子的

blocks.md: Once services agree on a trace id, the trace detail page renders every execution that ran under it, across services, requests, and jobs, as one waterfall: nesting depth as indentation, duration as bar length, and horizontal position as when the span ran. When reading it, keep the following in mind:
blocks.text: Once services agree on a trace id, the trace detail page renders every execution that ran under it, across services, requests, and jobs, as one waterfall: nesting depth as indentation, duration as bar length, and horizontal position as when the span ran. When reading it, keep the following in mind:
blocks.zh: 一旦服务就跟踪 id 达成一致，跟踪详细信息页面就会将在其下运行的每个执行（跨服务、请求和作业）呈现为一个瀑布：嵌套深度作为缩进，持续时间作为条形长度，水平位置作为跨度运行时。阅读时，请记住以下几点：

blocks.md:
- **Self time** is the number that matters. A span's duration minus the time its children account for is the time the span spent in its own code. Ranking by total duration always puts the controller at the top (it contains everything); ranking by self time surfaces the repository call that actually burned the time. Every execution page carries a spans table sorted this way.
- **Overlapping children are flagged.** When a span's children sum to more than the span's own duration, they ran concurrently (`Promise.all`, a parallel fan-out) and the row says so.
- **Failing spans are marked**, and the execution page leads with an error card for the first span that threw - class, message, the trimmed stack trace with the throwing frame marked, and the source lines around it when [`sourceContext`](/observability/sdk#error-source-context) is on.
- **Logs sit on the trace's clock.** With `forwardLogs` enabled, each line is placed at its offset from the start of the trace and labeled with the span that was in flight when it was written; hovering a line marks that instant on the waterfall.
blocks.text: Self time is the number that matters. A span's duration minus the time its children account for is the time the span spent in its own code. Ranking by total duration always puts the controller at the top (it contains everything); ranking by self time surfaces the repository call that actually burned the time. Every execution page carries a spans table sorted this way. Overlapping children are flagged. When a span's children sum to more than the span's own duration, they ran concurrently (Promise.all, a parallel fan-out) and the row says so. Failing spans are marked, and the execution page leads with an error card for the first span that threw - class, message, the trimmed stack trace with the throwing frame marked, and the source lines around it when sourceContext is on. Logs sit on the trace's clock. With forwardLogs enabled, each line is placed at its offset from the start of the trace and labeled with the span that was in flight when it was written; hovering a line marks that instant on the waterfall.
blocks.zh:
- **自我时间**是重要的数字。跨度的持续时间减去其子跨度所占的时间就是跨度在自己的代码中花费的时间。按总持续时间排名总是把控制器放在最上面（它包含了一切）；按自我时间排序浮出水面，实际上消耗了时间的存储库调用。每个执行页面都带有一个以这种方式排序的跨度表。
- **重叠的子级将被标记。**当跨度的子级总和大于跨度本身的持续时间时，它们将同时运行（`Promise.all`，平行扇出），行是这么说的。
- **标记失败的跨度**，执行页面将显示第一个抛出的跨度的错误卡 - 类、消息、标记了抛出帧的修剪堆栈跟踪及其周围的源行 [`sourceContext`](/observability/sdk#error-source-context) 开着。
- **日志放在 trace 的时钟上。**`forwardLogs` 启用后，每条线都放置在与轨迹起点的偏移量处，并用写入时的飞行跨度进行标记；悬停一条线在瀑布上立即标记。

blocks.md: From any failed or unusually slow execution, the **Copy agent prompt** button packages the whole page (context, error, stack trace with source, top spans by self time, and logs) as a self-contained markdown prompt for a coding agent. See [Dashboard](/observability/dashboard#handing-a-failure-to-a-coding-agent).

blocks.zh: 对于任何失败或异常缓慢的执行，**复制代理提示**按钮会将整个页面（上下文、错误、带源的堆栈跟踪、自我时间的顶部跨度和日志）打包为编码代理的独立降价提示。参见 [Dashboard](/observability/dashboard#handing-a-failure-to-a-coding-agent)。

chapters.title: Error monitoring
chapters.summary: Error monitoring is included in every NestJS Observe plan, Free included, and needs nothing beyond the SDK.

blocks.md: Error monitoring is included in every [NestJS Observe](https://www.observe.nestjs.com/ 'NestJS Observe') plan, Free included, and needs nothing beyond the [SDK](/observability/sdk). Once your application is instrumented, every error that escapes a controller, resolver, or queue consumer is captured with the request it broke, the code that threw it, and the trace it ran in. This page covers what gets captured, how occurrences are grouped into defects, how you get told about a new one, and how an error turns into a verified fix.
blocks.text: Error monitoring is included in every NestJS Observe plan, Free included, and needs nothing beyond the SDK. Once your application is instrumented, every error that escapes a controller, resolver, or queue consumer is captured with the request it broke, the code that threw it, and the trace it ran in. This page covers what gets captured, how occurrences are grouped into defects, how you get told about a new one, and how an error turns into a verified fix.
blocks.zh: 错误监控包含在每个 [NestJS Observe](https://www.observe.nestjs.com/) 计划，包括免费，除了 [SDK](/observability/sdk).一旦您的应用程序被检测出来，每个逃离控制器、解析器或队列使用者的错误都会被捕获，同时捕获它中断的请求、抛出它的代码以及它进入的跟踪。本页涵盖了捕获的内容、事件如何被分组为缺陷、您如何被告知新的缺陷，以及错误如何变成经过验证的修复。

blocks.md: To see it before installing anything, open the [live demo](https://www.observe-demo.nestjs.com/dashboard 'NestJS Observe live demo'). It shows a busy service's errors, grouped defects, and stack traces with source, with no signup.
blocks.text: To see it before installing anything, open the live demo. It shows a busy service's errors, grouped defects, and stack traces with source, with no signup.

blocks.md: What is captured
blocks.text: What is captured
blocks.zh: 捕获了什么

blocks.md: Errors that propagate out of a controller, resolver, job, or span are recorded automatically, across HTTP, GraphQL, gRPC, and `@nestjs/microservices` transports, and for queue consumers and cron runs. There is no error handler to register and nothing to call from your [exception filters](/exception-filters). A filter still decides what the client sees, and the SDK observes the failure on its way there, so the two work side by side.
blocks.text: Errors that propagate out of a controller, resolver, job, or span are recorded automatically, across HTTP, GraphQL, gRPC, and @nestjs/microservices transports, and for queue consumers and cron runs. There is no error handler to register and nothing to call from your exception filters. A filter still decides what the client sees, and the SDK observes the failure on its way there, so the two work side by side.
blocks.zh: 在 HTTP、GraphQL、gRPC 和 `@nestjs/microservices` 传输以及队列使用者和 cron 运行中，会自动记录从控制器、解析器、作业或跨度传播的错误。无需注册错误处理程序，也无需从您的 [异常筛选器](/exception-filters) 调用任何内容。过滤器仍然决定客户端看到什么，SDK 在到达那里的路上观察故障，所以两者并肩工作。

blocks.md: An error is not stored as a detached log line. An individual error _is_ the failed request, so its detail page is the request's own page with the failure leading: error class, message, stack trace, and source code first, then the request's context, then the trace waterfall and the logs written during that request. When an HTTP request fails, the SDK also records a small allow-list of its headers, and optionally its body (see [Capturing failed and slow requests](/observability/sdk#capturing-failed-and-slow-requests)). A job run that throws is recorded as a failed run, with its failure reason and attempt number, in the **Jobs** view.
blocks.text: An error is not stored as a detached log line. An individual error _is_ the failed request, so its detail page is the request's own page with the failure leading: error class, message, stack trace, and source code first, then the request's context, then the trace waterfall and the logs written during that request. When an HTTP request fails, the SDK also records a small allow-list of its headers, and optionally its body (see Capturing failed and slow requests). A job run that throws is recorded as a failed run, with its failure reason and attempt number, in the Jobs view.
blocks.zh: 错误不会存储为独立的日志行。一个单独的错误_is_是失败的请求，因此它的详细信息页面是请求自己的页面，失败前导是：首先是错误类、消息、堆栈跟踪和源代码，然后是请求的上下文，然后是跟踪瀑布和在该请求期间写入的日志。当 HTTP 请求失败时，SDK 还会记录其标头的小允许列表，可选地记录其主体（参见 [Capturing failed and slow requests](/observability/sdk#capturing-failed-and-slow-requests)）。抛出的作业运行会在**Jobs**视图中记录为失败运行，并记录其失败原因和尝试次数。

blocks.md: Not every error is a bug. An exception your code throws on purpose, such as a `NotFoundException` or a failed validation, still shows up in the **Errors** view, since it is still a failed request, but it doesn't count as a new defect for alerting. Only unhandled failures do: an error whose request answered with a 5xx, or one that failed on an entry point with no HTTP status at all, such as an RPC handler or a gateway message.
