A tick that finds the lock held is skipped, on this instance or any other: the ticks during a long count are dropped, and the first tick after it runs. If the run crashes, the lock expires after ttl and the next tick runs. @WithoutOverlapping() on its own, without @OnOneInstance(), means "any instance, one run at a time".
blocks.zh: 一个运行现在会使用第二个锁，以同一个键命名（一个方法上的两个装饰器共享它），在整个运行期间保持它，更新它，并在运行结束时释放它。在这个实例或任何其他实例中，发现锁被保持的刻度被跳过：长时间计数期间的刻度被丢弃，之后的第一个刻度被运行。如果运行崩溃，锁将在 `ttl` 下一个滴答运行。`@WithoutOverlapping()` 它本身，没有 `@OnOneInstance()`，表示“任何实例，一次运行一个”。

blocks.md: Fence the writes
blocks.text: Fence the writes
blocks.zh: 将铭文围起来

blocks.md: A lease can't stop a holder that is paused. Take the reconciliation on instance A: it reads the counts from the warehouse (salmon kibble: 12), and then A stalls, in a stop-the-world garbage collection, a swap, a VM migration, a debugger. It stops renewing. Thirty seconds later the database expires its locks, and B takes the job over at its next tick: it reads fresher counts (three bags were sold and shipped since: salmon kibble: 9) and writes them. Then A wakes up and finishes its run, with the counts it read before the pause. Salmon kibble is back at 12, and the store sells three bags it doesn't have.

Take the reconciliation on instance A: it reads the counts from the warehouse (salmon kibble: 12), and then A stalls, in a stop-the-world garbage collection, a swap, a VM migration, a debugger. It stops renewing. Thirty seconds later the database expires its locks, and B takes the job over at its next tick: it reads fresher counts (three bags were sold and shipped since: salmon kibble: 9) and writes them. Then A wakes up and finishes its run, with the counts it read before the pause. Salmon kibble is back at 12, and the store sells three bags it doesn't have.
blocks.zh: 租约不能阻止被暂停的持有人。以实例 A 中的对账为例：它读取仓库中的计数（鲑鱼粗粒：12），然后是一个摊位，在一个停止世界的垃圾收集中，一个交换，一个 VM 迁移，调试器。它停止更新。30 秒后，数据库的锁过期了，B 在下一次点击时接管了这项工作：它读取新的计数（自那以后，已经售出和发货了三袋：三文鱼粗粮：9）并写下它们。然后 A 醒来并完成它的运行，在暂停前读取计数。三文鱼粗粮在 12 点回来了，商店出售三袋它没有的。

blocks.md: A's signal aborts at its next renewal, when the database refuses it, but a write that is already on its way goes through. Note what the lease does and doesn't promise. A holder counts its own deadline, `ttl` from the moment it sent the last renewal the store confirmed, which is before the store processed it: a holder that is running gives up no later than the store's expiry, so its signal aborts before any other instance can take the key. The window exists only for a holder that isn't running (paused, stopped, its event loop blocked): from the store's expiry until it runs again, it still believes it holds the lock. What stops its write is the **fencing token**: every acquisition of a key gets a token greater than every token the key had before, and the resource being written keeps the highest token it has seen and refuses a lower one. A's token is lower than B's, so A's late write updates nothing.

A's token is lower than B's, so A's late write updates nothing.
blocks.zh: A 的信号在下一次更新时中止，此时数据库拒绝它，但是已经在路上的写会通过。注意租约承诺什么和不承诺什么。持有人计算自己的截止日期，`ttl` 从它发送最后一次续订的那一刻起，存储就确认了，这是在存储处理它之前：正在运行的持有者在存储到期之前放弃，因此它的信号在任何其他实例可以获取密钥之前中止。窗口只存在于没有运行的持有者（暂停、停止、其事件循环阻塞）：从存储到期到它再次运行，它仍然认为它持有锁。阻止它写入的是**围栏令牌**：每次获取一个密钥都会得到一个比密钥以前拥有的每个令牌都大的令牌，正在写入的资源保留它见过的最高令牌，并拒绝较低的令牌。A 的令牌低于 B 的，所以 A 的后期写入不会更新任何内容。

blocks.md: The token is the run lock's, a new and higher one for every run. The signal aborts when the run's lock or the instance's lease is lost, and its reason is a `LockLostError` that says how the loss was detected: the store refused a renewal, or `ttl` passed without one reaching the store. Pass the signal to what the job calls, `fetch`, the database driver, an HTTP client; a job that ignores it keeps running, as it would in any process. Nothing is killed.

blocks.md: `withLock(key, fn, options)` runs `fn` under the lock and releases it whether `fn` resolves or throws. `wait` is how long to keep trying, with backoff, before it gives up with a `LockNotAcquiredError`; the default is to try once. `acquire(key, options)` is the same without the callback: it resolves a `Lock`, or `null` when the key was taken, and you release it yourself, or with `await using`. A `Lock` has the `fencingToken` and the `signal`, and inside `withLock()` so does `LocksContext`, exactly as in a job.

A Lock has the fencingToken and the signal, and inside withLock() so does LocksContext, exactly as in a job.

A `Lock` 有 `fencingToken` 和 `signal`，和里面 `withLock()` 也是 `LocksContext` 就像工作一样。

blocks.md: Both also take a `signal` of their own, the request's for example, which stops the waiting. It stops the wait for the store too: a call still waiting for the store's answer rejects with the signal's reason, `fn` doesn't run, and a lock the store grants after that goes back to it. `wait` doesn't cut short a store call already on its way; the module's `storeTimeout` does, so a call takes at most `wait` plus `storeTimeout`. A store that doesn't answer within `storeTimeout` fails the call with a `LockStoreTimeoutError`.

A store that doesn't answer within storeTimeout fails the call with a LockStoreTimeoutError.
blocks.zh: 两者都采取 `signal` 例如，他们自己的请求，这停止了等待。它也停止了对存储的等待：仍在等待存储响应的呼叫由于信号的原因而被拒绝， `fn` 不运行，商店授予的锁将返回到它。 `wait` 不会中断已经在路上的商店电话；模块的 `storeTimeout` 是的，所以一个电话最多需要 `wait` 加 `storeTimeout`.一个不回答的商店 `storeTimeout` 调用失败 `LockStoreTimeoutError`.

blocks.md: Neither `LockNotAcquiredError` nor `LockStoreTimeoutError` carries an HTTP status: contention and a stalled store aren't the caller's mistake, so the handler decides. Here a taken lock is a `409`, and anything else is rethrown. While the export runs by hand, the scheduled tick on any instance finds the lock held and skips.

blocks.zh: 都不是 `LockNotAcquiredError` 也不 `LockStoreTimeoutError` 携带 HTTP 状态：争用和停滞的存储不是调用者的错误，所以处理程序决定。这里的锁是一个 `409`，其他任何东西都会被重新抛出。当导出由手动运行时，任何实例上的计划勾选会发现锁被持有并跳过。

blocks.md: The store is a contract, so it can live wherever your instances already meet. If that is Redis, each method is one Lua script, which Redis runs atomically:
blocks.text: The store is a contract, so it can live wherever your instances already meet. If that is Redis, each method is one Lua script, which Redis runs atomically:
blocks.zh: 存储是一个契约，因此它可以存在于您的实例已经遇到的任何地方。如果那是 Redis，每个方法是一个 Lua 脚本，它 Redis 原子运行：

blocks.md: `SET NX PX` takes the key only if it is free, expiring on Redis's clock in milliseconds, and the `INCR` in the same script draws the token from one counter for every key. Fencing is only as durable as that counter. It never expires, and it must never go back: give Redis persistence (AOF, or RDB with a short interval) and `maxmemory-policy noeviction`, because a counter that restarts at 1 (a restart without persistence, a `FLUSHALL`) hands out tokens that holders already have, and a lock evicted under memory pressure is a lock lost. A failover to an asynchronous replica can lose the last writes too: a lock taken just before it, which is the paused-holder case the token covers, but also the counter's last increments, after which the next holder may draw a token the previous one already has, and the token no longer tells them apart. Where fencing must hold across a failover, keep the locks in the database, whose sequence is in the same WAL as the rows, or replicate Redis synchronously.
blocks.text: SET NX PX takes the key only if it is free, expiring on Redis's clock in milliseconds, and the INCR in the same script draws the token from one counter for every key. Fencing is only as durable as that counter. It never expires, and it must never go back: give Redis persistence (AOF, or RDB with a short interval) and maxmemory-policy noeviction, because a counter that restarts at 1 (a restart without persistence, a FLUSHALL) hands out tokens that holders already have, and a lock evicted under memory pressure is a lock lost. A failover to an asynchronous replica can lose the last writes too: a lock taken just before it, which is the paused-holder case the token covers, but also the counter's last increments, after which the next holder may draw a token the previous one already has, and the token no longer tells them apart. Where fencing must hold across a failover, keep the locks in the database, whose sequence is in the same WAL as the rows, or replicate Redis synchronously.
blocks.zh: `SET NX PX` 仅当密钥是空闲的，过期日期为 Redis 以毫秒为单位的时钟，以及 `INCR` 在同一个脚本中，为每个键从一个计数器中提取令牌。围栏和柜台一样耐用。它永远不会过期，也永远不会回去：给予 Redis 持久性（AOF, 或 RDB 间隔很短）和 `maxmemory-policy noeviction`，因为在 1 重新启动的计数器（没有持久性的重新启动，`FLUSHALL`) 分发持有者已经拥有的令牌，在内存压力下被驱逐的锁是丢失的锁。对异步副本的故障转移也可能丢失最后一次写入：就在它之前的锁，这是令牌覆盖的暂停持有者情况，也是计数器的最后一次增量，之后下一个持有者可能会抽取前一个持有者已经拥有的令牌，并且令牌不再区分它们。如果在故障转移过程中必须使用围栏，则将锁保留在数据库中，其顺序相同 WAL 作为行，或复制 Redis 同步。

blocks.md: On Redis Cluster, `ACQUIRE` fails with a `CROSSSLOT` error as written: a cluster runs a script only when all its keys hash to the same slot, and the lock's key and the counter don't. Name both under one hash tag, `{locks}:key:<key>` and `{locks}:fencing-token`: the cluster then hashes only `locks`, so the counter and every lock share one slot, on one shard. A counter under a new name, or on a new cluster, starts again at 1, which is the restart it must never make. Before the first acquire on it, stop the instances that use the old keys and set the new counter to the old one's value (`SET {locks}:fencing-token <value>`), so the next token is higher than any already handed out.
blocks.text: On Redis Cluster, ACQUIRE fails with a CROSSSLOT error as written: a cluster runs a script only when all its keys hash to the same slot, and the lock's key and the counter don't. Name both under one hash tag, {locks}:key: and {locks}:fencing-token: the cluster then hashes only locks, so the counter and every lock share one slot, on one shard. A counter under a new name, or on a new cluster, starts again at 1, which is the restart it must never make. Before the first acquire on it, stop the instances that use the old keys and set the new counter to the old one's value (SET {locks}:fencing-token ), so the next token is higher than any already handed out.
blocks.zh: 在 Redis 集群，`ACQUIRE` 失败 `CROSSSLOT` 编写错误：集群只有在其所有密钥散列到同一个槽时才运行脚本，而锁的密钥和计数器不运行。在一个散列标记下命名两者，`{locks}:key:<key>` 和 `{locks}:fencing-token`：然后集群仅散列 `locks` 所以计数器和每个锁共享一个插槽，在一个碎片上。新名称下的计数器或新集群上的计数器从 1 重新开始，这是它绝不能进行的重启。在第一次获取之前，停止使用旧键的实例，并将新计数器设置为旧计数器的值（`SET {locks}:fencing-token <value>`），因此下一个令牌高于任何已经分发的令牌。

blocks.md: Close the Redis client in `onApplicationShutdown()`, as the module does; `@nestjs/drizzle` closes the database pool in the same phase. Nest runs each shutdown phase for the whole application before the next: the package hands the leases back in `onModuleDestroy()` and releases every other lock still held in `beforeApplicationShutdown()`, so by the time any module's `onApplicationShutdown()` runs, nothing of the package's needs the connection, whatever the import order. A tick or an election still waiting for the store when the shutdown begins stops waiting: the tick is skipped, and a lock the store grants after that goes back to it, so a stalled store doesn't hold up the deploy.

blocks.md: The warehouse pushes low-stock alerts over a feed that allows one connection per shop. That isn't a scheduled job; it's a connection one instance should hold for as long as it lives, and another should take over when it goes down. That is a leader election, and it is the same lease as a job's ownership, held on purpose:
blocks.text: The warehouse pushes low-stock alerts over a feed that allows one connection per shop. That isn't a scheduled job; it's a connection one instance should hold for as long as it lives, and another should take over when it goes down. That is a leader election, and it is the same lease as a job's ownership, held on purpose:
blocks.zh: 仓库通过允许每个商店一个连接的提要推送低库存警报。这不是一份预定的工作；这是一个连接，一个实例应该在它存在的时间内保持，另一个实例应该在它停止运行时接管。这是一次领导者选举，它与工作所有权相同，是故意持有的：

blocks.md: `@LeaderElection(key)` goes on a singleton provider. From `onApplicationBootstrap`, every instance tries to take the lease on the key, and keeps trying every `ttl / 3`; the one that has it renews it. `onLeadershipAcquired(lock)` runs when this instance becomes the leader, with the lease's `signal` and `fencingToken`; `onLeadershipLost(lock)` when it stops leading, because the lease was lost or because it stepped down, at shutdown or after `onLeadershipAcquired()` threw. The `ttl` option sets the lease's; the default is the module's 30 seconds, so a crashed leader is replaced within half a minute, and a leader that shuts down cleanly is replaced at the others' next try.
blocks.text: @LeaderElection(key) goes on a singleton provider. From onApplicationBootstrap, every instance tries to take the lease on the key, and keeps trying every ttl / 3; the one that has it renews it. onLeadershipAcquired(lock) runs when this instance becomes the leader, with the lease's signal and fencingToken; onLeadershipLost(lock) when it stops leading, because the lease was lost or because it stepped down, at shutdown or after onLeadershipAcquired() threw. The ttl option sets the lease's; the default is the module's 30 seconds, so a crashed leader is replaced within half a minute, and a leader that shuts down cleanly is replaced at the others' next try.
blocks.zh: `@LeaderElection(key)` 使用单例提供者。来自 `onApplicationBootstrap`，每个实例都试图获得钥匙上的租约，并不断尝试每个 `ttl / 3`;拥有它的人会更新它。 `onLeadershipAcquired(lock)` 当此实例成为领导者时运行，租约的 `signal` 和 `fencingToken`; `onLeadershipLost(lock)` 当它停止领导时，因为租约丢失或因为它下台，在关闭时或之后 `onLeadershipAcquired()` 扔了。这个 `ttl` 期权设定租赁；默认是模块的 30 秒，所以一个崩溃的领导者在半分钟内被替换，一个干净关闭的领导者在其他人下次尝试时被替换。

blocks.md: An application that imports `LocksModule` and registers no store runs on the in-memory store, so an end-to-end test of one instance needs nothing: every tick runs, once. To keep the Drizzle store out of a test, override its provider with a plain `InMemoryLockStore`; a plain instance doesn't register itself, so the in-memory default applies.

blocks.zh: 要测试包的用途，请在一个进程中运行多个实例。实例是 Nest 应用；一个应用程序的实例共享一个存储。示例的助手在共享数据库上启动一个，其中包含伪造的和测试的 `LocksModule` 选项：

blocks.md:
- **Share the database.** On PGlite, every instance gets the same Drizzle database by overriding the one `DrizzleModule` registers (`getDrizzleToken()`), with the real migrations applied; `DrizzleLockStore` injects it with `@InjectDrizzle()`, so the instances share the locks table as they share it in production. Against a PostgreSQL server, each instance opens its own pool from the database's URL. Without a database, share one `InMemoryLockStore` between the instances by registering it in each with `LocksStorage.registerSource()` and its `replace` option before `init()`.
- **Fire the jobs yourself.** Call the method (`await job.exportInvoices()`) on each instance, or go through `@nestjs/schedule` with `schedulerRegistry.getCronJob(name).fireOnTick()`. Both reach the wrapper. Point the real schedules at a date that never comes: the example's `vitest.config.mts` sets the two cron variables to February 29th at 3 AM.
- **Control time.** Override `LOCKS_MODULE_OPTIONS` with a `ManualLockClock`, and every renewal, deadline and `wait` in that instance moves only when the test advances the clock: `await clock.advance('5m')` fires what falls due on the way, in order, and waits for each renewal to reach the store. An instance whose clock you don't advance is a paused process. Against PGlite or a server, the store's clock is real time, so a short `ttl` (`'1s'`) and a `sleep` expire a paused instance's locks; with the in-memory store, give it the same `ManualLockClock` and expiries move with it.
- **Assert on the log** or on `LocksEvents.events$`: which instance runs a job, every skipped tick, every lost lock, every leadership change. The events are also published on the `nestjs:locks:lock-lost`, `nestjs:locks:leadership-acquired` and `nestjs:locks:leadership-lost` diagnostics channels.
- **Test your store** with the contract suite, as the Drizzle, TypeORM and Redis stores do, against the server you run in production.

blocks.zh:
- **共享数据库。**在 PGlite 上，每个实例通过覆盖一个 `DrizzleModule` 寄存器（`getDrizzleToken()`）获得相同的 Drizzle 数据库，并应用实际迁移；`DrizzleLockStore` 用 `@InjectDrizzle()` 注入它，因此实例共享锁表，就像它们在生产中共享它一样。对于 PostgreSQL 服务器，每个实例从数据库的 URL 打开自己的池。如果没有数据库，请在实例之间共享一个 `InMemoryLockStore`，方法是在每个实例中使用 `LocksStorage.registerSource()` 及其 `replace` 选项在 `init()` 之前注册它。
- **自己触发作业。**调用方法（`await job.exportInvoices()`）在每个实例上，或者通过 `@nestjs/schedule` 和 `schedulerRegistry.getCronJob(name).fireOnTick()`.两者都到达包装。指向一个永远不会到来的日期：示例 `vitest.config.mts` 将两个 cron 变量设置为 2 月 29 日 3 AM.
- **控制时间。**覆盖 `LOCKS_MODULE_OPTIONS` 用一个 `ManualLockClock` 以及每次续订、截止日期和 `wait` 在该实例中，只有当测试提前时钟时才会移动：`await clock.advance('5m')` 按顺序点燃途中到期的东西，等待每次更新到达商店。您不推进其时钟的实例是一个暂停进程。相对于 PGlite 或服务器，商店的时钟是实时的，所以一个短的 `ttl`(`'1s'`）和一个 `sleep` 使暂停实例的锁过期；对于内存存储，给它相同的 `ManualLockClock` 到期日也随之移动。
- **在日志上断言**或 `LocksEvents.events$`：哪个实例运行作业、每个跳过的勾号、每个丢失的锁、每个领导变更。这些事件也发布在 `nestjs:locks:lock-lost`,`nestjs:locks:leadership-acquired` 和 `nestjs:locks:leadership-lost` 诊断渠道。
- **使用合同套件测试您的商店**Drizzle,TypeORM 和 Redis 商店会，针对您在生产中运行的服务器。

blocks.md: Production checklist
blocks.text: Production checklist
blocks.zh: 生产检查表

blocks.md:
- Register a shared store, on your database or Redis, and run the contract suite against it with `concurrent` on, in CI, on the version you run in production. In production the application refuses to start without one, unless `allowInMemoryStorage` is set, which is only right for a single instance.
- Set `key` on every job that must never run twice, so a rename or a minifier can't change it during a rolling deploy.
- Pick a `ttl` well above the store's round trip and the longest event-loop stall you accept, and short enough that a crash doesn't skip too many ticks. Renewals go out every `ttl / 3`; 30 seconds fits most jobs. A long job's run lock is renewed at the same pace, so its `ttl` doesn't need to cover the run.
- Leave `storeTimeout` well above the store's slowest healthy answer: a store call that runs past it fails, so the tick doesn't run and `acquire()` rejects with `LockStoreTimeoutError`. The default, 10 seconds, also bounds how long a stalled store (an exhausted pool, a failover, a Redis client queueing commands while offline) holds up a job, a request or a renewal.
- Write jobs that do what is due, not what the tick was for. Missed ticks aren't caught up: a crashed owner costs up to `ttl` of ticks, and ticks during a long run are skipped.
- Pass `LocksContext.signal` to what a job calls, and fence the writes that can't be undone with `LocksContext.fencingToken`, in the same statement that writes. Alert on `lock-lost` from `LocksEvents` or the diagnostics channel: it means renewals failed for longer than `ttl`, because the store was unreachable or the event loop was blocked, and another instance may be running the same critical section.
- Call `app.enableShutdownHooks()`, so a deploy hands the leases over at once instead of leaving them to expire. Close the Redis client in `onApplicationShutdown()`, the phase in which `@nestjs/drizzle` closes the database pool: the package hands the leases back in `onModuleDestroy()` and releases every other lock in `beforeApplicationShutdown()`, phases Nest completes for the whole application first. A lease whose job started less than a second before the shutdown is kept for the rest of that second rather than handed back, so that instances firing the same tick skip it instead of running it a second time.
- With the Redis store, give Redis persistence and `maxmemory-policy noeviction`. The fencing counter must never go back, and a lock must never be evicted.
- With the database store, create the table and the sequence through your migrations, and size the connection pool for one short statement per renewal per held lock, plus one per tick per instance.
- Keep the instances' clocks synchronized with NTP anyway. Expiry is measured on the store's clock, but a holder counts its own deadline, and `@nestjs/schedule` fires on the instance's clock.
- Log level: the skipped ticks are logged at `debug`. Keep that level on for a while after the rollout, to see the jobs settle on one instance.

blocks.zh:
- 在数据库中注册共享存储或 Redis，并针对它运行合同套件 `concurrent` 在，在 CI，在生产中运行的版本上。在生产中，应用程序拒绝在没有它的情况下启动，除非 `allowInMemoryStorage` 设置，这仅适用于单个实例。
- 设置 `key` 每个作业都不能运行两次，因此重命名或缩小程序不能在滚动部署期间更改它。
- 挑选一个 `ttl` 远高于商店的往返行程和您接受的最长的活动循环摊位，并且足够短，撞车不会跳过太多刻度。每次续订都会到期 `ttl / 3`;30 秒适合大多数工作。长作业的运行锁以相同的速度更新，因此它 `ttl` 不需要报道跑步。
- 将 `storeTimeout` 留在商店最慢的健康响应上方：经过它的商店调用失败，因此勾号不运行，`acquire()` 用 `LockStoreTimeoutError` 拒绝。默认值为 10 秒，还限制了停滞存储（耗尽的池、故障转移、Redis 客户端在离线时排队命令）保留作业、请求或续订的时间。
- 写做该做的工作，而不是做该做的工作。错过的蜱虫不会被追上：崩溃的车主损失高达 `ttl` 的 ticks，并且跳过长时间运行期间的 ticks。
- 通过 `LocksContext.signal` 到作业调用的内容，并将无法撤销的写入围起来 `LocksContext.fencingToken`，在同一条语句中写道。警戒 `lock-lost` 来自 `LocksEvents` 或诊断通道：这意味着续订失败的时间超过 `ttl`，因为存储不可到达或事件循环被阻塞，而另一个实例可能正在运行相同的关键部分。
- 呼吁 `app.enableShutdownHooks()` 因此，部署会立即移交租约，而不是让它们到期。关闭 Redis 客户端 `onApplicationShutdown()`，阶段 `@nestjs/drizzle` 关闭数据库池：包将租约交回 `onModuleDestroy()` 并释放所有其他锁 `beforeApplicationShutdown()` 阶段 Nest 首先完成整个应用程序。在关闭前不到一秒钟开始工作的租约将在该一秒钟的剩余时间内保留，而不是交回，这样触发相同 tick 的实例就会跳过它，而不是第二次运行它。
- 对于 Redis 存储，给出 Redis 持久性和 `maxmemory-policy noeviction`。击剑柜台决不能回去，一把锁决不能被驱逐。
- 使用数据库存储，通过迁移创建表和序列，并调整连接池的大小，使每个持有的锁每次续订一个短语句，每个实例每次勾选一个。
- 保持实例的时钟与 NTP 无论如何。有效期是在商店的时钟上衡量的，但持有者会计算自己的截止日期，并且 `@nestjs/schedule` 实例的时钟开火。
- 日志级别：跳过的刻度记录在 `debug`。在推出后保持这个级别一段时间，看看作业在一个实例上解决。

blocks.md: The store contract
blocks.text: The store contract
blocks.zh: 商店合同

blocks.md: The tutorial wrote the store with Drizzle, with TypeORM and with Redis. This section sums up what any `LockStore` must do, for writing one with another database or ORM. The [`LockStore` interface](https://github.com/nestjs/locks/blob/master/lib/interfaces/lock-store.interface.ts) documents the full contract and the races each rule prevents.
blocks.text: The tutorial wrote the store with Drizzle, with TypeORM and with Redis. This section sums up what any LockStore must do, for writing one with another database or ORM. The LockStore interface documents the full contract and the races each rule prevents.
blocks.zh: 教程用 Drizzle、TypeORM 和 Redis 编写了商店。本节总结了任何 `LockStore` 必须做的事情，用另一个数据库或 ORM 编写一个数据库。[`LockStore` interface](https://github.com/nestjs/locks/blob/master/lib/interfaces/lock-store.interface.ts) 记录了完整的合同和每条规则阻止的比赛。

blocks.md: **Registration.** The store is an ordinary singleton provider that calls `registerSource(this)` on the injectable `LocksStorage` in its constructor. The registry checks the shape at once, refuses a second registration unless it passes `replace: true`, and locks when `LocksModule` initializes, logging the store in use. With nothing registered, the module uses `InMemoryLockStore`, which excludes callers in one process only. With `NODE_ENV=production`, startup fails instead, unless you set `allowInMemoryStorage: true`.
blocks.text: Registration. The store is an ordinary singleton provider that calls registerSource(this) on the injectable LocksStorage in its constructor. The registry checks the shape at once, refuses a second registration unless it passes replace: true, and locks when LocksModule initializes, logging the store in use. With nothing registered, the module uses InMemoryLockStore, which excludes callers in one process only. With NODE_ENV=production, startup fails instead, unless you set allowInMemoryStorage: true.
blocks.zh: **注册。**商店是一个普通的 singleton 提供者 `registerSource(this)` 关于注射剂 `LocksStorage` 在它的构造函数中。注册表会立即检查形状，除非通过，否则拒绝第二次注册 `replace: true`，并在 `LocksModule` 初始化，记录正在使用的存储。在没有注册任何内容的情况下，该模块使用 `InMemoryLockStore`，它只排除一个进程中的调用者。和 `NODE_ENV=production`，启动失败，除非您设置 `allowInMemoryStorage: true`.

blocks.md: **The methods.** All three are atomic: each decides who holds a key, and a read followed by a separate write lets two callers into the critical section, which is the duplicate run the package exists to prevent.
blocks.text: The methods. All three are atomic: each decides who holds a key, and a read followed by a separate write lets two callers into the critical section, which is the duplicate run the package exists to prevent.
blocks.zh: **方法。**这三个方法都是原子的：每个方法决定谁持有密钥，读取后单独写入允许两个调用者进入关键部分，这是包存在以防止的重复运行。

blocks.md:
| Method | What it does | How it stays atomic |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `acquire(key, owner, ttl)` | Takes the key if no live lock holds it (none, released, or expired), with a fencing token greater than every token the key had before | One insert that takes over a released or expired row in the same statement, re-checking the expiry in the write, so of many concurrent callers exactly one wins; the token is drawn after the check |
| `renew(key, owner, ttl)` | Moves the owner's live lock's expiry to `ttl` from now | A compare-and-set: the owner and the expiry are in the `WHERE` of the statement that writes |
| `release(key, owner)` | Frees the owner's live lock (deletes it, or marks it released), so the next caller takes it at once. Never resets the key's token | A compare-and-set, as `renew()` |
blocks.zh:
| 方法 | 它的作用 | 它如何保持原子状态 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `acquire(key, owner, ttl)` | 如果没有活动锁持有密钥（无、已释放或已过期），则获取密钥，其围栏标记大于密钥之前的每个标记 | 一个插入接管同一语句中已释放或过期的行，在写入时重新检查过期，因此在许多并发调用者中，只有一个获胜；在检查后抽取令牌 |
| `renew(key, owner, ttl)` | 将所有者的实时锁的到期日移至 `ttl` 从现在开始 | 比较设置：所有者和到期日在 `WHERE` 声明中写道 |
| `release(key, owner)` | 释放所有者的实时锁（删除它，或标记为已释放），以便下一个调用者立即拿走它。切勿重置密钥的令牌 | 比较集，如 `renew()` |

blocks.md: **What else the store must get right**, all of it checked by the suite: an expired lock doesn't exist, for every method, whether or not it has been deleted (`expires_at > now` in every condition, or let the server expire it); `ttl` is measured on the store's clock, in milliseconds, and can be weeks (past a 32-bit integer: `bigint`, `PEXPIRE`); keys are strings of up to 500 characters, any Unicode, kept apart exactly; tokens are positive safe integers returned as numbers. PostgreSQL returns a `bigint` column as a string unless the ORM converts it; the package refuses such a token at once, with a message naming the fix, rather than let fencing break silently.
blocks.text: What else the store must get right, all of it checked by the suite: an expired lock doesn't exist, for every method, whether or not it has been deleted (expires_at > now in every condition, or let the server expire it); ttl is measured on the store's clock, in milliseconds, and can be weeks (past a 32-bit integer: bigint, PEXPIRE); keys are strings of up to 500 characters, any Unicode, kept apart exactly; tokens are positive safe integers returned as numbers. PostgreSQL returns a bigint column as a string unless the ORM converts it; the package refuses such a token at once, with a message naming the fix, rather than let fencing break silently.
blocks.zh: **商店还必须做对**，所有这些都由套件检查：每个方法都不存在过期锁，无论它是否已被删除（在每种情况下都是 `expires_at > now`，或者让服务器过期）；`ttl` 是在商店的时钟上测量的，以毫秒为单位，可以是周（经过 32 位整数：`bigint`，`PEXPIRE`）；密钥是最多 500 个字符的字符串，任何 Unicode，完全分开；令牌是作为数字返回的正安全整数。PostgreSQL 将 `bigint` 列作为字符串返回，除非 ORM 转换它；包立即拒绝这样的令牌，并提供一条命名修复的消息，而不是让围栏无声地破坏。

blocks.md: **With Prisma.** The Drizzle store is the model, with the same table and sequence; [Keep locks in your database](/reliability/locks#keep-locks-in-your-database) also shows it with TypeORM. `acquire()` is one `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE ... WHERE owner IS NULL OR expires_at <= clock_timestamp() RETURNING fencing_token`, with the token drawn in the `SET`, after the row lock. Prisma's `upsert()` has no condition on the update, so use `$queryRaw`. `renew()` and `release()` put the owner and the expiry in the `WHERE` of `updateMany()` and check `count === 1`. Not `update()` after a `findUnique()`: it reads first.
blocks.text: With Prisma. The Drizzle store is the model, with the same table and sequence; Keep locks in your database also shows it with TypeORM. acquire() is one INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE ... WHERE owner IS NULL OR expires_at <= clock_timestamp() RETURNING fencing_token, with the token drawn in the SET, after the row lock. Prisma's upsert() has no condition on the update, so use $queryRaw. renew() and release() put the owner and the expiry in the WHERE of updateMany() and check count === 1. Not update() after a findUnique(): it reads first.
blocks.zh: **与 Prisma.** 这 Drizzle 存储是模型，有相同的表和顺序； [Keep locks in your database](/reliability/locks#keep-locks-in-your-database) 还显示了 TypeORM. `acquire()` 是一个 `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE ... WHERE owner IS NULL OR expires_at <= clock_timestamp() RETURNING fencing_token`，其中标记绘制在 `SET`，在行锁定之后。 Prisma's `upsert()` 更新没有条件，因此使用 `$queryRaw`. `renew()` 和 `release()` 将所有者和到期日放入 `WHERE` 的 `updateMany()` 并检查 `count === 1`.不 `update()` 之后 `findUnique()`：它先读。

blocks.md: **Test it** with the suite from `@nestjs/locks/testing`. `lockStoreContract()` returns cases for any test runner. `concurrent: true` races 16 callers for each key, and its `callers` option raises that; run it against a server with a connection pool, where the calls really overlap. `advanceTime` moves the store's clock for the expiry cases; without it they wait in real time, about twenty-five seconds in total, on locks of `ttl` (2.5 seconds by default, checked still held halfway through and free a sixth past it: raise it for a store whose round trips are slow).

blocks.zh: **使用套件进行测试** `@nestjs/locks/testing`. `lockStoreContract()` 返回任何测试运行程序的案例。 `concurrent: true` 每个密钥竞争 16 个呼叫者，其 `callers` 期权提高了这一点；在带有连接池的服务器上运行它，那里的调用实际上是重叠的。 `advanceTime` 为过期情况移动商店的时钟；如果没有它，他们就会实时等待，总共大约 25 秒，锁定 `ttl` （默认为 2.5 秒，中途勾选仍然持有，并释放六分之一过去：为往返缓慢的商店提高它）。

blocks.md: `LocksModule.forRoot()` takes these options; `forRootAsync()` takes them from `useFactory`, `useClass` or `useExisting` (a class implementing `LocksOptionsFactory`). The store isn't an option: register it with `LocksStorage`, as in [Keep locks in your database](/reliability/locks#keep-locks-in-your-database).
blocks.text: LocksModule.forRoot() takes these options; forRootAsync() takes them from useFactory, useClass or useExisting (a class implementing LocksOptionsFactory). The store isn't an option: register it with LocksStorage, as in Keep locks in your database.
blocks.zh: `LocksModule.forRoot()` 采取这些选项；`forRootAsync()` 从 `useFactory`、`useClass` 或 `useExisting`（实现 `LocksOptionsFactory` 的类）获取它们。存储不是一个选项：用 `LocksStorage` 注册它，如在 [Keep locks in your database](/reliability/locks#keep-locks-in-your-database) 中。

blocks.md:
| Option | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ttl` | `'30s'` | How long a lock lives without a renewal, so how soon another instance takes over after a crash. The default for every lock, lease and election. A duration: milliseconds, or a string such as `'15s'` or `'2m'` |
| `storeTimeout` | `'10s'` | How long to wait for each store call (`acquire()`, `renew()`, `release()`). Past it, the call fails with `LockStoreTimeoutError`: `acquire()` rejects, a tick doesn't run, a renewal is tried again at the next beat, and a lock the store grants after that goes back to it |
| `clock` | The system clock | A `LockClock`. Tests pass a `ManualLockClock` ([Testing](/reliability/locks#testing)) |
| `allowInMemoryStorage` | `false` | With `NODE_ENV=production` and no registered store, startup fails; `true` runs on the in-memory store anyway (one instance) |
| `isGlobal` | `true` | Registers the module globally. Top level of `forRoot()` and `forRootAsync()` |
blocks.zh:
| 选择 | 默认的 | 意义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ttl` | `'30s'` | 一个锁在不更新的情况下能存活多久，那么另一个实例在崩溃后多久会接管。每个锁、租约和选举的默认值。持续时间：毫秒，或字符串，如 `'15s'` 或者 `'2m'` |
| `storeTimeout` | `'10s'` | 每次商店呼叫需要等待多长时间（`acquire()`, `renew()`, `release()`).超过它，调用失败 `LockStoreTimeoutError`: `acquire()` 拒绝，勾号不运行，在下一个节拍时再次尝试续订，然后存储授予的锁返回到它 |
| `clock` | 系统时钟 | 和 `LockClock`。测试通过 `ManualLockClock` ([Testing](/reliability/locks#testing)) |
| `allowInMemoryStorage` | `false` | 和 `NODE_ENV=production` 没有注册商店，启动失败；`true` 无论如何都在内存存储中运行（一个实例） |
| `isGlobal` | `true` | 全局注册模块。的顶层 `forRoot()` 和 `forRootAsync()` |

blocks.md:
| API | Options | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `@OnOneInstance()` | `key`, `ttl` | Runs the job on the instance holding the `<key>:owner` lease; other instances skip the tick. [Run each job on one instance](/reliability/locks#run-each-job-on-one-instance) |
| `@WithoutOverlapping()` | `key`, `ttl` | Skips a tick while a run holds the `<key>` lock, on any instance. [Don't let a long run overlap itself](/reliability/locks#dont-let-a-long-run-overlap-itself) |
| `@LeaderElection(key)` | `ttl` | On a singleton provider implementing `OnLeadershipAcquired`, `OnLeadershipLost` or both. [Hold the warehouse feed on one instance](/reliability/locks#hold-the-warehouse-feed-on-one-instance) |
| `Locks.acquire(key, options)` | `ttl`, `wait`, `signal` | Resolves a `Lock`, or `null` when the key stayed taken. [Run the export by hand](/reliability/locks#run-the-export-by-hand) |
| `Locks.withLock(key, fn, options)` | `ttl`, `wait`, `signal` | Runs `fn(lock)` under the lock and releases it; rejects with `LockNotAcquiredError` when the key stayed taken |
blocks.zh:
| API | 选项 | 附注 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `@OnOneInstance()` | `key`,`ttl` | 在保存 `<key>:owner` 出租；其他实例跳过勾号。[Run each job on one instance](/reliability/locks#run-each-job-on-one-instance) |
| `@WithoutOverlapping()` | `key`,`ttl` | 运行时跳过勾号 `<key>` 无论如何都要锁上。[Don't let a long run overlap itself](/reliability/locks#dont-let-a-long-run-overlap-itself) |
| `@LeaderElection(key)` | `ttl` | 关于单例提供者实现 `OnLeadershipAcquired`,`OnLeadershipLost` 或者两者都有。[Hold the warehouse feed on one instance](/reliability/locks#hold-the-warehouse-feed-on-one-instance) |
| `Locks.acquire(key, options)` | `ttl`,`wait`,`signal` | 解决 `Lock`, 或 `null` 当钥匙被拿走时。[Run the export by hand](/reliability/locks#run-the-export-by-hand) |
| `Locks.withLock(key, fn, options)` | `ttl`,`wait`,`signal` | 运行 `fn(lock)` 在锁下并释放它；拒绝 `LockNotAcquiredError` 当钥匙被拿走时 |

blocks.md:
- `key` defaults to `ClassName.methodName`, and the two job decorators on one method share it. `ttl` defaults to the module's.
- `wait` defaults to `0` (try once); a longer wait retries with backoff. `signal` stops the waiting, also for a store call in flight. Neither `wait` nor `ttl` bounds a store call: the module's `storeTimeout` does.
- A `Lock` has `key`, `owner`, `fencingToken`, `signal`, `held`, `release()` and `[Symbol.asyncDispose]`, so `await using` releases it.
- `LocksContext` has `lock`, `fencingToken` and `signal` inside a job, a `withLock()` callback, or `run(lock, fn)`; outside one, they are `undefined`. [Fence the writes](/reliability/locks#fence-the-writes)

Neither wait nor ttl bounds a store call: the module's storeTimeout does. A Lock has key, owner, fencingToken, signal, held, release() and [Symbol.asyncDispose], so await using releases it. LocksContext has lock, fencingToken and signal inside a job, a withLock() callback, or run(lock, fn); outside one, they are undefined. Fence the writes
blocks.zh:
- `key` 默认值为 `ClassName.methodName`，并且一个方法上的两个作业装饰器共享它。`ttl` 模块的默认值。
- `wait` 默认值为 `0`（试一次）；更长的等待会带有后退的重试。`signal` 停止等待，也是在飞行中打电话给商店。都不是 `wait` 也不 `ttl` 限制存储调用：模块的 `storeTimeout` 是的。
- 一个 `Lock` 有 `key`,`owner`,`fencingToken`,`signal`,`held`,`release()` 和 `[Symbol.asyncDispose]`,所以 `await using` 释放它。
- `LocksContext` 在作业、`withLock()` 回调或 `run(lock, fn)` 中具有 `lock`、`fencingToken` 和 `signal`；在一个之外，它们是 `undefined`。[Fence the writes](/reliability/locks#fence-the-writes)

blocks.text: Errors
blocks.zh: 错误

blocks.md: None of them carries an HTTP status: contention isn't the caller's mistake, so the handler picks the response ([Run the export by hand](/reliability/locks#run-the-export-by-hand) answers `409`).
blocks.text: None of them carries an HTTP status: contention isn't the caller's mistake, so the handler picks the response (Run the export by hand answers 409).
blocks.zh: 他们都没有携带 HTTP 状态：争用不是调用者的错误，因此处理程序选择响应（[Run the export by hand](/reliability/locks#run-the-export-by-hand) 答案 `409`).

blocks.md:
| Error | Properties | Raised when |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `LocksError` | None | The base class of the three below |
| `LockNotAcquiredError` | `key`, `waitMs` | `withLock()` couldn't take the lock within `wait` |
| `LockLostError` | `key`, `fencingToken`, `detectedBy` | The reason a lost lock's `signal` aborts with: the store refused a renewal (`'renewal'`), or `ttl` passed without a confirmed one (`'deadline'`) |
| `LockStoreTimeoutError` | `key`, `method`, `timeoutMs` | A store call (`method`: `'acquire'`, `'renew'` or `'release'`) didn't answer within `storeTimeout` |
blocks.zh:
| 错误 | 属性 | 抚养时间 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `LocksError` | 没有一个 | 下面三个的基类 |
| `LockNotAcquiredError` | `key`,`waitMs` | `withLock()` 拿不到里面的锁 `wait` |
| `LockLostError` | `key`,`fencingToken`,`detectedBy` | 丢失锁的 `signal` 中止原因：商店拒绝续订（`'renewal'`），或 `ttl` 在没有确认续订的情况下通过（`'deadline'`） |
| `LockStoreTimeoutError` | `key`,`method`,`timeoutMs` | 商店呼叫（`method`:`'acquire'`,`'renew'` 或者 `'release'`）没有回答 `storeTimeout` |

chapters.title: Health checks
chapters.summary: The Terminus integration provides readiness/liveness health checks.

blocks.md:
The Terminus integration provides **readiness/liveness** health checks. Health checks are crucial in complex backend setups. In web development, a health check usually consists of a dedicated address, for example, `https://my-website.com/health/readiness`.
A service or component of your infrastructure (e.g., [Kubernetes](https://kubernetes.io/)) checks this address continuously. Depending on the HTTP status code returned from a `GET` request to this address, the service takes action when it receives an "unhealthy" response.
Because the definition of "healthy" or "unhealthy" varies with the type of service you provide, the **Terminus** integration offers a set of **health indicators**.
blocks.text: The Terminus integration provides readiness/liveness health checks. Health checks are crucial in complex backend setups. In web development, a health check usually consists of a dedicated address, for example, https://my-website.com/health/readiness. A service or component of your infrastructure (e.g., Kubernetes) checks this address continuously. Depending on the HTTP status code returned from a GET request to this address, the service takes action when it receives an "unhealthy" response. Because the definition of "healthy" or "unhealthy" varies with the type of service you provide, the Terminus integration offers a set of health indicators.
blocks.zh:
终端集成提供**就绪/活跃**健康检查。健康检查在复杂的后端设置中至关重要。在 web 开发中，健康检查通常由一个专用地址组成，例如 `https://my-website.com/health/readiness`。
基础架构的服务或组件（例如，[Kubernetes](https://kubernetes.io/)）会持续检查此地址。根据从 `GET` 请求返回到该地址的 HTTP 状态代码，服务在收到“不健康”响应时采取行动。
因为“健康”或“不健康”的定义因您提供的服务类型而异，所以**Terminus**集成提供了一组**健康指标**。

blocks.md:
For example, if your web server uses MongoDB to store its data, whether MongoDB is still up and running is vital information.
In that case, you can use the `MongooseHealthIndicator`. Once configured (as described below), your health check address returns
a healthy or unhealthy HTTP status code, depending on whether MongoDB is running.

blocks.md: Custom health indicator
blocks.text: Custom health indicator
blocks.zh: 自定义健康指示器

blocks.md: In some cases, the predefined health indicators provided by `@nestjs/terminus` don't cover all of your health check requirements. In that case, you can create a custom health indicator.
blocks.text: In some cases, the predefined health indicators provided by @nestjs/terminus don't cover all of your health check requirements. In that case, you can create a custom health indicator.
blocks.zh: 在某些情况下，由 `@nestjs/terminus` 不要涵盖您所有的健康检查要求。在这种情况下，您可以创建自定义健康指示器。

blocks.md: Most health indicators follow the same pattern: run an operation, then mark the indicator as `'up'` if it succeeds and as `'down'` if it fails. The `HealthIndicatorService` implements this pattern with `attempt()`. To show how an indicator is structured, we will create an example `DogHealthIndicator`. This service should have the state `'up'` as long as an external dog API responds within one second.
blocks.text: Most health indicators follow the same pattern: run an operation, then mark the indicator as 'up' if it succeeds and as 'down' if it fails. The HealthIndicatorService implements this pattern with attempt(). To show how an indicator is structured, we will create an example DogHealthIndicator. This service should have the state 'up' as long as an external dog API responds within one second.
blocks.zh: 大多数健康指标遵循相同的模式：运行一个操作，如果成功，则将指标标记为 `'up'`，如果失败，则将指标标记为 `'down'`。`HealthIndicatorService` 用 `attempt()` 实现了这种模式。为了展示指标的结构，我们将创建一个示例 `DogHealthIndicator`。只要外部狗 API 在一秒钟内响应，该服务就应该有状态 `'up'`。

blocks.md: `attempt()` accepts a sync or async function and marks the indicator as `'up'` once it resolves. Any data the function returns is appended to the result. If the function throws, the indicator is marked as `'down'` and the error message is added to the result. In both cases, the time the function took is reported as `responseTime`. `withTimeout()` limits the attempt to the given number of milliseconds (see [Timeouts and caching](#timeouts-and-caching)).
blocks.text: attempt() accepts a sync or async function and marks the indicator as 'up' once it resolves. Any data the function returns is appended to the result. If the function throws, the indicator is marked as 'down' and the error message is added to the result. In both cases, the time the function took is reported as responseTime. withTimeout() limits the attempt to the given number of milliseconds (see Timeouts and caching).
blocks.zh: `attempt()` 接受同步或异步函数，并将指示器标记为 `'up'` 一旦解决了。函数返回的任何数据都附加到结果中。如果函数抛出，则指示器标记为 `'down'` 并且错误消息被添加到结果中。在这两种情况下，函数花费的时间都报告为 `responseTime`. `withTimeout()` 将尝试限制为给定的毫秒数（请参见 [Timeouts and caching](#timeouts-and-caching)).

blocks.md: Explicit control with up() and down()
blocks.text: Explicit control with up() and down()
blocks.zh: 显式控制 up() 和 down()

blocks.md: Sometimes "healthy" means more than "the operation didn't throw". To decide the state yourself, return `up()` or `down()` directly instead of using `attempt()`. Assume the dogs are now stored locally, and the indicator should only be healthy if every `Dog` has the type `'goodboy'`.
blocks.text: Sometimes "healthy" means more than "the operation didn't throw". To decide the state yourself, return up() or down() directly instead of using attempt(). Assume the dogs are now stored locally, and the indicator should only be healthy if every Dog has the type 'goodboy'.
blocks.zh: 有时候“健康”不仅仅意味着“手术没有扔”。要自己决定状态，请返回 `up()` 或者 `down()` 直接而不是使用 `attempt()`.假设狗现在存放在本地，并且只有当每个 `Dog` 具有类型 `'goodboy'`.

blocks.md: Both `up()` and `down()` accept either an object with additional data, which is appended to the result, or a string, which is added as the `message` property.
blocks.text: Both up() and down() accept either an object with additional data, which is appended to the result, or a string, which is added as the message property.
blocks.zh: 两个 `up()` 和 `down()` 接受附加到结果的具有附加数据的对象，或作为 `message` 财产。

blocks.md: Degraded state
blocks.text: Degraded state
blocks.zh: 退化状态

blocks.md: Not every problem justifies taking the application out of rotation. An unreachable cache, for example, slows the application down but doesn't break it. For such cases, an indicator can return `degraded()`. A degraded indicator doesn't fail the health check: it is listed under `info`, the overall status becomes `'degraded'`, and the HTTP status code stays `200`. Orchestrators keep routing traffic, while the state remains visible in monitoring.
blocks.text: Not every problem justifies taking the application out of rotation. An unreachable cache, for example, slows the application down but doesn't break it. For such cases, an indicator can return degraded(). A degraded indicator doesn't fail the health check: it is listed under info, the overall status becomes 'degraded', and the HTTP status code stays 200. Orchestrators keep routing traffic, while the state remains visible in monitoring.
blocks.zh: 并不是每个问题都有理由让应用程序退出轮换。例如，不可到达的缓存会降低应用程序的速度，但不会破坏应用程序。在这种情况下，指示器可以返回 `degraded()`.降级指示器不会通过健康检查：它列在 `info`，整体状态变为 `'degraded'`，以及 HTTP 状态代码停留 `200`.编排器保持路由流量，而状态在监控中保持可见。

blocks.md: Like `up()` and `down()`, `degraded()` accepts either an object with additional data or a message string. As soon as any indicator is `'down'`, the overall status is `'error'` regardless of degraded indicators.
blocks.text: Like up() and down(), degraded() accepts either an object with additional data or a message string. As soon as any indicator is 'down', the overall status is 'error' regardless of degraded indicators.
blocks.zh: 喜欢 `up()` 和 `down()`,`degraded()` 接受具有附加数据的对象或消息字符串。一旦有任何指标 `'down'`，总体状态是 `'error'` 无论指标退化。

blocks.title: Warning
blocks.md: A health indicator built with `up()`, `down()`, and `degraded()` reports its state by returning one of them. An error thrown by such an indicator is treated as a bug, not an unhealthy state: it aborts the whole health check and results in a `500` response instead of a `503`. If your indicator wraps an operation that may throw, use `attempt()`, which translates a thrown error into a `'down'` state.
blocks.text: A health indicator built with up(), down(), and degraded() reports its state by returning one of them. An error thrown by such an indicator is treated as a bug, not an unhealthy state: it aborts the whole health check and results in a 500 response instead of a 503. If your indicator wraps an operation that may throw, use attempt(), which translates a thrown error into a 'down' state.
blocks.zh: 建立在 `up()`, `down()`，和 `degraded()` 通过返回其中一个来报告其状态。这种指示器引发的错误被视为 bug，而不是不健康状态：它会中止整个运行状况检查并导致 `500` 响应而不是 `503`.如果指示器包装了可能抛出的操作，请使用 `attempt()`，它将抛出的错误转换为 `'down'` 状态。

blocks.md: Timeouts and caching
blocks.text: Timeouts and caching
blocks.zh: 超时和缓存

blocks.md: Every check built with `attempt()` returns a `HealthCheckAttempt`. This includes your custom indicators as well as the built-in database, microservice, and gRPC indicators. Before the attempt is executed, you can configure it by chaining `withTimeout()` and `cacheFor()`.
blocks.text: Every check built with attempt() returns a HealthCheckAttempt. This includes your custom indicators as well as the built-in database, microservice, and gRPC indicators. Before the attempt is executed, you can configure it by chaining withTimeout() and cacheFor().
blocks.zh: 每个用 `attempt()` 构建的检查都返回一个 `HealthCheckAttempt`。这包括您的自定义指标以及内置数据库、微服务和 gRPC 指标。在执行尝试之前，您可以通过链接 `withTimeout()` 和 `cacheFor()` 来配置它。

blocks.md: Timeouts
blocks.text: Timeouts
blocks.zh: 超时

blocks.md: `withTimeout()` limits the attempt to the given number of milliseconds. Once the time is up, the indicator is marked as `'down'` and the `AbortSignal` passed to your function is aborted. Pass that `signal` to the underlying operation so that it is canceled as well, rather than lingering in the background.
blocks.text: withTimeout() limits the attempt to the given number of milliseconds. Once the time is up, the indicator is marked as 'down' and the AbortSignal passed to your function is aborted. Pass that signal to the underlying operation so that it is canceled as well, rather than lingering in the background.
blocks.zh: `withTimeout()` 将尝试限制在给定的毫秒数。一旦时间到了，指示器就被标记为 `'down'` 和 `AbortSignal` 传递给您的函数被中止。通过那个 `signal` 到底层操作，以便它也被取消，而不是停留在后台。

blocks.md: The `timeout` option of the built-in indicators (e.g., `this.db.pingCheck('database', { timeout: 1500 })`) is deprecated. Chain `.withTimeout()` on the returned attempt instead.
blocks.text: The timeout option of the built-in indicators (e.g., this.db.pingCheck('database', { timeout: 1500 })) is deprecated. Chain .withTimeout() on the returned attempt instead.

blocks.md: Caching
blocks.text: Caching
blocks.zh: 缓存

blocks.md: Orchestrators typically poll health checks every few seconds, and some checks are too expensive to run on every request. `cacheFor()` caches the result of an attempt for the given number of milliseconds. While a fresh result exists, the function isn't executed again, and concurrent health checks share a single in-flight execution. The cache is shared across requests and keyed by the indicator key.
blocks.text: Orchestrators typically poll health checks every few seconds, and some checks are too expensive to run on every request. cacheFor() caches the result of an attempt for the given number of milliseconds. While a fresh result exists, the function isn't executed again, and concurrent health checks share a single in-flight execution. The cache is shared across requests and keyed by the indicator key.
blocks.zh: 编排器通常每隔几秒钟轮询一次运行状况检查，有些检查过于昂贵，无法在每个请求上运行。`cacheFor()` 将尝试的结果缓存给定毫秒数。当新结果存在时，该函数不会再次执行，并且并发运行状况检查共享一个飞行中执行。高速缓存跨请求共享，并由指示符键加密。

blocks.md: Graceful shutdown timeout
blocks.text: Graceful shutdown timeout
blocks.zh: 优雅关机超时

blocks.md:
If your application needs to postpone its shutdown, Terminus can handle it for you with the `gracefulShutdownTimeoutMs` option (in milliseconds, `0` by default).
This setting is particularly useful with an orchestrator such as Kubernetes.
By setting a delay slightly longer than the readiness check interval, you can achieve zero downtime when shutting down containers: as soon as a termination signal is received, the health check reports `'shutting_down'` with a `503` status code, so the orchestrator stops routing new traffic while the application finishes in-flight requests during the delay.
blocks.text: If your application needs to postpone its shutdown, Terminus can handle it for you with the gracefulShutdownTimeoutMs option (in milliseconds, 0 by default). This setting is particularly useful with an orchestrator such as Kubernetes. By setting a delay slightly longer than the readiness check interval, you can achieve zero downtime when shutting down containers: as soon as a termination signal is received, the health check reports 'shutting_down' with a 503 status code, so the orchestrator stops routing new traffic while the application finishes in-flight requests during the delay.
blocks.zh:
如果您的应用程序需要延迟关闭，Terminus 可以使用 `gracefulShutdownTimeoutMs` 选项（单位为毫秒， `0` 默认情况下）。
此设置对于编排器特别有用，例如 Kubernetes.
通过设置稍长于就绪检查间隔的延迟，您可以在关闭容器时实现零停机时间：一旦收到终止信号，健康检查就会报告 `'shutting_down'` 用一个 `503` 状态代码，因此当应用程序在延迟期间完成飞行中请求时，编排器停止路由新流量。

blocks.title: Warning
blocks.md: The delay is only applied on `SIGTERM`, which is the signal orchestrators such as Kubernetes send when stopping a container. Other signals (e.g. `SIGINT` from `Ctrl+C`) still switch the health check to `'shutting_down'` but shut the application down immediately. Make sure [shutdown hooks](/fundamentals/lifecycle-events#application-shutdown) are enabled; otherwise, Terminus never receives the signal.
blocks.text: The delay is only applied on SIGTERM, which is the signal orchestrators such as Kubernetes send when stopping a container. Other signals (e.g. SIGINT from Ctrl+C) still switch the health check to 'shutting_down' but shut the application down immediately. Make sure shutdown hooks are enabled; otherwise, Terminus never receives the signal.
blocks.zh: 延迟仅适用于 `SIGTERM`，即信号编排器，例如 Kubernetes 停止容器时发送。其他信号（例如 `SIGINT` 来自 `Ctrl+C`) 仍然将健康检查切换到 `'shutting_down'` 但是立即关闭应用程序。确保 [关闭挂钩](/fundamentals/lifecycle-events#application-shutdown) 已启用；否则，终端永远不会接收到信号。

chapters.summary: GraphQL is a query language for APIs and a runtime for fulfilling those queries with your existing data.

blocks.md: Harnessing the power of TypeScript & GraphQL
blocks.text: Harnessing the power of TypeScript & GraphQL
blocks.zh: 利用 TypeScript&GraphQL

blocks.md: [GraphQL](https://graphql.org/) is a query language for APIs and a runtime for fulfilling those queries with your existing data. It solves many problems typically found with REST APIs. For background, see this [comparison of GraphQL and REST](https://www.apollographql.com/blog/graphql-vs-rest). Combined with [TypeScript](https://www.typescriptlang.org/), GraphQL gives you better type safety for your queries and end-to-end typing.
blocks.text: GraphQL is a query language for APIs and a runtime for fulfilling those queries with your existing data. It solves many problems typically found with REST APIs. For background, see this comparison of GraphQL and REST. Combined with TypeScript, GraphQL gives you better type safety for your queries and end-to-end typing.
blocks.zh: [GraphQL](https://graphql.org/) 是 API 的查询语言，也是使用现有数据完成这些查询的运行时。它解决了许多通常遇到的问题 REST 蜜蜂。有关背景信息，请参阅 [comparison of GraphQL and REST](https://www.apollographql.com/blog/graphql-vs-rest).结合 [TypeScript](https://www.typescriptlang.org/), GraphQL 为您的查询和端到端键入提供更好的键入安全性。

blocks.md: This chapter assumes a basic understanding of GraphQL and focuses on working with the built-in `@nestjs/graphql` module. The `GraphQLModule` can be configured to use [Apollo](https://www.apollographql.com/) Server (with the `@nestjs/apollo` driver) or [Mercurius](https://github.com/mercurius-js/mercurius) (with the `@nestjs/mercurius` driver). Nest provides official integrations for both packages (see also the [third-party integrations](/graphql/quick-start#third-party-integrations) below).

blocks.md: Overview
blocks.text: Overview
blocks.zh: 概述

blocks.md: Nest offers two ways of building GraphQL applications: **code first** and **schema first**. Choose the one that suits you best. Most chapters in this GraphQL section are divided into two parts: one for the **code first** approach and one for the **schema first** approach.
blocks.text: Nest offers two ways of building GraphQL applications: code first and schema first. Choose the one that suits you best. Most chapters in this GraphQL section are divided into two parts: one for the code first approach and one for the schema first approach.
blocks.zh: Nest 提供两种构建方式 GraphQL 应用：**代码优先**和**模式优先**。选择最适合你的。本书的大部分章节 GraphQL 本节分为两部分：一部分用于**代码优先**方法，另一部分用于**模式优先**方法。

blocks.md: In the **code first** approach, you use decorators and TypeScript classes to generate the corresponding GraphQL schema. This approach suits you if you prefer to work exclusively in TypeScript and avoid switching between language syntaxes.
blocks.text: In the code first approach, you use decorators and TypeScript classes to generate the corresponding GraphQL schema. This approach suits you if you prefer to work exclusively in TypeScript and avoid switching between language syntaxes.
blocks.zh: 在**代码优先**方法中，您使用装饰器和 TypeScript 类生成相应的 GraphQL 模式。如果您喜欢专门在 TypeScript 并避免在语言语法之间切换。

blocks.md: In the **schema first** approach, the source of truth is a set of GraphQL SDL (Schema Definition Language) files. SDL is a language-agnostic way to share schema files between platforms. Nest generates your TypeScript definitions (as classes or interfaces) from the GraphQL schemas, so you don't have to write redundant boilerplate code.

blocks.zh: 在**模式优先**方法中，真理的来源是一组 GraphQLSDL（模式定义语言）文件。SDL 是一种在平台之间共享模式文件的与语言无关的方式。Nest 生成您的 TypeScript 定义（如类或接口）GraphQL 模式，因此您不必编写冗余的样板代码。

chapters.title: Resolvers
chapters.summary: Resolvers provide the instructions for turning a GraphQL operation (a query, mutation, or subscription) into data.

blocks.md: Resolvers provide the instructions for turning a [GraphQL](https://graphql.org/) operation (a query, mutation, or subscription) into data. They return data in the shape specified in the schema, either synchronously or as a promise that resolves to a result of that shape. Typically, you create a **resolver map** manually. The `@nestjs/graphql` package, on the other hand, generates the resolver map automatically from the metadata provided by the decorators you use to annotate classes. To demonstrate how to create a GraphQL API with the package, we'll build a simple authors API.

The @nestjs/graphql package, on the other hand, generates the resolver map automatically from the metadata provided by the decorators you use to annotate classes. To demonstrate how to create a GraphQL API with the package, we'll build a simple authors API.

blocks.md: TypeScript's metadata reflection system has several limitations. For instance, it can't determine which properties a class consists of, or whether a given property is optional or required. Because of these limitations, you must either use the `@Field()` decorator in your schema definition classes to provide metadata about each field's GraphQL type and optionality, or use the [CLI plugin](/graphql/cli-plugin) to generate this metadata for you.

A GraphQL scalar type is a primitive (like `ID`, `String`, `Boolean`, or `Int`) that resolves to a single value.

blocks.md: Because this class includes a **field resolver** function (for the `posts` property of the `Author` object type), you **must** pass the `@Resolver()` decorator a value that indicates the parent type (i.e., the corresponding `ObjectType` class) for all field resolvers defined within the class. Here, the field resolver populates an author's `posts` array by calling a service with the author's `id`, which is why the parent object must be identified in the `@Resolver()` decorator. The `@Parent()` method parameter decorator then extracts a reference to that parent object in the field resolver.

chapters.title: Mutations
chapters.summary: Most discussions of GraphQL focus on data fetching, but any complete data platform needs a way to modify server-side data as well.

blocks.md: Most discussions of GraphQL focus on data fetching, but any complete data platform needs a way to modify server-side data as well. In REST, any request could cause side effects on the server, but best practice is not to modify data in `GET` requests. GraphQL is similar: technically, any query could be implemented to write data. However, as with REST, the convention is to send any operation that causes writes explicitly as a mutation (see [Mutations](https://graphql.org/learn/queries/#mutations) in the GraphQL documentation).
blocks.text: Most discussions of GraphQL focus on data fetching, but any complete data platform needs a way to modify server-side data as well. In REST, any request could cause side effects on the server, but best practice is not to modify data in GET requests. GraphQL is similar: technically, any query could be implemented to write data. However, as with REST, the convention is to send any operation that causes writes explicitly as a mutation (see Mutations in the GraphQL documentation).
blocks.zh: 大多数讨论 GraphQL 专注于数据获取，但任何完整的数据平台也需要一种修改服务器端数据的方法。在 REST，任何请求都可能对服务器造成副作用，但最佳做法是不要修改中的数据 `GET` 请求。GraphQL 是相似的：从技术上讲，任何查询都可以实现来写入数据。然而，与 REST 约定是将任何导致写的操作显式作为突变发送（参见 [Mutations](https://graphql.org/learn/queries/#mutations) 在 GraphQL 文档）。

chapters.title: Subscriptions
chapters.summary: In addition to fetching data with queries and modifying data with mutations, the GraphQL spec supports a third operation type, called subscription.

blocks.md: In addition to fetching data with queries and modifying data with mutations, the GraphQL spec supports a third operation type, called `subscription`. GraphQL subscriptions push data from the server to clients that choose to listen to real-time messages. Like queries, subscriptions specify a set of fields to be delivered to the client. Instead of immediately returning a single result, however, they open a channel, and the server sends a result to the client every time a particular event occurs.
blocks.text: In addition to fetching data with queries and modifying data with mutations, the GraphQL spec supports a third operation type, called subscription. GraphQL subscriptions push data from the server to clients that choose to listen to real-time messages. Like queries, subscriptions specify a set of fields to be delivered to the client. Instead of immediately returning a single result, however, they open a channel, and the server sends a result to the client every time a particular event occurs.
blocks.zh: 除了通过查询获取数据和通过突变修改数据之外，GraphQL 规范还支持第三种操作类型，称为 `subscription`。GraphQL 订阅将数据从服务器推送到选择监听实时消息的客户端。与查询一样，订阅指定要传递给客户端的一组字段。然而，它们不是立即返回单个结果，而是打开一个通道，服务器在每次发生特定事件时都会向客户端发送一个结果。

blocks.md: A common use case for subscriptions is notifying the client about particular events, such as the creation of a new object or updated fields (see [Subscriptions](https://www.apollographql.com/docs/react/data/subscriptions) in the Apollo documentation).

blocks.title: Warning
blocks.md: Support for `subscriptions-transport-ws` was **removed** in `@nestjs/graphql` v14. The package is no longer a dependency, and the `'subscriptions-transport-ws'` key is no longer accepted in the `subscriptions` options object. If you are upgrading, replace that key with `'graphql-ws'` and update your clients to the newer protocol. The two protocols are wire-incompatible, so clients still using `subscriptions-transport-ws` fail to connect. The `onConnect` callback signature differs as well: with `graphql-ws`, it receives the connection context, and extra context values belong in its `extra` field (see [Authentication over WebSockets](/graphql/subscriptions#authentication-over-websockets) below).

chapters.title: Scalars
chapters.summary: A GraphQL object type has a name and fields, but at some point those fields have to resolve to some concrete data.

blocks.md: A GraphQL object type has a name and fields, but at some point those fields have to resolve to some concrete data. Scalar types provide that data: they represent the leaves of the query (see [scalar types](https://graphql.org/learn/schema/#scalar-types) in the GraphQL documentation). GraphQL includes the following built-in scalar types: `Int`, `Float`, `String`, `Boolean`, and `ID`. In addition to these, you may need to support custom atomic data types (e.g., `Date`).

blocks.md: A directive can be attached to a field or fragment inclusion, and can affect execution of the query in any way the server desires (see [directives](https://graphql.org/learn/queries/#directives) in the GraphQL documentation). The GraphQL specification provides several default directives:

blocks.md:
- `@include(if: Boolean)`: include this field in the result only if the argument is `true`
- `@skip(if: Boolean)`: skip this field if the argument is `true`
- `@deprecated(reason: String)`: mark the field as deprecated, with a message

chapters.title: Field middleware
chapters.summary: Field middleware lets you run arbitrary code before or after a field is resolved.

blocks.title: Warning
blocks.md: This chapter applies only to the code first approach.
blocks.text: This chapter applies only to the code first approach.
blocks.zh: 本章仅适用于代码优先的方法。

blocks.md: Field middleware lets you run arbitrary code **before or after** a field is resolved. You can use field middleware to convert the result of a field, validate the arguments of a field, or check field-level roles (for example, the roles required to access the field the middleware function runs for).
blocks.text: Field middleware lets you run arbitrary code before or after a field is resolved. You can use field middleware to convert the result of a field, validate the arguments of a field, or check field-level roles (for example, the roles required to access the field the middleware function runs for).
blocks.zh: 字段中间件允许您在字段解析之前或之后运行任意代码。您可以使用字段中间件转换字段的结果、验证字段的参数或检查字段级角色（例如，访问中间件函数运行的字段所需的角色）。

blocks.md: You can connect multiple middleware functions to a field. In this case, they are called sequentially along a chain, where each middleware decides whether to call the next one. The order of the functions in the `middleware` array matters. The first one is the outermost layer, so it runs first and finishes last (similar to the `graphql-middleware` package). The second one is the next layer in, so it runs second and finishes second to last.
blocks.text: You can connect multiple middleware functions to a field. In this case, they are called sequentially along a chain, where each middleware decides whether to call the next one. The order of the functions in the middleware array matters. The first one is the outermost layer, so it runs first and finishes last (similar to the graphql-middleware package). The second one is the next layer in, so it runs second and finishes second to last.
blocks.zh: 您可以将多个中间件函数连接到一个字段。在这种情况下，它们沿着链顺序调用，每个中间件决定是否调用下一个中间件。函数的顺序 `middleware` 阵列很重要。第一个是最外层，所以它先运行，最后完成（类似于 `graphql-middleware` 包）。第二个是下一层，所以它运行第二个，倒数第二个完成。

blocks.text: MiddlewareContext is an object that consists of the same arguments that the GraphQL resolver function normally receives ({ source, args, context, info }), while NextFn is a function that executes the next middleware in the stack (bound to this field) or the actual field resolver.
blocks.zh: `MiddlewareContext` 是一个对象，它由与 GraphQL 解析器功能通常接收（`{ source, args, context, info }`），而 `NextFn` 是执行堆栈（绑定到此字段）或实际字段解析器中的下一个中间件的函数。

blocks.title: Warning
blocks.md: Field middleware functions can't inject dependencies or access Nest's DI container. They are designed to be lightweight and shouldn't perform potentially time-consuming operations (like retrieving data from the database). If you need to call external services or query a data source, do it in a guard or interceptor bound to a root query or mutation handler, and assign the result to the `context` object. You can then access it from within the field middleware (through the `MiddlewareContext` object).
blocks.text: Field middleware functions can't inject dependencies or access Nest's DI container. They are designed to be lightweight and shouldn't perform potentially time-consuming operations (like retrieving data from the database). If you need to call external services or query a data source, do it in a guard or interceptor bound to a root query or mutation handler, and assign the result to the context object. You can then access it from within the field middleware (through the MiddlewareContext object).
blocks.zh: 现场中间件函数不能注入依赖项或访问 Nest 的 DI 容器。它们被设计成轻量级的，不应该执行潜在的耗时操作（如从数据库中检索数据）。如果需要调用外部服务或查询数据源，请在绑定到根查询或突变处理程序的 guard 或 interceptor 中执行，并将结果分配给 `context` 物体。然后，您可以从字段中间件中访问它（通过 `MiddlewareContext` 对象）。

blocks.md: Field middleware must match the `FieldMiddleware` interface. In the example above, we first call the `next()` function (which executes the actual field resolver and returns the field value), and then log this value to the terminal. The value returned from the middleware function replaces the field value (if the middleware returns `undefined`, the value from `next()` is used). Since we don't want to change anything, we return the original value.

chapters.title: Complexity
chapters.summary: Query complexity lets you define how complex certain fields are, and restrict queries with a maximum complexity.

blocks.title: Warning
blocks.md: This chapter applies only to the code first approach.
blocks.text: This chapter applies only to the code first approach.
blocks.zh: 本章仅适用于代码优先的方法。

blocks.md: Query complexity lets you define how complex certain fields are, and restrict queries with a **maximum complexity**. The idea is to express the complexity of each field as a number. A common default is to give each field a complexity of `1`. You can also customize how the complexity of a GraphQL query is calculated with complexity estimators. A complexity estimator is a function that calculates the complexity of a field. You can add any number of estimators to the rule, and they run one after another. The first estimator that returns a numeric value determines the complexity of that field.
blocks.text: Query complexity lets you define how complex certain fields are, and restrict queries with a maximum complexity. The idea is to express the complexity of each field as a number. A common default is to give each field a complexity of 1. You can also customize how the complexity of a GraphQL query is calculated with complexity estimators. A complexity estimator is a function that calculates the complexity of a field. You can add any number of estimators to the rule, and they run one after another. The first estimator that returns a numeric value determines the complexity of that field.
blocks.zh: 查询复杂度允许您定义某些字段的复杂度，并以**最大复杂度**限制查询。这个想法是将每个字段的复杂性表示为一个数字。常见的默认值是给每个字段赋予 `1` 的复杂度。您还可以自定义如何使用复杂性估计器计算 GraphQL 查询的复杂性。复杂度估计器是计算字段复杂度的函数。您可以向规则中添加任意数量的估计量，它们会一个接一个地运行。返回数值的第一估计器确定该字段的复杂度。

blocks.md: The `@nestjs/graphql` package integrates with tools like [graphql-query-complexity](https://github.com/slicknode/graphql-query-complexity), which provides a solution based on cost analysis. With this library, you can reject queries that are too costly to execute.
blocks.text: The @nestjs/graphql package integrates with tools like graphql-query-complexity, which provides a solution based on cost analysis. With this library, you can reject queries that are too costly to execute.
blocks.zh: 这个 `@nestjs/graphql` 软件包与以下工具集成：[graphql-query-complexity](https://github.com/slicknode/graphql-query-complexity)，提供了基于成本分析的解决方案。有了这个库，您可以拒绝执行成本太高的查询。

blocks.md: Extensions are an **advanced, low-level feature** that lets you define arbitrary data in the types configuration. Attaching custom metadata to certain fields allows you to build more sophisticated, generic solutions. For example, with extensions, you can define the roles required to access particular fields. Your code can read these roles at runtime to determine whether the caller has sufficient permissions to retrieve a specific field.

chapters.title: CLI Plugin
chapters.summary: TypeScript's metadata reflection system has several limitations that make it impossible to, for instance, determine which properties a class consists of, or whether a given property is optional or required.

blocks.title: Warning
blocks.md: This chapter applies only to the code first approach.
blocks.text: This chapter applies only to the code first approach.
blocks.zh: 本章仅适用于代码优先的方法。

blocks.md: TypeScript's metadata reflection system has several limitations that make it impossible to, for instance, determine which properties a class consists of, or whether a given property is optional or required. However, some of these constraints can be addressed at compile time. Nest provides a plugin that enhances the TypeScript compilation process to reduce the amount of boilerplate code required.
blocks.text: TypeScript's metadata reflection system has several limitations that make it impossible to, for instance, determine which properties a class consists of, or whether a given property is optional or required. However, some of these constraints can be addressed at compile time. Nest provides a plugin that enhances the TypeScript compilation process to reduce the amount of boilerplate code required.
blocks.zh: TypeScript 的元数据反射系统有几个限制，例如，无法确定一个类由哪些属性组成，也无法确定给定的属性是可选的还是必需的。但是，这些约束中的一些可以在编译时解决。Nest 提供一个插件来增强 TypeScript 编译过程，以减少所需的样板代码量。

chapters.title: Other features
chapters.summary: In the GraphQL world, there is a lot of debate about handling concerns like authentication or the side effects of operations.

blocks.md: In the GraphQL world, there is a lot of debate about handling concerns like **authentication** or the **side effects** of operations. Some handle them inside the business logic, some use higher-order functions to enhance queries and mutations with authorization logic, and others use [schema directives](https://www.apollographql.com/docs/apollo-server/schema/directives/). There is no one-size-fits-all answer.
blocks.text: In the GraphQL world, there is a lot of debate about handling concerns like authentication or the side effects of operations. Some handle them inside the business logic, some use higher-order functions to enhance queries and mutations with authorization logic, and others use schema directives. chapters.title: Federation
chapters.summary: Federation lets you split a monolithic GraphQL server into independent microservices.

blocks.md: Federation lets you split a monolithic GraphQL server into independent microservices. It consists of two components: a gateway and one or more federated microservices. Each microservice holds part of the schema, and the gateway merges the schemas into a single schema that clients consume.
blocks.text: Federation lets you split a monolithic GraphQL server into independent microservices. It consists of two components: a gateway and one or more federated microservices. Each microservice holds part of the schema, and the gateway merges the schemas into a single schema that clients consume.
blocks.zh: 联邦可以让你拆分一个整体 GraphQL 服务器转换为独立的微服务。它由两个组件组成：网关和一个或多个联合微服务。每个微服务都持有模式的一部分，网关将模式合并到客户端使用的单个模式中。

blocks.md: As described in [Apollo's introduction to federation](https://blog.apollographql.com/apollo-federation-f260cf525d21), federation is designed around these core principles:
blocks.text: As described in Apollo's introduction to federation, federation is designed around these core principles:
blocks.zh: 如中所述 [Apollo's introduction to federation](https://blog.apollographql.com/apollo-federation-f260cf525d21) 联邦是围绕以下核心原则设计的：

blocks.md:
- Building a graph should be **declarative.** With federation, you compose a graph declaratively from within your schema instead of writing imperative schema stitching code.
- Code should be separated by **concern**, not by types. Often no single team controls every aspect of an important type like a User or Product, so the definition of these types should be distributed across teams and codebases, rather than centralized.
- The graph should be simple for clients to consume. Together, federated services can form a complete, product-focused graph that accurately reflects how it's being consumed on the client.
- It's just **GraphQL**, using only spec-compliant features of the language. Any language, not just JavaScript, can implement federation.
blocks.text: Building a graph should be declarative. With federation, you compose a graph declaratively from within your schema instead of writing imperative schema stitching code. Code should be separated by concern, not by types. Often no single team controls every aspect of an important type like a User or Product, so the definition of these types should be distributed across teams and codebases, rather than centralized. The graph should be simple for clients to consume. Together, federated services can form a complete, product-focused graph that accurately reflects how it's being consumed on the client. It's just GraphQL, using only spec-compliant features of the language. Any language, not just JavaScript, can implement federation.
blocks.zh:
- 构建一个图应该是**声明性的。**使用 federation，您可以在模式中声明性地组成一个图，而不是编写命令式的模式拼接代码。
- 代码应该用**关注**分隔，而不是按类型分隔。通常没有一个团队控制像用户或产品这样的重要类型的每个方面，因此这些类型的定义应该分布在团队和代码库之间，而不是集中的。
- 图表应该很容易让客户消费。联合服务可以一起形成一个完整的、以产品为中心的图表，准确地反映客户端如何使用它。
- 只是**GraphQL**，仅使用符合规范的语言特性。任何语言，不只是 JavaScript，可以实现联邦。

chapters.title: Gateways
chapters.summary: Most of the concepts discussed elsewhere in this documentation, such as dependency injection, decorators, exception filters, pipes, guards, and interceptors, apply equally to gateways.

blocks.md: Most of the concepts discussed elsewhere in this documentation, such as dependency injection, decorators, exception filters, pipes, guards, and interceptors, apply equally to gateways. Wherever possible, Nest abstracts implementation details so that the same components can run across HTTP-based platforms, WebSockets, and microservices. This section covers the aspects of Nest that are specific to WebSockets.
blocks.text: Most of the concepts discussed elsewhere in this documentation, such as dependency injection, decorators, exception filters, pipes, guards, and interceptors, apply equally to gateways. Wherever possible, Nest abstracts implementation details so that the same components can run across HTTP-based platforms, WebSockets, and microservices. This section covers the aspects of Nest that are specific to WebSockets.
blocks.zh: 本文档其他地方讨论的大多数概念，如依赖注入、装饰器、异常过滤器、管道、防护和拦截器，同样适用于网关。只要有可能，Nest 抽象实现细节，以便相同的组件可以跨 HTTP-基于平台、WebSockets 和微服务。本节涵盖 Nest 特定于 WebSockets。

blocks.md: In Nest, a gateway is a class annotated with the `@WebSocketGateway()` decorator. Gateways are platform-agnostic, so they work with any WebSockets library once an adapter exists for it. Nest supports two WebSocket platforms out of the box: [socket.io](https://github.com/socketio/socket.io) and [ws](https://github.com/websockets/ws). Choose the one that best suits your needs. You can also build your own adapter by following the [adapters guide](/websockets/adapter).
blocks.text: In Nest, a gateway is a class annotated with the @WebSocketGateway() decorator. Gateways are platform-agnostic, so they work with any WebSockets library once an adapter exists for it. Nest supports two WebSocket platforms out of the box: socket.io and ws. Choose the one that best suits your needs. You can also build your own adapter by following the adapters guide.
blocks.zh: 在 Nest 中，网关是用 `@WebSocketGateway()` 装饰器注释的类。网关与平台无关，因此一旦存在适配器，它们就可以与任何 WebSockets 库配合使用。Nest 开箱即用支持两个 WebSocket 平台：[socket.io](https://github.com/socketio/socket.io) 和 [ws](https://github.com/websockets/ws)。选择最适合你需求的。您也可以按照 [适配器指南](/websockets/adapter) 构建自己的适配器。

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md: Gateways are [providers](/providers): they can inject dependencies through the class constructor, and other classes (providers and controllers) can inject them.
blocks.text: Gateways are providers: they can inject dependencies through the class constructor, and other classes (providers and controllers) can inject them.
blocks.zh: 网关是 [供应商](/providers)：它们可以通过类构造函数注入依赖项，其他类（提供程序和控制器）也可以注入它们。

blocks.md: Overview
blocks.text: Overview
blocks.zh: 概述

blocks.md: By default, each gateway listens on the same port as the **HTTP server**. To use a different port, pass it as the first argument to the decorator, e.g., `@WebSocketGateway(80)`, where `80` is the chosen port number. You can also set the [namespace](https://socket.io/docs/v4/namespaces/) used by the gateway:
blocks.text: By default, each gateway listens on the same port as the HTTP server. To use a different port, pass it as the first argument to the decorator, e.g., @WebSocketGateway(80), where 80 is the chosen port number. You can also set the namespace used by the gateway:
blocks.zh: 默认情况下，每个网关在与**相同的端口上侦听 HTTP 服务器**。若要使用不同的端口，请将其作为第一个参数传递给装饰器，例如，`@WebSocketGateway(80)`，其中 `80` 是选定的端口号。您还可以设置 [命名空间](https://socket.io/docs/v4/namespaces/) 网关使用：

blocks.code: @WebSocketGateway(80, { namespace: 'events' })

blocks.title: Warning
blocks.md: Gateways are not instantiated until they are referenced in the providers array of an existing module.
blocks.text: Gateways are not instantiated until they are referenced in the providers array of an existing module.
blocks.zh: 在现有模块的提供程序数组中引用网关之前，网关不会被实例化。

blocks.md: The second argument of the `@WebSocketGateway()` decorator passes any supported [server option](https://socket.io/docs/v4/server-options/) to the socket server constructor. If you don't need a custom port, pass the options object as the only argument.
blocks.text: The second argument of the @WebSocketGateway() decorator passes any supported server option to the socket server constructor. If you don't need a custom port, pass the options object as the only argument.
blocks.zh: 第二个论点 `@WebSocketGateway()` 装饰器通过任何受支持的 [服务器选项](https://socket.io/docs/v4/server-options/) 到套接字服务器构造函数。如果您不需要自定义端口，请将 options 对象作为唯一的参数传递。

blocks.code: @WebSocketGateway(81, { transports: ['websocket'] })

blocks.md: The `@Ack()` parameter decorator injects the `ack` callback function directly into a message handler. When you use it, Nest doesn't send an acknowledgment based on the return value, so you must call `ack()` yourself. Without the decorator, the callback is passed as the third argument of the method.
blocks.text: The @Ack() parameter decorator injects the ack callback function directly into a message handler. When you use it, Nest doesn't send an acknowledgment based on the return value, so you must call ack() yourself. Without the decorator, the callback is passed as the third argument of the method.
blocks.zh: 这个 `@Ack()` 参数装饰器注入 `ack` 将函数直接回调到消息处理程序中。当你使用它的时候，Nest 不根据返回值发送确认，因此必须调用 `ack()` 你自己。如果没有 decorator，回调将作为方法的第三个参数传递。
