blocks.md: Global compiler options
blocks.text: Global compiler options
blocks.zh: 全局编译器选项

blocks.md: These properties specify the compiler to use, as well as options that affect **any** compilation step, whether it runs as part of `nest build` or `nest start`, and whichever compiler you use (`tsc`, `swc`, or Rspack).
blocks.text: These properties specify the compiler to use, as well as options that affect any compilation step, whether it runs as part of nest build or nest start, and whichever compiler you use (tsc, swc, or Rspack).
blocks.zh: 这些属性指定要使用的编译器，以及影响**任何**编译步骤的选项，无论它是作为 `nest build` 或者 `nest start`，以及您使用的编译器（`tsc`,`swc`，或 Rspack）。

blocks.md:
| Property Name       | Property Value Type | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ------------------- | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `webpack`           | boolean             | Deprecated legacy flag for webpack-based compilation. Use `builder` instead. |
| `tsConfigPath`      | string              | (**monorepo only**) Points at the file containing the `tsconfig.json` settings that will be used when `nest build` or `nest start` is called without a `project` option (e.g., when the default project is built or started).                                             |
| `webpackConfigPath` | string              | Deprecated legacy path for webpack options. Use `builder.options.configPath` instead.                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `deleteOutDir`      | boolean             | If `true`, the compiler first removes the compilation output directory (as configured in `tsconfig.json`; the default is `./dist`) every time it is invoked.                                                                                                              |
| `assets`            | array               | Enables automatic distribution of non-TypeScript assets whenever a compilation step begins (assets are **not** distributed on incremental compiles in `--watch` mode). See below for details.                                                                              |
| `watchAssets`       | boolean             | If `true`, runs in watch mode, watching **all** non-TypeScript assets. (For finer-grained control over which assets to watch, see the [Assets](/cli/monorepo#assets) section below.)                                                                                    |
| `manualRestart`     | boolean             | If `true`, enables the `rs` shortcut to restart the server manually. Defaults to `false`.                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `builder`           | string/object       | The builder the CLI uses to compile the project (`tsc`, `swc`, or `rspack`). To customize the builder's behavior, pass an object with two attributes: `type` (`tsc`, `swc`, or `rspack`) and `options`.                                                                  |
| `typeCheck`         | boolean             | If `true`, enables type checking for SWC-driven projects (when `builder` is `swc`). Defaults to `false`.                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `emitDeclarations`  | boolean             | If `true`, emits declaration files (`.d.ts`) when using the SWC builder. Defaults to `false`.                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `includeLibraryAssets` | array            | (**monorepo only**) List of library project names whose assets should also be copied when building this application.                                                                                                                                                      |
blocks.zh:
| 属性名称 | 属性值类型 | 描述 |
| ------------------- | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `webpack` | 布尔 | 基于 webpack 的编译已弃用的遗留标志。使用 `builder` 反而。 |
| `tsConfigPath` | 细绳 | （**仅限 monorepo**）指向包含 `tsconfig.json` 将在以下情况下使用的设置 `nest build` 或者 `nest start` 被称为没有 `project` 选项（例如，在构建或启动默认项目时）。 |
| `webpackConfigPath` | 细绳 | 已弃用 webpack 选项的旧有路径。使用 `builder.options.configPath` 反而。 |
| `deleteOutDir` | 布尔 | 如果 `true` 中，编译器首先删除编译输出目录（如中配置的 `tsconfig.json`；默认值是 `./dist`) 每次调用时。 |
| `assets` | 阵列 | 启用自动分发非 TypeScript 每当编译步骤开始时，资产（资产**不**分布在增量编译上 `--watch` 模式）。详情请见下文。 |
| `watchAssets` | 布尔 | 如果 `true`，在观看模式下运行，观看**全部**非-TypeScript 资产。（要更精细地控制要监视哪些资产，请参见 [Assets](/cli/monorepo#assets) 下面的部分。） |
| `manualRestart` | 布尔 | 如果 `true`，则启用 `rs` 快捷方式手动重新启动服务器。默认值为 `false`。 |
| `builder` | 字符串/对象 | CLI 用于编译项目的生成器（`tsc`、`swc` 或 `rspack`）。要自定义生成器的行为，请传递一个具有两个属性的对象：`type`（`tsc`、`swc` 或 `rspack`）和 `options`。 |
| `typeCheck` | 布尔 | 如果为 `true`，则为 SWC 驱动的项目启用类型检查（当 `builder` 为 `swc` 时）。默认值为 `false`。 |
| `emitDeclarations` | 布尔 | 如果 `true`，则在使用 SWC 生成器时发出声明文件（`.d.ts`）。默认值为 `false`。 |
| `includeLibraryAssets` | 阵列 | （**仅限 monorepo**）构建此应用程序时还应复制其资产的库项目名称列表。 |

blocks.md:
TypeScript compilation automatically distributes compiler output (`.js` and `.d.ts` files) to the specified output directory. It can also be convenient to distribute non-TypeScript files, such as `.graphql` files, images, `.html` files, and other assets. This lets you treat `nest build` (and any initial compilation step) as a lightweight **development build** step, in which you edit non-TypeScript files and compile and test iteratively.
Assets must be located in the `src` folder; otherwise, they are not copied.

chapters.title: Libraries
chapters.summary: Many applications need to solve the same general problems, or reuse a modular component in several contexts.

blocks.md: Many applications need to solve the same general problems, or reuse a modular component in several contexts. Nest offers a few ways to address this. Each works at a different level and helps meet different architectural and organizational objectives.
blocks.text: Many applications need to solve the same general problems, or reuse a modular component in several contexts. Nest offers a few ways to address this. Each works at a different level and helps meet different architectural and organizational objectives.
blocks.zh: 许多应用程序需要解决相同的一般问题，或者在几个上下文中重用模块化组件。Nest 提供了一些解决这个问题的方法。每个都在不同的层次上工作，并有助于满足不同的架构和组织目标。

blocks.md: Nest [modules](/modules) provide an execution context that lets components be shared within a single application. You can also package modules with [npm](https://npmjs.com) to create a reusable library that different projects can install. This is an effective way to distribute configurable, reusable libraries to loosely connected or unaffiliated organizations (e.g., by distributing and installing third-party libraries).
blocks.text: Nest modules provide an execution context that lets components be shared within a single application. You can also package modules with npm to create a reusable library that different projects can install. This is an effective way to distribute configurable, reusable libraries to loosely connected or unaffiliated organizations (e.g., by distributing and installing third-party libraries).
blocks.zh: Nest[模块](/modules) 提供一个执行上下文，允许在单个应用程序中共享组件。您还可以使用 [npm](https://npmjs.com) 创建不同项目可以安装的可重用库。这是将可配置的、可重用的库分发给松散连接的组织或无关组织的有效方式（例如，通过分发和安装第三方库）。

blocks.md: For sharing code within closely organized groups (e.g., within company or project boundaries), a more lightweight approach can be useful. Monorepos emerged to enable that, and within a monorepo, a **library** provides a lightweight way to share code. In a Nest monorepo, libraries make it straightforward to assemble applications that share components. This also encourages you to decompose monolithic applications, and to focus development on building and composing modular components.
blocks.text: For sharing code within closely organized groups (e.g., within company or project boundaries), a more lightweight approach can be useful. This also encourages you to decompose monolithic applications, and to focus development on building and composing modular components.
blocks.zh: 对于在组织紧密的组内（例如，在公司或项目边界内）共享代码，更轻量级的方法可能会很有用。Monorepos 的出现就是为了实现这一点，在 monorepo 中，**库**提供了一种轻量级的代码共享方式。在一个 Nestmonorepo，库使得组装共享组件的应用程序变得简单。这也鼓励您分解单片应用程序，并将开发重点放在构建和组成模块化组件上。

blocks.md: Nest libraries
blocks.text: Nest libraries
blocks.zh: Nest 文库

blocks.md: A Nest library is a Nest project that, unlike an application, cannot run on its own. A library must be imported into a containing application for its code to execute. The built-in support for libraries described in this section is only available for **monorepos** (standard mode projects can achieve similar functionality using npm packages).
blocks.text: A Nest library is a Nest project that, unlike an application, cannot run on its own. A library must be imported into a containing application for its code to execute. The built-in support for libraries described in this section is only available for monorepos (standard mode projects can achieve similar functionality using npm packages).
blocks.zh: 一个 Nest 图书馆是 Nest 与应用程序不同，不能自行运行的项目。库必须导入到包含应用程序中，才能执行其代码。本节中描述的对库的内置支持仅适用于**monorepos**（标准模式项目可以使用 npm 包实现类似的功能）。

blocks.md: For example, an organization may develop an `AuthModule` that manages authentication by implementing the company policies that govern all internal applications. Rather than building that module separately for each application, or packaging the code with npm and requiring each project to install it, a monorepo can define the module as a library. Organized this way, all consumers of the library module see an up-to-date version of `AuthModule` as soon as it is committed. This can significantly help coordinate component development and assembly, and it simplifies end-to-end testing.

This can significantly help coordinate component development and assembly, and it simplifies end-to-end testing.
blocks.zh: 例如，一个组织可以开发一个 `AuthModule` 它通过实施管理所有内部应用程序的公司策略来管理身份验证。monorepo 可以将模块定义为一个库，而不是为每个应用程序单独构建该模块，或者用 npm 打包代码并要求每个项目安装它。通过这种方式组织，库模块的所有使用者都会看到一个最新版本的 `AuthModule` 一旦提交。这可以极大地帮助协调组件开发和组装，并简化端到端测试。

blocks.md: Creating libraries
blocks.text: Creating libraries
blocks.zh: 创建库

blocks.md: Any functionality that is suitable for reuse is a candidate for a library. Deciding what should be a library, and what should be part of an application, is an architectural design decision. Creating a library involves more than copying code from an existing application into it: library code must be decoupled from the application. This may take **more** time up front and force design decisions that you wouldn't face with more tightly coupled code. The effort pays off when the library lets you assemble multiple applications more quickly.

This may take more time up front and force design decisions that you wouldn't face with more tightly coupled code. The effort pays off when the library lets you assemble multiple applications more quickly.

blocks.text: nest upgrade
blocks.zh: 嵌套升级

blocks.md: Upgrades an existing project to the latest NestJS major version.
blocks.text: Upgrades an existing project to the latest NestJS major version.

blocks.code:
$ nest upgrade [options]
$ nest update [options]

blocks.md: Description
blocks.text: Description
blocks.zh: 描述

blocks.md: Run from the root of a NestJS v11 project, `nest upgrade` updates your dependencies to v12 and applies the mechanical parts of the migration:
blocks.text: Run from the root of a NestJS v11 project, nest upgrade updates your dependencies to v12 and applies the mechanical parts of the migration:
blocks.zh: 从 a 的根运行 NestJSv11 项目，`nest upgrade` 将依赖项更新到 v12 并应用迁移的机械部分：

blocks.md:
- Refuses to run on Node.js releases that lack `require(esm)` (anything older than v20.19, or v22.x older than v22.12)
- Bumps every recognized `@nestjs/*` package to its v12-compatible major (`@nestjs/graphql`, `@nestjs/apollo`, and `@nestjs/mercurius` go to v14), and reports any other `@nestjs/*` package it doesn't recognize so you can review it yourself
- Bumps TypeScript to v6 (required by the v12 CLI and schematics), and raises `engines.node` in `package.json` to `>=20.19.0` if it declares a lower floor
- Migrates `nest-cli.json` off the deprecated `webpack` / `webpackConfigPath` options and onto `--builder rspack`, updating matching `package.json` scripts
- Renames the GraphQL `playground` option to `graphiql`, switches subscriptions from `subscriptions-transport-ws` to `graphql-ws`, and swaps the packages accordingly
- Replaces the legacy `nats` package with `@nats-io/transport-node` / `@nats-io/nats-core` and rewrites `nats` imports
- Moves library-specific `@nestjs/config` settings under `validationOptions.libraryOptions` and bumps Joi to v18 (the first release implementing Standard Schema)
- Bumps Jest to v30 (and `@types/jest` / `ts-jest` to matching releases) where present, and warns that Jest can `require()` the ESM-only v12 packages only on Node.js v24.9+
- Optionally installs and wires up [`@nestjs/observe`](/observability/overview). It prompts, unless you pass `--observe` or `--no-observe`
- Checks `tsconfig.json` and `tsconfig.build.json` for settings that TypeScript 6 or the ESM-only packages no longer support, such as a legacy `moduleResolution` or a missing `rootDir`
- Scans your sources and prints notes about behavior that changed but can't be migrated automatically, such as lifecycle hook ordering, refined pipe signatures, and structured logging params
blocks.text: Refuses to run on Node.js releases that lack require(esm) (anything older than v20.19, or v22.x older than v22.12) Bumps every recognized @nestjs/* package to its v12-compatible major (@nestjs/graphql, @nestjs/apollo, and @nestjs/mercurius go to v14), and reports any other @nestjs/* package it doesn't recognize so you can review it yourself Bumps TypeScript to v6 (required by the v12 CLI and schematics), and raises engines.node in package.json to >=20.19.0 if it declares a lower floor Migrates nest-cli.json off the deprecated webpack / webpackConfigPath options and onto --builder rspack, updating matching package.json scripts Renames the GraphQL playground option to graphiql, switches subscriptions from subscriptions-transport-ws to graphql-ws, and swaps the packages accordingly Replaces the legacy nats package with @nats-io/transport-node / @nats-io/nats-core and rewrites nats imports Moves library-specific @nestjs/config settings under validationOptions.libraryOptions and bumps Joi to v18 (the first release implementing Standard Schema) Bumps Jest to v30 (and @types/jest / ts-jest to matching releases) where present, and warns that Jest can require() the ESM-only v12 packages only on Node.js v24.9+ Optionally installs and wires up @nestjs/observe. It prompts, unless you pass --observe or --no-observe Checks tsconfig.json and tsconfig.build.json for settings that TypeScript 6 or the ESM-only packages no longer support, such as a legacy moduleResolution or a missing rootDir Scans your sources and prints notes about behavior that changed but can't be migrated automatically, such as lifecycle hook ordering, refined pipe signatures, and structured logging params
blocks.zh:
- 拒绝运行 Node.js 缺少的释放 `require(esm)`（任何早于 v20.19 或 v22.x 早于 v22.12）
- 每个识别的凸起 `@nestjs/*` 打包到其与 v12 兼容的主要发动机（`@nestjs/graphql`,`@nestjs/apollo`，和 `@nestjs/mercurius` 转到 v14），并报告任何其他 `@nestjs/*` 它无法识别的包，因此您可以自行查看
- 凸起 TypeScript 到 v6（v12 要求 CLI 和示意图），并提出 `engines.node` 在 `package.json` 二 `>=20.19.0` 如果它声明楼层较低
- 迁移 `nest-cli.json` 脱离陈旧的 `webpack`/`webpackConfigPath` 选项和 onto`--builder rspack`，更新匹配 `package.json` 脚本
- 重命名 GraphQL`playground` 选项 `graphiql`，将订阅从 `subscriptions-transport-ws` 二 `graphql-ws`，并相应地交换包
- 替换遗留 `nats` 包装 `@nats-io/transport-node`/`@nats-io/nats-core` 并重写 `nats` 进口
- 移动特定于库 `@nestjs/config` 下的设置 `validationOptions.libraryOptions` 并将 Joi 提升到 v18（实现标准模式的第一个版本）
- 凸起 Jest 到 v30（和 `@types/jest`/`ts-jest` 匹配版本）如果存在，并警告 Jest 可以 `require()` 这个 ESM-仅 v12 软件包 Node.jsv24.9+
- 可选地安装并连接 [`@nestjs/observe`](/observability/overview)。它会提示，除非您传递 `--observe` 或 `--no-observe`
- 支票 `tsconfig.json` 和 `tsconfig.build.json` 对于设置 TypeScript6 或 ESM-仅不再支持的包，如旧版 `moduleResolution` 或者失踪 `rootDir`
- 扫描源并打印有关已更改但无法自动迁移的行为的注释，例如生命周期挂钩排序、细化管道签名和结构化日志记录参数

chapters.title: Scripts
chapters.summary: This section explains how the nest command interacts with compilers and scripts, to help DevOps personnel manage the development environment.

blocks.md: This section explains how the `nest` command interacts with compilers and scripts, to help DevOps personnel manage the development environment.
blocks.text: This section explains how the nest command interacts with compilers and scripts, to help DevOps personnel manage the development environment.
blocks.zh: 本节解释如何 `nest` 命令与编译器和脚本交互，以帮助 DevOps 人员管理开发环境。

blocks.md: A Nest application is a **standard** TypeScript application that must be compiled to JavaScript before it can run. There are various ways to handle the compilation step, and developers and teams are free to choose the one that works best for them. With that in mind, Nest provides a set of tools out of the box that aim to:
blocks.text: A Nest application is a standard TypeScript application that must be compiled to JavaScript before it can run. There are various ways to handle the compilation step, and developers and teams are free to choose the one that works best for them. With that in mind, Nest provides a set of tools out of the box that aim to:
blocks.zh: 一个 Nest 应用是**标准**TypeScript 必须编译成 JavaScript 在它运行之前。有多种方法可以处理编译步骤，开发人员和团队可以自由选择最适合他们的方法。考虑到这一点，Nest 提供一套开箱即用的工具，旨在：

blocks.md:
- Provide a standard build/execute process, available at the command line, that works with reasonable defaults.
- Keep the build/execute process **open**, so developers can access the underlying tools directly and customize them using their native features and options.
- Remain a completely standard TypeScript/Node.js framework, so that any external tools the team chooses can manage the entire compile/deploy/execute pipeline.
blocks.text: Provide a standard build/execute process, available at the command line, that works with reasonable defaults. Keep the build/execute process open, so developers can access the underlying tools directly and customize them using their native features and options. Remain a completely standard TypeScript/Node.js framework, so that any external tools the team chooses can manage the entire compile/deploy/execute pipeline.
blocks.zh:
- 提供一个标准的构建/执行过程，可在命令行上使用，该过程使用合理的默认值。
- 保持构建/执行过程**开放**，以便开发人员可以直接访问底层工具，并使用其原生特性和选项对其进行定制。
- 保持完全标准 TypeScript/Node.js 框架，以便团队选择的任何外部工具都可以管理整个编译/部署/执行管道。

blocks.md: Nest achieves this through a combination of the `nest` command, a locally installed TypeScript compiler, and `package.json` scripts. The sections below describe how these pieces work together, what happens at each step of the build/execute process, and how to customize that behavior.
blocks.text: Nest achieves this through a combination of the nest command, a locally installed TypeScript compiler, and package.json scripts. The sections below describe how these pieces work together, what happens at each step of the build/execute process, and how to customize that behavior.
blocks.zh: Nest 通过结合 `nest` 命令，本地安装 TypeScript 编译器，以及 `package.json` 脚本。下面的部分描述了这些部分如何协同工作，在构建/执行过程的每一步会发生什么，以及如何定制该行为。

blocks.md: The nest binary
blocks.text: The nest binary
blocks.zh: 嵌套二进制

blocks.md: The `nest` command is an OS-level binary (i.e., it runs from the OS command line). It covers three distinct areas, described below. We recommend running the build (`nest build`) and execution (`nest start`) subcommands through the `package.json` scripts that are generated when you scaffold a project (see the [typescript starter](https://github.com/nestjs/typescript-starter) if you prefer to start by cloning a repository instead of running `nest new`).
blocks.text: The nest command is an OS-level binary (i.e., it runs from the OS command line). It covers three distinct areas, described below. We recommend running the build (nest build) and execution (nest start) subcommands through the package.json scripts that are generated when you scaffold a project (see the typescript starter if you prefer to start by cloning a repository instead of running nest new).
blocks.zh: `nest` 命令是一个 OS 级二进制文件（即，它从 OS 命令行运行）。它涵盖三个不同的领域，如下所述。我们建议通过构建项目时生成的 `package.json` 脚本运行构建(`nest build`) 和执行(`nest start`) 子命令（如果您喜欢从克隆存储库开始而不是运行 `nest new`，请参见 [typescript 启动器](https://github.com/nestjs/typescript-starter)）。

blocks.md: Build
blocks.text: Build
blocks.zh: 建立

blocks.md: `nest build` is a wrapper around the standard `tsc` or `swc` compiler (for [standard projects](/cli/overview#project-structure)) or the Rspack bundler (for [monorepos](/cli/overview#project-structure)). Apart from handling `tsconfig-paths` and running any enabled CLI plugins, it adds no compilation features or steps of its own. It exists because most developers, especially when starting out with Nest, don't need to adjust compiler options (e.g., in the `tsconfig.json` file), which can be tricky.
blocks.text: nest build is a wrapper around the standard tsc or swc compiler (for standard projects) or the Rspack bundler (for monorepos). Apart from handling tsconfig-paths and running any enabled CLI plugins, it adds no compilation features or steps of its own. It exists because most developers, especially when starting out with Nest, don't need to adjust compiler options (e.g., in the tsconfig.json file), which can be tricky.
blocks.zh: `nest build` 是标准的包装 `tsc` 或者 `swc` 编译器（用于 [标准项目](/cli/overview#project-structure)）或 Rspack 捆绑器（用于 [单一存储](/cli/overview#project-structure)).除了处理 `tsconfig-paths` 并运行任何启用的 CLI 插件，它没有添加自己的编译特性或步骤。它的存在是因为大多数开发人员，尤其是在刚开始使用 Nest，不需要调整编译器选项（例如，在 `tsconfig.json` 文件），这可能很棘手。

blocks.md: See the [nest build](/cli/usages#nest-build) documentation for more details.
blocks.text: See the nest build documentation for more details.
blocks.zh: 参见 [筑巢](/cli/usages#nest-build) 更多详细信息的文档。

blocks.md: Execution
blocks.text: Execution
blocks.zh: 执行

blocks.md: `nest start` ensures the project has been built (same as `nest build`), then invokes the `node` command in a portable way to execute the compiled application. As with builds, you can customize this process through the `nest start` command and its options, or replace it entirely. The whole process is a standard TypeScript build and execute pipeline, and you can manage it as such.
blocks.text: nest start ensures the project has been built (same as nest build), then invokes the node command in a portable way to execute the compiled application. As with builds, you can customize this process through the nest start command and its options, or replace it entirely. The whole process is a standard TypeScript build and execute pipeline, and you can manage it as such.
blocks.zh: `nest start` 确保项目已构建（与 `nest build`），然后调用 `node` 以可移植方式执行编译后的应用程序的命令。与构建一样，您可以通过 `nest start` 命令及其选项，或完全替换它。整个过程是一个标准 TypeScript 构建和执行管道，您可以对其进行管理。

blocks.md: See the [nest start](/cli/usages#nest-start) documentation for more details.
blocks.text: See the nest start documentation for more details.
blocks.zh: 参见 [巢穴开始](/cli/usages#nest-start) 更多详细信息的文档。

blocks.md: Generation
blocks.text: Generation
blocks.zh: 代

blocks.md: The `nest generate` commands generate new components, or new applications and libraries within a workspace. (To create a new project, use `nest new`.)
blocks.text: The nest generate commands generate new components, or new applications and libraries within a workspace. (To create a new project, use nest new.)
blocks.zh: `nest generate` 命令在工作区中生成新组件或新应用程序和库。（要创建新项目，请使用 `nest new`。）

blocks.md: Package scripts
blocks.text: Package scripts
blocks.zh: 包脚本

blocks.md: Running `nest` commands at the OS command level requires the `nest` binary to be installed globally. This is a standard npm feature, outside Nest's direct control. One consequence is that the globally installed `nest` binary is **not** managed as a project dependency in `package.json`, so two developers can run two different versions of it. The standard solution is to use package scripts, so that you can treat the tools used in the build and execute steps as development dependencies.
blocks.text: Running nest commands at the OS command level requires the nest binary to be installed globally. This is a standard npm feature, outside Nest's direct control. One consequence is that the globally installed nest binary is not managed as a project dependency in package.json, so two developers can run two different versions of it. The standard solution is to use package scripts, so that you can treat the tools used in the build and execute steps as development dependencies.
blocks.zh: 跑步 `nest` 命令 OS 命令级别要求 `nest` 将在全球范围内安装二进制文件。这是一个标准的 npm 功能，外部 Nest 的直接控制。一个后果是全球安装的 `nest` 二进制文件**不**作为项目依赖项进行管理 `package.json` 因此，两个开发人员可以运行两个不同的版本。标准的解决方案是使用包脚本，这样您就可以将构建和执行步骤中使用的工具视为开发依赖项。

blocks.md: When you run `nest new`, or clone the [typescript starter](https://github.com/nestjs/typescript-starter), Nest populates the new project's `package.json` scripts with commands such as `build` and `start`. It also installs the underlying compiler tools (such as `typescript`) as **dev dependencies**.
blocks.text: When you run nest new, or clone the typescript starter, Nest populates the new project's package.json scripts with commands such as build and start. It also installs the underlying compiler tools (such as typescript) as dev dependencies.
blocks.zh: 运行 `nest new` 或克隆 [typescript 启动器](https://github.com/nestjs/typescript-starter) 时，Nest 会使用 `build` 和 `start` 等命令填充新项目的 `package.json` 脚本。它还将底层编译器工具（如 `typescript`）安装为**dev 依赖项**。

blocks.md: You run the build and execute scripts with commands such as:
blocks.text: You run the build and execute scripts with commands such as:
blocks.zh: 您可以使用以下命令运行构建和执行脚本：

blocks.code: $ npm run build

blocks.md: and
blocks.text: and
blocks.zh: 和

blocks.code: $ npm run start

blocks.md: These commands use npm's script runner to execute `nest build` or `nest start` with the **locally installed** `nest` binary. By using these built-in package scripts, you get full dependency management over the Nest CLI commands\*. By following this **recommended** usage, all members of your organization run the same version of the commands.
blocks.text: These commands use npm's script runner to execute nest build or nest start with the locally installed nest binary. By using these built-in package scripts, you get full dependency management over the Nest CLI commands\*. By following this recommended usage, all members of your organization run the same version of the commands.
blocks.zh: 这些命令使用 npm 的脚本运行程序来执行 `nest build` 或者 `nest start` 使用**本地安装**`nest` 二进制。通过使用这些内置的包脚本，您可以在 NestCLI 命令\*。通过遵循此**推荐**用法，组织中的所有成员都运行相同版本的命令。

blocks.md: \*This applies to the `build` and `start` commands. The `nest new` and `nest generate` commands aren't part of the build/execute pipeline, so they operate in a different context and don't come with built-in `package.json` scripts.
blocks.text: \*This applies to the build and start commands. The nest new and nest generate commands aren't part of the build/execute pipeline, so they operate in a different context and don't come with built-in package.json scripts.
blocks.zh: \*这适用于 `build` 和 `start` 命令。这个 `nest new` 和 `nest generate` 命令不是构建/执行管道的一部分，因此它们在不同的上下文中运行，并且没有内置的 `package.json` 脚本。

blocks.md: We recommend that most developers and teams use the package scripts to build and run their Nest projects. You can customize the behavior of these scripts through their options, and customize the `tsc`, `swc`, or Rspack configuration files (e.g., `tsconfig.json`) as needed. You are also free to run a completely custom build process to compile the TypeScript (or even to execute TypeScript directly with `ts-node`).
blocks.text: We recommend that most developers and teams use the package scripts to build and run their Nest projects. You can customize the behavior of these scripts through their options, and customize the tsc, swc, or Rspack configuration files (e.g., tsconfig.json) as needed. You are also free to run a completely custom build process to compile the TypeScript (or even to execute TypeScript directly with ts-node).
blocks.zh: 我们建议大多数开发人员和团队使用包脚本来构建和运行他们的 Nest 项目。您可以通过这些脚本的选项自定义这些脚本的行为，并根据需要自定义 `tsc`、`swc` 或 Rspack 配置文件（例如，`tsconfig.json`）。您还可以自由运行完全自定义的构建过程来编译 TypeScript（甚至直接使用 `ts-node` 执行 TypeScript）。

blocks.md: Backward compatibility
blocks.text: Backward compatibility
blocks.zh: 向后兼容性

blocks.md: Because Nest applications are pure TypeScript applications, previous versions of the Nest build/execute scripts continue to work. You are not required to upgrade them. You can adopt the `nest build` and `nest start` commands when you're ready, or keep running your previous or customized scripts.
blocks.text: Because Nest applications are pure TypeScript applications, previous versions of the Nest build/execute scripts continue to work. You are not required to upgrade them. You can adopt the nest build and nest start commands when you're ready, or keep running your previous or customized scripts.
blocks.zh: 因为 Nest 应用是纯粹的 TypeScript 应用程序，以前版本的 Nest 构建/执行脚本继续工作。您不需要升级它们。您可以采用 `nest build` 和 `nest start` 准备就绪时命令，或者继续运行以前的或自定义的脚本。

blocks.md: Migration

chapters.title: Introduction
chapters.summary: The OpenAPI specification is a language-agnostic definition format for describing RESTful APIs.

blocks.md: The [OpenAPI](https://swagger.io/specification/) specification is a language-agnostic definition format for describing RESTful APIs. Nest provides a dedicated [module](https://github.com/nestjs/swagger) that generates such a specification from decorators in your code.
blocks.text: The OpenAPI specification is a language-agnostic definition format for describing RESTful APIs. Nest provides a dedicated module that generates such a specification from decorators in your code.
blocks.zh: 这个 [OpenAPI](https://swagger.io/specification/) 规范是一种与语言无关的定义格式，用于描述 RESTful API。Nest 提供专用的 [模块](https://github.com/nestjs/swagger) 这就从代码中的装饰者那里生成了这样一个规范。

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md: Wrapping `SwaggerModule.createDocument()` in a factory function defers document generation until the document is first requested, which saves initialization time. The resulting document is a serializable object that conforms to the [OpenAPI Document](https://swagger.io/specification/#openapi-document) specification. Instead of serving it over HTTP, you can also save it as a JSON or YAML file and use it elsewhere.
blocks.text: Wrapping SwaggerModule.createDocument() in a factory function defers document generation until the document is first requested, which saves initialization time. The resulting document is a serializable object that conforms to the OpenAPI Document specification. Instead of serving it over HTTP, you can also save it as a JSON or YAML file and use it elsewhere.
blocks.zh: 包装 `SwaggerModule.createDocument()` 在工厂函数中，推迟文档生成，直到首次请求文档，这样可以节省初始化时间。生成的文档是符合 [OpenAPI Document](https://swagger.io/specification/#openapi-document) 规格。而不是把它端上来 HTTP，您也可以将其另存为 JSON 或者 YAML 归档并在其他地方使用。

blocks.title: Warning
blocks.md: If you call `createDocument()` eagerly (rather than in a factory function, as shown above), make sure `app.enableVersioning()` runs first. Otherwise, the generated `paths` are missing the version prefix. The factory pattern is unaffected, because the document isn't built until it is first requested.
blocks.text: If you call createDocument() eagerly (rather than in a factory function, as shown above), make sure app.enableVersioning() runs first. Otherwise, the generated paths are missing the version prefix. The factory pattern is unaffected, because the document isn't built until it is first requested.
blocks.zh: 如果你打电话 `createDocument()` 急切地（而不是在工厂函数中，如上所示），确保 `app.enableVersioning()` 先跑。否则，生成的 `paths` 缺少版本前缀。工厂模式不受影响，因为在首次请求文档之前不会生成文档。

blocks.md: `DocumentBuilder` structures a base document that conforms to the OpenAPI Specification. Its methods let you set properties such as the title, description, and version. To create a full document (with all HTTP routes defined), use the `createDocument()` method of the `SwaggerModule` class. It takes two arguments: an application instance and the base document configuration returned by `DocumentBuilder#build()`. An optional third argument, of type `SwaggerDocumentOptions`, is covered in the [document options](/openapi/introduction#document-options) section.

To create a full document (with all HTTP routes defined), use the createDocument() method of the SwaggerModule class. It takes two arguments: an application instance and the base document configuration returned by DocumentBuilder#build(). An optional third argument, of type SwaggerDocumentOptions, is covered in the document options section.
blocks.zh: `DocumentBuilder` 构建符合 OpenAPI 规范的基础文档。它的方法允许您设置标题、描述和版本等属性。要创建完整的文档（定义了所有 HTTP 路由），请使用 `SwaggerModule` 类的 `createDocument()` 方法。它需要两个参数：应用程序实例和 `DocumentBuilder#build()` 返回的基本文档配置。[文档选项](/openapi/introduction#document-options) 部分涵盖了类型为 `SwaggerDocumentOptions` 的可选第三个参数。

blocks.title: Warning
blocks.text: When you register helmet directly with Fastify instead, its CSP can block the Swagger UI. To resolve this conflict, configure the CSP as shown below: typescript app.register(helmet, { contentSecurityPolicy: { directives: { defaultSrc: ['self'], styleSrc: ['self', 'unsafe-inline'], imgSrc: ['self', 'data:', 'validator.swagger.io'], scriptSrc: ['self', https:, 'unsafe-inline'], }, }, }); // If you are not going to use CSP at all, you can use this: app.register(helmet, { contentSecurityPolicy: false, });

blocks.md: Standard Schema (Zod, Valibot)
blocks.text: Standard Schema (Zod, Valibot)
blocks.zh: 标准方案（Zod、Valibot）

blocks.md: Nest route parameter decorators accept a [Standard Schema](https://standardschema.dev/) compatible schema through their `schema` option (see the [controllers](/controllers#request-object) chapter):
blocks.text: Nest route parameter decorators accept a Standard Schema compatible schema through their schema option (see the controllers chapter):
blocks.zh: Nest 路由参数装饰器接受 [Standard Schema](https://standardschema.dev/) 通过他们的兼容模式 `schema` 选项（参见 [控制器](/controllers#request-object) 章）：

blocks.md: The Swagger module picks up these schemas and turns them into request bodies and parameters in the generated document.
blocks.text: The Swagger module picks up these schemas and turns them into request bodies and parameters in the generated document.
blocks.zh: 这个 Swagger 模块获取这些模式，并在生成的文档中将它们转换为请求主体和参数。

blocks.md: Libraries that need no configuration
blocks.text: Libraries that need no configuration
blocks.zh: 无需配置的库

blocks.md: If your validation library implements the **Standard JSON Schema** extension (that is, its schemas expose `~standard.jsonSchema`), Nest converts the schemas itself, and there is nothing to configure. Zod 4.2 and later implements this extension, for example. Nest requests the `openapi-3.0` target and uses the `input` or `output` variant, depending on whether the schema describes a request or a response.
blocks.text: If your validation library implements the Standard JSON Schema extension (that is, its schemas expose ~standard.jsonSchema), Nest converts the schemas itself, and there is nothing to configure. Zod 4.2 and later implements this extension, for example. Nest requests the openapi-3.0 target and uses the input or output variant, depending on whether the schema describes a request or a response.
blocks.zh: 如果您的验证库实现了**标准 JSON 架构**扩展（即，其架构公开 `~standard.jsonSchema`),Nest 转换模式本身，无需配置任何内容。例如，Zod 4.2 和更高版本实现了这种扩展。Nest 请求 `openapi-3.0` 目标并使用 `input` 或者 `output` 变体，取决于模式描述的是请求还是响应。

blocks.md: Supplying a converter
blocks.text: Supplying a converter
blocks.zh: 提供转换器

blocks.md: For libraries that don't expose that extension (or when you want to control the conversion yourself), provide a `standardSchemaConverter` in `SwaggerDocumentOptions`. It receives the raw schema and the `schemaType` being generated, and returns the converted OpenAPI schema:
blocks.text: For libraries that don't expose that extension (or when you want to control the conversion yourself), provide a standardSchemaConverter in SwaggerDocumentOptions. It receives the raw schema and the schemaType being generated, and returns the converted OpenAPI schema:
blocks.zh: 对于不公开该扩展的库（或者当您想自己控制转换时），请在 `SwaggerDocumentOptions` 中提供 `standardSchemaConverter`。它接收原始模式和正在生成的 `schemaType`，并返回转换后的 OpenAPI 模式：

blocks.md: Nest calls the converter before trying the native conversion. Returning `undefined` tells Nest that the converter doesn't handle this schema, so Nest falls back to the native conversion described above. This makes it safe to support several libraries from one converter.
blocks.text: Nest calls the converter before trying the native conversion. Returning undefined tells Nest that the converter doesn't handle this schema, so Nest falls back to the native conversion described above. This makes it safe to support several libraries from one converter.
blocks.zh: Nest 在尝试本机转换之前调用转换器。返回 `undefined` 告诉 Nest 转换器不处理此模式，因此 Nest 回到上面描述的本机转换。这使得从一个转换器支持多个库变得安全。

blocks.md: For **Zod**, you can use [zod-openapi](https://github.com/samchungy/zod-openapi):
blocks.text: For Zod, you can use zod-openapi:
blocks.zh: 对于**Zod**，您可以使用 [zod-openapi](https://github.com/samchungy/zod-openapi)：

blocks.code: $ npm i --save-dev zod-openapi

blocks.md: For **Valibot**, use [@valibot/to-json-schema](https://github.com/fabian-hiller/valibot/tree/main/packages/to-json-schema):
blocks.text: For Valibot, use @valibot/to-json-schema:
blocks.zh: 对于**Valibot**，请使用 [@valibot/to-json-schema](https://github.com/fabian-hiller/valibot/tree/main/packages/to-json-schema)：

blocks.code: $ npm i --save-dev @valibot/to-json-schema

blocks.md: The two converters differ in one respect. `createSchema()` can hoist reusable definitions, so its result carries a `components` map, which you pass through and Nest merges into the document's shared components. `toJsonSchema()` returns a single self-contained schema, so the Valibot converter omits `components`.
blocks.text: The two converters differ in one respect. createSchema() can hoist reusable definitions, so its result carries a components map, which you pass through and Nest merges into the document's shared components. toJsonSchema() returns a single self-contained schema, so the Valibot converter omits components.
blocks.zh: 这两个转换器在一个方面有所不同。`createSchema()` 可以提升可重用的定义，因此其结果携带一个 `components` 映射，您可以通过该映射，Nest 将其合并到文档的共享组件中。`toJsonSchema()` 返回一个独立的模式，因此 Valibot 转换器省略了 `components`。

blocks.md: Supporting several libraries at once
blocks.text: Supporting several libraries at once
blocks.zh: 同时支持多个库

blocks.md: Because the converter receives the schema as `unknown`, you can branch on the schema's vendor and support more than one library in the same application. Every Standard Schema exposes its vendor at `~standard.vendor`:
blocks.text: Because the converter receives the schema as unknown, you can branch on the schema's vendor and support more than one library in the same application. Every Standard Schema exposes its vendor at ~standard.vendor:
blocks.zh: 因为转换器将模式接收为 `unknown`，所以您可以在模式的供应商上进行分支，并在同一应用程序中支持多个库。每个标准模式在 `~standard.vendor` 处公开其供应商：

blocks.title: Warning
blocks.md: Always narrow by vendor before calling a library-specific converter. Passing a Valibot schema to `createSchema()` (or the reverse) throws at document generation time instead of failing gracefully.
blocks.text: Always narrow by vendor before calling a library-specific converter. Passing a Valibot schema to createSchema() (or the reverse) throws at document generation time instead of failing gracefully.
blocks.zh: 在调用特定于库的转换器之前，始终按供应商缩小范围。将 Valibot 架构传递给 `createSchema()`（或者相反）在文档生成时间上折腾，而不是优雅地失败。

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md: `schemaType` matters when your schema performs transformations: the `input` shape is what clients send, and the `output` shape is what your handler receives after parsing. Nest requests the variant that fits the position being documented, so pass the value straight through to your converter instead of hardcoding one.
blocks.text: schemaType matters when your schema performs transformations: the input shape is what clients send, and the output shape is what your handler receives after parsing. Nest requests the variant that fits the position being documented, so pass the value straight through to your converter instead of hardcoding one.
blocks.zh: `schemaType` 模式执行转换时很重要：`input` 形状是客户端发送的，`output`shape 是处理程序在解析后接收到的内容。Nest 请求符合记录位置的变体，因此将值直接传递给您的转换器，而不是硬编码。

blocks.md: Setup options
blocks.text: Setup options
blocks.zh: 设置选项

blocks.md: You can configure Swagger UI by passing an options object that implements the `SwaggerCustomOptions` interface as the fourth argument of the `SwaggerModule#setup()` method.
blocks.text: You can configure Swagger UI by passing an options object that implements the SwaggerCustomOptions interface as the fourth argument of the SwaggerModule#setup() method.
blocks.zh: 您可以配置 SwaggerUI 通过传递实现 `SwaggerCustomOptions` 接口作为第四个参数 `SwaggerModule#setup()` 方法。

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.text: ui and raw are independent options. Disabling the Swagger UI (ui: false) doesn't disable the API definitions (JSON/YAML). Conversely, disabling the API definitions (raw: []) doesn't disable the Swagger UI. For example, the following configuration disables the Swagger UI but keeps the JSON API definition available: typescript const options: SwaggerCustomOptions = { ui: false, // Swagger UI is disabled raw: ['json'], // JSON API definition is still accessible (YAML is disabled) }; SwaggerModule.setup('api', app, documentFactory, options); In this case, http://localhost:3000/api-json is still accessible, but http://localhost:3000/api (the Swagger UI) is not.

blocks.md: OpenAPI 3.2 extends the Tag Object so that tags can be organized into a hierarchy and annotated with a hint about how they should be presented. To declare these relationships, define the tags up front with `DocumentBuilder` and pass the `parent` and `kind` options to `addTag()`:
blocks.text: OpenAPI 3.2 extends the Tag Object so that tags can be organized into a hierarchy and annotated with a hint about how they should be presented. To declare these relationships, define the tags up front with DocumentBuilder and pass the parent and kind options to addTag():
blocks.zh: OpenAPI 3.2 扩展了 Tag 对象，这样标签就可以被组织成一个层次结构，并带有关于它们应该如何呈现的提示进行注释。要声明这些关系，请预先使用 `DocumentBuilder` 定义标记，并将 `parent` 和 `kind` 选项传递给 `addTag()`：

blocks.md: The `parent` option references another tag by name. The `kind` option is a free-form, machine-readable string that hints at how the tag should be used, commonly `nav`, `badge`, or `audience`. The same options object also accepts a `summary`, another OpenAPI 3.2 Tag Object field.
blocks.text: The parent option references another tag by name. The kind option is a free-form, machine-readable string that hints at how the tag should be used, commonly nav, badge, or audience. The same options object also accepts a summary, another OpenAPI 3.2 Tag Object field.
blocks.zh: `parent` 选项按名称引用另一个标记。`kind` 选项是一个自由格式、机器可读的字符串，它提示应该如何使用标记，通常是 `nav`、`badge` 或 `audience`。同一个选项对象还接受另一个 OpenAPI 3.2 标记对象字段 `summary`。

Otherwise, the generated document still declares `openapi: 3.0.0`, and strict validators reject these fields. Hierarchy fields can only be defined through `DocumentBuilder.addTag()`. The `@ApiTags()` decorator ignores them and logs a warning.

chapters.title: CLI Plugin
chapters.summary: TypeScript's metadata reflection system has several limitations.

blocks.md: [TypeScript](https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/decorators.html)'s metadata reflection system has several limitations. For instance, it can't determine which properties a class consists of, or whether a given property is optional or required. However, some of these constraints can be addressed at compile time. Nest provides a plugin that enhances the TypeScript compilation process to reduce the amount of boilerplate code required.
blocks.text: TypeScript's metadata reflection system has several limitations. For instance, it can't determine which properties a class consists of, or whether a given property is optional or required. However, some of these constraints can be addressed at compile time. Nest provides a plugin that enhances the TypeScript compilation process to reduce the amount of boilerplate code required.
blocks.zh: [TypeScript](https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/decorators.html) 的元数据反映系统有几个局限性。例如，它不能确定一个类由哪些属性组成，也不能确定给定的属性是可选的还是必需的。但是，这些约束中的一些可以在编译时解决。Nest 提供一个插件来增强 TypeScript 编译过程，以减少所需的样板代码量。

blocks.md: Overview
blocks.text: Overview
blocks.zh: 概述

blocks.md: The Swagger plugin automatically:
blocks.text: The Swagger plugin automatically:
blocks.zh: 这个 Swagger 插件自动：

blocks.md:
- annotates all DTO properties with `@ApiProperty()`, unless `@ApiHideProperty()` is used
- sets the `required` property depending on the question mark (e.g., `name?: string` sets `required: false`)
- sets the `type` or `enum` property depending on the type (arrays are supported as well)
- sets the `default` property based on the assigned default value
- sets several validation rules based on `class-validator` decorators (if `classValidatorShim` is set to `true`)
- adds a response decorator to every endpoint with a proper status and `type` (response model)
- generates descriptions for properties and endpoints based on comments (if `introspectComments` is set to `true`)
- generates example values for properties based on comments (if `introspectComments` is set to `true`)

- 设置 `type` 或者 `enum` 属性取决于类型（也支持数组）
- 设置 `default` 基于指定的默认值的属性
- 基于 `class-validator` 装饰器设置几个验证规则（如果 `classValidatorShim` 设置为 `true`）
- 向具有适当状态的每个端点添加响应装饰器，并且 `type`（响应模型）
- 根据注释生成属性和端点的描述（如果 `introspectComments` 设置为 `true`）
- 根据注释生成属性的示例值（如果 `introspectComments` 设置为 `true`）

blocks.md: Descriptions are matched by the **variable name**, which is what `@param` documents. blocks.zh: 描述由**变量名**匹配，这是什么 `@param` 文件。所以 `@Query('order_by') orderBy: string` 记录为 `@param orderBy ...`,不 `@param order_by ...`.明确的 `@ApiQuery()` / `@ApiParam()` 装修师总是优先，从不被覆盖。

blocks.md: Use the `options` property to customize the behavior of the plugin:

blocks.md: The `options` property accepts the following options (among others):
blocks.text: The options property accepts the following options (among others):
blocks.zh: 这个 `options`property 接受以下选项（除其他外）：

blocks.md:
Option Default Description
dtoFileNameSuffix ['.dto.ts', '.entity.ts'] DTO (Data Transfer Object) files suffix
controllerFileNameSuffix ['.controller.ts'] Controller files suffix
classValidatorShim true If set to true, the plugin reuses class-validator validation decorators (e.g., @Max(10) adds max: 10 to the schema definition)
classTransformerShim false If set to true, the plugin skips properties decorated with class-transformer's @Exclude(). If set to 'exclusive', it documents only properties decorated with @Expose() or @ApiProperty()
dtoKeyOfComment 'description' The property key to set the comment text to on ApiProperty.
controllerKeyOfComment 'summary' The property key to set the comment text to on ApiOperation.
introspectComments false If set to true, the plugin generates descriptions and example values for properties based on comments
skipAutoHttpCode false Disables the automatic addition of @HttpCode() in controllers
skipDefaultValues false If set to true, the plugin doesn't set the default property from property initializers
autoFillEnumName false If set to true, the plugin sets enumName to the name of the enum type for enum properties that don't declare one
esmCompatible Detected per file Makes the generated code compatible with ESM ({ "type": "module" }). When omitted, the plugin detects whether each file is emitted as ESM from your compiler options and package.json
Delete the `/dist` folder and rebuild your application whenever you update plugin options.

blocks.zh: 删除 `/dist` 每当您更新插件选项时，文件夹并重建您的应用程序。

chapters.summary: A REPL is an interactive environment that takes single user inputs, executes them, and returns the result to the user.

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md: These function interfaces are written in [TypeScript function type expression syntax](https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/2/functions.html#function-type-expressions).
blocks.text: These function interfaces are written in TypeScript function type expression syntax.

blocks.md:
| Function     | Description                                                                                                        | Signature                                                             |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `debug`      | Prints all registered modules as a list, together with their controllers and providers. Pass a module (e.g., `debug(MyModule)`) to print only that module's components. | `debug(moduleCls?: ClassRef \| string) => void`                       |
| `get` or `$` | Retrieves an instance of a provider or controller; throws an exception if it can't be found.                       | `get(token: InjectionToken) => any`                                   |
| `help`       | Displays all available REPL native functions.                                                                      | `help() => void`                                                      |
| `methods`    | Displays all public methods available on a given provider or controller.                                           | `methods(token: ClassRef \| string) => void`                          |
| `resolve`    | Resolves a transient or request-scoped instance of a provider or controller; throws an exception if it can't be found. | `resolve(token: InjectionToken, contextId: any) => Promise<any>`      |
| `select`     | Navigates through the modules tree, for example, to pull out a specific instance from the selected module.        | `select(token: DynamicModule \| ClassRef) => INestApplicationContext` |
blocks.zh:
| 功能 | 描述 | 签名 |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `debug` | 将所有注册的模块及其控制器和提供程序打印为列表。传递模块（例如，`debug(MyModule)`）仅打印该模块组件。 | ` 调试(moduleCls?: 类参考 \ | 字符串）=>空 ` |
| `get` 或者 `$` | 检索提供程序或控制器的实例；如果找不到异常，则抛出异常。 | `get(token: InjectionToken) => any` |
| `help` | 显示所有可用内容 REPL 本机函数。 | `help() => void` |
| `methods` | 显示给定提供程序或控制器上可用的所有公共方法。 | `methods(token: ClassRef \ | 字符串）=>空 ` |
| `resolve` | 解析提供程序或控制器的瞬态或请求作用域实例；如果找不到异常，则抛出异常。 | `resolve(token: InjectionToken, contextId: any) => Promise<any>` |
| `select` | 例如，浏览模块树，从选定的模块中提取特定实例。 | `select(token: DynamicModule \ | 类参考) => INestApplicationContext` |

chapters.title: CRUD generator
chapters.summary: Over the lifespan of a project, building new features often means adding new resources to the application.

blocks.md: Over the lifespan of a project, building new features often means adding new resources to the application. Each new resource typically requires the same set of repetitive operations.
blocks.text: Over the lifespan of a project, building new features often means adding new resources to the application. Each new resource typically requires the same set of repetitive operations.
blocks.zh: 在项目的生命周期中，构建新功能通常意味着向应用程序添加新资源。每个新资源通常需要相同的一组重复操作。

blocks.md: Introduction
blocks.text: Introduction
blocks.zh: 介绍

blocks.md: Consider a real-world scenario in which you need to expose CRUD endpoints for two entities, **User** and **Product**. Following best practices, you would have to perform several operations for each entity:
blocks.text: Consider a real-world scenario in which you need to expose CRUD endpoints for two entities, User and Product. Following best practices, you would have to perform several operations for each entity:
blocks.zh: 考虑一个需要暴露的现实场景 CRUD**用户**和**产品**两个实体的端点。按照最佳实践，您必须为每个实体执行几个操作：

blocks.md:
- Generate a module (`nest g mo`) to keep code organized and establish clear boundaries (grouping related components)
- Generate a controller (`nest g co`) to define CRUD routes (or queries/mutations for GraphQL applications)
- Generate a service (`nest g s`) to implement and isolate business logic
- Generate an entity class/interface to represent the resource data shape
- Generate Data Transfer Objects (or inputs for GraphQL applications) to define how the data will be sent over the network
blocks.text: Generate a module (nest g mo) to keep code organized and establish clear boundaries (grouping related components) Generate a controller (nest g co) to define CRUD routes (or queries/mutations for GraphQL applications) Generate a service (nest g s) to implement and isolate business logic Generate an entity class/interface to represent the resource data shape Generate Data Transfer Objects (or inputs for GraphQL applications) to define how the data will be sent over the network
blocks.zh:
- 生成模块（`nest g mo`）保持代码有条理并建立清晰的边界（对相关组件进行分组）
- 生成控制器（`nest g co`）来定义 CRUD 路由（或查询/突变 GraphQL 应用）
- 生成服务（`nest g s`) 实现和隔离业务逻辑
- 生成实体类/接口以表示资源数据形状
- 生成数据传输对象（或输入 GraphQL 应用程序）定义如何通过网络发送数据

blocks.md: To speed up this repetitive process, the [Nest CLI](/cli/overview) provides a generator (schematic) that generates all of this boilerplate code automatically.
blocks.text: To speed up this repetitive process, the Nest CLI provides a generator (schematic) that generates all of this boilerplate code automatically.
blocks.zh: 为了加快这个重复的过程，[Nest CLI](/cli/overview) 提供自动生成所有这些样板代码的生成器（示意图）。

blocks.title: Note
blocks.md: The schematic supports generating **HTTP** controllers, **Microservice** controllers, **GraphQL** resolvers (both code first and schema first), and **WebSocket** Gateways.
blocks.text: The schematic supports generating HTTP controllers, Microservice controllers, GraphQL resolvers (both code first and schema first), and WebSocket Gateways.
blocks.zh: 原理图支持生成**HTTP**控制器，**微服务**控制器，**GraphQL**解析器（代码优先和模式优先）和**WebSocket**网关。

blocks.text: The command also creates placeholders for all the CRUD endpoints: routes for REST APIs, queries and mutations for GraphQL, and message handlers for both microservices and WebSocket gateways.
blocks.zh: 该命令还为所有 CRUD 端点：路由 RESTAPI、查询和突变 GraphQL 以及微服务和 WebSocket 网关的消息处理程序。

blocks.md: Generated service classes are **not** tied to any specific **ORM (or data source)**, which makes the generator generic enough to meet the needs of any project. By default, all methods contain placeholders that you can populate with the data sources specific to your project.

chapters.title: SWC (fast compiler)
chapters.summary: SWC (Speedy Web Compiler) is an extensible Rust-based platform that can be used for both compilation and bundling.

blocks.md: [SWC](https://swc.rs/) (Speedy Web Compiler) is an extensible Rust-based platform that can be used for both compilation and bundling. Using SWC with the Nest CLI is a straightforward way to significantly speed up your development process.
blocks.text: SWC (Speedy Web Compiler) is an extensible Rust-based platform that can be used for both compilation and bundling. Using SWC with the Nest CLI is a straightforward way to significantly speed up your development process.
blocks.zh: [SWC](https://swc.rs/)（Speedy Web Compiler）是一个可扩展的基于 Rust 的平台，可用于编译和捆绑。使用 SWC 与 NestCLI 是显著加快开发过程的直接方法。

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md: SWC is approximately **20 times faster** than the default TypeScript compiler.
blocks.text: SWC is approximately 20 times faster than the default TypeScript compiler.
blocks.zh: SWC 大约比默认值快**20 倍**TypeScript 编译器。

blocks.text: Type checking

blocks.md: Unlike the default TypeScript compiler, SWC doesn't perform any type checking itself. To turn type checking on, use the `--type-check` flag:

chapters.title: Passport (auth)
chapters.summary: Passport is the most popular Node.js authentication library, well known in the community and used in many production applications.

blocks.md: [Passport](https://github.com/jaredhanson/passport) is the most popular Node.js authentication library, well known in the community and used in many production applications. You can integrate it with a **Nest** application using the `@nestjs/passport` module. At a high level, Passport executes a series of steps to:
blocks.text: Passport is the most popular Node.js authentication library, well known in the community and used in many production applications. You can integrate it with a Nest application using the @nestjs/passport module. At a high level, Passport executes a series of steps to:
blocks.zh: [Passport](https://github.com/jaredhanson/passport) 是最受欢迎的 Node.js 认证库，在社区中广为人知，并在许多生产应用程序中使用。您可以将其与**集成 Nest**使用 `@nestjs/passport` 模块。在高水平上，Passport 执行一系列步骤以：

blocks.md:
- Authenticate a user by verifying their "credentials" (such as username/password, JSON Web Token ([JWT](https://jwt.io/)), or identity token from an Identity Provider)
- Manage authenticated state (by issuing a portable token, such as a JWT, or creating an [Express session](https://github.com/expressjs/session))
- Attach information about the authenticated user to the `Request` object for further use in route handlers
blocks.text: Authenticate a user by verifying their "credentials" (such as username/password, JSON Web Token (JWT), or identity token from an Identity Provider) Manage authenticated state (by issuing a portable token, such as a JWT, or creating an Express session) Attach information about the authenticated user to the Request object for further use in route handlers
blocks.zh:
- 通过验证用户的“凭据”（如用户名/密码，JSONWeb 令牌（[JWT](https://jwt.io/))，或来自身份提供者的身份令牌)
- 管理身份验证状态（通过发布可移植令牌，如 JWT 或创建 [Express session](https://github.com/expressjs/session)）
- 将有关经过身份验证的用户的信息附加到 `Request` 进一步用于路由处理程序的对象

blocks.md: Passport has a rich ecosystem of [strategies](http://www.passportjs.org/) that implement various authentication mechanisms. While simple in concept, the set of Passport strategies to choose from is large and varied. Passport abstracts these varied steps into a standard pattern, and the `@nestjs/passport` module wraps this pattern in familiar Nest constructs.
blocks.text: Passport has a rich ecosystem of strategies that implement various authentication mechanisms. While simple in concept, the set of Passport strategies to choose from is large and varied. Passport abstracts these varied steps into a standard pattern, and the @nestjs/passport module wraps this pattern in familiar Nest constructs.
blocks.zh: Passport 拥有丰富的生态系统 [策略](http://www.passportjs.org/) 实现各种认证机制。虽然概念简单，Passport 可供选择的策略多种多样。Passport 将这些不同的步骤抽象成一个标准模式，并且 `@nestjs/passport` 模块将此模式包装在熟悉的 Nest 构造。

blocks.md: In this chapter, we'll implement a complete end-to-end authentication solution for a RESTful API server using these modules. You can follow the steps in this chapter to build the complete example, and apply the same concepts to implement any Passport strategy and customize your authentication scheme.
blocks.text: In this chapter, we'll implement a complete end-to-end authentication solution for a RESTful API server using these modules. You can follow the steps in this chapter to build the complete example, and apply the same concepts to implement any Passport strategy and customize your authentication scheme.
blocks.zh: 在本章中，我们将为 RESTful 实现一个完整的端到端身份验证解决方案 API 使用这些模块的服务器。您可以按照本章中的步骤来构建完整的示例，并应用相同的概念来实现任何 Passport 策略并自定义您的身份验证方案。

blocks.md: Authentication requirements
blocks.text: Authentication requirements
blocks.zh: 认证要求

blocks.md: For this use case, clients start by authenticating with a username and password. Once authenticated, the server issues a JWT that the client can send as a [bearer token in an authorization header](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6750) on subsequent requests to prove authentication. We'll also create a protected route that is accessible only to requests that contain a valid JWT.
blocks.text: For this use case, clients start by authenticating with a username and password. Once authenticated, the server issues a JWT that the client can send as a bearer token in an authorization header on subsequent requests to prove authentication. We'll also create a protected route that is accessible only to requests that contain a valid JWT.
blocks.zh: 对于这个用例，客户端首先使用用户名和密码进行身份验证。经过身份验证后，服务器会发出一个 JWT，客户端可以在后续请求时将其作为 [授权头中的承载令牌](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6750) 发送，以证明身份验证。我们还将创建一个受保护的路由，只有包含有效 JWT 的请求才能访问该路由。

blocks.md: We'll start with the first requirement: authenticating a user. We'll then extend that by issuing a JWT. Finally, we'll create a protected route that checks for a valid JWT on the request.
blocks.text: We'll start with the first requirement: authenticating a user. We'll then extend that by issuing a JWT. Finally, we'll create a protected route that checks for a valid JWT on the request.
blocks.zh: 我们将从第一个要求开始：对用户进行身份验证。然后，我们将通过发布一个 JWT.最后，我们将创建一个受保护的路由，检查是否有效 JWT 应要求。

blocks.md: First, install the required packages. Passport provides a strategy called [passport-local](https://github.com/jaredhanson/passport-local) that implements a username/password authentication mechanism, which suits this part of our use case.
blocks.text: First, install the required packages. Passport provides a strategy called passport-local that implements a username/password authentication mechanism, which suits this part of our use case.
blocks.zh: 首先，安装所需的软件包。Passport 提供了一个名为 [passport-local](https://github.com/jaredhanson/passport-local) 它实现了用户名/密码身份验证机制，这适合我们用例的这一部分。

blocks.code:
$ npm install --save @nestjs/passport passport passport-local
$ npm install --save-dev @types/passport-local

blocks.title: Notice
blocks.md: For **any** Passport strategy you choose, you always need the `@nestjs/passport` and `passport` packages. You also need the strategy-specific package (e.g., `passport-jwt` or `passport-local`) that implements the authentication strategy you are building. You can also install the type definitions for the strategy, as shown above with `@types/passport-local`, to get type checking and editor assistance while writing TypeScript code.

You also need the strategy-specific package (e.g., passport-jwt or passport-local) that implements the authentication strategy you are building. You can also install the type definitions for the strategy, as shown above with @types/passport-local, to get type checking and editor assistance while writing TypeScript code.
blocks.zh: 对于**任何**Passport 你选择的策略，你总是需要 `@nestjs/passport` 和 `passport` 包裹。您还需要特定于策略的软件包（例如，`passport-jwt` 或者 `passport-local`) 实现您正在构建的身份验证策略。还可以安装策略的类型定义，如上所示 `@types/passport-local`，以在编写时获得类型检查和编辑器帮助 TypeScript 代码。

blocks.md: Implementing Passport strategies
blocks.text: Implementing Passport strategies
blocks.zh: 实施 Passport 策略

blocks.md: We're now ready to implement the authentication feature. We'll start with an overview of the process used for **any** Passport strategy. It's helpful to think of Passport as a mini framework in itself. It abstracts the authentication process into a few basic steps that you customize based on the strategy you're implementing. It's like a framework because you configure it by supplying customization parameters (as plain JSON objects) and custom code in the form of callback functions, which Passport calls at the appropriate time. The `@nestjs/passport` module wraps this framework in a Nest-style package, so that it integrates naturally into a Nest application. We'll use `@nestjs/passport` below, but first, let's consider how **vanilla Passport** works.
blocks.text: We're now ready to implement the authentication feature. We'll start with an overview of the process used for any Passport strategy. It's helpful to think of Passport as a mini framework in itself. It abstracts the authentication process into a few basic steps that you customize based on the strategy you're implementing. It's like a framework because you configure it by supplying customization parameters (as plain JSON objects) and custom code in the form of callback functions, which Passport calls at the appropriate time. The @nestjs/passport module wraps this framework in a Nest-style package, so that it integrates naturally into a Nest application. We'll use @nestjs/passport below, but first, let's consider how vanilla Passport works.
blocks.zh: 我们现在准备实现身份验证功能。我们将首先概述用于**any**的流程 Passport 战略。想想很有帮助 Passport 作为一个迷你框架本身。它将身份验证过程抽象为几个基本步骤，您可以根据正在实施的策略进行定制。它就像一个框架，因为您可以通过提供自定义参数来配置它（就像普通的 JSON 对象）和回调函数形式的自定义代码，Passport 在适当的时间打电话。这个 `@nestjs/passport` 模块将此框架包装在 Nest-风格包，使其自然地集成到一个 Nest 应用。我们将使用 `@nestjs/passport` 下面，但首先，让我们考虑如何**香草 Passport**作品。

blocks.md: In vanilla Passport, you configure a strategy by providing two things:
blocks.text: In vanilla Passport, you configure a strategy by providing two things:
blocks.zh: 香草 Passport 您可以通过提供以下两件事来配置策略：

blocks.md:
1. A set of options that are specific to that strategy. For example, in a JWT strategy, you might provide a secret to sign tokens.
2. A "verify callback", which is where you tell Passport how to interact with your user store (where you manage user accounts). Here, you verify whether a user exists (and/or create a new user), and whether their credentials are valid. Passport expects this callback to return a full user if the validation succeeds, or `null` if it fails (failure means either that the user is not found or, in the case of passport-local, that the password does not match).
blocks.text: A set of options that are specific to that strategy. For example, in a JWT strategy, you might provide a secret to sign tokens. A "verify callback", which is where you tell Passport how to interact with your user store (where you manage user accounts). Here, you verify whether a user exists (and/or create a new user), and whether their credentials are valid. Passport expects this callback to return a full user if the validation succeeds, or null if it fails (failure means either that the user is not found or, in the case of passport-local, that the password does not match).
blocks.zh:
1. 特定于该策略的一组选项。例如，在 JWT 策略，你可以提供一个秘密来签署令牌。
2. “验证回调”，即您告诉 Passport 如何与您的用户商店（您管理用户帐户的地方）交互。在这里，您验证用户是否存在（和/或创建新用户），以及他们的凭据是否有效。Passport 如果验证成功，则期望此回调返回一个完整的用户，或者 `null` 如果失败（失败意味着找不到用户，或者在 passport-local 的情况下，密码不匹配）。

blocks.md: With `@nestjs/passport`, you configure a Passport strategy by extending the `PassportStrategy` class. You pass the strategy options (item 1 above) by calling `super()` in your subclass's constructor, optionally with an options object. You provide the verify callback (item 2 above) by implementing a `validate()` method in your subclass.
blocks.text: With @nestjs/passport, you configure a Passport strategy by extending the PassportStrategy class. You pass the strategy options (item 1 above) by calling super() in your subclass's constructor, optionally with an options object. You provide the verify callback (item 2 above) by implementing a validate() method in your subclass.
blocks.zh: 和 `@nestjs/passport`，您配置 Passport 通过扩展 `PassportStrategy` 班级。您通过调用来传递策略选项（上面的第 1 项）`super()` 在子类的构造函数中，可选地使用 options 对象。您通过实现 `validate()` 子类中的方法。

blocks.md: Our `AuthService` retrieves a user and verifies the password. We create a `validateUser()` method for this purpose. blocks.title: Warning
blocks.md: In a real application, never store a password in plain text. Instead, use a library like [bcrypt](https://github.com/kelektiv/node.bcrypt.js#readme) with a salted one-way hash algorithm. With that approach, you store only hashed passwords and compare the stored hash to a hashed version of the **incoming** password, so user passwords are never stored or exposed in plain text. To keep our sample app simple, we violate that rule and use plain text. **Don't do this in your real app.**

blocks.md:
- Restrict the routes an unauthenticated user can access (i.e., deny access to restricted routes). blocks.md:
- `jwtFromRequest`: supplies the method by which the JWT is extracted from the `Request`. We use the standard approach of supplying a bearer token in the `Authorization` header of our API requests. See [extracting the JWT from the request](https://github.com/mikenicholson/passport-jwt#extracting-the-jwt-from-the-request) for other options.
- `ignoreExpiration`: to be explicit, we set the default `false` value, which delegates the responsibility of ensuring that a JWT has not expired to the Passport module. If our route receives an expired JWT, the request is denied with a `401 Unauthorized` response.
- `secretOrKey`: we use the expedient option of supplying a symmetric secret for signing the token. Other options, such as a PEM-encoded public key, may be more appropriate for production apps (see the [passport-jwt strategy options](https://github.com/mikenicholson/passport-jwt#configure-strategy) for more information). In any case, as cautioned earlier, **do not expose this secret publicly**.

blocks.md: The `validate()` method deserves some discussion. For the JWT strategy, Passport first verifies the JWT's signature and decodes the JSON. It then invokes our `validate()` method, passing the decoded JSON as its single parameter. Based on the way JWT signing works, **we're guaranteed to receive a valid token** that we previously signed and issued to a valid user.

blocks.md: This approach also leaves room ('hooks', as it were) to inject other business logic into the process. For example, we could do a database lookup in our `validate()` method to extract more information about the user, resulting in a more enriched `user` object being available in our `Request`. This is also the place we may decide to do further token validation, such as looking up the `userId` in a list of revoked tokens, enabling us to perform token revocation. The model we've implemented here in our sample code is a fast, "stateless JWT" model, where each API call is immediately authorized based on the presence of a valid JWT, and a small bit of information about the requester (its `userId` and `username`) is available in our Request pipeline.

blocks.md: Request-scoped strategies
blocks.text: Request-scoped strategies
blocks.zh: 请求范围策略

blocks.md: The Passport API is based on registering strategies with the global instance of the library. Therefore, strategies are not designed to have request-dependent options or to be dynamically instantiated per request (see [injection scopes](/fundamentals/injection-scopes) to learn more about request-scoped providers). If you configure your strategy to be request-scoped, Nest never instantiates it, since it's not tied to any specific route, and there is no way to determine which "request-scoped" strategies should run for a given request.
blocks.text: The Passport API is based on registering strategies with the global instance of the library. Therefore, strategies are not designed to have request-dependent options or to be dynamically instantiated per request (see injection scopes to learn more about request-scoped providers). If you configure your strategy to be request-scoped, Nest never instantiates it, since it's not tied to any specific route, and there is no way to determine which "request-scoped" strategies should run for a given request.
blocks.zh: 这个 PassportAPI 是基于向库的全局实例注册策略。因此，策略不是设计成具有依赖于请求的选项，也不是为每个请求动态实例化（请参见 [注射镜](/fundamentals/injection-scopes) 了解有关请求范围提供程序的更多信息）。如果将策略配置为请求作用域，Nest 永远不要实例化它，因为它不绑定到任何特定的路由，也没有办法确定哪些“请求范围”策略应该为给定的请求运行。

blocks.md: **TypeScript compilation** has the biggest impact on your application's bootstrapping time. With [webpack](https://github.com/webpack/webpack) HMR (Hot-Module Replacement), you don't need to recompile the entire project each time a change occurs. This significantly decreases the time it takes to instantiate your application and makes iterative development much faster.

chapters.summary: The flow of simple CRUD (Create, Read, Update and Delete) applications can be described as follows:.

blocks.md: The flow of simple [CRUD](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Create,_read,_update_and_delete) (Create, Read, Update and Delete) applications can be described as follows:
blocks.text: The flow of simple CRUD (Create, Read, Update and Delete) applications can be described as follows:
blocks.zh: 简单的流程 [CRUD](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Create,_read,_update_and_delete)（创建、读取、更新和删除）应用程序可以描述如下：

blocks.md:
1. The controllers layer handles HTTP requests and delegates tasks to the services layer.
2. The services layer is where most of the business logic lives.
3. Services use repositories or DAOs to change and persist entities.
4. Entities act as containers for values, with setters and getters.
blocks.text: The controllers layer handles HTTP requests and delegates tasks to the services layer. The services layer is where most of the business logic lives. Services use repositories or DAOs to change and persist entities. Entities act as containers for values, with setters and getters.
blocks.zh:
1. 控制器层处理 HTTP 请求并将任务委派给服务层。
2. 服务层是大多数业务逻辑的所在地。
3. 服务使用存储库或 DAO 来更改和持久化实体。
4. 实体充当值的容器，具有 setter 和 getter。

blocks.md: While this pattern is usually sufficient for small and medium-sized applications, it may not be the best choice for larger, more complex ones. In such cases, the **CQRS** (Command and Query Responsibility Segregation) model may be more appropriate and scalable, depending on the application's requirements. Benefits of this model include:
blocks.text: While this pattern is usually sufficient for small and medium-sized applications, it may not be the best choice for larger, more complex ones. In such cases, the CQRS (Command and Query Responsibility Segregation) model may be more appropriate and scalable, depending on the application's requirements. Benefits of this model include:
blocks.zh: 虽然这种模式对于中小型应用程序来说通常就足够了，但对于更大、更复杂的应用程序来说，它可能不是最佳选择。在这种情况下，**CQRS**（命令和查询责任隔离）模型可能更合适，也更可扩展，具体取决于应用程序的需求。该模型的优点包括：

blocks.md:
- **Separation of concerns**. Read and write operations are handled by separate models.
- **Scalability**. Read and write operations can be scaled independently.
- **Flexibility**. Reads and writes can use different data stores.
- **Performance**. Each data store can be optimized for its workload (reads or writes).
blocks.text: Separation of concerns. Read and write operations are handled by separate models. Scalability. Read and write operations can be scaled independently. Flexibility. Reads and writes can use different data stores. Performance. Each data store can be optimized for its workload (reads or writes).
blocks.zh:
- **关注点分离**。读和写操作由单独的模型处理。
- **可扩展性**。读取和写入操作可以独立缩放。
- **灵活性**。读取和写入可以使用不同的数据存储。
- **表演**。每个数据存储都可以针对其工作负载（读取或写入）进行优化。

blocks.md: To support this model, Nest provides a lightweight [CQRS module](https://github.com/nestjs/cqrs). This chapter describes how to use it.
blocks.text: To support this model, Nest provides a lightweight CQRS module. This chapter describes how to use it.
blocks.zh: 为了支持这个模型，Nest 提供了一个轻量级的 [CQRS 模块](https://github.com/nestjs/cqrs)。本章描述了如何使用它。

blocks.md:
| Attribute                     | Description                                                                                                                  | Default                           |
| ----------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| `commandPublisher`            | The publisher responsible for dispatching commands to the system.                                                            | `DefaultCommandPubSub`            |
| `eventPublisher`              | The publisher used to publish events, allowing them to be broadcasted or processed.                                          | `DefaultPubSub`                   |
| `queryPublisher`              | The publisher used for publishing queries, which can trigger data retrieval operations.                                      | `DefaultQueryPubSub`              |
| `unhandledExceptionPublisher` | The publisher used to publish unhandled exceptions to the `UnhandledExceptionBus`.                                           | `DefaultUnhandledExceptionPubSub` |
| `eventIdProvider`             | Service that retrieves unique event IDs from event instances.                                                                | `DefaultEventIdProvider`          |
| `rethrowUnhandled`            | Whether exceptions thrown by event handlers and sagas are rethrown instead of being published to the `UnhandledExceptionBus`. | `false`                           |
blocks.zh:
| 特征 | 描述 | 默认的 |
| ----------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| `commandPublisher` | 负责向系统发送命令的发布者。 | `DefaultCommandPubSub` |
| `eventPublisher` | 发布者用于发布事件，允许它们被广播或处理。 | `DefaultPubSub` |
| `queryPublisher` | 用于发布查询的发布者，可以触发数据检索操作。 | `DefaultQueryPubSub` |
| `unhandledExceptionPublisher` | 发布者用于将未处理的异常发布到 `UnhandledExceptionBus`。 | `DefaultUnhandledExceptionPubSub` |
| `eventIdProvider` | 从事件实例中检索唯一事件 ID 的服务。 | `DefaultEventIdProvider` |
| `rethrowUnhandled` | 事件处理程序和传奇引发的异常是否被重新引发，而不是发布到 `UnhandledExceptionBus`。 | `false` |

blocks.md: Commands
blocks.text: Commands
blocks.zh: 命令

blocks.md: Commands change the application state. They should be task-based rather than data-centric. When a command is dispatched, it is handled by a corresponding **command handler**, which is responsible for updating the application state.
blocks.text: Commands change the application state. They should be task-based rather than data-centric. When a command is dispatched, it is handled by a corresponding command handler, which is responsible for updating the application state.

blocks.md: Queries
blocks.text: Queries
blocks.zh: 查询

blocks.text: Queries retrieve data from the application state. They should be data-centric rather than task-based. When a query is dispatched, it is handled by a corresponding query handler, which is responsible for retrieving the data.
