blocks.md: Events
blocks.text: Events
blocks.zh: 事件

blocks.md: Events notify other parts of the application about changes in the application state. They are dispatched by **models** or directly through the `EventBus`. When an event is dispatched, it is handled by the corresponding **event handlers**, which can, for example, update the read model.
blocks.text: Events notify other parts of the application about changes in the application state. They are dispatched by models or directly through the EventBus. When an event is dispatched, it is handled by the corresponding event handlers, which can, for example, update the read model.
blocks.zh: 事件将应用程序状态的更改通知应用程序的其他部分。它们由**models**或直接通过 `EventBus` 发送。当事件被调度时，它由相应的**事件处理程序**处理，例如，这些处理程序可以更新读取模型。

blocks.md: The `EventPublisher#mergeObjectContext` method merges the event publisher into the provided object. This object must implement the `IAggregateRoot` interface (or extend the `AggregateRoot` class). Once merged, the object can publish events to the event stream.
blocks.text: The EventPublisher#mergeObjectContext method merges the event publisher into the provided object. This object must implement the IAggregateRoot interface (or extend the AggregateRoot class). Once merged, the object can publish events to the event stream.
blocks.zh: 这个 `EventPublisher#mergeObjectContext` 方法将事件发布者合并到提供的对象中。此对象必须实现 `IAggregateRoot` 接口（或扩展 `AggregateRoot` 类）。合并后，对象可以将事件发布到事件流。

blocks.md: Events applied with `apply()` are queued until you call the model's `commit()` method, which dispatches all outstanding events. To dispatch events as soon as they are applied, set the `autoCommit` property to `true`:
blocks.text: Events applied with apply() are queued until you call the model's commit() method, which dispatches all outstanding events. To dispatch events as soon as they are applied, set the autoCommit property to true:

blocks.code:
const HeroModel = this.publisher.mergeClassContext(Hero);
const hero = new HeroModel('id'); // <-- HeroModel is a class

blocks.md: Every instance of the `HeroModel` class can now publish events without calling the `mergeObjectContext()` method.

blocks.zh: 的每个实例 `HeroModel` 类现在可以发布事件，而无需调用 `mergeObjectContext()` 方法。

blocks.md: As of `@nestjs/cqrs` 12.1, a model's `commit()`, `publish()` and `publishAll()` return what the event bus returns, which is whatever the event publisher returns. The default in-memory publisher returns nothing, as it doesn't wait for the event handlers. With an asynchronous publisher, such as one that writes to a message broker, `await hero.commit()` waits for it and throws when it fails.

The default in-memory publisher returns nothing, as it doesn't wait for the event handlers. With an asynchronous publisher, such as one that writes to a message broker, await hero.commit() waits for it and throws when it fails.
blocks.zh: 作为 `@nestjs/cqrs`12.1，模型的 `commit()`,`publish()` 和 `publishAll()` 返回事件总线返回的内容，即事件发布者返回的任何内容。默认的内存发布程序不返回任何内容，因为它不等待事件处理程序。使用异步发布者（例如写入消息代理的发布者），`await hero.commit()` 等待它，失败时扔掉。

blocks.md: All three also accept a dispatcher context, which the event publisher receives in place of the model. A command handler can pass its transaction this way, for a publisher that writes through it:
blocks.text: All three also accept a dispatcher context, which the event publisher receives in place of the model. A command handler can pass its transaction this way, for a publisher that writes through it:
blocks.zh: 所有三个都接受调度程序上下文，事件发布者接收该上下文来代替模型。命令处理程序可以通过以下方式传递其事务：

blocks.code: await hero.commit({ transaction: tx });

blocks.md: `commit()` clears the model's events as soon as it hands them to the event bus, without waiting for the publisher, so calling it again never publishes the same events twice. If an awaited `commit()` fails, roll back and run the command again with a freshly loaded model.
blocks.text: commit() clears the model's events as soon as it hands them to the event bus, without waiting for the publisher, so calling it again never publishes the same events twice. If an awaited commit() fails, roll back and run the command again with a freshly loaded model.
blocks.zh: `commit()` 一旦模型将事件交给事件总线，就会立即清除它们，而无需等待发布者，因此再次调用它永远不会两次发布相同的事件。如果等待 `commit()` 失败，请回滚并使用新加载的模型再次运行该命令。

blocks.md: Flexible Aggregate Roots
blocks.text: Flexible Aggregate Roots
blocks.zh: 柔性骨料根

blocks.md: The `AggregateRoot` class is a base class that you can extend to add event-driven capabilities to your domain models. However, this approach requires domain entities to extend `AggregateRoot` directly, which can be a limitation if your application already has an established entity inheritance hierarchy (e.g., a base `Entity` class or domain-specific base classes such as `Monster` or `Vehicle`).
blocks.text: The AggregateRoot class is a base class that you can extend to add event-driven capabilities to your domain models. However, this approach requires domain entities to extend AggregateRoot directly, which can be a limitation if your application already has an established entity inheritance hierarchy (e.g., a base Entity class or domain-specific base classes such as Monster or Vehicle).
blocks.zh: `AggregateRoot` 类是一个基类，您可以扩展它来向域模型添加事件驱动功能。但是，这种方法要求域实体直接扩展 `AggregateRoot`，如果您的应用程序已经具有已建立的实体继承层次结构（例如，基类 `Entity` 类或特定于域的基类，如 `Monster` 或 `Vehicle`），这可能是一个限制。

blocks.md: For more flexibility, the `@nestjs/cqrs` package supports three approaches to implementing aggregate roots:
blocks.text: For more flexibility, the @nestjs/cqrs package supports three approaches to implementing aggregate roots:
blocks.zh: 为了提高灵活性，`@nestjs/cqrs` 包支持实现聚合根的三种方法：

blocks.md: **Approach 1: Traditional (Class Inheritance)**
blocks.text: Approach 1: Traditional (Class Inheritance)
blocks.zh: **方法一：传统（类继承）**

blocks.md: This is the standard approach shown in the previous examples. It works well for simple scenarios and greenfield projects.
blocks.text: This is the standard approach shown in the previous examples. It works well for simple scenarios and greenfield projects.
blocks.zh: 这是前面示例中所示的标准方法。它适用于简单的场景和绿地项目。

blocks.md: **Approach 2: Mixin (For existing hierarchies)**
blocks.text: Approach 2: Mixin (For existing hierarchies)
blocks.zh: **方法 2：Mixin（针对现有层级）**

blocks.md: If you already have a base class and can't extend `AggregateRoot` directly, use the `WithAggregateRoot<EventBase, TBase>()` mixin function. It applies aggregate root behavior to any existing base class.
blocks.text: If you already have a base class and can't extend AggregateRoot directly, use the WithAggregateRoot () mixin function. It applies aggregate root behavior to any existing base class.
blocks.zh: 如果您已经有一个基类，但不能扩展 `AggregateRoot` 直接使用 `WithAggregateRoot<EventBase, TBase>()` 混合函数。它将聚合根行为应用于任何现有的基类。

blocks.md: **Approach 3: Custom Implementation**
blocks.text: Approach 3: Custom Implementation
blocks.zh: **方法三：自定义实施**

blocks.md: For maximum control, or to keep your domain layer completely framework-agnostic, implement the `IAggregateRoot` interface directly:
blocks.text: For maximum control, or to keep your domain layer completely framework-agnostic, implement the IAggregateRoot interface directly:
blocks.zh: 为了获得最大程度的控制，或者为了保持域层与框架完全无关，请实现 `IAggregateRoot` 直接接口：

blocks.md: All three approaches work with `EventPublisher`, which accepts any object that implements the `IAggregateRoot` interface. As of `@nestjs/cqrs` 12.1, `mergeObjectContext()` and `mergeClassContext()` give the model `publish()` and `publishAll()` methods that pass a dispatcher context on to the event bus and return its result. A custom `commit()` supports the dispatcher context by passing it on to `publishAll()`. The parameters are optional: an implementation without them, whose methods return nothing, still satisfies the interface.
blocks.text: All three approaches work with EventPublisher, which accepts any object that implements the IAggregateRoot interface. As of @nestjs/cqrs 12.1, mergeObjectContext() and mergeClassContext() give the model publish() and publishAll() methods that pass a dispatcher context on to the event bus and return its result. A custom commit() supports the dispatcher context by passing it on to publishAll(). The parameters are optional: an implementation without them, whose methods return nothing, still satisfies the interface.
blocks.zh: 这三种方法都适用于 `EventPublisher`，它接受实现 `IAggregateRoot` 接口。作为 `@nestjs/cqrs` 12.1, `mergeObjectContext()` 和 `mergeClassContext()` 给出模型 `publish()` 和 `publishAll()` 将调度程序上下文传递到事件总线并返回其结果的方法。定制 `commit()` 通过将调度程序上下文传递给 `publishAll()` 参数是可选的：没有参数的实现（其方法不返回任何内容）仍然满足接口。

blocks.md: The `EventBus` is an injectable class.
blocks.text: The EventBus is an injectable class.
blocks.zh: 这个 `EventBus` 是一个可注入类。

blocks.md: Each event can have multiple **event handlers**.
blocks.text: Each event can have multiple event handlers.
blocks.zh: 每个事件可以有多个**事件处理程序**。

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md:
Event handlers run outside the traditional HTTP request context:

- Errors thrown in command handlers can still be caught by the built-in [exception filters](/exception-filters).
- Errors thrown in event handlers can't be caught by exception filters, so you have to handle them yourself: with a `try/catch` block, with a [saga](/recipes/cqrs#sagas) that triggers a compensating event, or with another approach of your choice.
- The value returned by a command handler can still be sent back to the client in the HTTP response.
- Event handlers can't send HTTP responses. To send information to the client, use [WebSockets](/websockets/gateways), [server-sent events](/http/server-sent-events), or another mechanism.
blocks.text: Event handlers run outside the traditional HTTP request context: Errors thrown in command handlers can still be caught by the built-in exception filters. Errors thrown in event handlers can't be caught by exception filters, so you have to handle them yourself: with a try/catch block, with a saga that triggers a compensating event, or with another approach of your choice. The value returned by a command handler can still be sent back to the client in the HTTP response. Event handlers can't send HTTP responses. To send information to the client, use WebSockets, server-sent events, or another mechanism.
blocks.zh:
事件处理程序在传统的 HTTP 请求上下文之外运行：

-在命令处理程序中抛出的错误仍然可以被内置的 [异常筛选器](/exception-filters) 捕获。
- 事件处理程序中抛出的错误无法被异常筛选器捕获，因此您必须自己处理它们：使用 `try/catch` 块，使用触发补偿事件的 [传奇](/recipes/cqrs#sagas)，或者使用您选择的其他方法。
-命令处理程序返回的值仍然可以在 HTTP 响应中发送回客户端。
-事件处理程序不能发送 HTTP 响应。要向客户端发送信息，请使用 [WebSockets](/websockets/gateways)、[服务器发送事件](/http/server-sent-events) 或其他机制。

blocks.md: Durable sagas
blocks.text: Durable sagas
blocks.zh: 持久传奇

blocks.md: Sagas and event handlers run in memory. If the process stops between an event and the command a saga dispatches, the command is never dispatched. A saga that combines several events, such as one that waits for the payment after an order and gives up after an hour, loses the events it has seen on a restart. An event published just before the transaction behind it rolls back still reaches them.

An event published just before the transaction behind it rolls back still reaches them.

blocks.md: Unhandled exceptions
blocks.text: Unhandled exceptions
blocks.zh: 未处理的异常

blocks.md: Event handlers are executed asynchronously, so they must always handle exceptions properly to prevent the application from entering an inconsistent state. If an exception isn't handled, the `EventBus` logs it, creates an `UnhandledExceptionInfo` object, and pushes it to the `UnhandledExceptionBus` stream. The same applies to exceptions thrown by sagas and by command handlers executing commands that sagas dispatched. The `UnhandledExceptionBus` is an `Observable` that you can subscribe to in order to process unhandled exceptions. If the `rethrowUnhandled` option is set to `true`, these exceptions are rethrown instead of being published to the `UnhandledExceptionBus`.
blocks.text: Event handlers are executed asynchronously, so they must always handle exceptions properly to prevent the application from entering an inconsistent state. If an exception isn't handled, the EventBus logs it, creates an UnhandledExceptionInfo object, and pushes it to the UnhandledExceptionBus stream. The same applies to exceptions thrown by sagas and by command handlers executing commands that sagas dispatched. The UnhandledExceptionBus is an Observable that you can subscribe to in order to process unhandled exceptions. If the rethrowUnhandled option is set to true, these exceptions are rethrown instead of being published to the UnhandledExceptionBus.

blocks.text: Request-scoping
blocks.zh: 请求范围

blocks.md: If you're coming from other programming languages, you may be surprised that in Nest, most things are shared across incoming requests: a connection pool to the database, singleton services with global state, and more. Node.js doesn't follow the request/response multi-threaded stateless model, in which each request is processed by a separate thread. As a result, using singleton instances is **safe** for your applications.
blocks.text: If you're coming from other programming languages, you may be surprised that in Nest, most things are shared across incoming requests: a connection pool to the database, singleton services with global state, and more. Node.js doesn't follow the request/response multi-threaded stateless model, in which each request is processed by a separate thread. As a result, using singleton instances is safe for your applications.
blocks.zh: 如果您来自其他编程语言，您可能会惊讶地发现 Nest 大多数东西都是在传入请求之间共享的：到数据库的连接池、具有全局状态的单例服务等等。Node.js 不遵循请求/响应多线程无状态模型，其中每个请求由单独的线程处理。因此，使用单例实例对您的应用程序来说是**安全的**。

blocks.md: However, there are edge cases where a request-based lifetime for a handler is desirable, such as per-request caching in GraphQL applications, request tracking, or multi-tenancy. See the [injection scopes](/fundamentals/injection-scopes) chapter to learn how to control scopes.

blocks.zh: 这个 [`ServeStaticModule`](https://github.com/nestjs/serve-static) 接受各种选项来自定义其行为。例如，您可以设置静态应用程序的呈现路径，排除特定路径，或者启用或禁用 `Cache-Control` 响应头。参见 [`ServeStaticModuleOptions` interface](https://github.com/nestjs/serve-static/blob/master/lib/interfaces/serve-static-options.interface.ts) 查看完整的选项列表。

blocks.title: Notice
blocks.md: By default, `renderPath` matches all paths, and the module responds with the `index.html` file. This enables client-side routing for your SPA, while routes declared in your controllers are still handled by the server. You can change this behavior by combining the `serveRoot` and `renderPath` options with the other options. With the Fastify adapter, set `serveStaticOptions.fallthrough` to `true` to mimic the Express fallthrough behavior, i.e., to send `index.html` instead of a 404 error for routes that don't exist.

blocks.md: `nest-commander` lets you write command-line applications with [decorators](https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/decorators.html): the `@Command()` decorator for classes and the `@Option()` decorator for methods of those classes. Every command class should extend the `CommandRunner` abstract class and be decorated with the `@Command()` decorator.

blocks.zh: `nest-commander` 允许您使用 [装饰师](https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/decorators.html)：`@Command()` 类的装饰器 `@Option()` 这些类方法的装饰器。每个命令类都应该扩展 `CommandRunner` 抽象类并用 `@Command()` 装修师。

blocks.md: Nest treats every command as an `@Injectable()`, so dependency injection works as usual. The `CommandRunner` abstract class ensures that every command has a `run()` method that returns a `Promise<void>` and takes the parameters `string[], Record<string, any>`. The `run()` method is where your command's logic starts. Its first argument is an array of all parameters that didn't match an option flag, in case you need to work with multiple parameters. In the second argument, the options object, the property names match the `name` property given to the `@Option()` decorators, and their values are the return values of the corresponding option handlers. For better type safety, you can also create an interface for your options.

blocks.md: By default, Nest's logger is disabled when using the `CommandFactory`. To enable it, pass a logger as the second argument to the `run()` method. You can provide either a custom NestJS logger or an array of the log levels you want to keep. For example, pass `['error']` to print only Nest's error logs.

blocks.md: Under the hood, `CommandFactory` calls `NestFactory` for you and calls `app.close()` when the command finishes, so you don't need to worry about memory leaks. To add error handling, wrap the `run()` call in a `try/catch` block, or chain a `.catch()` call to the `bootstrap()` call.

chapters.title: Async local storage
chapters.summary: AsyncLocalStorage is a Node.js API (based on the asynchooks API) that provides an alternative way of propagating local state through the application without explicitly passing it as a function parameter.

blocks.md: `AsyncLocalStorage` is a [Node.js API](https://nodejs.org/api/async_context.html#class-asynclocalstorage) (based on the `async_hooks` API) that provides an alternative way of propagating local state through the application without explicitly passing it as a function parameter. It's similar to thread-local storage in other languages.
blocks.text: AsyncLocalStorage is a Node.js API (based on the async_hooks API) that provides an alternative way of propagating local state through the application without explicitly passing it as a function parameter. It's similar to thread-local storage in other languages.
blocks.zh: `AsyncLocalStorage` 是一个 [Node.js API](https://nodejs.org/api/async_context.html#class-asynclocalstorage)（基于 `async_hooks`API）提供了一种通过应用程序传播局部状态的替代方法，而无需将其显式地作为函数参数传递。它类似于其他语言中的线程本地存储。

blocks.md: The main idea of Async Local Storage is that you can _wrap_ a function call with the `AsyncLocalStorage#run` call. All code invoked within the wrapped call gets access to the same `store`, which is unique to each call chain.
blocks.text: The main idea of Async Local Storage is that you can _wrap_ a function call with the AsyncLocalStorage#run call. All code invoked within the wrapped call gets access to the same store, which is unique to each call chain.
blocks.zh: 异步本地存储的主要思想是，您可以使用 `AsyncLocalStorage#run` 呼吁。包装调用中调用的所有代码都可以访问相同的 `store`，这是每个调用链唯一的。

blocks.md: In the context of NestJS, this means that if you find a place within the request's lifecycle to wrap the rest of the request's code, you can access and modify state visible only to that request. This can serve as an alternative to REQUEST-scoped providers, avoiding some of their limitations.
blocks.text: In the context of NestJS, this means that if you find a place within the request's lifecycle to wrap the rest of the request's code, you can access and modify state visible only to that request. This can serve as an alternative to REQUEST-scoped providers, avoiding some of their limitations.
blocks.zh: 在以下背景下 NestJS 这意味着，如果在请求的生命周期中找到一个位置来包装请求的其余部分代码，则可以访问和修改只有该请求可见的状态。这可以作为替代方案 REQUEST-范围内的提供者，避免了它们的一些限制。

blocks.md: Alternatively, you can use ALS to propagate context for only a part of the system (e.g., the _transaction_ object) without passing it around explicitly across services, which can increase isolation and encapsulation.
blocks.text: Alternatively, you can use ALS to propagate context for only a part of the system (e.g., the _transaction_ object) without passing it around explicitly across services, which can increase isolation and encapsulation.
blocks.zh: 或者，您可以使用 ALS 仅传播系统的一部分（例如_transaction_对象）的上下文，而不显式地跨服务传递上下文，这会增加隔离和封装。

blocks.md: If your application is instrumented with [NestJS Observe](/observability/overview), you already have a request-scoped store and don't need to build one. See the [NestJS Observe](/recipes/async-local-storage#nestjs-observe) section below.

blocks.md: NestJS Observe
blocks.text: NestJS Observe
blocks.zh: NestJS 观察

blocks.md: If you run [NestJS Observe](/observability/overview), the `@nestjs/observe` SDK already maintains an `AsyncLocalStorage` store for every request, job, and message it instruments. This store carries the trace context through your call stack. `TracerService` exposes it, so request-scoped state is something you read and write rather than something you set up: there's no module to write, no middleware to mount, and nothing to re-wire per transport.

blocks.md: `setAttribute(key, value)` writes to the current context store, and `getAttribute(key)` reads the value back from anywhere downstream on the same request (a different service, a guard, or an interceptor) without threading it through every function signature:

blocks.md: `getAttribute()` returns `undefined` for a key that was never set. Both methods throw when called outside a traced context, since there's no store to read from or write to. If a value may legitimately be read before any request exists, guard the call accordingly.

chapters.title: Serverless
chapters.summary: Serverless computing is a cloud computing execution model in which the cloud provider allocates machine resources on demand, managing the servers on behalf of its customers.

blocks.md: Serverless computing is a cloud computing execution model in which the cloud provider allocates machine resources on demand, managing the servers on behalf of its customers. When an app is not in use, no computing resources are allocated to it. Pricing is based on the actual amount of resources the application consumes ([source](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Serverless_computing)).
blocks.text: Serverless computing is a cloud computing execution model in which the cloud provider allocates machine resources on demand, managing the servers on behalf of its customers. When an app is not in use, no computing resources are allocated to it. Pricing is based on the actual amount of resources the application consumes (source).
blocks.zh: 无服务器计算是一种云计算执行模型，其中云提供者按需分配机器资源，代表其客户管理服务器。当应用程序未使用时，不会为其分配任何计算资源。定价基于应用程序消耗的实际资源量（[来源](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Serverless_computing)）。

blocks.md: With a **serverless architecture**, you focus on the individual functions in your application code. Services such as AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions, and Microsoft Azure Functions manage the physical hardware, the virtual machine operating system, and the web server software.
blocks.text: With a serverless architecture, you focus on the individual functions in your application code. Services such as AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions, and Microsoft Azure Functions manage the physical hardware, the virtual machine operating system, and the web server software.
blocks.zh: 使用**无服务器架构**，您可以专注于应用程序代码中的单个功能。服务，例如 AWSLambda、Google Cloud 功能和 Microsoft Azure 功能管理物理硬件、虚拟机操作系统和 web 服务器软件。

blocks.md: Cold start
blocks.text: Cold start
blocks.zh: 冷启动

blocks.md:
A cold start is the first time your code runs in a while. Depending on your cloud provider, it may span several operations, from downloading the code and bootstrapping the runtime to running your code.
This process adds **significant latency**, depending on several factors such as the language and the number of packages your application requires.
blocks.text: A cold start is the first time your code runs in a while. Depending on your cloud provider, it may span several operations, from downloading the code and bootstrapping the runtime to running your code. This process adds significant latency, depending on several factors such as the language and the number of packages your application requires.
blocks.zh:
冷启动是指您的代码在一段时间内第一次运行。根据您的云提供者，它可能跨越几个操作，从下载代码和引导运行时到运行代码。
这个过程会增加**显著的延迟**，这取决于几个因素，如语言和应用程序所需的包数量。

blocks.md: Some of these factors are beyond your control, but there's still a lot you can do on your side to keep the cold start as short as possible.
blocks.text: Some of these factors are beyond your control, but there's still a lot you can do on your side to keep the cold start as short as possible.
blocks.zh: 其中一些因素是你无法控制的，但你仍然可以做很多事情来尽可能缩短冷启动期。

blocks.md: Runtime optimizations
blocks.text: Runtime optimizations
blocks.zh: 运行时优化

blocks.md: So far, we've covered compile-time optimizations. These are unrelated to the way you define providers and load Nest modules in your application, which plays an essential role as your application grows.
blocks.text: So far, we've covered compile-time optimizations. These are unrelated to the way you define providers and load Nest modules in your application, which plays an essential role as your application grows.
blocks.zh: 到目前为止，我们已经介绍了编译时的优化。这些与定义提供程序和加载方式无关 Nest 应用程序中的模块，随着应用程序的增长，模块起着至关重要的作用。

blocks.md:
For example, imagine a database connection defined as an [asynchronous provider](/fundamentals/async-providers). Async providers are designed to delay the application start until one or more asynchronous tasks complete.
If your serverless function needs 2s on average to connect to the database on bootstrap, your endpoint needs at least two extra seconds to send a response on a cold start, because it must wait until the connection is established.
blocks.text: For example, imagine a database connection defined as an asynchronous provider. Async providers are designed to delay the application start until one or more asynchronous tasks complete. If your serverless function needs 2s on average to connect to the database on bootstrap, your endpoint needs at least two extra seconds to send a response on a cold start, because it must wait until the connection is established.
blocks.zh:
例如，假设数据库连接被定义为 [异步提供程序](/fundamentals/async-providers)。异步提供程序旨在延迟应用程序启动，直到一个或多个异步任务完成。
如果您的无服务器函数在引导时平均需要 2 秒才能连接到数据库，那么您的端点至少需要额外的两秒钟才能在冷启动时发送响应，因为它必须等到连接建立。

blocks.md:
In a **serverless environment**, where bootstrap time matters, you structure your providers somewhat differently.
For example, if you use Redis for caching only in certain scenarios, you probably shouldn't define the Redis connection as an async provider: it would slow down bootstrap even for function invocations that don't need it.
blocks.text: In a serverless environment, where bootstrap time matters, you structure your providers somewhat differently. For example, if you use Redis for caching only in certain scenarios, you probably shouldn't define the Redis connection as an async provider: it would slow down bootstrap even for function invocations that don't need it.
blocks.zh:
在**无服务器环境**中，引导时间很重要，您会略有不同地构建您的提供者。
例如，如果您使用 Redis 对于仅在某些情况下缓存，您可能不应该定义 Redis 作为异步提供程序的连接：即使对于不需要它的函数调用，它也会减慢引导速度。

blocks.md:
You can also lazy load entire modules with the `LazyModuleLoader` class, as described in the [lazy-loading modules](/fundamentals/lazy-loading-modules) chapter. Caching is a good example here too.
Imagine that your application has a `CacheModule` that connects to Redis and exports a `CacheService` for interacting with the Redis storage. If not every function invocation needs it,
you can load it lazily, on demand. This way, all invocations that don't require caching get a faster startup time on a cold start.
blocks.text: You can also lazy load entire modules with the LazyModuleLoader class, as described in the lazy-loading modules chapter. Caching is a good example here too. Imagine that your application has a CacheModule that connects to Redis and exports a CacheService for interacting with the Redis storage. If not every function invocation needs it, you can load it lazily, on demand. This way, all invocations that don't require caching get a faster startup time on a cold start.
blocks.zh:
还可以使用 `LazyModuleLoader` 类，如中所述 [延迟加载模块](/fundamentals/lazy-loading-modules) 篇章。缓存在这里也是一个很好的例子。
假设您的应用程序有一个 `CacheModule` 连接到 Redis 并出口 a`CacheService` 与 Redis 存储。如果不是每个函数调用都需要它，
你可以按需懒洋洋地加载它。这样，所有不需要缓存的调用在冷启动时都能获得更快的启动时间。

blocks.md:
Another example is a webhook or worker that performs different operations depending on specific conditions (e.g., input arguments).
In this case, you can add a condition inside your route handler that lazily loads the appropriate module for the specific function invocation, and load every other module lazily as well.
blocks.text: Another example is a webhook or worker that performs different operations depending on specific conditions (e.g., input arguments). In this case, you can add a condition inside your route handler that lazily loads the appropriate module for the specific function invocation, and load every other module lazily as well.
blocks.zh:
另一个例子是 webhook 或 worker，它根据特定条件（例如，输入参数）执行不同的操作。
在这种情况下，您可以在路由处理程序中添加一个条件，该条件为特定函数调用延迟加载适当的模块，并延迟加载所有其他模块。

blocks.md: Example integration
blocks.text: Example integration
blocks.zh: 示例集成

blocks.md:
What your application's entry file (typically `main.ts`) should look like **depends on several factors**, so **there's no single template** that works for every scenario.
For example, the initialization file required to spin up your serverless function varies by cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.).
Also, your application's code looks different depending on whether you want to run a typical HTTP application with multiple routes/endpoints or provide a single route (or execute a specific portion of code).
For example, for the endpoint-per-function approach, you could use `NestFactory.createApplicationContext()` instead of booting the HTTP server, setting up middleware, etc.
blocks.text: What your application's entry file (typically main.ts) should look like depends on several factors, so there's no single template that works for every scenario. For example, the initialization file required to spin up your serverless function varies by cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.). Also, your application's code looks different depending on whether you want to run a typical HTTP application with multiple routes/endpoints or provide a single route (or execute a specific portion of code). For example, for the endpoint-per-function approach, you could use NestFactory.createApplicationContext() instead of booting the HTTP server, setting up middleware, etc.
blocks.zh:
应用程序的条目文件（通常是 `main.ts`）应该看起来像**取决于几个因素**，所以**没有单一的模板**适用于每个场景。

with the [Serverless](https://www.serverless.com/) framework (in this case, targeting AWS Lambda). As mentioned earlier, your code will differ depending on the cloud provider you choose, among many other factors.

blocks.text: To speed up development cycles, we install the serverless-offline plugin, which emulates AWS Lambda and API Gateway locally.
blocks.zh: 为了加快开发周期，我们安装了 `serverless-offline` 插件，它模拟 AWSλ和 API 本地网关。

blocks.md: Once the installation is complete, create the `serverless.yml` file to configure the Serverless framework:
blocks.text: Once the installation is complete, create the serverless.yml file to configure the Serverless framework:
blocks.zh: 安装完成后，创建 `serverless.yml` 配置无服务器框架的文件：

blocks.code:
service: serverless-example

plugins:
  - serverless-offline

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: nodejs22.x

functions:
  main:
    handler: dist/main.handler
    events:
      - http:
          method: ANY
          path: /
      - http:
          method: ANY
          path: '{proxy+}'

The sections above show that bundling your app with `webpack` can have a significant impact on the overall bootstrap time.
To make it work with this example, the bundle must expose the exported `handler` function. Starting with `@nestjs/cli` v12.0.8, the default `webpack` configuration does this by setting `output.library.type` to `commonjs2`, as long as your `webpack.config.js` keeps `...options.output` when it overrides `output`.
With older versions of the CLI, or with a configuration that doesn't extend `options.output`, add a few more settings to your `webpack.config.js` file. In particular, set the `output.libraryTarget` property to `commonjs2`.

chapters.title: HTTP adapter
chapters.summary: Occasionally, you may need to access the underlying HTTP server, either from within the Nest application context or from outside of it.

blocks.md: Occasionally, you may need to access the underlying HTTP server, either from within the Nest application context or from outside of it.
blocks.text: Occasionally, you may need to access the underlying HTTP server, either from within the Nest application context or from outside of it.
blocks.zh: 有时，您可能需要访问底层 HTTP 服务器，或者来自 Nest 应用程序上下文或来自应用程序上下文之外。

blocks.md: Every native (platform-specific) HTTP server or library instance (e.g., Express or Fastify) is wrapped in an **adapter**. The adapter is registered as a globally available provider, so you can retrieve it from the application context or inject it into other providers.
blocks.text: Every native (platform-specific) HTTP server or library instance (e.g., Express or Fastify) is wrapped in an adapter. The adapter is registered as a globally available provider, so you can retrieve it from the application context or inject it into other providers.
blocks.zh: 每个本机（特定于平台）HTTP 服务器或库实例（例如，Express 或者 Fastify）被包装在一个**适配器**中。适配器注册为全局可用的提供程序，因此您可以从应用程序上下文中检索它或将其注入到其他提供程序中。

chapters.title: Keep-Alive connections
chapters.summary: By default, the NestJS HTTP adapters wait until responses have finished before closing the application.

blocks.md: By default, the NestJS HTTP adapters wait until responses have finished before closing the application. Sometimes this behavior is unwanted or unexpected: some requests use `Connection: Keep-Alive` headers and keep their connections open for a long time.
blocks.text: By default, the NestJS HTTP adapters wait until responses have finished before closing the application. Sometimes this behavior is unwanted or unexpected: some requests use Connection: Keep-Alive headers and keep their connections open for a long time.
blocks.zh: 默认情况下，NestJSHTTP 适配器会等到响应完成后再关闭应用程序。有时这种行为是不需要的或出乎意料的：有些请求使用 `Connection: Keep-Alive` 头并保持它们的连接长时间打开。

blocks.md: If you want your application to always exit without waiting for these connections to end, enable the `forceCloseConnections` option when creating your NestJS application.
blocks.text: If you want your application to always exit without waiting for these connections to end, enable the forceCloseConnections option when creating your NestJS application.
blocks.zh: 如果希望应用程序总是退出，而不必等待这些连接结束，请启用 `forceCloseConnections` 创建您的 NestJS 应用。

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md: Most users don't need this option. The typical symptom that you do is an application that doesn't exit when you expect it to, usually with `app.enableShutdownHooks()` enabled, and most often during development when running with `--watch`.
blocks.text: Most users don't need this option. The typical symptom that you do is an application that doesn't exit when you expect it to, usually with app.enableShutdownHooks() enabled, and most often during development when running with --watch.
blocks.zh: 大多数用户不需要这个选项。您遇到的典型症状是应用程序不会在您期望的时候退出，通常启用了 `app.enableShutdownHooks()`，最常见的是在使用 `--watch` 运行的开发过程中。

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md: The `path` property supports wildcard parameters through the [path-to-regexp](https://github.com/pillarjs/path-to-regexp#parameters) package. Bare wildcard asterisks (`*`) are deprecated; use parameters (`:param`) or named wildcards (`*splat`) instead. A named wildcard requires at least one extra segment, so `health/*splat` excludes `/health/status` but not `/health` itself. To exclude both, wrap the wildcard in braces: `health/{*splat}`.

chapters.title: Request lifecycle
chapters.summary: Nest applications handle requests and produce responses in a sequence called the request lifecycle.

blocks.md: Nest applications handle requests and produce responses in a sequence called the **request lifecycle**. With middleware, pipes, guards, and interceptors in play, it can be challenging to track down where a particular piece of code runs during the request lifecycle, especially when global, controller-level, and route-level components are combined. In general, a request flows through middleware, then guards, then interceptors, then pipes, and finally back through interceptors on the return path (as the response is generated).
blocks.text: Nest applications handle requests and produce responses in a sequence called the request lifecycle. With middleware, pipes, guards, and interceptors in play, it can be challenging to track down where a particular piece of code runs during the request lifecycle, especially when global, controller-level, and route-level components are combined. In general, a request flows through middleware, then guards, then interceptors, then pipes, and finally back through interceptors on the return path (as the response is generated).
blocks.zh: Nest 应用程序按照称为**请求生命周期**的顺序处理请求并生成响应。在使用中间件、管道、防护和拦截器的情况下，跟踪特定代码在请求生命周期中的运行位置可能具有挑战性，尤其是当组合了全局、控制器级和路由级组件时。一般来说，请求流经中间件，然后是防护，然后是拦截器，然后是管道，最后在返回路径上通过拦截器返回（生成响应时）。

blocks.md: Middleware
blocks.text: Middleware
blocks.zh: 中间件

blocks.md: Middleware runs in a specific sequence. First, Nest runs globally bound middleware (such as middleware bound with `app.use()`), and then it runs [module-bound middleware](/middleware), which is matched by path. Middleware runs sequentially in the order it is bound, just like middleware in Express. For middleware bound in different modules, middleware from global modules (decorated with `@Global()`) runs first, then middleware bound in the root module, followed by middleware from the other modules, ordered by their distance from the root module in the import graph.
blocks.text: Middleware runs in a specific sequence. First, Nest runs globally bound middleware (such as middleware bound with app.use()), and then it runs module-bound middleware, which is matched by path. Middleware runs sequentially in the order it is bound, just like middleware in Express. For middleware bound in different modules, middleware from global modules (decorated with @Global()) runs first, then middleware bound in the root module, followed by middleware from the other modules, ordered by their distance from the root module in the import graph.
blocks.zh: 中间件以特定的顺序运行。首先， Nest 运行全局绑定的中间件（例如与 `app.use()`），然后它运行 [模块绑定中间件](/middleware)，由路径匹配。中间件按照绑定的顺序顺序运行，就像中间件一样 Express.对于绑定在不同模块中的中间件，来自全局模块的中间件（用 `@Global()`）首先运行，然后是绑定在根模块中的中间件，然后是来自其他模块的中间件，按照它们在导入图中与根模块的距离排序。

blocks.text: Guards

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md: "Global", "controller", and "route" refer to where the guard (or other component) is bound. A component registered with `app.useGlobalGuards()` (or a similar method), or provided through a module with the `APP_GUARD` token (or a similar token), is globally bound. Otherwise, it is bound to a controller if the decorator precedes a controller class, or to a route if the decorator precedes a route handler.

A component registered with app.useGlobalGuards() (or a similar method), or provided through a module with the APP_GUARD token (or a similar token), is globally bound. Otherwise, it is bound to a controller if the decorator precedes a controller class, or to a route if the decorator precedes a route handler.
blocks.zh: “全局”、“控制器”和“路由”是指防护（或其他组件）的绑定位置。注册的组件 `app.useGlobalGuards()`（或类似方法），或通过具有 `APP_GUARD` 令牌（或类似的令牌）是全局绑定的。否则，如果装饰器位于控制器类之前，则绑定到控制器；如果装饰器位于路由处理程序之前，则绑定到路由。

blocks.md: Interceptors
blocks.text: Interceptors
blocks.zh: 拦截器

blocks.md: Interceptors mostly follow the same pattern as guards, with one difference: because interceptors return [RxJS Observables](https://github.com/ReactiveX/rxjs), the observables are resolved in a first-in, last-out manner. Inbound requests go through the standard global, controller, route order, but the response side (i.e., after the route handler returns) is resolved from route to controller to global. Also, any errors thrown by pipes, controllers, or services can be read in an interceptor's `catchError` operator.
blocks.text: Interceptors mostly follow the same pattern as guards, with one difference: because interceptors return RxJS Observables, the observables are resolved in a first-in, last-out manner. Inbound requests go through the standard global, controller, route order, but the response side (i.e., after the route handler returns) is resolved from route to controller to global. Also, any errors thrown by pipes, controllers, or services can be read in an interceptor's catchError operator.
blocks.zh: 拦截器大多遵循与后卫相同的模式，只有一个不同：因为拦截器返回 [RxJS Observables](https://github.com/ReactiveX/rxjs)，可观测值以先进后出的方式解决。入站请求经过标准的全局、控制器、路由顺序，但是响应端（即，在路由处理程序返回之后）从路由到控制器再到全局进行解析。此外，管道、控制器或服务引发的任何错误都可以在拦截器中读取 `catchError` 经营者。

blocks.md: Filters
blocks.text: Filters
blocks.zh: 过滤器

blocks.md: Filters are the only component that don't resolve global first. Instead, filters resolve from the lowest level possible: Nest checks route-bound filters first, then controller-level filters, and finally global filters. Exceptions can't be passed from filter to filter; if a route-level filter catches the exception, a controller-level or global filter can't catch the same exception. To achieve a similar effect, use inheritance between the filters.
blocks.text: Filters are the only component that don't resolve global first. Instead, filters resolve from the lowest level possible: Nest checks route-bound filters first, then controller-level filters, and finally global filters. Exceptions can't be passed from filter to filter; if a route-level filter catches the exception, a controller-level or global filter can't catch the same exception. To achieve a similar effect, use inheritance between the filters.
blocks.zh: 过滤器是唯一不首先解析全局的组件。相反，过滤器从可能的最低级别进行解析：Nest 首先检查路由绑定过滤器，然后检查控制器级过滤器，最后检查全局过滤器。异常不能从过滤器传递到过滤器；如果路由级筛选器捕获异常，则控制器级或全局筛选器无法捕获相同的异常。要达到类似的效果，请在过滤器之间使用继承。

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md: Filters run only when an uncaught exception occurs during request processing. Exceptions you catch yourself (e.g., with `try/catch`) don't trigger exception filters. As soon as an uncaught exception is encountered, the rest of the lifecycle is skipped and the request goes straight to the filter. Exceptions thrown from [middleware](/middleware#error-handling) are handled by the exceptions layer as well, but only **global** exception filters apply, because middleware runs before a route handler is selected.

As soon as an uncaught exception is encountered, the rest of the lifecycle is skipped and the request goes straight to the filter. Exceptions thrown from middleware are handled by the exceptions layer as well, but only global exception filters apply, because middleware runs before a route handler is selected.
blocks.zh: 过滤器仅在请求处理过程中发生未捕获的异常时才运行。您发现自己的例外（例如，`try/catch`) 不触发异常筛选器。一旦遇到未捕获的异常，生命周期的其余部分将被跳过，请求将直接进入过滤器。从 [中间件](/middleware#error-handling) 也由异常层处理，但只有**全局**异常过滤器适用，因为中间件在选择路由处理程序之前运行。

chapters.title: Common errors
chapters.summary: While learning and working with NestJS, you may run into the errors described on this page.

blocks.md: While learning and working with NestJS, you may run into the errors described on this page.
blocks.text: While learning and working with NestJS, you may run into the errors described on this page.
blocks.zh: 在学习和工作时 NestJS，您可能会遇到本页所述的错误。

blocks.md: "Cannot resolve dependency" error
blocks.text: "Cannot resolve dependency" error
blocks.zh: “无法解析依赖关系”错误

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md: [NestJS Devtools](/devtools/overview#debugging-cannot-resolve-dependency-errors) can help you resolve the "Cannot resolve dependency" error.
blocks.text: NestJS Devtools can help you resolve the "Cannot resolve dependency" error.
blocks.zh: [NestJS Devtools](/devtools/overview#debugging-cannot-resolve-dependency-errors) 可以帮助您解决“无法解决依赖项”错误。

blocks.md: The most common error message says that Nest can't resolve the dependencies of a provider. It usually looks like this:
blocks.text: The most common error message says that Nest can't resolve the dependencies of a provider. It usually looks like this:
blocks.zh: 最常见的错误信息是 Nest 无法解析提供程序的依赖项。它通常看起来像这样：

blocks.md: The most common cause is that `<unknown_token>` is not available in `<module>`: it is neither listed in the module's `providers` array nor exported by one of the modules in its `imports` array. Make sure the provider is registered and follows [standard NestJS provider practices](/fundamentals/custom-providers#di-fundamentals).
blocks.text: The most common cause is that is not available in : it is neither listed in the module's providers array nor exported by one of the modules in its imports array. Make sure the provider is registered and follows standard NestJS provider practices.
blocks.zh: 最常见的原因是 `<unknown_token>` 在 `<module>` 中不可用：它既没有列在模块的 `providers` 数组中，也没有由其中一个模块在其 `imports` 数组中导出。确保提供程序已注册并遵循 [standard NestJS provider practices](/fundamentals/custom-providers#di-fundamentals)。

blocks.md: Another common mistake is putting a provider in a module's `imports` array. If the class is decorated with `@Injectable()`, Nest detects this at startup and throws an error stating that the class cannot appear in the "imports" array; move it to the `providers` array instead.
blocks.text: Another common mistake is putting a provider in a module's imports array. If the class is decorated with @Injectable(), Nest detects this at startup and throws an error stating that the class cannot appear in the "imports" array; move it to the providers array instead.
blocks.zh: 另一个常见的错误是将提供程序放在模块的 `imports` 阵列。如果班级装饰有 `@Injectable()`,Nest 在启动时检测到这一点，并抛出一个错误，说明该类不能出现在“imports”数组中；将其移动到 `providers` 而是数组。

blocks.md: When you run into this error, open the module named in the error message and review its `providers`. For each provider in the `providers` array, make sure the module has access to all of its dependencies. Providers are often duplicated in a feature module and the root module, which makes Nest try to instantiate the provider twice. In most cases, you should remove the duplicate and add the module that contains the `<provider>` to the root module's `imports` array instead.
blocks.text: When you run into this error, open the module named in the error message and review its providers. For each provider in the providers array, make sure the module has access to all of its dependencies. Providers are often duplicated in a feature module and the root module, which makes Nest try to instantiate the provider twice. In most cases, you should remove the duplicate and add the module that contains the to the root module's imports array instead.
blocks.zh: 当您遇到此错误时，请打开错误消息中命名的模块并查看其 `providers`。对于 `providers` 数组中的每个提供程序，确保模块可以访问其所有依赖项。提供程序经常在特征模块和根模块中复制，这使得 Nest 尝试两次实例化提供程序。在大多数情况下，您应该删除重复项，并将包含 `<provider>` 的模块添加到根模块的 `imports` 数组中。

blocks.md: Also make sure you didn't inject a provider into itself: self-injection is not allowed in NestJS. When this happens, `<unknown_token>` is usually equal to `<provider>`.
blocks.text: Also make sure you didn't inject a provider into itself: self-injection is not allowed in NestJS. When this happens, is usually equal to .
blocks.zh: 还要确保您没有将提供程序注入自身：NestJS 中不允许自我注入。当发生这种情况时，`<unknown_token>` 通常等于 `<provider>`。

blocks.md: If the dependency at the reported index resolves to `undefined` or `Object` at runtime, the error message omits the token name, refers to the **current** module, and lists a different set of potential solutions:
blocks.text: If the dependency at the reported index resolves to undefined or Object at runtime, the error message omits the token name, refers to the current module, and lists a different set of potential solutions:
blocks.zh: 如果报告索引处的依赖关系解析为 `undefined` 或者 `Object` 在运行时，错误消息会省略令牌名称，引用**当前**模块，并列出一组不同的潜在解决方案：

blocks.code:
Nest can't resolve dependencies of the <provider> (?). Please make sure that the argument at index [<index>] is available in the current module.

Potential solutions:
- The dependency at index [<index>] appears to be undefined at runtime
- This commonly occurs when using 'import type' instead of 'import' for injectable classes
...

blocks.md: This usually has one of the following causes:
blocks.text: This usually has one of the following causes:
blocks.zh: 这通常有以下原因之一：

blocks.md:
1. **A circular file import.** Unlike the [circular dependency](/faq/common-errors#circular-dependency-error) described below, the providers don't depend on each other in their constructors; two files end up importing each other. For example, a module file declares a token and imports a provider, and the provider imports that token constant from the module file. If you use barrel files, make sure your barrel imports don't create such circular imports.
2. **Injecting by a type or an interface.** Types and interfaces don't exist at runtime, so Nest can't use them as injection tokens. Inject the class reference instead, or use a custom token with the `@Inject()` decorator (see [custom providers](/fundamentals/custom-providers)).
3. **Type-only imports.** For class-based providers, import the concrete class instead of only its type with the [`import type ...`](https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/release-notes/typescript-3-8.html#type-only-imports-and-export) syntax.
blocks.text: A circular file import. Unlike the circular dependency described below, the providers don't depend on each other in their constructors; two files end up importing each other. For example, a module file declares a token and imports a provider, and the provider imports that token constant from the module file. If you use barrel files, make sure your barrel imports don't create such circular imports. Injecting by a type or an interface. Types and interfaces don't exist at runtime, so Nest can't use them as injection tokens. Inject the class reference instead, or use a custom token with the @Inject() decorator (see custom providers). Type-only imports. For class-based providers, import the concrete class instead of only its type with the import type ... syntax.
blocks.zh:
1. **循环文件导入。**与 [循环依赖性](/faq/common-errors#circular-dependency-error) 如下所述，提供者在他们的构造函数中并不相互依赖；两个文件最终会相互导入。例如，模块文件声明一个令牌并导入一个提供程序，而提供程序从模块文件导入该令牌常量。如果使用桶文件，请确保您的桶导入不会创建此类循环导入。
2. **通过类型或接口进行注入。**类型和接口在运行时不存在，因此 Nest 不能将它们用作注入标记。改为注入类引用，或者使用带有 `@Inject()` 装饰器的自定义令牌（参见 [定制提供者](/fundamentals/custom-providers)）。
3. **仅导入类型。**对于基于类的提供程序，使用 [`import type ...`](https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/release-notes/typescript-3-8.html#type-only-imports-and-export) 句法。

blocks.md: In a **monorepo setup**, you may see the same error for the core `ModuleRef` provider as the `<unknown_token>`:
blocks.text: In a monorepo setup, you may see the same error for the core ModuleRef provider as the :
blocks.zh: 在**monorepo 设置**中，您可能会看到核心 `ModuleRef` 提供程序与 `<unknown_token>` 相同的错误：

blocks.code:
Nest can't resolve dependencies of the <provider> (?).
Please make sure that the argument ModuleRef at index [<index>] is available in the <module> module.
...

blocks.md: This usually happens when your project loads two copies of the `@nestjs/core` package, like this:
blocks.text: This usually happens when your project loads two copies of the @nestjs/core package, like this:
blocks.zh: 当项目加载两个副本时，通常会发生这种情况 `@nestjs/core` 包，如下所示：

blocks.code:
.
├── package.json
├── apps
│   └── api
│       └── node_modules
│           └── @nestjs/bull
│               └── node_modules
│                   └── @nestjs/core
└── node_modules
    ├── (other packages)
    └── @nestjs/core

blocks.md: Solutions:
blocks.text: Solutions:
blocks.zh: 解决方案：

blocks.md:
- For **Yarn** workspaces, use the [nohoist feature](https://classic.yarnpkg.com/blog/2018/02/15/nohoist) to prevent hoisting the `@nestjs/core` package.
- For **pnpm** workspaces, declare `@nestjs/core` as a peer dependency in your other module, and set `"dependenciesMeta": {"other-module-name": {"injected": true }}` in the package.json of the app that imports the module. See [dependenciesMeta.injected](https://pnpm.io/package_json#dependenciesmetainjected) in the pnpm documentation.
blocks.text: For Yarn workspaces, use the nohoist feature to prevent hoisting the @nestjs/core package. For pnpm workspaces, declare @nestjs/core as a peer dependency in your other module, and set "dependenciesMeta": {"other-module-name": {"injected": true }} in the package.json of the app that imports the module. See dependenciesMeta.injected in the pnpm documentation.
blocks.zh:
- 对于**Yarn**工作区，请使用 [nohoist 功能](https://classic.yarnpkg.com/blog/2018/02/15/nohoist) 防止吊装 `@nestjs/core` 包装。
- 对于**pnpm**工作区，声明 `@nestjs/core` 作为其他模块中的对等依赖项，并设置 `"dependenciesMeta": {"other-module-name": {"injected": true }}` 在 package.json 导入模块的应用程序。看 [dependenciesMeta.injected](https://pnpm.io/package_json#dependenciesmetainjected) 在 pnpm 文档中。

blocks.md: "Circular dependency" error
blocks.text: "Circular dependency" error
blocks.zh: “循环依赖”错误

blocks.md: Occasionally, you'll find it difficult to avoid [circular dependencies](/fundamentals/circular-dependency) in your application, and you'll need to help Nest resolve them. Errors caused by circular dependencies look like this:
blocks.text: Occasionally, you'll find it difficult to avoid circular dependencies in your application, and you'll need to help Nest resolve them. Errors caused by circular dependencies look like this:
blocks.zh: 偶尔，你会发现很难避免 [循环依赖关系](/fundamentals/circular-dependency) 在您的应用程序中，您需要帮助 Nest 解决它们。由循环依赖项引起的错误如下所示：

blocks.code:
Nest cannot create the <module> instance.
The module at index [<index>] of the <module> "imports" array is undefined.

Potential causes:
- A circular dependency between modules. Use forwardRef() to avoid it. Read more: https://docs.nestjs.com/fundamentals/circular-dependency
- The module at index [<index>] is of type "undefined". Check your import statements and the type of the module.

Scope [<module_import_chain>]
# example chain AppModule -> FooModule

blocks.md: Circular dependencies can arise from providers that depend on each other, or from TypeScript files that depend on each other for constants (e.g., a module file exports a constant that a service file imports). In the latter case, move the constants to a separate file. In the former case, follow the [circular dependency](/fundamentals/circular-dependency) guide and make sure that both the modules **and** the providers are wrapped with `forwardRef()`.
blocks.text: Circular dependencies can arise from providers that depend on each other, or from TypeScript files that depend on each other for constants (e.g., a module file exports a constant that a service file imports). In the latter case, move the constants to a separate file. In the former case, follow the circular dependency guide and make sure that both the modules and the providers are wrapped with forwardRef().
blocks.zh: 循环依赖关系可以来自相互依赖的提供程序，也可以来自相互依赖常量的 TypeScript 文件（例如，模块文件导出服务文件导入的常量）。在后一种情况下，将常量移动到单独的文件中。在前一种情况下，请遵循 [循环依赖性](/fundamentals/circular-dependency) 指南，并确保模块**和**提供程序都用 `forwardRef()` 包装。

blocks.md: Debugging dependency errors
blocks.text: Debugging dependency errors
blocks.zh: 调试相关性错误

blocks.md: Besides verifying your dependencies manually, you can set the `NEST_DEBUG` environment variable to any non-empty string to get extra logging while Nest resolves the application's dependencies.
blocks.text: Besides verifying your dependencies manually, you can set the NEST_DEBUG environment variable to any non-empty string to get extra logging while Nest resolves the application's dependencies.
blocks.zh: 除了手动验证依赖项之外，还可以设置 `NEST_DEBUG` 将环境变量转换为任何非空字符串以获取额外的日志记录 Nest 解析应用程序的依赖项。

blocks.md: In the image above, the string in yellow is the host class of the dependency being injected, the string in blue is the name (or injection token) of the injected dependency, and the string in purple is the module in which Nest searches for the dependency. With this output, you can usually trace the dependency resolution and find out why injection fails.
blocks.text: In the image above, the string in yellow is the host class of the dependency being injected, the string in blue is the name (or injection token) of the injected dependency, and the string in purple is the module in which Nest searches for the dependency. With this output, you can usually trace the dependency resolution and find out why injection fails.
blocks.zh: 在上图中，黄色字符串是被注入依赖项的主机类，蓝色字符串是被注入依赖项的名称（或注入令牌），紫色字符串是其中 Nest 搜索依赖项。有了这个输出，您通常可以跟踪依赖解析，并找出注入失败的原因。

blocks.md: "File change detected" loops endlessly
blocks.text: "File change detected" loops endlessly
blocks.zh: “检测到文件更改”无休止地循环

blocks.md: Windows users on TypeScript 4.9 or later may encounter this problem. When you run your application in watch mode (e.g., `npm run start:dev`), you see an endless loop of the following log messages:
blocks.text: Windows users on TypeScript 4.9 or later may encounter this problem. When you run your application in watch mode (e.g., npm run start:dev), you see an endless loop of the following log messages:
blocks.zh: Windows 用户开启 TypeScript4.9 或更高版本可能会遇到此问题。当您在监视模式下运行应用程序时（例如，`npm run start:dev`)，您将看到以下日志消息的无尽循环：

blocks.code:
XX:XX:XX AM - File change detected. Starting incremental compilation...
XX:XX:XX AM - Found 0 errors. Watching for file changes.

blocks.md:
When you start your application in watch mode with the Nest CLI, it runs the TypeScript compiler in watch mode (the equivalent of `tsc --watch`). TypeScript 4.9 introduced a [new strategy](https://devblogs.microsoft.com/typescript/announcing-typescript-4-9/#file-watching-now-uses-file-system-events) for detecting file changes, which is the likely cause of this problem.
To fix it, add the following setting to your `tsconfig.json` file, after the `"compilerOptions"` option:
blocks.text: When you start your application in watch mode with the Nest CLI, it runs the TypeScript compiler in watch mode (the equivalent of tsc --watch). TypeScript 4.9 introduced a new strategy for detecting file changes, which is the likely cause of this problem. To fix it, add the following setting to your tsconfig.json file, after the "compilerOptions" option:
blocks.zh:
当您使用 NestCLI 在监视模式下启动应用程序时，它会在监视模式下运行 TypeScript 编译器（相当于 `tsc --watch`）。TypeScript4.9 引入了一个 [新战略](https://devblogs.microsoft.com/typescript/announcing-typescript-4-9/#file-watching-now-uses-file-system-events) 来检测文件更改，这可能是这个问题的原因。
要解决此问题，请在 `"compilerOptions"` 选项之后添加以下设置到 `tsconfig.json` 文件中：

blocks.md:
This tells TypeScript to poll for file changes instead of using file system events (the default since 4.9), which can cause issues on some machines.
To learn more, see the [`watchFile` option](https://www.typescriptlang.org/tsconfig#watch-watchFile) in the TypeScript documentation.

blocks.zh:
这说明 TypeScript 轮询文件更改，而不是使用文件系统事件（自 4.9 以来的默认设置），这可能会在某些计算机上导致问题。
要了解更多信息，请参阅 [`watchFile` option](https://www.typescriptlang.org/tsconfig#watch-watchFile) 在 TypeScript 文件。

chapters.title: Overview
chapters.summary: Nest Devtools gives you an interactive, always up-to-date view of your application's internals: modules, providers, controllers, and the routes and events that tie them together.

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md: This chapter covers the Nest Devtools integration with the Nest framework. If you are looking for the Devtools application, visit the [Devtools](https://devtools.nestjs.com) website.
blocks.text: This chapter covers the Nest Devtools integration with the Nest framework. If you are looking for the Devtools application, visit the Devtools website.
blocks.zh: 本章涵盖 NestDevtools 与 Nest 框架。如果您正在查找 Devtools 应用程序，请访问 [Devtools](https://devtools.nestjs.com) 网站。

blocks.md: Nest Devtools gives you an interactive, always up-to-date view of your application's internals: modules, providers, controllers, and the routes and events that tie them together. Instead of piecing that picture together from imports and constructor signatures, you get a live graph you can search, filter, and click through. This chapter walks you through connecting your local application to Devtools for the first time.
blocks.text: Nest Devtools gives you an interactive, always up-to-date view of your application's internals: modules, providers, controllers, and the routes and events that tie them together. Instead of piecing that picture together from imports and constructor signatures, you get a live graph you can search, filter, and click through. This chapter walks you through connecting your local application to Devtools for the first time.
blocks.zh: NestDevtools 为您提供了应用程序内部的交互式、始终最新的视图：模块、提供程序、控制器以及将它们联系在一起的路由和事件。你可以得到一个可以搜索、筛选和点击的实时图表，而不是从导入和构造函数签名中拼凑图片。本章将引导您首次将本地应用程序连接到 Devtools。

blocks.md: Getting started takes less than five minutes. Open your `main.ts` file and set the `snapshot` attribute to `true` in the application options object:
blocks.text: Getting started takes less than five minutes. Open your main.ts file and set the snapshot attribute to true in the application options object:
blocks.zh: 开始只需不到五分钟。打开你的 `main.ts` 文件并设置 `snapshot` 归因于 `true` 在应用程序选项对象中：

blocks.md: This tells Nest to collect the metadata Devtools needs to reconstruct and visualize your application's dependency graph.
blocks.text: This tells Nest to collect the metadata Devtools needs to reconstruct and visualize your application's dependency graph.
blocks.zh: 这说明 Nest 为了收集元数据，Devtools 需要重建和可视化应用程序的依赖图。

blocks.md: Next, install the Devtools integration package:
blocks.text: Next, install the Devtools integration package:
blocks.zh: 接下来，安装 Devtools 集成包：

blocks.code: $ npm i @nestjs/devtools-integration

blocks.md: With the package installed, open `app.module.ts` and import `DevtoolsModule`:
blocks.text: With the package installed, open app.module.ts and import DevtoolsModule:
blocks.zh: 安装软件包后，打开 `app.module.ts` 并导入 `DevtoolsModule`：

blocks.title: Note
blocks.md: We check `NODE_ENV` here because `DevtoolsModule` should never run in production.
blocks.text: We check NODE_ENV here because DevtoolsModule should never run in production.
blocks.zh: 我们检查 `NODE_ENV` 这里是因为 `DevtoolsModule` 永远不应该投入生产。

blocks.md: The `http` flag controls whether `DevtoolsModule` starts its introspection server at all. With the flag disabled, the module doesn't expose anything, which is the safety net you want if this configuration accidentally makes it past a review. The runtime overhead is negligible: with `snapshot` enabled, Nest collects the graph metadata once, while the application bootstraps, so your application's regular request handling is unaffected.
blocks.text: The http flag controls whether DevtoolsModule starts its introspection server at all. With the flag disabled, the module doesn't expose anything, which is the safety net you want if this configuration accidentally makes it past a review. The runtime overhead is negligible: with snapshot enabled, Nest collects the graph metadata once, while the application bootstraps, so your application's regular request handling is unaffected.
blocks.zh: 这个 `http` 标志控制是否 `DevtoolsModule` 启动内省服务器。禁用标志后，模块不会暴露任何内容，如果这种配置意外通过了审查，这就是您想要的安全网。运行时开销可以忽略不计：`snapshot` 启用，Nest 在应用程序引导时收集一次图形元数据，因此应用程序的常规请求处理不受影响。

blocks.md: Once `DevtoolsModule` is imported and your application is running (`npm run start:dev`), open [Devtools](https://devtools.nestjs.com) to see your introspected graph.
blocks.text: Once DevtoolsModule is imported and your application is running (npm run start:dev), open Devtools to see your introspected graph.
blocks.zh: 一次 `DevtoolsModule` 正在导入并且您的应用程序正在运行（`npm run start:dev`)，打开 [Devtools](https://devtools.nestjs.com) 看看你的自省图。

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md: Every module connects to `InternalCoreModule`, a global module that Nest always imports into the root module. Because it's registered globally, Nest draws an edge between it and every other module in your application. To declutter the view, select the **Hide global modules** checkbox in the sidebar.
blocks.text: Every module connects to InternalCoreModule, a global module that Nest always imports into the root module. Because it's registered globally, Nest draws an edge between it and every other module in your application. To declutter the view, select the Hide global modules checkbox in the sidebar.
blocks.zh: 每个模块连接到 `InternalCoreModule`，一个全局模块 Nest 总是导入到根模块中。因为它是全球注册的，Nest 在它和应用程序中的每个其他模块之间画一条边。要清理视图，请选中侧边栏中的**隐藏全局模块**复选框。

blocks.md: Under the hood, `DevtoolsModule` starts a lightweight HTTP server (on port 8000 by default) that the dashboard uses to introspect your application in real time. No extra configuration is required. If port 8000 is taken, pass a different one with the `port` option of `DevtoolsModule.register()`.
blocks.text: Under the hood, DevtoolsModule starts a lightweight HTTP server (on port 8000 by default) that the dashboard uses to introspect your application in real time. No extra configuration is required. If port 8000 is taken, pass a different one with the port option of DevtoolsModule.register().
blocks.zh: 在底层，`DevtoolsModule` 启动一个轻量级的 HTTP 服务器（默认情况下在端口 8000 上），仪表板使用该服务器实时内省您的应用程序。不需要额外的配置。如果端口 8000 被占用，请使用 `DevtoolsModule.register()` 的 `port` 选项传递另一个端口。

blocks.md: To confirm everything is wired up correctly, switch the graph view to "Classes". You should see something like this:

blocks.md: Click any node to open a popup with a **"Focus"** button that isolates it on the graph, or use the search bar in the sidebar to jump to a specific node.
blocks.text: Click any node to open a popup with a "Focus" button that isolates it on the graph, or use the search bar in the sidebar to jump to a specific node.
blocks.zh: 单击任何节点以打开带有**“焦点”**按钮的弹出窗口，该按钮将其隔离在图表上，或者使用侧边栏中的搜索栏跳转到特定节点。

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md: Clicking **Inspect** takes you to the `/debug` page with that node preselected, which is useful for digging into a specific provider or controller.
blocks.text: Clicking Inspect takes you to the /debug page with that node preselected, which is useful for digging into a specific provider or controller.

blocks.md: Slow bootstraps usually have a few common causes: heavy synchronous work inside a constructor, a provider awaiting a slow external call in `onModuleInit`, or a module instantiating far more dependencies than it needs. blocks.text: Slow bootstraps usually have a few common causes: heavy synchronous work inside a constructor, a provider awaiting a slow external call in onModuleInit, or a module instantiating far more dependencies than it needs. blocks.md: Think of it as a linter for your application's architecture: a fast way to catch issues before they catch you. Some of the built-in rules flag problems you'd otherwise discover the hard way: a controller carrying far more routes than its neighbors, a module pulling in an unusually large number of dependencies, a provider named `SomethingGuard` that was never registered as a guard, or a request-scoped provider that's a strong candidate for [durable providers](/fundamentals/injection-scopes#durable-providers). Your test suite won't catch any of these, but they are exactly the kind of thing that slows a codebase down over time.

blocks.md: Local usage is great for exploring your application as you build it, but the real payoff comes when Devtools becomes part of your delivery pipeline. CI/CD integration publishes a snapshot of your application's graph on every build. You get a running history of how your architecture evolves and, more importantly, an automatic report on every pull request that shows exactly what changed structurally. It's the difference between hoping a refactor didn't break anything and knowing it didn't.

blocks.md: Reports

blocks.md: Devtools generates a report for every build, **as long as** a matching snapshot already exists in the registry. If you open a pull request against `master` and a graph for `master` was already published, Devtools detects the differences and builds a report automatically. Otherwise, there's nothing to compare against yet.

blocks.md: Create a new workflow file in `.github/workflows` (for example, `publish-graph.yml`) with the following content:
blocks.text: Create a new workflow file in .github/workflows (for example, publish-graph.yml) with the following content:
blocks.zh: 中创建新的工作流文件 `.github/workflows`（例如，`publish-graph.yml`）具有以下内容：

blocks.code:
name: Devtools

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - '*'

jobs:
  publish:
    if: github.actor != 'dependabot[bot]'
    name: Publish graph
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'npm'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Setup Environment (PR)
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "COMMIT_SHA=${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}" >>\${GITHUB_ENV}
      - name: Setup Environment (Push)
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "COMMIT_SHA=\${GITHUB_SHA}" >> \${GITHUB_ENV}
      - name: Publish
        run: PUBLISH_GRAPH=true npm run start
        env:
          DEVTOOLS_API_KEY: CHANGE_THIS_TO_YOUR_API_KEY
          REPOSITORY_NAME: ${{ github.event.repository.name }}
          BRANCH_NAME: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
          TARGET_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}

chapters.title: Migration guide
chapters.summary: This article walks you through migrating from NestJS version 11 to version 12.

blocks.md: This article walks you through migrating from NestJS version 11 to version 12. Version 12 centers on ESM packages, updated CLI defaults, first-class support for [Standard Schema](https://standardschema.dev/)-based validation and serialization, and native [observability](/observability/overview) support.
blocks.text: This article walks you through migrating from NestJS version 11 to version 12. Version 12 centers on ESM packages, updated CLI defaults, first-class support for Standard Schema-based validation and serialization, and native observability support.
blocks.zh: 本文将向您介绍从 NestJS 版本 11 到版本 12。版本 12 以 ESM 更新的软件包 CLI 默认值，一流支持 [Standard Schema](https://standardschema.dev/)-基于验证和序列化，以及本机 [可观测性](/observability/overview) 支持。

blocks.md: Upgrading packages
blocks.text: Upgrading packages
blocks.zh: 升级包

blocks.md: Start by upgrading the Nest CLI itself, because the upgrade command used below ships with it:
blocks.text: Start by upgrading the Nest CLI itself, because the upgrade command used below ships with it:
blocks.zh: 首先升级 NestCLI 它本身，因为下面使用的升级命令与它一起：

blocks.code: $ npm i -g @nestjs/cli@latest @nestjs/schematics@latest

blocks.md: If your project keeps the CLI as a local dev dependency, update it there as well, together with TypeScript. `@nestjs/schematics` v12 requires TypeScript 6 as a peer dependency, so npm refuses to install it next to TypeScript 5:
blocks.text: If your project keeps the CLI as a local dev dependency, update it there as well, together with TypeScript. @nestjs/schematics v12 requires TypeScript 6 as a peer dependency, so npm refuses to install it next to TypeScript 5:
blocks.zh: 如果您的项目保持 CLI 作为本地开发依赖项，也在那里更新它，以及 TypeScript. `@nestjs/schematics` v12 要求 TypeScript 6 作为对等依赖项，因此 npm 拒绝将其安装在 TypeScript 5:

blocks.code: $ npm i -D @nestjs/cli@latest @nestjs/schematics@latest typescript@^6

blocks.md: If npm still reports a peer dependency conflict, your lockfile most likely pins an older `ts-jest` or `typescript-eslint` release that doesn't accept TypeScript 6. Both come with projects generated by the v11 CLI. Run `npm update ts-jest typescript-eslint` to move them to newer releases within their current ranges, then run the command above again.
blocks.text: If npm still reports a peer dependency conflict, your lockfile most likely pins an older ts-jest or typescript-eslint release that doesn't accept TypeScript 6. Both come with projects generated by the v11 CLI. Run npm update ts-jest typescript-eslint to move them to newer releases within their current ranges, then run the command above again.
blocks.zh: 如果 npm 仍然报告对等依赖关系冲突，则您的锁文件很可能固定一个较旧的 `ts-jest` 或者 `typescript-eslint` 不接受的版本 TypeScript 6. 两者都带有 v11 生成的项目 CLI.运行 `npm update ts-jest typescript-eslint` 要将它们移动到当前范围内的较新版本，请再次运行上面的命令。

blocks.md: With the latest CLI in place, run `nest upgrade` from the root of your project:
blocks.text: With the latest CLI in place, run nest upgrade from the root of your project:
blocks.zh: 最新的 CLI 就位，运行 `nest upgrade` 从项目的根源：

blocks.code: $ nest upgrade

blocks.md: The command moves every recognized `@nestjs/*` package to its v12-compatible major at once, so the framework, platform adapters, and companion packages stay in sync, and then installs them. It also bumps TypeScript to v6 and applies the mechanical parts of the migration described in this guide (`nest-cli.json` webpack options, the GraphQL `playground` and subscriptions transport changes, the NATS package swap, and `@nestjs/config` validation options). Finally, it prints a report of everything it changed, plus notes on the behavioral changes it can't migrate for you. To see that report without touching your files, run the command with `--dry-run` first. See [nest upgrade](/cli/usages#nest-upgrade) for the full list of steps and options.
blocks.text: The command moves every recognized @nestjs/* package to its v12-compatible major at once, so the framework, platform adapters, and companion packages stay in sync, and then installs them. It also bumps TypeScript to v6 and applies the mechanical parts of the migration described in this guide (nest-cli.json webpack options, the GraphQL playground and subscriptions transport changes, the NATS package swap, and @nestjs/config validation options). Finally, it prints a report of everything it changed, plus notes on the behavioral changes it can't migrate for you. To see that report without touching your files, run the command with --dry-run first. See nest upgrade for the full list of steps and options.
blocks.zh: 命令移动每个识别的 `@nestjs/*` 一次打包到其 v12 兼容的主要包，这样框架、平台适配器和配套包就会保持同步，然后安装它们。它还颠簸 TypeScript 到 v6，并应用本指南中描述的迁移的机械部分（`nest-cli.json`webpack 选项，GraphQL`playground` 和订阅传输更改，NATS 包交换，以及 `@nestjs/config` 验证选项）。最后，它会打印一份它所更改的所有内容的报告，以及它不能为您迁移的行为更改的注释。若要在不接触文件的情况下查看该报告，请使用 `--dry-run` 第一。看 [嵌套升级](/cli/usages#nest-upgrade) 有关步骤和选项的完整列表。

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md: `nest upgrade` replaces the manual [npm-check-updates (ncu)](https://npmjs.com/package/npm-check-updates) flow previously recommended here. You can still upgrade packages manually if you prefer; what matters is that every Nest package moves to the same major at once. The command only bumps the CLI dependency inside your project, which is why you upgrade the global binary first.
blocks.text: nest upgrade replaces the manual npm-check-updates (ncu) flow previously recommended here. You can still upgrade packages manually if you prefer; what matters is that every Nest package moves to the same major at once. The command only bumps the CLI dependency inside your project, which is why you upgrade the global binary first.
blocks.zh: `nest upgrade` 替换手册 [npm-check-updates (ncu)](https://npmjs.com/package/npm-check-updates) 之前在这里推荐的流程。如果您愿意，您仍然可以手动升级软件包；重要的是每一个 Nest 包一次移动到同一专业。该命令仅缓冲 CLI 项目内部的依赖关系，这就是为什么您首先升级全局二进制文件。

blocks.md: Node.js requirements
blocks.text: Node.js requirements
blocks.zh: Node.js 要求

blocks.md: The Node.js requirement differs depending on whether you are **running** an application or **generating** code with the CLI:
blocks.text: The Node.js requirement differs depending on whether you are running an application or generating code with the CLI:
blocks.zh: Node.js 要求因您是**运行**应用程序还是**生成**使用 CLI 的代码而异：

blocks.md:
| What you are doing | Minimum Node.js |
| --- | --- |
| Running a Nest 12 application | **v20.19+**, or **v22.12+** on the 22.x line |
| `nest new`, `nest generate`, `nest upgrade` (`@nestjs/schematics`) | **v22.22.3+**, **v24.15+**, or **v26+** |
blocks.zh:
| 你在做什么 | 最低 Node.js |
| --- | --- |
| 运行一个 Nest12 应用 | **v20.19+**，或 22.x 行上的**v22.12+** |
| `nest new`,`nest generate`,`nest upgrade`(`@nestjs/schematics`) | **v22.22.3+**、**v24.15+**或**v26+** |

blocks.md: `@nestjs/core` itself still declares `>= 20`, but the v12 packages are ESM-only, and consuming them from a CommonJS application relies on `require(esm)`, which is unflagged only from Node.js 20.19 and 22.12 onwards. The 21.x line never received it and is not supported. `nest upgrade` enforces exactly this and refuses to run on an older release.
blocks.text: @nestjs/core itself still declares >= 20, but the v12 packages are ESM-only, and consuming them from a CommonJS application relies on require(esm), which is unflagged only from Node.js 20.19 and 22.12 onwards. The 21.x line never received it and is not supported. nest upgrade enforces exactly this and refuses to run on an older release.
blocks.zh: `@nestjs/core` 它自己仍然宣称 `>= 20`，但是 v12 包是 ESM-仅，并且从 CommonJS 应用程序使用它们依赖于 `require(esm)`，仅从 Node.js20.19 和 22.12 起。21.x 行从未收到，不受支持。`nest upgrade` 强制执行这一点，并拒绝在旧版本上运行。

blocks.md: AWS Lambda disables `require(esm)` by default on its Node.js 20, 22, and 24 runtimes, even when the corresponding upstream Node.js release enables it. To run a CommonJS Nest 12 application on these Lambda runtimes, enable it through the function's `NODE_OPTIONS` environment variable:
blocks.text: AWS Lambda disables require(esm) by default on its Node.js 20, 22, and 24 runtimes, even when the corresponding upstream Node.js release enables it. To run a CommonJS Nest 12 application on these Lambda runtimes, enable it through the function's NODE_OPTIONS environment variable:
blocks.zh: AWSLambda 残疾人 `require(esm)` 默认情况下 Node.js20、22 和 24 个运行时，即使对应的上游 Node.js 释放启用它。运行 CommonJSNest12 这些 Lambda 运行时上的应用程序，通过函数的 `NODE_OPTIONS` 环境变量：

blocks.code: NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-require-module

blocks.md: If `NODE_OPTIONS` already contains other flags, append this flag to the existing value. See the [AWS Lambda documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-nodejs.html#nodejs-experimental) for details and for the support limitations of experimental features.
blocks.text: If NODE_OPTIONS already contains other flags, append this flag to the existing value. See the AWS Lambda documentation for details and for the support limitations of experimental features.
blocks.zh: 如果 `NODE_OPTIONS` 已包含其他标志，请将此标志附加到现有值。参见 [AWS Lambda documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-nodejs.html#nodejs-experimental) 详细信息和实验功能的支持限制。

blocks.md: The CLI's schematics have a higher floor of their own: `@nestjs/schematics` requires **Node.js v22.22.3+, v24.15+, or v26+**, inherited from the Angular devkit it builds on. Scaffolding and upgrading therefore need a newer runtime than running the framework does. The 23.x and 25.x lines, as well as earlier 22.x and 24.x releases, are excluded.
