Scaffolding and upgrading therefore need a newer runtime than running the framework does. The 23.x and 25.x lines, as well as earlier 22.x and 24.x releases, are excluded.
blocks.zh: 这个 CLI 的原理图有自己的较高楼层：`@nestjs/schematics` 要求**Node.jsv22.22.3+、v24.15+或 v26+**，继承自 Angular 它所建立的开发工具包。因此，脚手架和升级需要比运行框架更新的运行时。23.x 和 25.x 系列以及早期的 22.x 和 24.x 版本被排除在外。

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md: The simplest way to satisfy every requirement is to run the latest active LTS release. Pick the bare minimum only if you have a specific reason to stay there. If you do, keep in mind that Node.js 20.19 is enough to run your application, but not to use the CLI's generators.
blocks.text: The simplest way to satisfy every requirement is to run the latest active LTS release. Pick the bare minimum only if you have a specific reason to stay there. If you do, keep in mind that Node.js 20.19 is enough to run your application, but not to use the CLI's generators.
blocks.zh: 满足每个要求的最简单方法是运行最新的活动 LTS 释放。只有当你有特定的理由留在那里时，才选择最低限度。如果你这样做，请记住 Node.js20.19 足以运行您的应用程序，但不能使用 CLI 的生成器。

blocks.md: ESM packages
blocks.text: ESM packages
blocks.zh: ESM 包装

blocks.md: All core Nest packages now ship as ESM. For most existing applications, this is much less disruptive than it would have been a few years ago, because modern Node.js releases support `require(esm)`.
blocks.text: All core Nest packages now ship as ESM. For most existing applications, this is much less disruptive than it would have been a few years ago, because modern Node.js releases support require(esm).
blocks.zh: 所有核心 Nest 包现在都作为 ESM 发货。对于大多数现有的应用程序来说，这比几年前的破坏性要小得多，因为现代的 Node.js 版本支持 `require(esm)`。

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md: Migrating **your own** application to ESM is entirely optional and **not** part of upgrading to v12. Because Nest's ESM packages can be consumed from CommonJS through `require(esm)`, a CommonJS application can upgrade to v12 and stay CommonJS for as long as you like; `nest upgrade` deliberately leaves your module format alone. Whether you switch is a matter of preference. If you decide to, the last two sections of this guide, [Switching your project to ESM](#switching-your-project-to-esm) and [Moving your own code to ESM](#moving-your-own-code-to-esm), walk you through it.
blocks.text: Migrating your own application to ESM is entirely optional and not part of upgrading to v12. Because Nest's ESM packages can be consumed from CommonJS through require(esm), a CommonJS application can upgrade to v12 and stay CommonJS for as long as you like; nest upgrade deliberately leaves your module format alone. Whether you switch is a matter of preference. If you decide to, the last two sections of this guide, Switching your project to ESM and Moving your own code to ESM, walk you through it.
blocks.zh: 将**您自己的**应用程序迁移到 ESM 完全是可选的，**不是**升级到 v12 的一部分。因为 Nest 的 ESM 可以通过以下方式从 CommonJS 消费包 `require(esm)`CommonJS 应用程序可以升级到 v12，并在 CommonJS 上停留多长时间；`nest upgrade` 故意不管你的模块格式。是否转换是个人喜好问题。如果您决定，本指南的最后两节，[Switching your project to ESM](#switching-your-project-to-esm) 和 [Moving your own code to ESM](#moving-your-own-code-to-esm)，带你穿过它。

blocks.md: In practice, this means:
blocks.text: In practice, this means:
blocks.zh: 实际上，这意味着：

blocks.md:
- Many existing CommonJS applications continue to work without a full rewrite
- Review custom bootstrapping scripts, build tooling, and test runners if they make assumptions about CommonJS-only packages
- If you maintain a custom bundler or runtime configuration, make sure it matches the module format your project actually uses
blocks.text: Many existing CommonJS applications continue to work without a full rewrite Review custom bootstrapping scripts, build tooling, and test runners if they make assumptions about CommonJS-only packages If you maintain a custom bundler or runtime configuration, make sure it matches the module format your project actually uses
blocks.zh:
- 许多现有的 CommonJS 应用程序无需完全重写即可继续工作
- 如果自定义引导脚本、构建工具和测试运行程序对仅适用于 CommonJS 的包做出了假设，请审查它们
- 如果维护自定义捆绑程序或运行时配置，请确保它与项目实际使用的模块格式相匹配

blocks.md: For new projects, the CLI now lets you choose between a CommonJS and an ESM project layout.
blocks.text: For new projects, the CLI now lets you choose between a CommonJS and an ESM project layout.
blocks.zh: 对于新项目，CLI 现在允许您在 CommonJS 和 ESM 项目布局。

blocks.md: New project defaults
blocks.text: New project defaults
blocks.zh: 新项目默认值

blocks.md: `nest new` now prompts you to choose whether to generate a CommonJS or an ESM project.
blocks.text: nest new now prompts you to choose whether to generate a CommonJS or an ESM project.
blocks.zh: `nest new` 现在提示您选择是生成 CommonJS 还是生成 ESM 项目。

blocks.md:
- ESM projects use Vitest by default (CommonJS projects use Jest)
- All generated projects use oxlint by default
blocks.text: ESM projects use Vitest by default (CommonJS projects use Jest) All generated projects use oxlint by default
blocks.zh:
- ESM 项目默认使用 Vitest（CommonJS 项目使用 Jest）
- 默认情况下，所有生成的项目都使用 oxlint

blocks.md: This only changes what the CLI scaffolds for you. Existing projects can keep their current tooling and migrate on their own schedule.
blocks.text: This only changes what the CLI scaffolds for you. Existing projects can keep their current tooling and migrate on their own schedule.
blocks.zh: 这只会改变 CLI 给你的脚手架。现有项目可以保留当前的工具，并按照自己的计划进行迁移。

blocks.md: Testing stack
blocks.text: Testing stack
blocks.zh: 测试堆栈

blocks.md: Nest's testing utilities remain the same. The main change is the default stack used by generated ESM projects and by the framework's own repositories and samples: Vitest is now the primary default for ESM workflows.
blocks.text: Nest's testing utilities remain the same. The main change is the default stack used by generated ESM projects and by the framework's own repositories and samples: Vitest is now the primary default for ESM workflows.
blocks.zh: Nest 的测试实用程序保持不变。主要更改是生成使用的默认堆栈 ESM 项目以及框架自己的存储库和示例：Vitest 现在是 ESM 工作流程。

blocks.md: If your application already uses a different test runner, you don't need to migrate immediately. `@nestjs/testing` remains test-runner agnostic.
blocks.text: If your application already uses a different test runner, you don't need to migrate immediately. @nestjs/testing remains test-runner agnostic.
blocks.zh: 如果您的应用程序已经使用了不同的测试运行程序，则不需要立即迁移。`@nestjs/testing` 仍然是测试运行者不可知的。

blocks.title: Warning
blocks.md: If you stay on Jest, note that it can load the ESM-only v12 packages only on Node.js v24.9 or later (older versions fail with `ERR_REQUIRE_ASYNC_MODULE`). Run your test suite on Node.js v24.9+, or consider migrating to Vitest. `nest upgrade` bumps Jest to v30 and warns about this.
blocks.text: If you stay on Jest, note that it can load the ESM-only v12 packages only on Node.js v24.9 or later (older versions fail with ERR_REQUIRE_ASYNC_MODULE). Run your test suite on Node.js v24.9+, or consider migrating to Vitest. nest upgrade bumps Jest to v30 and warns about this.
blocks.zh: 如果您停留在 Jest 上，请注意，它只能在 Node.jsv24.9 或更高版本上加载 ESM-仅 v12 软件包（旧版本在 `ERR_REQUIRE_ASYNC_MODULE` 下失败）。在 Node.jsv24.9+上运行您的测试套件，或者考虑迁移到 Vitest。`nest upgrade` 将 Jest 推到 v30，并就此发出警告。

blocks.md: Nest adds a new `schema` option to route parameter decorators such as `@Body()`, `@Query()`, `@Param()`, and `@RawBody()`. The schema metadata is designed for [Standard Schema](https://standardschema.dev/)-compatible libraries such as Zod, Valibot, and ArkType.
blocks.text: Nest adds a new schema option to route parameter decorators such as @Body(), @Query(), @Param(), and @RawBody(). The schema metadata is designed for Standard Schema-compatible libraries such as Zod, Valibot, and ArkType.
blocks.zh: Nest 添加了一个新的 `schema` 选项来路由参数装饰器，例如 `@Body()`、`@Query()`、`@Param()` 和 `@RawBody()`。模式元数据是为 [Standard Schema](https://standardschema.dev/) 兼容的库设计的，如 Zod、Valibot 和 ArkType。

blocks.md: For example:
blocks.text: For example:

blocks.code: app.useGlobalPipes(new StandardSchemaValidationPipe());

blocks.md: The existing decorator-based approach remains fully supported, and there are no plans to remove it. The `schema` option is an additional choice for teams that prefer schema-first libraries such as Zod.
blocks.text: The existing decorator-based approach remains fully supported, and there are no plans to remove it. The schema option is an additional choice for teams that prefer schema-first libraries such as Zod.

blocks.text: The microservices package now targets NATS v3, which includes a breaking dependency change. If you use the NATS transport, replace the old nats package with @nats-io/transport-node:
blocks.zh: 微服务包现在的目标是 NATS v3，其中包括一个破坏性的依赖项更改。如果您使用 NATS 运输，更换旧的 `nats` 包装 `@nats-io/transport-node`:

blocks.code:
$ npm uninstall nats
$ npm install @nats-io/transport-node

blocks.zh: 如果您的应用程序直接导入 NATS 助手，请同时安装 `@nats-io/nats-core` 并更新这些导入。NATSv3 还放弃了 `StringCodec` 和 `JSONCodec` 助手。例如，`headers()` 助手现在来自 `@nats-io/nats-core`：

blocks.md: Also review any custom serializers or deserializers. Nest now serializes NATS packets as JSON strings, and custom NATS deserializers receive the full NATS message object instead of a raw `Uint8Array`. In practice, custom deserializers should read the payload with `msg.json()` instead of decoding bytes manually.
blocks.text: Also review any custom serializers or deserializers. Nest now serializes NATS packets as JSON strings, and custom NATS deserializers receive the full NATS message object instead of a raw Uint8Array. In practice, custom deserializers should read the payload with msg.json() instead of decoding bytes manually.
blocks.zh: 还要查看任何自定义序列化程序或反序列化程序。Nest 现在将 NATS 数据包序列化为 JSON 字符串，自定义 NATS 反序列化程序接收完整的 NATS 消息对象，而不是原始的 `Uint8Array`。实际上，自定义反序列化程序应该使用 `msg.json()` 读取有效载荷，而不是手动解码字节。

blocks.md: Lifecycle hook ordering
blocks.text: Lifecycle hook ordering
blocks.zh: 生命周期挂钩排序

blocks.md: Lifecycle hooks are now called by component hierarchy level. This can change the execution order of hooks such as `onModuleInit`, `onApplicationBootstrap`, and the shutdown hooks when multiple providers or modules depend on one another.
blocks.text: Lifecycle hooks are now called by component hierarchy level. This can change the execution order of hooks such as onModuleInit, onApplicationBootstrap, and the shutdown hooks when multiple providers or modules depend on one another.
blocks.zh: 生命周期挂钩现在由组件层次结构级别调用。这可以更改钩子的执行顺序，例如 `onModuleInit`,`onApplicationBootstrap` 以及当多个提供程序或模块相互依赖时关闭挂钩。

blocks.md: If your application relies on a specific hook order between related providers, review that flow during the upgrade and update any assumptions in initialization logic, teardown logic, or tests.
blocks.text: If your application relies on a specific hook order between related providers, review that flow during the upgrade and update any assumptions in initialization logic, teardown logic, or tests.
blocks.zh: 如果您的应用程序依赖于相关提供者之间的特定钩子顺序，请在升级期间查看该流程，并更新初始化逻辑、拆卸逻辑或测试中的任何假设。

blocks.md: `@Optional()` is no longer inherited by a redeclared constructor
blocks.text: @Optional() is no longer inherited by a redeclared constructor
blocks.zh: `@Optional()` 不再由重新声明的构造函数继承

blocks.md: Nest now reads the optional markers of constructor parameters from the class that declares the constructor. A subclass that declares its own constructor no longer inherits the markers of its parent's constructor, so Nest throws `UnknownDependenciesException` where v11 resolved such a parameter as `undefined`.
blocks.text: Nest now reads the optional markers of constructor parameters from the class that declares the constructor. A subclass that declares its own constructor no longer inherits the markers of its parent's constructor, so Nest throws UnknownDependenciesException where v11 resolved such a parameter as undefined.
blocks.zh: Nest 现在从声明构造函数的类中读取构造函数参数的可选标记。声明自己构造函数的子类不再继承其父构造函数的标记，因此 Nest 投掷 `UnknownDependenciesException` 其中 v11 解析了这样的参数 `undefined`.

blocks.md: This is deliberate: a dependency that was genuinely missing used to resolve to `undefined` silently. Declare the marker again in the subclass's constructor:
blocks.text: This is deliberate: a dependency that was genuinely missing used to resolve to undefined silently. Declare the marker again in the subclass's constructor:
blocks.zh: 这是故意的：一个真正缺失的依赖项用于解决 `undefined` 默默地。在子类的构造函数中再次声明标记：

blocks.md: Starting with NestJS v12.1, a subclass without its own constructor keeps the optional markers of its parent's constructor, as in v11. Versions 12.0.x dropped them in this case too.
blocks.text: Starting with NestJS v12.1, a subclass without its own constructor keeps the optional markers of its parent's constructor, as in v11. Versions 12.0.x dropped them in this case too.
blocks.zh: 从 NestJSv12.1，没有自己构造函数的子类保留其父构造函数的可选标记，就像 v11 一样。12.0.x 版本在这种情况下也删除了它们。

blocks.md: class-validator and class-transformer
blocks.text: class-validator and class-transformer
blocks.zh: 类验证器和类转换器

blocks.md: The existing decorator-based workflow still works in v12. `ValidationPipe` and `ClassSerializerInterceptor` remain supported and are still a good fit for class-based DTO projects.
blocks.text: The existing decorator-based workflow still works in v12. ValidationPipe and ClassSerializerInterceptor remain supported and are still a good fit for class-based DTO projects.
blocks.zh: 现有的基于装饰器的工作流程在 v12 中仍然有效。`ValidationPipe` 和 `ClassSerializerInterceptor` 仍然受到支持，并且仍然非常适合基于类的 DTO 项目。

blocks.md: Version 12 broadens the built-in options rather than replacing the existing ones:
blocks.text: Version 12 broadens the built-in options rather than replacing the existing ones:
blocks.zh: 版本 12 扩展了内置选项，而不是替换现有选项：

blocks.md:
- Use `ValidationPipe` when your DTOs are class-based and rely on decorators
- Use `StandardSchemaValidationPipe` when your validation library already exposes a Standard Schema-compatible schema
- Use `ClassSerializerInterceptor` when your response shaping is based on `class-transformer`
- Use `StandardSchemaSerializerInterceptor` when your response shape should be derived from a schema
blocks.text: Use ValidationPipe when your DTOs are class-based and rely on decorators Use StandardSchemaValidationPipe when your validation library already exposes a Standard Schema-compatible schema Use ClassSerializerInterceptor when your response shaping is based on class-transformer Use StandardSchemaSerializerInterceptor when your response shape should be derived from a schema
blocks.zh:
- 使用 `ValidationPipe` 当您的 DTO 基于类并依赖于装饰器时

blocks.md: Native observability support
blocks.text: Native observability support
blocks.zh: 原生可观测性支持

blocks.md: Version 12 adds first-class observability support through the official [`@nestjs/observe`](/observability/overview) SDK. Instead of attaching a generic Node.js APM agent to the HTTP server, the SDK plugs into Nest's own request lifecycle through the `instrument` application option. As a result, requests, jobs, errors, and traces are reported in terms of your controllers, providers, resolvers, and queue consumers.
blocks.text: Version 12 adds first-class observability support through the official @nestjs/observe SDK. Instead of attaching a generic Node.js APM agent to the HTTP server, the SDK plugs into Nest's own request lifecycle through the instrument application option. As a result, requests, jobs, errors, and traces are reported in terms of your controllers, providers, resolvers, and queue consumers.
blocks.zh: 版本 12 通过官方 [`@nestjs/observe`](/observability/overview)SDK 增加了一流的可观测性支持。SDK 不是将通用 Node.jsAPM 代理附加到 HTTP 服务器，而是通过 `instrument` 应用程序选项插入到 Nest 自己的请求生命周期中。因此，会根据控制器、提供程序、解析器和队列使用者报告请求、作业、错误和跟踪。

blocks.md: There is nothing to migrate here: it is a new, opt-in capability. See the [Observability chapter](/observability/overview) for what auto-instrumentation covers, and the [SDK reference](/observability/sdk) for configuration options.

blocks.md: Other notable release changes
blocks.text: Other notable release changes
blocks.zh: 其他值得注意的版本变化

blocks.md: Depending on which Nest packages you use, you may also want to review the following changes:
blocks.text: Depending on which Nest packages you use, you may also want to review the following changes:
blocks.zh: 取决于哪一个 Nest 您使用的软件包，您可能还需要查看以下更改：

blocks.md:
- **Pipe transform signatures** have been refined for stronger type safety, and `ArgumentMetadata` now takes a generic parameter. Custom pipes with hand-written signatures may need their types adjusted.
- **`ValidationPipe` error format**: the new `errorFormat` option (`'list'` or `'grouped'`) controls the shape of validation error responses.
- **gRPC exception filter**: `GrpcExceptionFilter`, plus a family of status-specific exceptions, maps errors to the proper gRPC status codes instead of `UNKNOWN`. See the [gRPC chapter](/microservices/grpc#exception-handling).
- **Regex Kafka patterns**: `@MessagePattern()` and `@EventPattern()` now accept a `RegExp` on the Kafka transport. See the [Kafka chapter](/microservices/kafka#regular-expression-patterns).
- **Request-scoped WebSocket gateways**: gateways now support request-scoped providers, with the socket injectable through the `REQUEST` token. See the [Gateways chapter](/websockets/gateways#request-scoped-gateways).
- **WebSocket disconnect reason**: `handleDisconnect` can now receive the reason for the disconnection.
- **Microservices pre-request hook**: a new hook runs before a message handler is invoked.
- **Express graceful shutdown**: the Express adapter now drains in-flight requests on shutdown.
- **HTTP adapter error mapping** has been reworked across the core, Express, and Fastify adapters.
blocks.text: Pipe transform signatures have been refined for stronger type safety, and ArgumentMetadata now takes a generic parameter. Custom pipes with hand-written signatures may need their types adjusted. ValidationPipe error format: the new errorFormat option ('list' or 'grouped') controls the shape of validation error responses. gRPC exception filter: GrpcExceptionFilter, plus a family of status-specific exceptions, maps errors to the proper gRPC status codes instead of UNKNOWN. See the gRPC chapter. Regex Kafka patterns: @MessagePattern() and @EventPattern() now accept a RegExp on the Kafka transport. See the Kafka chapter. Request-scoped WebSocket gateways: gateways now support request-scoped providers, with the socket injectable through the REQUEST token. See the Gateways chapter. WebSocket disconnect reason: handleDisconnect can now receive the reason for the disconnection. Microservices pre-request hook: a new hook runs before a message handler is invoked. Express graceful shutdown: the Express adapter now drains in-flight requests on shutdown. HTTP adapter error mapping has been reworked across the core, Express, and Fastify adapters.
blocks.zh:
- **管道改造签名**经过改进，以增强类型安全性，并且 `ArgumentMetadata` 现在取一个通用参数。带有手写签名的自定义管道可能需要调整其类型。
- **`ValidationPipe` 错误格式**：新 `errorFormat` 选项（`'list'` 或者 `'grouped'`) 控制验证错误响应的形状。
- **gRPC 异常筛选器**：`GrpcExceptionFilter` 加上一系列特定于状态的异常，将错误映射到正确的 gRPC 状态代码，而不是 `UNKNOWN`。参见 [gRPC 篇章](/microservices/grpc#exception-handling)。
- **正则表达式 Kafka 模式**：`@MessagePattern()` 和 `@EventPattern()` 现在接受 Kafka 传输上的 `RegExp`。参见 [Kafka chapter](/microservices/kafka#regular-expression-patterns)。
- **请求范围的 WebSocket 网关**：网关现在支持请求范围的提供程序，套接字可通过 `REQUEST` 令牌注入。参见 [Gateways chapter](/websockets/gateways#request-scoped-gateways)。
- **WebSocket 断开原因**：`handleDisconnect` 现在可以接收断开连接的原因。
- **微服务预请求钩子**：在调用消息处理程序之前运行新钩子。
- **Express 优雅关闭**：Express 适配器现在在关机时耗尽飞行中的请求。
- **HTTP 适配器错误映射**已在整个内核中重新处理，Express，和 Fastify 适配器。

blocks.title: Warning
blocks.md: `"module": "nodenext"` derives the module format of each file from the nearest `package.json`. Adding `"type": "module"` therefore changes how **every** `.ts` file in the project is emitted, and TypeScript starts reporting the missing import extensions described below. Expect to fix them in the same pass rather than incrementally.
blocks.text: "module": "nodenext" derives the module format of each file from the nearest package.json. Adding "type": "module" therefore changes how every .ts file in the project is emitted, and TypeScript starts reporting the missing import extensions described below. Expect to fix them in the same pass rather than incrementally.
blocks.zh: `"module": "nodenext"` 从最近的 `package.json` 导出每个文件的模块格式。因此，添加 `"type": "module"` 会更改项目中**每个**`.ts` 文件的发送方式，并且 TypeScript 开始报告下述丢失的导入扩展名。期望在同一个过程中修复它们，而不是逐步修复。

blocks.md: With the configuration in place, the two things in your own code that most often need attention are relative imports and CommonJS-only globals.
blocks.text: With the configuration in place, the two things in your own code that most often need attention are relative imports and CommonJS-only globals.
blocks.zh: 配置到位后，您自己的代码中最需要注意的两件事是相对导入和仅 CommonJS 的全局。

blocks.md: Relative imports must carry a file extension:
blocks.text: Relative imports must carry a file extension:
blocks.zh: 相对导入必须带有文件扩展名：

blocks.md: The extension is `.js` even though the source file is `.ts`, because the specifier refers to the emitted file.
blocks.text: The extension is .js even though the source file is .ts, because the specifier refers to the emitted file.
blocks.zh: 扩展是 `.js` 即使源文件是 `.ts`，因为说明符引用发出的文件。

blocks.md: `__dirname` and `__filename` do not exist in ESM. Use `import.meta.dirname` instead (or `import.meta.url` with `fileURLToPath` on older Node.js versions):
blocks.text: dirname and filename do not exist in ESM. Use import.meta.dirname instead (or import.meta.url with fileURLToPath on older Node.js versions):
blocks.zh: `__dirname` 和 `__filename` 在 ESM 中不存在。改用 `import.meta.dirname`（或在旧版本 Node.js 上使用 `import.meta.url` 和 `fileURLToPath`）：

blocks.md: Similarly, `require()` is unavailable. If you need it for interop, create it explicitly with `createRequire(import.meta.url)` from `node:module`.
blocks.text: Similarly, require() is unavailable. If you need it for interop, create it explicitly with createRequire(import.meta.url) from node:module.
blocks.zh: 同样，`require()` 也不可用。如果您需要它进行互操作，请使用 `createRequire(import.meta.url)` 从 `node:module` 显式创建它。

blocks.title: Hint
blocks.md: Many code samples throughout these docs use the ESM conventions above. If your project is still CommonJS, drop the `.js` extensions, keep `__dirname`, and call `bootstrap()` without `await`.
blocks.text: Many code samples throughout these docs use the ESM conventions above. If your project is still CommonJS, drop the .js extensions, keep __dirname, and call bootstrap() without await.
blocks.zh: 这些文档中的许多代码示例使用了上面的 ESM 约定。如果您的项目仍然是 CommonJS，请删除 `.js` 扩展，保留 `__dirname`，并调用 `bootstrap()` 而不使用 `await`。
